jobs.title: VP, Engagement Strategy
jobs.description:
About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The VP, Engagement Strategy turns brand strategy into connected omnichannel engagement.
This senior leader defines how audience insight, behavioral science, content, media, CRM, field engagement, technology, and measurement work together across the customer journey. The VP leads clients and integrated teams from insight through activation and optimization, while helping grow BGBx's Engagement Strategy capability.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Omnichannel Strategy

Lead audience-centered, behaviorally informed omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and other stakeholder audiences
Translate brand and business strategy into connected journeys, engagement architectures, channel roles, sequencing, triggers, and activation roadmaps
Define how content, media, CRM, field, social, experiential, and digital interactions work together to move audiences toward desired behaviors
Make clear strategic choices and tradeoffs that focus investment on the moments and interactions most likely to create impact

Audience, Content & Experience

Turn research, segmentation, behavioral data, cultural context, and market dynamics into actionable audience understanding
Identify the beliefs, motivations, barriers, decision pathways, and moments of receptivity that engagement must address
Shape content and experience strategy so each interaction has a clear role, purpose, call to action, and connection to what happens next
Maintain the strategic throughline as work moves from strategy into creative development, implementation, and optimization

Measurement & Optimization

Define engagement objectives, KPI frameworks, signal plans, and learning agendas
Design closed-loop approaches that use customer response and performance data to improve content, channels, sequencing, and future engagement
Turn performance findings into clear strategic implications and optimization recommendations

Client, Growth & Team Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior clients and lead executive presentations, workshops, and high-stakes strategic conversations
Lead engagement and omnichannel strategy for pitches, organic growth opportunities, and capability development
Manage, mentor, and develop strategists while raising the quality, consistency, and visibility of BGBx's Engagement Strategy offering

Qualifications

10+ years of relevant experience across engagement strategy, omnichannel strategy, experience planning, digital strategy, CRM strategy, integrated strategy, or related disciplines
Significant pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences experience, preferably in an agency, communications, or consulting environment
Proven ability to lead complex engagement strategy from audience insight and problem definition through activation, measurement, and optimization
Strong understanding of HCP and patient journeys and the strategic roles of media, CRM, digital, social, field engagement, data, analytics, experience design, and marketing technology
Fluency in how personalization, marketing automation, modular content, next-best action, and decisioning can support omnichannel engagement
Strong client leadership, facilitation, executive communication, and strategic storytelling skills
Experience leading pitches, growing client relationships, and managing or developing strategists
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, consent, and compliance considerations

Preferred Experience

Experience across both HCP and patient engagement and across launch, growth, or mature brand challenges
Experience translating global strategy into locally relevant engagement approaches
Practical experience with advanced segmentation, dynamic personalization, closed-loop marketing, or AI-enabled planning and optimization
Experience building or evolving an engagement, omnichannel, digital, or experience strategy capability

Interview Process

Candidates will be invited to discuss two anonymized examples of work they personally led, including one demonstrating end-to-end omnichannel strategy. We are most interested in problem framing, strategic choices, cross-functional leadership, measurement, and impact. Confidential client information and unpaid speculative work are not required.

Salary Range:
$200,000 - $240,000 CAD

The salary range provided represents what a potential hire may expect to earn in this role at BGBx. Actual salary decisions will be influenced by several factors that we use to determine overall fit, including experience (both direct and indirect), education, training, demonstrated qualifications, and organizational need. Salary is only one component of the total rewards package offered at BGBx.

What We Offer

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package for full-time employees typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. Additional benefits may be available based on your location. Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.

BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.

As Director of Technical Program Management, you will lead a senior team responsible for delivering some of the organization's most critical engineering and infrastructure initiatives. You will shape the strategy and execution of complex, cross-functional programmes spanning data infrastructure, developer platforms, AI enablement, privacy, and reliability. Working closely with executive and engineering leaders, you will influence investment priorities, strengthen operational performance, and ensure teams deliver measurable business outcomes. Combining technical expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership, you will help transform how engineering foundations operate at scale. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity in a flexible, remote-first technology environment where collaboration, innovation, and accountability are central to success.

Lead, mentor, and develop a senior team of Technical Program Managers, establishing a clear vision for a high-performing organization and supporting individual growth and career development.
Define and drive the strategic direction of Engineering Foundations initiatives, including data product strategy, data quality and governance, financial data transformation, AI enablement, privacy, and reliability.
Establish operational improvements across engineering foundations, setting clear reliability expectations, improving real-time visibility into key performance metrics, and enabling proactive investment decisions.
Partner with VPs, Senior Directors, and Directors of Engineering, as well as leaders across Finance, Legal, Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance, to coordinate strategic planning and execution of critical programmes.

Drive alignment across teams, resolve competing priorities, reduce ambiguity, and proactively manage risks throughout complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Support international expansion by ensuring that privacy requirements, regulatory obligations, and operational controls are appropriately addressed.
Build a culture of curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and measurable impact across the Technical Program Management team.
Strengthen programme management practices and operating processes to improve execution consistency, organizational visibility, and delivery outcomes.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
At least 12 years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, technical product management, or a closely related field.
Proven experience as both a hands-on individual contributor and a people leader, with a track record of leading, mentoring, and growing teams of Technical Program Managers or engineers.
Significant experience working in large-scale infrastructure environments, such as data infrastructure, developer infrastructure, platform engineering, reliability, or privacy.
Demonstrated ability to influence technical and business strategy and deliver measurable organizational outcomes.
Strong executive presence and experience influencing senior engineering leaders, resolving conflicts, building consensus, and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Excellent strategic planning and programme management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple high-impact initiatives across technical and business functions.
Strong technical understanding and product judgment, enabling effective prioritization, data-driven decision-making, and evaluation of short- and long-term investments.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present complex topics and recommendations to executive audiences.

Preferred: Familiarity with executive-level operational reviews and engineering planning processes.

will own the strategy and execution of marketing programs that drive customer expansion (cross-sell, upsell, and account growth), generate partner-sourced pipeline, and support retention. Programs span SOCi’s customers (multi-location brands, franchise organizations, and property businesses) and its partners (agencies, technology providers, and resellers).

Working closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Product Marketing, this leader will develop targeted, data-driven campaigns that engage customer buying groups, create demand for additional SOCi solutions, and reinforce customer value. This leader will align with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success leaders on where to focus limited marketing resources to hit expansion and partner pipeline targets.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and revenue accountability for expansion and partner-sourced pipeline goals, with a strong emphasis on using AI, automation, and data to drive performance and operational efficiency. Customer Growth, Expansion & Retention

Develop and execute customer marketing strategies that generate expansion pipeline, accelerate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and support customer retention.
Partner with Account Management and Customer Success to align marketing programs with revenue targets, renewal priorities, and strategic account opportunities.
Work with Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success leaders to prioritize programs and allocate limited marketing resources against expansion and partner pipeline targets.
Build targeted, account-based campaigns that engage customer buying groups across multi-location brands, franchise organizations, and property businesses, identify new stakeholders, and create demand for additional SOCi solutions.
Lead customer lifecycle marketing, including targeted campaigns, nurture programs, webinars, events, and customer communications.
Use customer segmentation, account intelligence, and behavioral signals to deliver personalized marketing experiences and improve engagement.
Partner with Product Marketing to turn product launches and new-module releases into cross-sell and upsell campaigns, and help support customer advocacy programs (references, case studies, reviews) that provide proof points for expansion and partner campaigns.

Partner Marketing

At the State of Minnesota, employees play a critical role in developing policies, providing essential services, and working to improve the well-being and quality of life for all Minnesotans. The State of Minnesota is committed to equity and inclusion, and invests in employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities.

Minnesota Management and Budget (MMB) is seeking an Enterprise Business Systems Director to provide strategic leadership for the statewide enterprise resource planning (ERP) ecosystem that supports key government functions such as finance, budgeting, human resources, procurement, learning, and reporting. Serving as a critical bridge between business operations and technology strategy, the Enterprise Business Systems Director works with executive leaders, agency partners, governance committees, and technology teams to ensure systems deliver meaningful value. The position will shape the long-term direction of enterprise technology investments, promote continuous improvement modernization, and help ensure that statewide systems remain effective, sustainable, and responsive to the evolving needs of agencies, employees, and Minnesotans.

Job Duties For This Position Include

Establishing and leading the strategic vision, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Minnesota’s enterprise business systems portfolio, including the statewide ERP ecosystem
Directing enterprise portfolio management efforts to align technology investments, modernization initiatives, and product strategies with statewide business priorities and desired outcomes
Facilitating executive- and enterprise-level governance processes that support informed decision-making, prioritization, risk management, and cross-agency collaboration
Leading organizational change, business modernization, and adoption strategies to maximize the value, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of statewide business systems
Developing and maintaining strategic partnerships with agency leaders, governance committees, technology partners, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure successful delivery and evolution of enterprise solutions
Managing a team of product specialists, including supervisory functions such as hiring, performance management, coaching, and directing and reviewing work

Telework options for this position are dependent on where the employee lives. With approval, employees that live within 50 miles from the primary work location may telework up to 50%. Employees that live 50 miles or more from the primary location and live in Minnesota
may telework more than 50% with approval.

All MMB Leaders are expected to demonstrate and develop the six competency themes from the Enterprise-Wide Leader Competency Model:

Leading Self
Leading Others
Leading the Organization
Leading Outside the Organization
Leading with DEAI
Getting Work Done

Minimum Qualifications

To facilitate proper years of service crediting, please ensure that your resume indicates the beginning and ending month and year for each job held. Resume tips are available here .

Applicants Must Demonstrate The Following In Their Application Materials

At least five (5) years of experience* in roles with primary responsibility for developing and implementing strategic plans, governance frameworks, and organizational priorities that align technology investments with business objectives
Knowledge of and familiarity with foundational product management principles, such as customer-centricity, strategic alignment, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement
Leadership experience which includes supervising staff, leading managers, directing cross-functional teams, or providing executive-level oversight of enterprise initiatives
A bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, information systems, management information systems (MIS), computer science, information technology, organizational leadership, operations management, finance, accounting, or human resources may substitute for one (1) year of experience. A master’s degree in a similar field may substitute for eighteen months of experience. A doctorate degree in a similar field may substitute for two (2) years of experience.

Qualifications

In addition to the qualifications above, the following qualifications are also required and will be further assessed if invited to interview:

Demonstrated ability to facilitate product lifecycle management including strategy, planning, implementation, adoption, optimization, and modernization
Communication and writing skills sufficient to advise executives and convey complex information to a variety of audiences in varying contexts
Analytical and problem-solving skills sufficient to identify organizational challenges, evaluate options using sound judgement, and develop solutions that support effective operations
Demonstrated respect for diversity and a commitment to fostering an inclusive and collaborative work environment

Preferred Qualifications

MMB values diverse perspectives and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not meet 100% of the preferred qualifications. Your unique skills and background might be just what we need!

Bachelor’s degree or higher in business administration, public administration, information systems, management information systems (MIS), computer science, information technology, organizational leadership, operations management, finance, accounting, or human resources
Experience in roles with primary responsibility for product management in the public sector (city, county, state, federal, or Tribal)
Experience with State of Minnesota finance, budgeting, human resources, learning, reporting, and/or procurement systems, such as SEMA4 and SWIFT
Experience establishing or leading governance committees, advisory boards, steering committees, or portfolio management processes
Relevant certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Prosci Change Management, SAFe, Lean Six Sigma, or portfolio management certifications.

Additional Requirements

It is the policy of Minnesota Management and Budget that a successful candidate must pass all required checks prior to employment which may consist of the below checks:

SEMA4 records check (applies to current and past state employees only)
Criminal history check
Reference check
Social Security and address verification
Education verification

A criminal history does not automatically disqualify candidates, and each case will be reviewed individually on a case-by-case basis and in alignment with fair and equitable hiring practices.

Minnesota Management & Budget does not participate in E-Verify. Minnesota Management & Budget will not sponsor applicant work visas, including F-1 STEM OPT extensions. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Select “Apply for Job” at the top of this page. If you have questions about applying for jobs, contact the Careers Help Desk at 651-259-3637 or email careers@state.mn.us. For additional information about the application process, go to http://www.mn.gov/careers.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Director - Directeur, marketing de croissance
jobs.description:
Love your job!

Are you looking for an exciting new opportunity?

DAVIDsTEA is a leading branded retailer and growing wholesaler of specialty loose leaf tea, offering a selection of signature blends, single-origin teas, and tea-related gifts and accessories through our e-commerce platform and 23 Canadian retail stores. Based in Montreal, we focus on innovative flavours, wellness-driven ingredients, and organic tea. We’re making tea fashionable and fun, and we pride ourselves on offering both the best possible service to our customers and a positive work environment for our employees!

About the role

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Director
to own site conversion, demand capture, and lifecycle marketing.

Sounds like you? Keep reading…

Responsibilities

Site and conversion:
Own site experience, PDP optimization and checkout flow end-to-end
Build and run a structured testing roadmap (A/B, multivariate) across landing pages, offers, and nuances to consistently improve conversion and LTV
Optimize conversion and ensure site search and tracking perform reliably

Demand capture:
Own the agency relationship and paid media budget with our performance marketing partner: brief, review and hold accountable against efficiency and growth targets
Ensure accurate media tracking and attribution across paid channels and our performance marketing partner
Manage branded search, and paid social with audience-targeted, CAC/ROAS-optimized spend
Own SEO and monitor and experiment with AEO, to optimize for both

Lifecycle and retention:
Establish and own email/SMS and lifecycle marketing strategy and design world-class retention and loyalty programs (Frequent Steepers) with clear success metrics; then implement and execute
Create an operational playbook for segment-specific channel mix, cadence, offer approach, and measurement
Mentor and manage a small team of marketing specialists/analysts

So are YOU our next Growth Marketing Director?

Requirements

7+ years in growth, performance, lifecycle or digital marketing, ideally in retail, ecommerce, or DTC
Proven track record managing significant paid digital media budgets and hitting acquisition/efficiency targets
Strong fluency across paid media, SEO/SEM, email/lifecycle marketing, and paid media platforms, plus a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or similar) for reporting
Comfortable with data: can build and interpret dashboards, run cohort/LTV analysis, and translate numbers into action
Experience running structured A/B and multivariate tests
Strong project management skills — able to juggle multiple campaigns and cross-functional stakeholders at once
Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
A bias toward action and iteration over perfection
Bonus: experience with marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart), performance-based affiliate/influencer programs, or loyalty programs
Location: Montreal or remote in Canada, with ability to travel

Sound good? Then join us in our mission of making the world smile— one cup at a time.

DAVIDsTEA is passionate about Diversity and Inclusion and committed to building an inclusive positive work culture that fosters diversity, inclusion, and accessibility.

Please let us know if you require accommodation during the recruitment process.

Aimez votre emploi!

Êtes-vous à la recherche d'une nouvelle opportunité excitante?

Nous sommes un détaillant chef de file et un grossiste en pleine croissance de thé en feuilles de spécialité offrant une sélection de mélanges signature, de thés d’origine unique et de cadeaux et accessoires liés au thé vendus par l’entremise de notre plateforme de commerce en ligne et de 23 boutiques au Canada. Établis à Montréal, nous privilégions des saveurs innovatrices, des ingrédients mieux-être et des thés biologiques. Nous rendons le thé tendance et amusant, et nous sommes fiers d’offrir à la fois le meilleur service possible à nos clients et un environnement de travail positif à nos employés!

Aperçu

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un Directeur, marketing de croissance
qui sera responsable de la conversion sur le site, de la captation de la demande et du marketing du cycle de vie client.

Cela vous ressemble? Continuez de lire…

Responsabilités

Site et conversion :
Assumer l’entière responsabilité de l’expérience sur le site, de l’optimisation des pages produits (PDP) et du processus de paiement
Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une feuille de route de tests structurée (A/B, multivariés) visant les pages d’atterrissage, les offres et les nuances afin d’améliorer de façon constante la conversion et la valeur à vie du client (LTV)
Optimiser la conversion et veiller au bon fonctionnement de la recherche sur le site et des outils de suivi

Captation de la demande :
Gérer la relation avec notre partenaire en marketing de performance et le budget médias payants qui y est associé : rédiger les mandats, évaluer les résultats et assurer l’atteinte des objectifs d’efficacité et de croissance
Assurer l’exactitude du suivi et de l’attribution médias sur l’ensemble des canaux payants et auprès de notre partenaire en marketing de performance
Gérer la recherche payante de marque et les médias sociaux payants grâce à des investissements ciblés par audience et optimisés selon le CAC et le ROAS
Prendre en charge le référencement naturel (SEO), ainsi que suivre l’évolution de l’optimisation pour les moteurs de réponse (AEO) et mener des expériences, afin d’optimiser les deux

Cycle de vie et fidélisation :
Établir et piloter la stratégie de marketing par courriel/SMS et du cycle de vie client, et concevoir des programmes de fidélisation de calibre mondial (Frequent Steepers) assortis d’indicateurs de réussite clairs; puis en assurer la mise en œuvre et l’exécution
Créer un guide opérationnel définissant, pour chaque segment, la combinaison de canaux, la cadence, l’approche des offres et la mesure du rendement
Encadrer et gérer une petite équipe de spécialistes et d’analystes en marketing

Alors, êtes-VOUS notre prochain Directeur, marketing de croissance?

Exigences

Plus de 7 ans d’expérience en marketing de croissance, de performance, du cycle de vie ou numérique, idéalement dans le commerce de détail, le commerce en ligne ou la vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC)
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion d’importants budgets de médias numériques payants et dans l’atteinte d’objectifs d’acquisition et d’efficacité
Excellente maîtrise des médias payants, du SEO/SEM, du marketing par courriel et du cycle de vie ainsi que des plateformes médias payantes, en plus d’un outil de BI (Looker, Tableau ou autre) pour la production de rapports
À l’aise avec les données : capacité à créer et à interpréter des tableaux de bord, à réaliser des analyses de cohortes et de LTV, et à transformer les chiffres en actions
Expérience dans la réalisation de tests A/B et multivariés structurés
Solides compétences en gestion de projets; capacité à mener de front plusieurs campagnes et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes de différents services
S’épanouit dans un environnement dynamique au rythme rapide
Privilégie l’action et l’itération plutôt que la perfection
Atout : expérience avec les places de marché (Amazon, Walmart), les programmes d’affiliation ou d’influence axés sur la performance, ou les programmes de fidélisation
Lieu : Montréal ou télétravail au Canada, avec possibilité de se déplacer

Ça vous plaît? Joignez-vous à nous pour poursuivre notre mission, qui vise à faire sourire le monde… une tasse à la fois.

DAVIDsTEA a à cœur la diversité et l’inclusion et s’engage à bâtir une culture de travail positive et inclusive qui favorise la diversité, l’inclusion et l’accessibilité.

As the Senior Director, Operations in Canadian Wealth Management Operations, you will help drive strategy in a large diverse group of departments that supports multiple business lines across RBC. Develop and execute short- and long-term strategies to ensure operational readiness for day-to-day deliverables, new regulations and system implementations.

jobs.title: AVP, Financial Risk Management
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 

 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

 Overview 
 The role supports the Financial Risk function within MUFG Canada Risk Management, with a focus on the production, analysis, governance and continuous enhancement of liquidity risk, market risk, credit risk and interest rate risk in the banking book reporting. Reporting to the Financial Risk Vice President, the incumbent is responsible for preparing and maintaining recurring risk reports, supporting ECL and portfolio credit risk analysis, monitoring risk appetite and limit metrics, maintaining EUC and procedure documentation, and assisting with committee materials for IRC, ECC, Liquidity Risk and Market Risk governance forums. The role requires excellent technical capability, including advanced data analysis, Excel/Power Query/VBA automation, source-data reconciliation, AI literacy and the ability to responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, trend analysis, control effectiveness and management insight. The incumbent must demonstrate strong knowledge of the underlying risk metrics, data sources such as OVS extracts, Bloomberg and internal reporting files, and the ability to translate complex technical outputs into clear, audit-ready commentary and management materials.

 Key Accountabilities 
 Risk reporting, analytics and governance support - responsibilities include:
 Prepare, analyze and maintain recurring Financial Risk reports across liquidity risk, market risk, credit risk and IRRBB, including Liquidity Early Warning Indicators, Liquidity Limit Dashboard, Liquidity Stress Testing, daily and monthly liquidity monitoring, VaR, stress testing, DV01, sensitivity measures, portfolio concentration, IFRS 9 ECL, Watchlist inputs, Risk Appetite metrics and interest rate risk analytics.
 Compile and validate source data from OVS extracts, Bloomberg, internal risk files, Treasury reports, Middle Office data, Finance inputs, facility and commitment data, exposure reports and locally maintained EUC tools to support recurring production and independent review of risk metrics.
 Support the preparation of IRC, ECC, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk and other governance materials by compiling metrics, drafting commentary, preparing exhibits, explaining drivers, documenting assumptions and ensuring materials are accurate, complete and delivered within required timelines.
 Perform review and challenge of report outputs, investigate material movements or exceptions, document rationale, reconcile data back to source systems, and escalate breaches, data issues or control concerns in accordance with applicable procedures.

 Support for stakeholders - responsibilities include: 
 Coordinate with Treasury, Middle Office, Finance, Operations, Compliance, business lines, regional risk teams and Head Office to obtain data, validate assumptions, clarify methodology, and support timely completion of Financial Risk deliverables.
 Provide support, oversight and guidance to first line and independent risk monitoring functions on risk reporting, risk appetite monitoring, limit usage, breach escalation and remediation tracking.
 Support audit, regulatory and internal review requests by maintaining clear evidence, audit trails, version logs, approvals and supporting documentation for recurring reporting processes.
 Monitor relevant regulatory, Head Office and regional risk requirements and assist in translating them into local policies, procedures, controls, testing approaches and reporting processes.
 Support the review and enhancement of local risk policies, procedures, EUC documentation and user manuals, including documentation for EWI, liquidity limits, LST, market risk reporting, RFR-linked submissions and ECL processes.
 Assist with annual recalibration and methodology review processes for liquidity risk metrics, EWI thresholds, LST assumptions, local limits and other Financial Risk measures, including coordination with ALRMO, Head Office and first line stakeholders.
 Identify opportunities to automate, streamline and strengthen recurring reports, tracking logs, confirmations and control processes while maintaining appropriate governance, documentation and change management.

 Technical Skills 
 Excellent technical skills, including advanced Microsoft Excel capability with complex formulas, Power Query, pivot tables, data validation, reconciliations, financial modelling, VBA/macros and automation techniques used to streamline recurring risk reporting processes.
 Strong knowledge of liquidity risk metrics and reporting, including Early Warning Indicators, Liquidity Stress Testing, liquidity limits, limit utilization, funds position, cash-flow analysis, contingency funding plan inputs, liquidity risk appetite measures, threshold recalibration and breach/escalation monitoring.
 Strong knowledge of market risk metrics and analytics, including VaR, stress testing, DV01, sensitivity analysis, limit monitoring, market data validation, rate and spread movements, exposure drivers and recurring market risk reporting packages.
 Strong knowledge of credit risk and ECL analytics, including IFRS 9 ECL, exposure and commitment utilization, portfolio concentration, industry and obligor analysis, facility data, credit exposure trends and credit risk appetite reporting.
 Working knowledge of IRRBB concepts and tools, including interest rate sensitivity, earnings and economic value perspectives, repricing profile analysis, scenario-based impacts, assumptions review and coordination with regional or Head Office stakeholders on IRRBB methodology and tool development.
 Ability to source, extract, reconcile and analyze data from multiple internal and external risk systems, Treasury and Middle Office files, Finance inputs, facility and commitment reports, shared-drive repositories, SharePoint sites and locally maintained EUC tools.
 Advanced data analytics capability, including the ability to work with large and complex data sets, identify data quality issues, perform variance and trend analysis, reconcile outputs across systems, design repeatable controls, and convert raw data into meaningful risk insights and executive-level commentary.
 Practical knowledge of AI-enabled productivity and analytics tools, with the ability to responsibly leverage AI to support data validation, report drafting, process documentation, variance investigation, coding assistance, workflow automation, knowledge management and management reporting, while maintaining appropriate human review, confidentiality and control standards.
 Ability to identify and implement opportunities for automation, AI-assisted analysis and process improvement in recurring reports, EUC tools, tracking logs, confirmations, procedure manuals, management materials and control evidence repositories.
 Experience preparing high-quality committee, management and audit materials, including metric dashboards, variance explanations, trend summaries, breach or exception commentary, methodology notes, procedure documentation and evidence packages.
 Sound understanding of financial risk concepts, governance expectations and control requirements, including liquidity risk, market risk, credit risk, IFRS 9 ECL, IRRBB, risk appetite metrics, stress testing, concentration risk, EUC governance and risk measurement methodologies.

 Experience & Abilities 
 Minimum of 3 years of banking, risk management, treasury, finance, audit, data analytics or related financial services experience; experience in a second line risk management function is preferred.
 Demonstrated ability to prepare, analyze and explain recurring risk reports and supporting materials across liquidity risk, market risk, credit risk and IRRBB, including EWI, LST, liquidity limits, VaR, stress testing, DV01, sensitivity measures, ECL, commitment utilization, concentration, risk appetite and governance reporting.
 Strong technical aptitude and curiosity, with a proven ability to learn new systems, adopt emerging technologies, use AI-enabled tools responsibly, and translate technical outputs into practical risk management conclusions.
 Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data issues, explain key drivers, assess materiality, reconcile outputs to source data, validate AI-assisted outputs and recommend practical control or reporting improvements.
 Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft concise commentary, document rationale, present results, and coordinate deliverables with stakeholders at different levels.
 Ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines, maintain strong attention to detail, preserve accurate audit trails, and ensure technology-enabled improvements remain transparent, controlled and well documented.

 Education & Training 
 University degree in finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, business, risk management, data analytics, computer science, information systems or a related discipline.
 Post-graduate education, professional designation or progress toward a designation such as FRM, CFA, CPA, MBA, data analytics certification, AI-related training or equivalent risk/finance certification is considered beneficial.
 Additional training in liquidity risk, market risk, credit risk, IFRS 9, regulatory reporting, data analytics, automation, responsible AI use, prompt engineering, model/EUC governance or technology risk controls is considered an asset.

Our next phase of growth is focused on expanding into higher-value engineering and professional technical services, including engineering staffing, specialized technical consulting, and project-based engineering solutions.

jobs.description:
Burnaby, BC

Annual Salary Range: $150,000 - $200,000 CAD

Lead and grow Building Science & Resiliency across British Columbia, with a priority on expanding our Building Envelope and Structural Engineering capabilities

Pinchin makes buildings and environments better. We are a multidisciplinary engineering and consulting firm with offices across North America. Our teams bring together expertise in environmental services, compliance, building science and resiliency, occupational health and safety, sustainability, and engineering. We help clients create safe, healthy, and higher performing places through solutions that reflect innovation, care, and deep technical insight.

At Pinchin, we empower our people to uphold unwavering principles and work with purpose to create better outcomes for our clients, communities, and environments.

The Opportunity

Pinchin is seeking a Director to lead our Building Science & Resiliency teams across British Columbia, including Property Condition Assessment, Building Envelope, Structural Engineering, and Sustainability. Based in our Burnaby office and reporting to the Senior Vice President, Building Science & Resiliency, this is a senior leadership role for an accomplished consulting professional who can balance people leadership, client development, technical governance, and financial performance.

A key mandate will be to accelerate the growth of our Building Envelope and Structural Engineering practices across BC by strengthening market presence, building technical and leadership capacity, attracting and developing talent, expanding client relationships, and creating a sustainable project pipeline. You will set direction for the BC teams while supporting strong performance across our established practices and strengthening delivery capacity for continued growth.

As part of Pinchin’s national Building Science & Resiliency structure, you will work closely with national BSR leaders and technical specialists to align priorities, share expertise and resources, maintain consistent technical standards, and pursue opportunities across offices.

Practice leadership and integration: Provide overall leadership to the Property Condition Assessment, Building Envelope, Structural Engineering, and Sustainability teams across British Columbia. Maintain strong performance in the established practices while creating a connected operating model that supports targeted expansion of Building Envelope and Structural Engineering.
Building Envelope and Structural expansion: Develop and execute a focused growth plan for the Building Envelope and Structural Engineering practices across British Columbia. Build market visibility, establish the required technical and leadership capacity, recruit key talent, strengthen service delivery, and develop a healthy pipeline of work.

Partner with the Senior Vice President, regional leaders, MEP leadership, and national technical leadership to align strategy, share expertise and resources, support consistent technical standards, coordinate multi-office delivery, and pursue cross-office opportunities.
Visible leadership: Model integrity, sound judgment, accountability, and collaboration. Communicate clearly, remain close to the work and the market, and help teams navigate change with confidence and purpose.

What You’ll Bring To Pinchin

The ideal candidate is a credible, relationship-driven consulting leader who is comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You know how to grow a business, develop future leaders, build trusted client relationships, navigate complex or higher-risk assignments, and turn market opportunities into focused plans and measurable results.

A degree in engineering, architecture, building science, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing business planning, forecasting, pricing, utilization, revenue, profitability, and overall financial performance.
Executive-level communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships across clients, disciplines, offices, and levels of an organization.
A practical, collaborative leadership style grounded in sound judgment, integrity, and accountability.

For Current Employees

Compensation And Assessment

What makes Pinchin different?

We offer competitive salaries and great benefits. What sets Pinchin apart is our commitment to people and purpose. You will join a team that values curiosity, integrity, and learning. You will grow alongside supportive leaders and subject matter experts who want you to succeed.

Step into a dynamic leadership role where you’ll mentor talented professionals, benefit from competitive compensation and extended coverage from day one, enjoy an RRSP Matching Program and annual bonuses, engage with expert led problem solving networks, and thrive in a flexible, supportive environment dedicated to recognizing and developing senior level expertise.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 À propos du poste 

 McKesson est à la recherche d’un(e) Directeur(trice), Gouvernance des données stratégique et expérimenté(e) pour diriger les programmes de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise afin d’améliorer la qualité des données, la conformité réglementaire, la confiance des parties prenantes et l’excellence opérationnelle. Cette personne définira et mettra en œuvre des stratégies de gouvernance couvrant la gouvernance des données, la gestion des métadonnées, le catalogage des données, la qualité des données, la gestion des données maîtres (MDM) et les capacités de traçabilité des données (data lineage).

 Le ou la titulaire collaborera étroitement avec les équipes d’affaires, technologiques, de gestion des risques, de conformité et de données afin d’établir des cadres de gouvernance, des normes, des politiques et des contrôles soutenant la prise de décisions fondée sur les données et le respect des exigences réglementaires. Ce rôle requiert une solide combinaison de leadership, d’influence, d’expertise en gestion des données et d’engagement des parties prenantes au sein d’un environnement organisationnel complexe.

 Ce que vous ferez 
 Diriger la stratégie de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise, y compris le modèle opérationnel, les politiques, les normes et les mécanismes de contrôle.

 Favoriser l’adoption et l’optimisation des plateformes de gouvernance et de catalogage des données.

 Établir et superviser les programmes de qualité des données, de gestion des métadonnées, de gestion des données maîtres et de traçabilité des données.

 Collaborer avec les équipes des Risques, de la Conformité, de la Protection de la vie privée, de la Sécurité et de l’Audit afin d’assurer la conformité réglementaire et la maturité des pratiques de gouvernance.

 Développer des indicateurs de gouvernance, des KPI de santé des données et des rapports destinés à la haute direction.

 Travailler avec les parties prenantes de l’entreprise pour définir la propriété des données, l’intendance (data stewardship), la reddition de comptes et les priorités de gouvernance.

 Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires responsables d’initiatives d’envergure en gouvernance et en gestion des données.

 Recruter, développer et mobiliser des équipes performantes en favorisant une culture de responsabilité, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

 Exigences de base 
 Plus de 12 ans d’expérience professionnelle en gouvernance des données, gestion des données, architecture des données, analytique, conformité ou dans un domaine connexe, dont au moins 4 ans d’expérience en gestion d’équipes.

 Baccalauréat ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

 Expérience dans la direction de programmes et de modèles opérationnels de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

 Expérience dans l’implantation ou la gestion de plateformes de catalogage, de gestion des métadonnées ou de gouvernance des données.

 Expérience en gestion de la qualité des données, traçabilité des données, intendance des données et contrôles de gouvernance.

 Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes de conformité, de gestion des risques, de protection de la vie privée, d’audit ou de réglementation.

 Capacité démontrée à diriger des initiatives transversales et à influencer des parties prenantes de haut niveau.

 Expérience dans l’élaboration de politiques, de normes, de KPI et de cadres de reddition de comptes en matière de gouvernance.

 Compétences et expérience privilégiées 
 Maîtrise en gestion de l’information, informatique, administration des affaires, analytique des données ou dans un domaine connexe.

 Expérience dans des secteurs réglementés tels que les soins de santé, les produits pharmaceutiques, les services financiers ou l’assurance.

 Connaissance de plateformes de gouvernance des données telles que Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Microsoft Purview ou des outils similaires.

 Expérience avec les principes DAMA-DMBOK et les cadres de gestion des données d’entreprise.

 Connaissance des règlements en matière de protection des données, des mécanismes de gouvernance et des cadres de gestion des risques.

 Expérience à diriger des initiatives de transformation des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

 Excellentes compétences en communication auprès des dirigeants et en gestion du changement organisationnel.

 Certifications pertinentes en gouvernance des données, gestion des données, protection de la vie privée ou technologies infonuagiques.

 Déplacements, environnement de travail et exigences physiques 
 Capacité à voyager jusqu’à 20 % du temps, selon les besoins de l’entreprise.

 Modalités de travail hybrides ou à distance pouvant être offertes selon les besoins de l’entreprise et la situation géographique.

 Capacité à participer à des réunions virtuelles et en personne et à travailler efficacement dans un environnement soutenu par la technologie.

 Pour McKesson Canada: Présence requise deux (2) jours par semaine au bureau, à Ville Saint-Laurent (QC). 

 ___

 About the Role   

 McKesson is seeking a strategic and experienced Director, Data Governance to lead enterprise-wide data governance programs that improve data quality, regulatory compliance, business trust, and operational excellence. This leader will define and execute governance strategies across data governance, metadata management, data cataloging, data quality, master data management, and data lineage capabilities.   

 The Director will partner with business, technology, risk, compliance, and data leaders to establish governance frameworks, standards, policies, and controls that support data-driven decision making and regulatory requirements. This role requires a strong combination of leadership, stakeholder engagement, data management expertise, and the ability to influence outcomes across a complex enterprise environment.   

 What You'll Do   

 Lead enterprise data governance strategy, operating model, policies, standards, and controls.   

 Drive adoption and optimization of data governance and data catalog platforms.   

 Establish and oversee data quality, metadata management, master data, and data lineage programs.   

 Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Security, and Audit teams to ensure regulatory compliance and governance readiness.   

 Develop governance metrics, data health KPIs, and executive reporting for senior leadership.   

 Engage business stakeholders to define data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and governance priorities.   

 Lead cross-functional teams delivering large-scale governance and data management initiatives.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Program Director – Program Delivery Executive based in Canada.

We are seeking an accomplished Program Director to lead the successful execution of complex enterprise software programs within the insurance technology sector. In this senior leadership role, you will oversee end-to-end program delivery, ensuring projects meet agreed milestones, budgets, timelines, and business objectives. You will manage multiple workstreams, lead international cross-functional teams, and establish strong governance frameworks that drive accountability and operational excellence. A key priority will be accelerating customer value realization through AI-enabled delivery models, streamlined SaaS implementations, and proactive risk management. Working closely with executive stakeholders and Customer Success teams, you will strengthen customer relationships while contributing to commercial growth and long-term account performance. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to shape innovative delivery practices and lead strategic transformation initiatives in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities

Program Delivery and Strategic Execution
Take full ownership of the program lifecycle, from initiation and planning through execution and closure, ensuring delivery remains on time, within scope, and within budget.
Oversee complex, multi-workstream programs involving software platform implementation, system integration, data migration, and business transformation.
Establish delivery strategies, governance structures, and execution standards that ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability.
Define and monitor time-to-value baselines, ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes as efficiently as possible.
Accelerate SaaS implementation cycles by promoting AI-led delivery practices and configuration-over-customization approaches.
Integrate AI-powered tools into program management activities, including status tracking, risk analysis, documentation, reporting, and execution monitoring.

Commercial Performance and Customer Value
Partner with Customer Success leadership to support commercial performance across customer accounts, including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), account margins, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and cross-selling during program execution, translating customer needs into business growth opportunities.
Monitor financial performance, delivery costs, budgets, forecasts, and commercial commitments.
Ensure program milestones align with contractual obligations, billing triggers, and agreed commercial events.
Contribute to long-term customer value realization and strengthen customer relationships through consistent delivery performance.

Milestone Governance and Risk Management
Define, manage, and track program milestones, ensuring each phase has clear deliverables, definitions of done, and formal customer acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with customers to establish and agree on exit criteria at the beginning of each program phase.
Maintain strict scope control and manage changes through structured change orders aligned with contractual and delivery requirements.
Maintain an up-to-date risk and dependency register, identifying potential challenges early and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Coordinate interdependencies across teams and workstreams, ensuring timely issue resolution and continuous delivery progress.

Insurance Industry Expertise and Customer Relationship Management
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer business models, operational structures, insurance processes, and regulatory environments.
Apply strong insurance industry knowledge to guide implementation decisions and ensure solutions address customer-specific requirements.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including C-suite executives.
Serve as the primary program-level escalation point, addressing critical concerns and maintaining confidence throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Anticipate customer challenges and proactively resolve issues before they affect program performance or customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Resource Management
Coordinate multidisciplinary delivery teams comprising internal employees, offshore resources, systems integration partners, and customer-side stakeholders.
Ensure alignment, accountability, communication, and execution discipline across all participating teams.
Directly lead and develop Project Managers, establishing delivery standards, performance expectations, and professional development objectives.
Oversee the full talent lifecycle, including onboarding, capability development, performance management, and role transitions.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial awareness.
Work closely with Customer Success teams to ensure a structured transition between implementation delivery and long-term customer value management.
Represent the organization's technology vision and strategic positioning in customer environments, communicating the value of insurance-focused technology, AI innovation, and autonomous insurance capabilities.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline is required. A postgraduate qualification in a related field is considered an asset.
At least 15 years of experience leading complex enterprise software programs, including a minimum of 5 years in senior delivery leadership positions.
Extensive knowledge of the insurance industry, particularly Life and Pensions, Property and Casualty (P&C), or specialized insurance lines.
Familiarity with insurance technology platforms, enterprise software implementations, and the operational and regulatory requirements of insurance organizations.
Demonstrated expertise in milestone-based delivery governance, exit criteria definition, scope management, change control, and customer acceptance processes.
Proven experience managing complex, multi-workstream programs from initiation through implementation and closure.
Strong background leading global, cross-functional teams, including systems integration partners, offshore delivery resources, and customer stakeholders.
Experience with AI-driven transformation initiatives and the practical application of AI tools across program management, reporting, documentation, risk management, and delivery operations.
Strong understanding of SaaS implementation methodologies, implementation acceleration, and configuration-over-customization principles.
Demonstrated financial and commercial management capabilities, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, account profitability, and cost-to-serve management.
Experience managing commercial performance indicators, including NRR, ARR, account margins, and customer value realization.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex delivery strategies and business outcomes to senior leadership.
Strong customer relationship management capabilities, including executive-level engagement, escalation management, and strategic partnership development.
Proven leadership skills, with the ability to coach, mentor, and develop Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities, combined with sound judgment and the capacity to make effective decisions in complex environments.
Ability to anticipate risks, manage competing priorities, and maintain delivery momentum in fast-paced, international business settings.

Experience managing SaaS implementation programs within enterprise software environments.
Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), hybrid delivery methodologies, and other structured program management approaches.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PgMP, or PRINCE2.
Experience driving AI-enabled operational transformation and implementing automation to improve delivery efficiency.

Vice President, Enterprise Asset Protection, Fraud, Security & Intelligence
jobs.description:
Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

Loblaw Technology and Analytics power some of Canada’s most game-changing retail solutions. We connect Canadians to things that matter most. Food, health, beauty, money, and time. Curiosity drives us as we solve complex problems at pace and lay foundation for a secure organization today while influencing a better future for our customers tomorrow. Join us and work alongside some of Canada’s most diverse and talented innovators supporting retail, digital customer solutions and analytical platforms.

The Impact You’ll Make

Transforming how Loblaw prevents fraud, reduces shrink and operational loss through intelligence, technology, and analytics. This is a significant enterprise leadership opportunity to modernize how Loblaw identifies, prevents, and reduces fraud, shrink and operational loss across retail, pharmacy, digital and supply chain operations. The mandate combines commercial judgment, intelligence-led prevention, security operations, data and technology modernization, and enterprise-wide change.

The successful executive will inherit an established asset protection and security organization and help evolve its operating model. The opportunity includes connecting information across functions, improving the use of analytics and intelligence, reducing manual effort, strengthening preventive controls, and translating insights into measurable financial and operational outcomes. The role reports to the Chief Technology & Analytics Officer and works closely with field operations leaders and stakeholders across the business.

What You’ll Do

Own the enterprise fraud, shrink and loss reduction roadmap, identifying root causes and prioritizing measurable opportunities.
Modernize operating models, workflows and cross-functional accountability across Asset Protection, fraud, investigations, and operations.
Advance intelligence-led prevention by integrating signals from stores, digital channels, inventory, investigations, and emerging threats.
Guide the evolution of centralized security and intelligence operations, including the GSOC (Global Security Operations Center), and improve how data becomes coordinated action.
Champion analytics, automation and technologies such as case management, video intelligence, exception analytics, and retail crime intelligence tools, with disciplined investment ROI.
Strengthen responses to organized retail crime and major fraud, and support partnerships with law enforcement, government, and industry.
Partner with field operations, Supply Chain, Pharmacy, Digital, Finance, Technology, HR and Legal to implement practical solutions and protect customer and colleague experiences.
Lead and develop an experienced organization, building leadership depth, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring

Senior executive leadership with demonstrated enterprise transformation and operating-model modernization.
Substantial experience in fraud prevention, intelligence, investigations, operational loss, or adjacent relevant risk disciplines.
A track record of measurable outcomes in loss reduction, improved controls, operational effectiveness, or financial value creation.
Experience using data, analytics, and technology to connect fragmented information and enable more proactive decision-making.
Strong relationships with field or distributed operations leadership, with the ability to influence change without direct authority.
Commercial and financial judgment, including investment prioritization and return-on-investment evaluation.
Experience leading senior leaders and working across complex, matrixed organizations.
Substantial experience in fraud prevention, intelligence, investigations, asset protection, or operational loss reduction, with demonstrated responsibility for preventing financial or inventory losses in complex operating environments.
CPP/CFE and English/French bilingualism are assets.

Our CORE Values – Care, Ownership, Respect and Excellence – guide all our decision-making and come to life through our Blue Culture. We offer our colleagues progressive careers, comprehensive training, flexibility, and other competitive benefits – these are some of the many reasons why we are one of Canada’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers & Canada’s Top Employers for Young People.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Digital Operations to lead and optimize the delivery of comprehensive digital marketing services across a large portfolio of small and medium-sized businesses. In this senior leadership role, you will oversee SEO, paid advertising, social media marketing, and website content operations while driving service quality, customer satisfaction, and business performance. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, establish scalable processes, and ensure marketing initiatives deliver measurable results and long-term customer value. A key focus will be accelerating digital transformation through artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging search technologies, including AEO and GEO. Excellent communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational strategies.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration
, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems
across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide
, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global,
we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform
. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified.
Visionary
in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™

Most Flexible Companies

About The Role

Camunda's procurement function makes buying easy for every Camundi while keeping spend under control and compliant with finance, legal and security requirements. As Head of Procurement you lead the function, report directly to the CFO, and manage a Procurement Specialist and an external procurement contractor.

You own procurement at Camunda end to end: strategy, process, systems and the commercial outcome of our largest vendor relationships. This is a hands-on leadership role. You negotiate the big contracts yourself, set how we buy, and build a small, AI-first team that scales with the company.

What You Will Do

Own sourcing, contracting and purchasing company-wide: define the procurement operating model, policy (incl. escalations and exceptions) and SLAs, from intake to signed contract and PO.
Lead negotiations for new purchases and renewals, with a focus on software and SaaS, cloud and AI tools, and professional services. Lead executive-level vendor negotiations personally.
Drive spend reduction and tool consolidation with IT and budget owners; own the savings target, savings tracking and ROI before/after for major spend.
Partner with FP&A on the annual budget and forecast: renewal calendar, committed spend, multi-year cost structure.
Partner with IT and business stakeholders on proactive renewal planning and execution of software tools, managing with clear ownership and negotiation timelines
Run supplier governance with Legal, InfoSec and Accounting: vendor risk, contract terms, DPAs, vendor master data and P2P controls (audit-ready); clarify ownership and exact responsibilities
Own and improve our procurement stack (Zip for intake-to-PO, NetSuite, Brex, Ironclad for contracts) and establish and manage the operating model with external procurement partners. Use automation and AI to cut cycle times and manual work and partner with internal automation team to use our own process automation tool.
Lead and develop the team (Procurement Specialist, external contractor): clear priorities, coaching, and a plan for how the function grow while also providing hands-on operational support, workload prioritization and capacity management
Be the trusted advisor to the SLT and budget owners on sourcing strategy and vendor risk; report procurement KPIs (savings, cycle time, policy compliance, spend under management) to the CFO.

What You Will Bring To The Role

7+ years in procurement or strategic sourcing, ideally in a scaling B2B software / SaaS company, with at least 2 years leading people.
A track record of negotiating significant software and SaaS contracts and showing the savings.
Experience building procurement processes and policy from an early-stage base, and rolling out a procure-to-pay tooling
Commercial and financial acumen: you think in total cost of ownership, unit cost and budget impact, and you are comfortable with contract terms and vendor risk.
Strong stakeholder skills: you influence without authority, say no with a better alternative, and keep the process simple for requesters.
Hands-on with data and AI tools; you automate your own work.
Fluent English.
Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Nice To Haves

Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency procurement (EU, US, UK, APAC).
Experience working with SaaS buying platforms or benchmarking partners (e.g. Vendr, Vertice).

jobs.description:

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

 We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Canada to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centres are sited, built, and operated. This role sits where community engagement, government relations and public affairs meet, and you may come from any of them. What matters is that you know how decisions get made in Alberta and can earn trust in a county council chamber, a minister's office or a community hall. Your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbour, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

 You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

 You will travel regularly within Alberta, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data centre markets. We will also consider applicants based in Ottawa who have established professional experience or relationships relevant to Alberta and can spend at least half their time in the province.

 Key responsibilities

 Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with municipal governments, both elected and unelected, MLAs, provincial ministers and agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the data centre markets you cover

 Engage respectfully and meaningfully with Indigenous communities, including First Nations, Metis Settlements, and Métis governments and organizations, building sustained relationships and supporting consultation and partnership efforts related to our projects

 Support projects through local decisions such as development permits and public hearings, working closely with our development partners and their community and Indigenous relations teams

 Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

 Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

 Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

 Monitor community sentiment and local and provincial political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

 Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced

 Work with Communications and Policy colleagues on public affairs in Alberta, including local media, advertising and trusted third-party voices

 Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships and helping show what that investment delivers

 Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use

 Work with colleagues in Alberta to build a playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

 Minimum qualifications

 Experience in government relations, public affairs, political or government staff roles, community affairs, economic development, or a closely related field

 Direct experience working in or with Alberta's municipal or provincial governments, and a working understanding of how local and provincial politics and community dynamics actually play out

 A skilled relationship and coalition builder who earns trust with a diverse group of stakeholders, and who maintains relationships through difficult conversations

 The ability to represent a company credibly in public settings, including town halls, hearings, and press interviews

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn a complex operational plan into plain language that a local official or reporter can understand and respond to

 Preferred qualifications

 7+ years of experience in government relations, public affairs, or community engagement, ideally including energy, utility, or large-scale industrial infrastructure projects

 Experience on a public affairs campaign that combined stakeholder outreach with earned or paid media

 Familiarity with land use, zoning, and development permitting processes at the municipal and provincial level

 Experience managing corporate social responsibility programs

 Established relationships with economic development, workforce, or civic organizations in the markets this role covers

 Experience working with real estate, legal, communications, and policy teams at the same time

 Expert in the Canadian Leasing Compute space

 It's a bonus if you: 

 Have experience with data center or hyperscale infrastructure transactions specifically

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time.
