jobs.title: Head of AI Asset Review
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


This senior leadership role is accountable for independent second\-line (2LOD) review, credible challenge, and lifecycle oversight of all AI Assets (Generative AI components and AI Agents) across the enterprise.

  

  

As part of the consolidation of AI review capabilities into Enterprise Risk Management, this role leads a global team of quantitative specialists, AI engineers, and reviewers. The role establishes review standards and evaluates the firm's portfolio of AI assets—including enterprise GenAI components, custom AI presets, multi\-step agentic workflows, and autonomous agents across banking, markets, consumer lines, and enterprise functions.

  

  

The role combines hands\-on depth in GenAI and agentic architectures with executive risk leadership, ensuring AI implementations are sound, robust, safe, and regulatory compliant. A key near\-term priority is delivering governance commitments to strengthen AI review and non\-model risk frameworks in line with evolving industry and supervisory standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


1\. Review Leadership \& Strategy


* **Review Authority for GenAI \& Agentic AI:** Serve as the primary 2LOD authority responsible for independent review, credible challenge, and sign\-off for GenAI components, presets, and AI agents firmwide.
* **Operating Model Execution:** Lead the organizational integration and ongoing management of the AI Asset review division within Enterprise Risk Management.
* **Specialized Review Frameworks:** Refine and execute review methodologies addressing GenAI and agentic failure modes—including prompt injection, hallucination, non\-deterministic behaviors, autonomous tool/action execution, memory persistence, context retrieval leakage, and multi\-agent coordination.
* **Evaluation Automation:** Drive innovation in review tooling, leveraging automated evaluation pipelines, synthetic benchmark generation, AI\-assisted evaluation suites, and automated prompt/code review tools to support review velocity.

2\. Independent Oversight \& Credible Challenge


* **Hands\-On Evaluation of AI Assets:** Direct deep\-dives and effective challenge on high\-impact AI assets—including operational presets, autonomous coding tools, and client\-facing solutions.
* **Agentic AI \& Workflow Governance:** Establish review standards for Agentic AI, assessing operational boundaries, human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) controls, permissions sandboxing, emergency shutdown mechanisms, and autonomous decision chains.
* **Adversarial Testing \& Red\-Teaming Integration:** Partner with Cyber Risk, Technology Risk, and Compliance to define 2LOD expectations for adversarial testing, red\-teaming (jailbreak resistance, prompt extraction, data poisoning), and guardrails, translating findings into review decisions.
* **Lifecycle Reviews:** Oversee end\-to\-end assessments—including development documentation sufficiency, pre\-deployment performance testing, review reports, change assessments, and periodic monitoring.

3\. Governance and Framework Enhancement


* **Governance Commitments:** Lead the enhancement and execution of comprehensive AI review frameworks, standards, and review methodologies across classification, change management materiality, and lifecycle review pathways.
* **Risk\-Based Framework Evolution:** Establish continuous review mechanisms for AI asset risk tiers, dynamic runtime behaviors, and ongoing performance assessments.
* **Industry \& Regulatory Standards:** Maintain alignment with international standards (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001\) and evolving prudential supervisory expectations.

4\. Stakeholder Engagement, Audit Defense \& Talent Leadership


* **Executive Advisory:** Serve as primary AI Asset review advisor to the Chief Risk Officer, AI Risk governance committees, and business leadership on AI risk posture.
* **Regulatory \& Audit Defense:** Lead the defense of GenAI and Agentic AI review methodologies during supervisory exams and Internal Audit reviews.
* **Global Team Leadership:** Mentor and scale a dual\-shore team across North America and offshore hubs, fostering rigor, intellectual curiosity, and objective risk challenge.

**Qualifications \& Experience**


Education


* **Advanced Degree (Master’s or Ph.D.)** in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computational Engineering, or related quantitative/STEM discipline.
  

  

Experience \& Competencies


* **15\+ years of relevant experience** in financial institutions, technology companies, or advanced research organizations.
* **8\+ years in leadership roles** managing teams in AI review, quantitative risk management, model governance, or AI systems engineering.
* **Hands\-on expertise in Generative AI \& LLMs**, including Transformer architectures, fine\-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector embeddings, and API integrations.
* **Practical experience with Agentic AI**, autonomous tool/function calling, multi\-agent frameworks, and runtime guardrails.
* **Regulatory \& Audit Engagement:** Proven track record engaging prudential regulators and internal audit on emerging technology risk, AI explainability, non\-deterministic review, and governance enhancement.
* **Decisive 2LOD Challenge:** Ability to deliver firm, objective challenge to technology sponsors and business heads, balancing innovation with risk management.
* **Executive Communication:** Strong ability to synthesize complex AI concepts into clear, decision\-ready briefings for executive leadership, the Board, and regulators.

 Every client journey starts with a secure sign-in, and attackers never stop probing it. As Director, CIAM Engineering, you will lead one of three engineering teams that build and run RBC’s customer identity platforms (such as Okta and Auth0). Depending on the team, your focus will be Authentication &
 Authorization (sign-in, federation, MFA and access policy), Credential Management & Identity Verification (credential lifecycle, passkeys, secrets and identity proofing), or New Capabilities, Cyber & Fraud (proofs of concept, bot and fraud defense, attack analysis). You will own delivery from design to
 production, partner with Strategy, Integration Assurance and Controls, and coach engineers who care about doing identity well.

jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Supply chain strategy and operations

Define and deliver the Canadian supply chain strategy, annual operating plan and improvement roadmap, aligned with country and North America priorities. Oversee product availability, order fulfilment, warehousing, transportation and finished goods inventory, balancing service, cost, working capital and risk. Ensure capacity and contingency plans support promotions, seasonal peaks, growth and continuity. Lead recovery from supply and logistics disruptions.

Demand planning and S&OP

Lead and develop the Demand Planning team, setting objectives for forecast accuracy, bias and planning quality, and addressing performance gaps. Provide direction, resources and constructive challenge while the team owns demand plan development. Ensure sound assumptions aligned with Sales, Marketing and Finance. Own Supply Chain's S&OP contribution, presenting demand and supply risks, capacity constraints, inventory and cost implications. Secure country and North America decisions and deliver agreed actions.

Customer replenishment and collaboration

Lead and develop the Customer Replenishment and Collaboration team, setting strategy and goals for service, on-shelf availability, inventory and customer supply chain relationships. Provide direction, coaching and resources, aligning replenishment and collaboration priorities with Sales and Canadian objectives. Be accountable for team performance and relationship outcomes. Support strategic customer discussions and escalations, and ensure improvement plans address service gaps and avoidable costs.

Value Added Services (VAS) and rework

Define VAS strategy, priorities and targets; own service, cost and quality performance. Direct and support the VAS Manager on capacity, providers and delivery. Support manager-led continuous improvement, cost efficiency and waste reduction, securing resources for capability and capacity needs. Ensure traceability and inventory controls, with Quality and Regulatory alignment on specifications, approvals and release.

Innovation and product changes

Be accountable for the North America Project Management team's performance in delivering Canadian innovations and product changes on time, within budget and to customer requirements. Ensure Canadian business and customer needs are captured early in scope, milestones, dependencies and timelines, supporting customer setup, launch readiness and delivery dates. Agree Canadian priorities, responsibilities and commitments with regional project leaders. Review progress, secure corrective actions and resources, and escalate delivery risks.

North America service delivery and governance

Represent Canadian requirements in regional planning, logistics and shared-service decisions, ensuring North America priorities support local commitments. Agree service levels, responsibilities, performance measures and escalation routes with regional functions serving Canada. Review service quality, reliability, responsiveness and cost. Secure resources and corrective actions with owners and timelines; ensure sustained results. Influence across reporting lines and resolve competing priorities while retaining accountability for Canadian operations.

Budget and cost delivery

Own the Canadian supply chain budget, rolling forecasts and approved cost targets, including North America service costs. Manage warehousing, transportation, VAS, rework, inventory write-offs, customer penalties and other supply chain costs. Partner with Finance to explain variances, validate charges and accruals, and implement corrective actions. Assess cost to serve by customer, channel and activity. Deliver measurable savings and productivity improvements while maintaining service and quality. Build investment, outsourcing and network change business cases.

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Typically +10-15 or more years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 5 years leading teams and substantial operational scope; consumer packaged goods or a comparable retail-driven environment preferred.

jobs.title: Directeur du développement logiciel | Director, Software Development, Platform
jobs.description:
À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS

Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions à la fine pointe qui soutient la prochaine génération d'énergie propre grâce à Unity
, l'une des suites de gestion des énergies renouvelables (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché.

L'entreprise gère plus de 300 GW
d'actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d'énergie à l'échelle mondiale, au service de plus de 600 clients
et de 18 000 sites
, représentant 25 % des données mondiales en énergie renouvelable
*.

La suite Unity REMS de Power Factors couvre l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur énergétique, allant de la supervision et du contrôle jusqu'aux analyses de marché. Grâce à des applications ouvertes axées sur les données, la plateforme permet aux acteurs du secteur des énergies renouvelables de collaborer efficacement, d'automatiser des processus critiques et de prendre des décisions éclairées afin d'optimiser la performance et la rentabilité des actifs.

S'appuyant sur une expertise approfondie du domaine, Power Factors déploie des analyses propulsées par l'intelligence artificielle à grande échelle permettant aux organisations d'optimiser leurs actifs, d'accélérer leur croissance et de prendre de meilleures décisions alors que le monde accélère sa transition vers les énergies propres.

Power Factors lutte contre les changements climatiques avec le code.

À l'extérieur de la Chine et de l'Inde.

À propos du poste

La plateforme Unity REMS constitue le socle de services sur lequel reposent nos produits APM, SCADA et EMS. En tant que Directeur / Directrice du développement logiciel, vous piloterez le périmètre Plateforme : les pipelines, les données, l'observabilité et les services transverses dont dépendent toutes les équipes produit.

Vous dirigerez des Development Managers (responsables du développement) et leurs équipes, en collaboration avec le Product Management, les Principal Engineers, le CloudOps et la Sécurité, afin de produire des résultats à l'échelle de l'organisation. Il s'agit d'un poste de direction senior, doté d'une large responsabilité technique et d'une forte influence transverse. Vous serez membre à part entière de l'équipe de direction du CTO.

Vos missions

Diriger et faire grandir les équipes

Accompagner et développer les Development Managers, définir des attentes claires en matière de livraison, de santé des équipes et d'excellence technique, et les responsabiliser grâce à des entretiens individuels réguliers, du feedback et des séances de calibration
Piloter le recrutement, la gestion de la performance et le développement de carrière au sein de votre ligne hiérarchique, y compris traiter résolument les situations de sous-performance
Façonner la topologie des équipes et l'organisation au fil de l'évolution de la plateforme, et préparer la relève en faisant émerger les futurs Development Managers en interne
Animer les rituels de pilotage qui favorisent la responsabilisation et l'amélioration continue : planification trimestrielle, revues d'OKR, revues DORA et rétrospectives d'incidents
Incarner une culture orientée client et résultats, qui vise des objectifs dépassant les frontières des équipes et des départements

Piloter les résultats de la plateforme

Porter les initiatives transverses de la plateforme en matière de scalabilité, de fiabilité, de performance et de coûts, et traduire la stratégie en feuilles de route exécutables par vos équipes
Faire de la plateforme un multiplicateur de force pour les équipes produit grâce à des services et des API stables, des contrats clairs, de bonnes configurations par défaut et une observabilité complète
Porter la qualité sur l'ensemble de la pile de tests (unitaires, d'intégration, de performance, de charge et de résistance) comme une pratique d'ingénierie à part entière
Travailler avec le Produit, le CloudOps, la Sécurité et l'Architecture sur les exigences non fonctionnelles et la préparation à la mise en production
Représenter l'organisation Plateforme dans les instances de direction du CTO et les forums transverses, avec clarté et en vous appuyant sur des faits

Votre profil

Indispensable

Plus de 12 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle, dont au moins 4 ans à encadrer des managers (management de managers)
Une solide expertise technique opérationnelle : vous savez revoir des conceptions, remettre en question des décisions d'architecture et poser les bonnes questions sur la sécurité, la scalabilité, la performance et l'ingénierie de la qualité
Une expérience avérée de direction d'équipes plateforme, infrastructure ou transverses à une échelle significative (systèmes distribués, cloud-native, approche pilotée par l'observabilité)
Une expérience concrète du développement logiciel natif IA et agentique au cours des 12 derniers mois au moins, incluant l'adoption effective d'outils tels que Cursor, Claude Code ou équivalents, les intégrations basées sur MCP et les conventions d'ingénierie « AI-first », ainsi qu'une compréhension claire des enjeux de gouvernance, de qualité et de productivité liés au développement assisté par l'IA
Un état d'esprit axé sur la qualité et la scalabilité, qui traite les exigences non fonctionnelles comme des livrables à part entière

Atouts appréciés

Familiarité avec notre stack ou des technologies proches : Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Kafka, Cassandra, Databricks, Grafana et Prometheus, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP, ainsi que les modèles de streaming et de concurrence
Connaissance du secteur des énergies renouvelables, des services publics ou de l'IoT industriel (SCADA, EMS, APM), ou d'environnements réglementés et à haute fiabilité comparables
Expérience de la gestion d'équipes distribuées dans plusieurs pays
Connaissance pratique des métriques DORA, des cadres d'expérience développeur et de la gestion de la dette organisationnelle

À quoi ressemble la réussite au cours des 12 premiers mois

Les Development Managers de votre ligne dirigent des équipes en bonne santé, alignées sur les OKR, avec des tendances DORA positives

La fiabilité, la performance et le niveau de sécurité de la plateforme s'améliorent de manière mesurable

Les pratiques de développement natives IA sont adoptées durablement au sein de votre ligne, avec un impact observable sur le débit de livraison et la qualité

Vous êtes reconnu(e) comme une voix de confiance dans les décisions plateforme transverses au niveau de la direction

LA VIE CHEZ POWER FACTORS

Power Factors est une entreprise de développement logiciel agile, suffisamment structurée pour avoir un impact concret tout en demeurant flexible et réactive dans un secteur en forte croissance. Nous réunissons des talents audacieux, créatifs et orientés vers les résultats qui souhaitent contribuer concrètement à un avenir énergétique plus durable.

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À NOUS

En vous joignant à Power Factors, vous intégrerez une équipe innovante et engagée dont le travail a un impact direct sur la transition énergétique mondiale. Vous bénéficierez d'un environnement collaboratif, de nombreuses opportunités d'apprentissage et d'un cadre propice au développement professionnel.

ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES EN EMPLOI

Power Factors souscrit au principe de l'égalité des chances en emploi et favorise un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront considérées sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'origine nationale, le handicap ou le statut d'ancien combattant.

About Power Factors

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world's renewable energy data.*

Power Factors' Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company's suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

Outside China and India

About The Role

The Unity REMS platform is the services foundation underneath our APM, SCADA, and EMS products. As Director of Software Development, you will own the Platform scope: the shared pipeline, data, observability, and cross-cutting services that every product team depends on.

You will lead Development Managers and their teams, partnering with Product Management, Principal Engineers, CloudOps, and Security to drive outcomes across the organization. This is a senior leadership role with broad technical accountability and cross-team influence, and you will be a core member of the CTO's leadership team.

What You'll Do

Coach and develop Development Managers, set clear expectations on delivery, team health, and technical excellence, and hold them accountable through regular 1:1s, feedback, and calibration
Own hiring, performance management, and career development across your line, including addressing underperformance decisively
Shape team topology and org design as the platform evolves, and build succession depth by growing future Development Managers from within
Run the operating cadences that drive accountability and continuous improvement: quarterly planning, OKR reviews, DORA reviews, and incident retrospectives
Champion a customer-focused, results-oriented culture that pursues outcomes beyond team and department boundaries

Drive platform outcomes

Make the platform a force multiplier for product teams through stable services and APIs, clear contracts, strong defaults, and comprehensive observability
Drive quality across the full testing stack (unit, integration, performance, load, and stress) as a first-class engineering practice

Represent the Platform organization in CTO-level and cross-functional leadership forums with clarity and evidence

What You'll Bring

12+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading managers (manager-of-managers)
Strong hands-on technical depth: you can review designs, challenge architectural decisions, and ask the right questions on security, scalability, performance, and quality engineering
Proven experience leading platform, infrastructure, or cross-cutting engineering teams at meaningful scale (distributed systems, cloud-native, observability-driven)
Hands-on experience with AI-native and agentic software development over the past 12+ months, including working adoption of tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalents, MCP-based integrations, and AI-first engineering conventions, plus a clear understanding of the governance, quality, and productivity implications of AI-assisted development
A quality- and scalability-first mindset that treats non-functional requirements as first-class deliverables

Familiarity with our stack or close equivalents: Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Kafka, Cassandra, Databricks, Grafana and Prometheus, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP, and streaming and concurrency patterns
Domain exposure to renewable energy, utilities, or

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Overall Job Purpose

Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails
Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
Serve as trusted advisor on the highest-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.

Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.
DevSecOps and Secure Delivery
Sponsor policy-as-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.
Systemic Constraint Resolution
Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.

Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.
AI-Enabled Practices
Shape and sponsor AI-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy-as-code, aligned to security and governance.
People and Capability Uplift
Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.
Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

Post-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk-informed decisions across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership-by-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
Ability to shape AI-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500
which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

The Position

MoveSmart Rentals is looking for a Vice President of Marketing to take ownership of the company’s marketing strategy, customer-acquisition engine, brand growth, and marketing infrastructure.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who has built and managed complex marketing functions across several markets, customer groups, campaigns, or business lines.

The person hired will be responsible for creating a more structured and measurable marketing organization. This includes deciding how work is prioritized, how campaigns are developed, how budgets are allocated, how leads are tracked, how teams are organized, and how performance is connected to customers and revenue.

The role will oversee property-owner acquisition, paid advertising, local-market growth, content, social media, SEO, reputation, public relations, partnerships, creative production, reporting, AI, automation, and marketing technology.

We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to campaign management or one marketing channel. We need an executive who can build the full marketing function and hold it accountable for business results.

Areas of Leadership

The Vice President Of Marketing Will Be Responsible For

Property-owner acquisition across multiple Canadian markets
Paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant platforms
Lead-generation funnels, landing pages, remarketing, and conversion improvement
Social media, content planning, publishing, and community engagement
Video, photography, design, copywriting, testimonials, and other creative production
SEO, local search, location pages, citations, backlinks, reviews, and Google Business Profiles
Brand reputation, review growth, public complaints, and negative-review response
Public relations, partnerships, awards, media, events, podcasts, and thought leadership
Marketing dashboards, lead reporting, attribution, budget management, and customer-acquisition performance
Internal, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based marketing resources
CRM workflows, automation, AI tools, analytics, websites, and marketing software
Brand consistency, public messaging, customer trust, and quality assurance

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy for customer acquisition, market growth, brand visibility, and reputation
Build a clear operating structure for campaign requests, planning, production, approvals, launches, reporting, and performance review
Create consistent standards for brand messaging, creative quality, public communication, and customer-facing materials
Lead paid-media strategy and determine how advertising budgets are allocated across platforms, audiences, markets, and campaigns
Improve the quality of property-owner leads, booked consultations, conversion rates, and customer-acquisition costs
Establish clear reporting from initial inquiry through qualified lead, booked appointment, signed customer, active listing, and revenue
Create strong working relationships between marketing, sales, leasing operations, customer service, finance, and technology
Lead content, social media, video, creative, SEO, local search, PR, reputation, and partnership initiatives
Develop repeatable marketing plans for launching and growing new cities and service areas
Improve search visibility, Google rankings, reviews, brand awareness, and public trust in target markets
Partner with technology and CRM teams to improve forms, tracking, lead routing, call tracking, landing pages, follow-up automation, and attribution
Use AI, automation, and marketing software to improve speed, output, accuracy, reporting, and cost efficiency
Manage and evaluate media buyers, designers, writers, editors, SEO specialists, social media resources, analysts, PR support, and marketing coordinators
Oversee external creators and partners, including videographers, photographers, influencers, event teams, podcast teams, and agencies
Build executive reporting that clearly shows advertising spend, qualified leads, appointments, conversions, acquisition costs, SEO growth, reviews, and revenue impact
Balance priorities across markets, departments, leadership requests, campaigns, launches, and growth initiatives
Recruit, train, coach, and evaluate members of the marketing team
Address weak performance, missed deadlines, inefficient spending, tracking problems, inconsistent messaging, and quality concerns
Present leadership with clear findings, risks, recommendations, resource requirements, and growth opportunities

Experience And Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of progressive marketing experience
At least 5 of those years must have been in a senior marketing leadership role
Relevant senior roles may include Vice President of Marketing, Chief Marketing Officer, Head of Marketing, Marketing Director, Head of Growth, or a comparable position
Senior experience must include direct ownership of strategy, budgets, team performance, execution, and measurable business outcomes
Experience managing marketing across several markets, brands, business units, customer segments, or client accounts
Strong experience in performance marketing, lead generation, service-based marketing, agency operations, or multi-location growth
Experience managing remote, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based resources
Strong paid-advertising experience across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, retargeting, landing pages, funnels, and conversion tracking
Strong understanding of lead quality, customer acquisition, attribution, sales conversion, budget optimization, and revenue reporting
Experience connecting marketing activity to CRM data, booked appointments, signed customers, active listings, or revenue
Strong SEO and local-search experience, including Google Business Profiles, location pages, citations, backlinks, reviews, content, and ranking improvement
Experience managing reputation, public complaints, negative reviews, review-generation programs, PR, media, awards, events, and brand credibility
Strong understanding of brand positioning, public messaging, creative direction, customer trust, and customer perception
Experience working with developers, CRM teams, website teams, automation specialists, analysts, and technology vendors
Strong practical experience using AI, automation, and software to improve marketing productivity and decision-making
Experience managing marketing budgets, team output, campaign performance, acquisition costs, and business results
Experience building marketing processes, reporting systems, approval structures, playbooks, and quality controls
Strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and accountability skills
Ability to work successfully in a fast-moving, founder-led environment
Ontario or GTA-based candidates are preferred
Ability to attend meetings, shoots, events, planning sessions, and launches in Vaughan when required

Experience That Would Be Especially Relevant

Real estate, rentals, leasing, property management, brokerage, or home services
Lead generation for property owners, investors, or high-consideration service customers
Multi-city or multi-location growth
Building local-market launch strategies
Improving lead quality and sales conversion
Managing marketing for service businesses with strong reputation requirements
Agency leadership or responsibility for managing outside agencies
Building distributed or offshore marketing teams
CRM implementation and end-to-end marketing attribution
Referral, partnership, community, and event marketing
National or regional brand expansion
Reputation recovery or review-growth programs

Who We Are Looking For

You are a senior marketing leader who knows how to turn strategy into a reliable operating function.

You understand that success is not measured by activity alone. More posts, more clicks, and more inquiries only matter when they produce qualified property owners, booked appointments, signed customers, listings, and revenue.

You know how to build teams, assign ownership, create reporting, control budgets, and establish standards without becoming involved in every individual task.

You are comfortable managing internal staff, offshore resources, freelancers, agencies, creators, technology, AI, and automation within one coordinated structure.

You can identify weak performance quickly, challenge poor decisions, improve accountability, and keep marketing focused on business priorities.

You also understand the importance of trust in a property-services business. Brand reputation, reviews, public communication, local visibility, and customer experience are treated as core growth drivers.

How Performance Will Be Measured

Success In This Role Will Include

A consistent and predictable flow of qualified property-owner leads
Better visibility into how marketing activity converts into customers, listings, and revenue
Improved lead quality and appointment conversion
Controlled customer-acquisition costs
Stronger paid-media performance across target markets
Successful launches and growth in new cities and service areas
Improved Google rankings, local visibility, reviews, and reputation
Clear and consistent brand messaging
Higher-quality creative and content output
Reliable campaign planning, deadlines, approvals, and reporting
Clear responsibilities and accountability across the marketing team
Effective use of internal, offshore, freelance, agency, and project-based resources
Practical use of AI and automation to increase efficiency
Better alignment between marketing, sales, operations, technology, and leadership
Clear executive recommendations supported by useful data

Earnings and Incentive Plan

This role offers an annual base salary of up to C$160,000, depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, leadership background, and the scale of the marketing teams and budgets they have previously managed.
The successful candidate will also be eligible to earn up to C$60,000 annually through a performance-based leadership incentive.
The incentive is intended to reward measurable commercial impact, including improvements in customer acquisition, conversion performance, marketing efficiency, brand visibility, market expansion, team productivity, and the development of scalable marketing systems.
At full achievement, total annual compensation may reach C$220,000.
The final compensation package will reflect the candidate’s senior marketing leadership experience, history of managing complex teams and budgets, multi-market or multi-brand background, and demonstrated ability to build marketing operations that produce reliable business results.

Work Arrangement

This is a hybrid position.

The Vice President of Marketing will be expected to attend the Vaughan office when needed for leadership planning, strategy meetings, campaign launches, shoots, partnerships, events, and other important business initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build the marketing function behind a growing Canadian leasing-services company and directly influence customer acquisition, local-market expansion,

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Level:
Management, M4

Location:
Ottawa, ON or Toronto, ON

Reports To:
Jesse Bruyn | SVP, Revenue

Type:
Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most
. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster
by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

Solink is hiring a Director of Solutions Engineering
to lead our two Solutions Engineering teams, covering SMB through Enterprise, and build a high-performing pre-sales technical organization across Solink’s software and hardware solutions.

You will own how Solink engages customers technically throughout the sales process, from discovery and solution design through demos, pilots, technical validation, and technical close. Your SEs will be the technical leaders of the deal and speak the language of the customer—the priorities, workflows, and challenges of each industry and persona we serve.

This role reports to the Senior Vice President of Revenue and partners closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Channel, and Implementation. The role will include occasional travel to events and customer sites across North America.

What You’ll Do

Lead the SE Organization: Lead, coach, and develop two SE teams and their leaders, with clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards. Run a consistent operating model across segments and focus SE capacity on the highest-value and most complex opportunities.
Drive Technical Sales Execution: Oversee technical discovery, solution design, demos, workshops, objection handling, competitive positioning, technical validation, closing, and clean handoff across the sales organization.
Build a World-Class Demo and Storytelling Culture: Set the standard for how Solink demonstrates its platform through customer use cases and business outcomes. Build repeatable demo frameworks and talk tracks by vertical and persona, and coach SEs on storytelling, executive presence, and technical credibility.
Design Solutions That Can Be Deployed: Ensure solutions account for customer camera, recorder, network, and POS infrastructure, including hardware needs, appliance sizing, bandwidth planning, site readiness, and deployment requirements.
Lead Technical Workshops & Pilots: Lead architecture discussions, site surveys, RFPs, security and compliance reviews, and pilot design, with clear success criteria and a path to full deployment.
Scale Technical Capability Beyond the SE Team: Partner with Sales Enablement to raise AE technical competency, help channel partners and installers become more technically self-sufficient, and define when partner-led scoping and installation is appropriate.
Partner with Product: Build a strong feedback loop with Product around recurring customer requirements, technical gaps, competitive intelligence, and field readiness for new launches.

Role Expectations

This is an M4
level role. At Solink, leaders at this level are accountable for leading through managers and driving the execution of significant initiatives across their area. They operate with a high degree of autonomy, translate strategy into clear priorities for their teams, and partner with senior leaders to solve complex problems and make effective decisions.

In this role, you’ll be expected to:

Set clear priorities and operating expectations across the Solutions Engineering organization, aligning team capacity and execution with broader Sales and company goals.
Lead and develop SE leaders and teams, creating accountability for performance while building capability, career growth, and succession within the organization.
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve technical sales execution, customer experience, and the scalability of the Solutions Engineering function.
Identify technical, operational, and capacity challenges early, develop thoughtful solutions, and proactively resolve dependencies across Sales, Product, Channel, Customer Success, and Implementation.
Use business and team performance metrics to evaluate SE effectiveness, prioritize investments, and make decisions that improve deal progression, technical quality, and organizational efficiency.
Drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.

What Success Looks Like

Solutions Engineering operates with a clear and consistent model across SMB through Enterprise, with strong leadership, clear ownership, and effective allocation of SE capacity.
SE teams consistently deliver high-quality technical discovery, demos, solution designs, pilots, and handoffs that support strong sales outcomes and predictable deployment.
Customers receive compelling, persona- and industry-specific technical experiences that clearly connect Solink’s capabilities to their business needs and outcomes.
AEs and channel partners have stronger technical capability and know when and how to engage Solutions Engineering to maximize deal outcomes.
Solution designs can be deployed as sold, improving implementation predictability, customer experience, and margin protection.
The Solutions Engineering organization continuously improves through better processes, feedback loops, technical standards, and an AI-first approach that can scale with the business.

These outcomes are directly grounded in the source JD’s stated success measures, particularly around operating consistency, demo quality, deployable solutions, increased AE/partner capability, and an AI-first approach.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

Experienced Solutions Engineering Leader: You bring 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture, including 3+ years leading leaders.
Complex Technical Sales Experience: You have experience supporting complex B2B SaaS or technical sales within enterprise and multi-location environments.
Strong Technical & Commercial Acumen: You bring a strong technical discovery and solution design background, combined with excellent demo, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
Customer-Centric Solution Design: You can tailor technical messaging by persona, industry, and business outcome while maintaining strong commercial instincts.
Hardware + Software Experience: You have experience selling solutions that combine software and hardware, such as physical security, video, networking, or IoT. AI or computer vision experience is an asset.

Nice-to-Have:

Experience leading Solutions Engineering teams across multiple customer segments.
Experience with physical security, video surveillance, networking, IoT, AI, or computer vision.
Experience working with channel partners and partner-led technical sales motions.
Experience scaling pre-sales organizations through periods of significant growth.

Security Requirements

Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;
Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;
Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is CA$279,504 – CA$349,380 On-Target Earnings (OTE).

We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role.

Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate proficient
capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and leadership capabilities needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.
Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.
Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.
Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.
Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.
Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.
Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.
Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.
Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.
Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

Intro call with our Talent Team
Interview with the Hiring Manager
Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)
Final interviews with cross-functional team members
Reference Checks
Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How To Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink
uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

Compensation Range: CA$279,504 - CA$349,380

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

IMPACT

The Group Director, Addressable Activation is responsible for management and leadership of unified and client focused Search, Social, Programmatic and eCommerce activation teams within the agency. This role requires proven experience in biddable media planning, multi channel activation, optimization, process development, management, and leadership. The incumbent is a highly passionate and dynamic media professional keen on applying their understanding, skills, and experience to drive client outcomes and foster career growth for data-driven search, social, programmatic and eCommerce specialists.

Key Accountabilities

Client and Agency

Establish, own, monitor, optimize, performance metrics of client campaigns within relevant platforms
Work with clients, agency leadership and performance leads to uncover business needs and objectives
Develop, maintain and refine trusted relationships and service levels that bridge key client and agency stakeholders
Proactively identify and solve client risks before they escalate

Team Leadership

Provide strategic input to manage and develop campaigns with various strategies, such as, prospecting, remarketing, contextual targeting to meet client goals
Oversee the client activation performance audits and WPP Media best practice implementation to enhance client outcomes across channels
Lead deployment of available WPP Media automation and product solutions across agency clients.
Develop process and lead compliance to mitigate risk throughout media activation lifecycle
Understand clients' business and coach team members to enhance client performance with new ideas
Assist agency teams and clients to define their performance marketing approach to achieve business results
Manage project plans, scope of work, and timelines meeting delivery all required expectations
Develop relationships of key platform partners
Develop and own activation team staff plans (onshore / offshore), monitoring hours to ensure effective client focused service levels and efficiency
Ensure best practice optimization approaches to meet client objectives as well as workflows with internal groups
Lead team & agency training sessions related to media activation and WPP Media best practices.

P&L and Business Development Support

Collaborate with Media Solutions & agency partners to identify and develop proposals
Identify and improve account profitability, billings and revenue through client growth roadmap creation and overall GroupM product adoption
Support budget development and client forecasting
Develop media strategies for new business pitches
Collaborate with agency and wider WPP Media teams to identify opportunities for SEO, Content, and other services

Job Requirements

7+ years of related industry experience, and demonstrated strong client relationship responsibility, preferably agency: Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, eCommerce, SEO
Experience overseeing and managing organizational performance with strategic objectives and financial targets
University Degree or proven equivalent experience in related field
Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
Demonstrated track record of client relationship development and service
Strong knowledge or proven experience account management/coordination, buying, client/campaign strategy, and media planning
Highly developed communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills
Excellent organizational, time management and multi-tasking skills
Advanced ability to plan, implement and manage strategic and operational initiatives
Keen attention to details, robust critical thinking and proactive problem-solving
Foster a team culture that creates highly effective teams who delight clients with great service and media results
Experience in leading cross functional teams

jobs.title: Head of Product and Solutions
jobs.description:
About Vayle

Vayle is a Canadian technology company transforming how the public sector manages information access and privacy compliance. Our platform supports municipalities, police services, and government institutions across Canada in meeting complex legislative and regulatory requirements. Recent changes to information access and privacy legislation have created real momentum for the business.

The Role

We are looking for a Head of Product and Solutions to own the Vayle product roadmap. This is a technical product manager role. You will decide what we build, why, and in what order, and you will be credible with our developers on how it gets built.

You will sit at the intersection of customers, engineering, and partners. You are comfortable reviewing a technical design, reading code, and challenging an estimate, and you are equally comfortable in a room with a customer who is working through a complex regulatory requirement. This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting directly to the CEO, with real ownership and a direct line to company leadership.

What You Will Do

Own the roadmap

Set and maintain the product roadmap across Vayle FOI, Vayle PIA, Vayle FormLink/Pay, Vayle Portal, and our optional modules
Balance customer requests, strategic priorities, compliance obligations, and technical debt into a clear, defensible plan
Work with engineering to size and scope work, and make trade-offs transparent to leadership, sales, and customers
Define the strategic imperatives that determine what makes the roadmap and what does not

Be the technical bridge between customers and engineering

Translate customer needs and legislative and regulatory change into detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that developers can build from
Participate in architecture and design discussions, review technical approaches, and help the team make sound decisions on data models, integrations, and security
Dig into issues alongside developers, including reading logs, inspecting data, and tracing behaviour, to understand root causes and shape the right fix
Own release planning and release content, and ensure product decisions support our security and compliance posture, including SOC 2 Type II

Lead customer engagement and solutions

Work directly with customers to understand how their teams use the platform and where the pain points are
Act as the technical authority on what the platform does and does not do, supporting proposals, RFP responses, and security and architecture reviews
Guide solution design for complex deployments, including data migrations, integrations, and hosting considerations
Work with partners so integrations and deployments are designed properly from the start

Communicate and report

Provide regular roadmap and delivery updates to the CEO and leadership team
Communicate priorities and release information clearly to customers, partners, and internal teams

What You Bring

Required

7 or more years in technical product management, solutions architecture, or a related role, with a background in software development or engineering
Strong hands-on technical fluency with the Microsoft stack, including .NET and C#, SQL databases, and REST APIs, and the ability to review code and technical designs with developers
Solid understanding of modern cloud application architecture, integrations, identity and access management, and secure software design
Experience building or managing products that handle sensitive or regulated data
Experience with complex regtech or compliance solutions, or experience in the privacy and information access sector
Strong customer-facing skills, including running discovery, leading working sessions, presenting to executives, and building trust with customers
A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product in a B2B SaaS environment
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences
Comfort with high autonomy, shifting priorities, and a startup pace

Strongly preferred

Experience in the Canadian public sector, whether selling to it, building for it, or working inside it
Familiarity with FOI, privacy impact assessments, and Canadian access and privacy legislation
Experience supporting security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001
Experience with document processing, workflow, or case management platforms
Experience working with distributed or outsourced development teams

Why Vayle

Direct influence on product direction at a growing company
Meaningful work that supports the public institutions serving Canadians
Close access to leadership, with real decision-making authority
A collaborative team that values urgency, ownership, and practical thinking

Vayle is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate needs during the hiring process on request.

jobs.title: Director of Finance | Hotel PUR, Quebec, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
jobs.description:
Discover Hotel PUR, Quebec, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, where bold design, local spirit and modern hospitality come together in the heart of Quebec City’s vibrant Saint-Roch district. With striking city views, distinctive spaces, locally inspired dining, a heated indoor pool and a neighborhood filled with art, culture, boutiques and celebrated restaurants, Hotel PUR offers guests an experience that is anything but ordinary. For hospitality professionals, it’s an opportunity to be part of a dynamic, design-forward property where the energy of Quebec City is woven into every guest experience.

The Director of Finance is responsible for providing ethical and consistent leadership in the financial area of the hotel by supplying management with guidance, training and support. The Director of Finance is also responsible for focusing on the profitability of the business, maintaining accurate and timely financial reporting, ensuring acceptable levels of internal controls, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and safeguarding owners/investors assets.

Responsibilities

Financial:

Acts as the “Chief Business Officer” to the general manager and EC Team, and as such is responsible for evaluating the financial impact on business decisions.
Ensure that all levels of management are promptly notified of any financial deviations from established policies and/or control weaknesses in the hotel.
Effectively manage and communicate cash flow related issues, as required to management and ownership. This includes the accurate and timely preparation of cash-flow statements, management of receivables, cash balances, control mechanisms and timely deposits of all funds.
Monitor hotel revenues and expenses and ensure the accurate recording in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts established guidelines. Investigate and critique variances to budget or to prior year and offer practical improvement strategies to management.
Monitor the capital planning process by assisting management with calculation of return on capital improvements, gathering support and monitoring the bid process, and evaluating scope of work and specifications.
Ensure Hotels’ compliance on all regulatory licenses and permits, leases, contracts, legal agreements, and the proper execution of all operational taxes. Provide assistance to management in enforcing compliance on all these items.
Coordinate the completion of all forecasts and budgets as required, with the full and active participation of EC Team and department managers.
Analyze financial data and operations in order to assist and advise management in maintaining the Hotels’ financial objectives.
Ensure that all balance sheet accounts, including bank reconciliations are reconciled on a timely basis.
Establish and continually audit all internal financial controls including purchasing, cash handling, disbursements, credit extension, inventories, hotel assets, master keys, payroll, and employee records.
Embrace a continuous growth environment by actively hiring professional staff and assisting in recruiting, reviewing, recommending and maintaining an inventory of qualified and promotable Associates that can potentially become Directors of Finance, Assistant Directors of Finance, Accounting Managers, and other managers for the organization.
Continually focus on training and development programs for finance associates to cultivate the “brightest” and “best” talent within the industry.
Hire, train, supervise and develop staff, including coaching, counseling and discipline.
Maintain compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to ensure safe and efficient operation of the hotel.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance and periodic upgrades of all IT systems and equipments.
Direct and/or prepare all financial reports in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts requirements meeting various due dates and deadlines:
Ensure and monitor that the hotel is in compliance with all report deadlines and due dates and react accordingly.
Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in finding and implementing their solutions.
Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards, as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing the professional attire and nametag when working.
Comply at all times with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.

QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education & Experience

A minimum of 8 years of related progressive experience in hotel Accounting or related field; or a 4-year college degree with an Accounting/Finance concentration and a minimum of 4 years of related progressive experience; or a 2-year college degree and a minimum of 6 years of related progressive experience.
Must be fluent in both written and spoken English and French.
