jobs.title: Managing Director, Corporate Communications
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As Managing Director, Corporate Communications, you will lead CPP Investments’ media relations strategy and execution in Canada and provide senior oversight of media engagement across the Americas. You will strengthen and protect the organization’s reputation while helping priority audiences understand its mandate, investment approach and long-term performance. 

As a trusted adviser to senior executives and investment leaders, you will provide strategic communications counsel on financial results, investment transactions, corporate developments and emerging issues. This senior individual-contributor role combines strategic judgment and established media relationships with hands-on execution, including reporter engagement, executive preparation and issues management. 

 The Team 

 Public Affairs & Communications supports CPP Investments’ reputation and engagement with external audiences, helping stakeholders understand the organization’s purpose, mandate, investment activities and long-term performance. 

Within the function, this role leads engagement with journalists and news organizations, provides strategic communications advice and coordinates responses to significant corporate developments and issues across Canada and the Americas.  

 Accountabilities   
 Lead media relations strategy and execution across Canada and the Americas, partnering with regional and global Public Affairs & Communications colleagues.  
 Build and maintain trusted relationships with influential business, financial, investment and national journalists to support informed and credible media engagement.  
 Provide strategic communications counsel to senior executives and investment leaders on complex, sensitive and high-profile matters, including financial results, investment transactions and corporate announcements.  
 Lead communications planning and responses for emerging issues, crises and portfolio company developments, including scenario assessment, escalation and coordinated execution.  
 Serve as a spokesperson and senior point of escalation for priority media inquiries, personally managing sensitive matters and preparing executives for media engagements.  
 Develop and refine media statements, briefing materials, executive messaging and proactive media opportunities that strengthen understanding of CPP Investments’ mandate, investment strategy and performance.  
 Use media intelligence and analytics to inform strategy, evaluate effectiveness and identify emerging risks while collaborating across investment teams, Legal, Risk and regional offices and other colleagues.  

 What You Bring   
 A university or college degree in communications, journalism, business, finance, public affairs or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.  
 A minimum of 15 years of progressively senior experience in media relations, corporate communications, financial communications, or a related discipline.  
 Extensive experience leading media relations in a complex, high-profile organization, ideally within institutional investing, asset management, financial services or another highly scrutinized environment.  
 Deep knowledge of the Canadian business, financial and media landscape, established relationships with senior Canadian journalists, and familiarity with the United States media environment. Experience in Latin America and French-language capability are assets.  
 Demonstrated experience advising senior executives, managing complex reputation issues and crises, and leading communications for financial, investment and/or corporate developments.  
 Strong financial literacy, exceptional writing and verbal communication skills, and the ability to translate complex investment matters into clear, accurate messaging, including as a spokesperson and executive adviser.  
 Sound judgment, discretion and adaptability, with the ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across functions, mentor colleagues and remain directly involved in execution, including time-sensitive matters outside standard business hours when required. 

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Inclusion & Accessibility 
 CPP Investments is committed to  equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.   

 Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud 
 CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.  

 CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

 #LI-ONSITE

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Overview 

 We are looking for a Director of Technical Program Management to lead a senior team of TPMs driving Instacart's most critical Engineering Foundations initiatives across Data Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, Platform, AI enablement, Privacy, and Reliability. In this highly visible role, you will shape the strategy and direction of company-critical, cross-functional programs while staying hands-on in how they are planned and delivered. You will partner closely with VPs and Directors of Engineering, Finance, Legal, GRC, Data Science, and other cross-functional leaders. This is a terrific opportunity for a technical leader who is passionate about people, program management, and engineering, and who understands that our success hinges on our ability to deliver impact as a team.

 The Technical Program Management team leads Instacart's most impactful cross-functional efforts, bringing technical expertise, product sense, and business acumen to deliver highly complex initiatives at scale. 

  

 About the Job 

 Lead and grow a senior team of TPMs, building a vision for a high-performing TPM organization while actively mentoring and developing individuals to succeed.

 Shape the vision, strategy, and investment needs across Engineering Foundations, including data product strategy, data quality and governance, financial data transformation, AI enablement, privacy, and reliability.

 Drive a step change in how Engineering Foundations operates: clear reliability expectations, real-time visibility into top-line metrics, and proactive investment decisions owned by each pillar.

 Partner with VPs, Senior Directors, and Directors of Engineering and with leaders in Finance, Legal, and Security to enable effective strategic planning and timely execution of company-critical programs.

 Present regularly to the CTO and influence engineering leadership on key investments needed to hold a high bar on our operational health.

 Use your technical knowledge and product sense to drive data-driven decisions, negotiate prioritization, weigh long-term and short-term investments, and reduce ambiguity and risk.

 Enable the company to expand into new markets with privacy and regulatory compliance in strong shape.

 Build a team culture of curiosity, impact, and ownership that reinforces the core values of Instacart.

  

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product management in a technical domain, or a related discipline.

 Track record as both a strong individual contributor and a people leader, with experience leading and growing a team of TPMs or engineers.

 Experience in infrastructure domains (such as data infrastructure, developer infrastructure, platform, reliability, or privacy) at scale.

 Demonstrated influence on technical or business strategy, with a record of measurable outcomes delivered for the organization.

 Proven ability to influence senior engineering and executive leaders, resolve conflict, and build consensus while navigating ambiguity.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience in infrastructure at a leading technology company operating at scale, as both an individual contributor and a leader.

 Experience with data governance, privacy, or regulatory compliance programs.

 Experience supporting executive-level operating reviews and engineering planning processes.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. 

 Job Summary 

 About the Role

 McKesson is seeking a Director, Distribution Center Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership for a pharmaceutical distribution center supporting McKesson Specialized Distribution (MSD).

 This leader will have overall accountability for distribution center performance, including customer service, operational execution, inventory accuracy, financial performance, regulatory compliance, safety, quality, and people leadership. The Director will lead cross-functional initiatives, drive continuous improvement, develop leaders, and ensure operations meet customer commitments and applicable Health Canada and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) requirements.

 This role is ideal for an experienced pharmaceutical distribution, 3PL, supply chain, or logistics leader who can balance customer expectations, regulatory requirements, employee engagement, and business performance.

 What You’ll Do
 Provide overall leadership and accountability for distribution center operations, customers, financial performance, inventory, safety, quality, and service.
 Develop and execute operational strategies that improve service levels, productivity, cost, capacity, and operational efficiency.
 Establish and monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure performance meets customer and manufacturer agreements.
 Develop and manage the distribution center budget and identify opportunities to control costs and increase operational efficiency.
 Lead inventory management and analysis to drive high levels of inventory accuracy and control.
 Ensure compliance with applicable Health Canada regulations, GMP requirements, security, health and safety, environmental, and quality standards.
 Ensure SOPs accurately reflect operations and customer requirements across 3PL, consignment, and wholesale distribution models.
 Oversee business continuity planning, testing, training, and ongoing readiness.
 Lead and develop managers and their teams through coaching, performance management, succession planning, cross-training, and professional development.
 Champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, employee engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
 Build strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners and anticipate changing customer and business requirements.
 Partner across functions on strategic initiatives and responses to RFI, RFP, RFT, and RFQ opportunities.
 Identify opportunities to leverage warehouse and logistics technology to improve operational performance.
 Oversee import/export brokerage relationships and processes.

 Basic Requirements
 Degree or equivalent experience.
 12+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years of management experience. 
 Demonstrated experience leading distribution center, warehouse, supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations.
 Management experience leading operational teams and/or leaders.
 Experience with budget management, operating costs, inventory management, and operational KPIs.

Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years.  Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.
Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.
 
The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite.  For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

Working in partnership with LEO SE and segment teams, your department will complement LEO SE’s continuing engineering work by adding scalable delivery capacity and reusable engineering capabilities across the division.
Why this role
Build a lasting engineering capability while delivering meaningful technical outcomes on Lightspeed. You will have scope to develop leaders, connect Systems Engineering and software disciplines, and introduce tools that teams use in their everyday engineering work. This role suits a high-energy leader who builds momentum, drives results and thrives in a demanding, fast-moving program environment.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Cytel is a global leader in statistical software and advanced analytics for clinical research and drug development. For nearly four decades, Cytel has pioneered innovative statistical methodologies and software solutions that help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies make better decisions, accelerate clinical development, and bring life-changing therapies to patients.

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Vice President of Software Development
to lead our global software development organization. This executive will be responsible for the strategy, execution, and operational excellence of Cytel's software engineering function, encompassing software development, statistical methodology development, quality assurance, DevOps, and technical project management.

The VP of Software Development will play a critical role in translating Cytel's product vision and scientific innovation into scalable, reliable, secure, and commercially successful software solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise, exceptional organizational leadership, and a disciplined approach to software delivery with an understanding of the unique requirements of scientific software development within the pharmaceutical industry.

This position requires a leader capable of managing multidisciplinary teams, modernizing development practices, scaling engineering capabilities, and fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Software Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for Cytel's global software development organization, including software engineers, statistical methodologists, quality assurance professionals, DevOps engineers, and project managers.
Develop and execute a comprehensive software engineering strategy aligned with Cytel's product roadmap, commercial objectives, and long-term technology vision.
Establish and maintain a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering multiple software products and initiatives simultaneously.
Define engineering standards, architectural principles, development methodologies, and technology strategies that promote scalability, maintainability, security, and performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies, development frameworks, and engineering practices, including artificial intelligence and AI-assisted software development, to improve innovation and productivity.
Balance investments in new product capabilities, technical debt reduction, architectural modernization, and ongoing product maintenance.
Partner closely with Product Management to translate product strategy and customer requirements into actionable engineering plans.
Software Development & Product Delivery
Assume executive accountability for the successful delivery of Cytel's software product roadmap, ensuring commitments are met with predictable timelines, appropriate resource utilization, and high-quality outcomes.
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through testing, release, deployment, and maintenance.
Establish effective Agile and other fit-for-purpose development practices that support both iterative product development and complex scientific software engineering.
Drive continuous improvements in engineering productivity, development velocity, release frequency, and delivery predictability.
Ensure effective prioritization and resource allocation across multiple products, projects, and development teams.
Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and key performance indicators to monitor project execution, delivery risks, engineering capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
Proactively identify and resolve technical, organizational, and operational obstacles that threaten product delivery.
Scientific Methodology Development & Computational Excellence
Lead and support teams of statistical methodologists responsible for the research, design, implementation, and validation of advanced statistical and computational methods incorporated into Cytel's software products.
Foster close collaboration between statistical scientists, software engineers, and product managers to ensure scientific innovation is translated into robust, commercially viable software capabilities.
Establish rigorous processes for scientific verification, numerical accuracy, reproducibility, and computational performance.
Ensure that statistical algorithms and scientific software implementations meet the high standards of accuracy, reliability, and transparency expected by pharmaceutical customers and regulatory stakeholders.
Promote effective collaboration with internal and external scientific experts, academic researchers, and industry partners.
Support the integration of emerging statistical methods, simulation techniques, machine learning, and other advanced analytical approaches into Cytel's software portfolio.
Quality Assurance, Validation & Regulatory Readiness
Provide executive oversight of software quality assurance, testing, and validation practices across the product portfolio.
Establish and continuously improve comprehensive quality management processes encompassing automated testing, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, and scientific algorithm validation.
Ensure software development and quality processes support applicable regulatory expectations and customer requirements, including GxP-related considerations, where appropriate.
Promote strong traceability, documentation, reproducibility, and change-control practices consistent with the requirements of pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers.
Drive a culture in which quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle rather than treated as a downstream activity.
Establish measurable quality objectives and continuously reduce defect rates, production incidents, and customer-reported software issues.
DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Operations
Lead DevOps and engineering infrastructure functions responsible for build systems, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), release engineering, deployment automation, and development environments.
Drive the adoption of modern DevSecOps practices, incorporating security, reliability, and compliance into automated engineering workflows.
Oversee the technical infrastructure supporting cloud-based SaaS products, including availability, scalability, observability, performance, and operational resilience.
Establish effective processes for incident management, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity in collaboration with IT and security leadership.
Optimize cloud infrastructure utilization and engineering operating costs while maintaining appropriate service levels.
Ensure development and deployment processes support Cytel's evolving portfolio of desktop, cloud-based, and enterprise software solutions.
Project Management & Operational Excellence
Oversee the technical project management function, ensuring disciplined planning, execution, risk management, and cross-functional coordination.
Establish consistent governance processes for engineering initiatives, including milestone tracking, resource planning, dependency management, and executive reporting.
Develop engineering capacity plans and budgets aligned with product priorities and commercial commitments.
Improve the predictability of software delivery through effective estimation, performance measurement, and continuous process improvement.
Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and contractors, as appropriate.
Establish a performance-driven operating model that balances delivery speed, scientific rigor, product quality, and financial discipline.
Talent Development & Organizational Leadership
Build, develop, and retain a world-class, multidisciplinary software development organization.
Lead organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent acquisition across engineering, methodology, QA, DevOps, and project management functions.
Recruit, mentor, and develop strong technical leaders capable of scaling teams and driving organizational performance.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, accountability structures, and performance expectations.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and results-oriented culture characterized by technical excellence, scientific curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
Promote knowledge sharing, technical mentorship, and professional development across teams.
Establish effective strategies for leveraging geographically distributed development teams.
Executive Collaboration & Business Partnership
Serve as a key member of Cytel's software leadership team, contributing to product strategy, technology investment decisions, organizational planning, and business performance.
Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer and Product Management leadership to ensure alignment between product strategy, engineering capabilities, investment priorities, and delivery commitments.
Collaborate with commercial, customer success, professional services, and support teams to address customer requirements and ensure product quality and customer satisfaction.
Participate in strategic customer discussions, particularly those involving technical architecture, product capabilities, software quality, security, and deployment requirements.
Communicate engineering strategy, organizational performance, risks, and investment requirements clearly to executive stakeholders.
Contribute to build-versus-buy decisions, technology partnerships, and the technical evaluation of potential acquisitions or integrations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline.
15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, including substantial experience leading large, multidisciplinary software development organizations.
7+ years of senior engineering leadership experience, preferably at the Director, Senior Director, or Vice President level.
Demonstrated success delivering complex commercial software products within a multi-product software organization.
Proven experience leading teams encompassing software engineering, QA, DevOps, and technical project management.
Strong understanding of modern software architectures, cloud computing, SaaS platforms, APIs, databases, and software development frameworks.
Extensive experience with Agile software development, CI/CD, automated testing, DevSecOps, and modern engineering management practices.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering performance metrics, improve delivery predictability, and drive organizational transformation.
Experience managing engineering budgets, resource allocation, organizational growth, and geographically distributed teams.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing scientific, statistical, analytical, or other computationally intensive commercial software products.
Familiarity with pharmaceutical clinical development, biostatistics, clinical trial design, or regulatory science.
Experience managing teams of statistical scientists, quantitative researchers, or scientific methodologists alongside software engineering teams.
Understanding of statistical programming environments and technologies such as R, Python, C++, and related computational frameworks.
Experience with software quality and validation requirements in regulated industries, including pharmaceutical GxP environments.
Experience developing products deployed in both traditional desktop and modern cloud/SaaS architectures.
Familiarity with numerical computing, simulation, high-performance computing, and scientific algorithm validation.

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**


GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non\-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well\-being potential.


Through our unique integrated payer\-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non\-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well\-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025\. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.


At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**


The Director, People Operations \& Solutions reports to the Executive Vice President, Head of People \& Culture as part of GreenShield’s (GS) People \& Culture (P\&C) department. This role will be accountable to design, develop, deploy, and operate the technology and analytics capabilities and roadmap for the tools and data needed to support our strategy, operating model, structure, processes, and people.  

This role will be focused on establishing business solutions that support and drive ongoing operational efficiency for our people and in service of our overall workforce. This role also establishes the digital foundation for outstanding service standards and pre\-determines intake and access routes tailored to specific client groups.  

This role will enable enhanced service delivery for our people processes to improve the employee and leader experience through enhanced insights and direct access to information and knowledge sharing.  

This role will play a critical leadership role in for our people.


Responsibilities:

* Operational Frameworks, Process Improvements, or Direction Definition: Oversight and support in delivering the people, process and technology solutions in service of continuous modernization of the P\&C Target Operating Model.
* Organization Enablement: Optimized and enhanced interactions to enable future state experiences and outcomes.
* Technology \& Analytics Enabler: Technical and analytics solutions to enable better outcomes.
* People Operations: Lead operational delivery across payroll, case management, service intake/routing, knowledge management, controls, issue resolution, and service quality, ensuring reliable experiences for employees, leaders, and People \& Culture stakeholders.
* Workday Application Management Service Management: Own and lead the ongoing Workday AMS operating model, including service governance, vendor coordination, release/enhancement prioritization, issue resolution, sustainment planning, and alignment of Workday capability to People \& Culture priorities.
* Process Transformation \& Automation:Identify opportunities to leverage workflow automation, AI, self\-service and digital solutions to reduce manual effort, improve employee and leader experience and increase the scalability of People \& Culture Operations.
* Team Leadership: Provide leadership, prioritization, coaching, resource planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery oversight for the People Operations \& Solutions team, balancing strategic project delivery with business\-as\-usual operational excellence.
* Technology Strategy: Develop \& implement.
* Technology Operations: Solution design, implementation, ongoing maintenance, solution support.
* Metrics: OKRs \& Operational KPIs.
* Data: Data governance, quality, data models and controls across employee data.
* Reporting: Design and quality assurance.
* Analytics: Supporting proactive decision\-making for P\&C operations, GreenShield organization design, and the overall people strategy and its workforce planning.
* Change Management: Ongoing processes \& systems engagement \& support.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

  

* Leadership: Strong leadership skills, self\-driven and resourceful
* Process Design \& Improvements: Problem\-solving experience with the ability to analyze processes and provide innovative solutions in a collaborative, agile way from process design to implementation. Experience with people and/or human resources processes and operations is an asset but not required.
* Technology Solution Design, Delivery \& Support: Experience solving complex business challenges through technology. This includes providing direction as a subject matter expert capable of conceptualizing, designing, delivering, and managing ongoing support for technology solutions. Experience with people and/or human resources technology solutions is an asset but not required.
* Data, Reporting \& Analysis: Demonstrated experience leading enterprise data, reporting and analytics capabilities, including data governance, data quality, reporting strategy, workforce insights and analytics. Experience working with People/HR data and translating workforce data into actionable business insights is required.


SKILL COMPETENCIES:

* Strategic Thinker: Capable of seeing the big picture and anticipating future needs through planning.
* Detail\-Oriented: Ensures accuracy and thoroughness in tasks by understanding their components.

**What We Offer**

Join a global technology organization that gives Generative AI engineers the scale, data, and problem complexity to make a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Risk & Insurance
jobs.description:
**Position: Director, Enterprise Risk \& Insurance**

**Location: Toronto, ON or Kansas City, MO**

**Employment: Full\-time, Director level**

**Reports to: Chief Financial Officer**

**Function: Corporate Finance**

**The Opportunity**


Black \& McDonald is a decentralized organization with significant operations across Canada and the United States. We are seeking an experienced risk and insurance leader to **oversee our enterprise\-wide property and casualty insurance program**, support our captive insurance entities, coordinate claims and loss\-management activities, and **lead our Enterprise Risk Management program**. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director, Enterprise Risk \& Insurance will work closely with regional and corporate leaders to strengthen risk management while respecting the accountability and entrepreneurial approach of our operating businesses. **This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can combine technical insurance knowledge, financial analysis and practical business judgment.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Insurance and Risk Financing**

* Lead and coordinate the annual insurance renewal process across Canada and the United States.
* Evaluate insurance structures, limits, deductibles, retentions, exclusions, pricing and emerging coverage requirements.
* Analyze insurer proposals, loss trends, collateral requirements and alternative risk\-financing structures, and make recommendations to senior management.
* Oversee policy administration, endorsements, certificates of insurance, premium allocation and insurance documentation.
* Conduct periodic reviews of coverage gaps and emerging exposures, including cyber, professional liability, pollution, crime and project\-specific risks.

**Captive Insurance Oversight**

* Support the strategy, governance and financial oversight of the Company's captive insurance entities.
* Review captive financial results, reserves, loss development, liquidity, capital requirements and regulatory obligations.
* valuate retention levels, reinsurance structures, new coverage opportunities and alternative uses of captive capital.

**Claims and Loss Management**

* Lead regular reviews of loss runs and significant or developing claims.
* Challenge claim strategy, case reserves and expected outcomes where appropriate.
* Monitor loss frequency, severity and reserve development and translate findings into practical loss\-prevention and risk\-financing actions.

**Enterprise Risk Management**

* Lead the annual enterprise risk assessment process across operating regions and corporate functions.
* Maintain the enterprise risk framework, risk taxonomy, assessment tools, reporting and annual ERM calendar.
* Facilitate executive interviews, regional risk workshops and senior\-management risk discussions.

**Fraud Risk, Analytics and External Partners**

* Coordinate or support reviews of significant fraud or control incidents, including root\-cause analysis and remediation tracking.

**What You Bring**

* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in insurance, risk management, finance, audit or a related discipline.
* Meaningful experience managing complex commercial property and casualty insurance programs and annual renewals.
* Experience working directly with insurance brokers, insurers and underwriters.
* Familiarity with claims management, loss runs, actuarial reserving, collateral requirements and loss development.
* Experience leading enterprise risk assessments and presenting risk matters to senior executives.
* Strong financial literacy and the ability to evaluate insurance and alternative risk\-financing structures.
* An undergraduate degree in business, finance, accounting, risk management or a related field.
* A relevant insurance, accounting or risk designation is considered an asset.
* Experience in a decentralized, multi\-location organization is preferred. Construction, engineering, infrastructure or another project\-based industry would be an asset.

**The Leadership Profile**


The successful candidate will be a credible and pragmatic leader who can influence without relying on formal authority. You will build trusted relationships with regional executives, Controllers and operational leaders while constructively challenging assumptions when risks require further attention.


You will bring structure and discipline to complex processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Just as importantly, you will be willing to perform substantive analysis, translate technical concepts into clear business recommendations and exercise sound judgment about when matters require senior\-management attention.


This is an opportunity to shape and strengthen the risk and insurance function within a large, complex North American organization while working directly with senior leadership and operating businesses.


Please be advised that a Criminal Background Check and Professional Reference Check will be required as part of our employment screening and selection process. Additionally, all applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada, unless otherwise stated in the job posting.


Black \& McDonald welcomes and encourages applications from persons with accessibility accommodation requirements. Accessibility accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are \#EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading\-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel\-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock\-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.


The Opportunity


Dover Fueling Solutions is seeking a commercial leader to shape the next phase of growth


for Bulloch POS in Canada. Bulloch is a proven point\-of\-sale technology platform with a


strong position in the Canadian market.


The immediate mandate is clear: build and embed a disciplined, scalable account


management model that deepens our most important customer relationships, strengthens


execution, and creates durable growth.


The Director will engage senior IT and business leaders at large enterprise accounts,


translate their priorities and technology roadmaps into actionable account strategies, and


coordinate DFS resources to deliver long\-term customer value.


Additional focus will be selective new\-logo growth with Canadian retailers not currently


using Bulloch. These are strategic pursuits with sales cycles that can extend several years


and require thoughtful relationship development, technical credibility, and disciplined


opportunity management.


The Director will lead a team and have significant exposure across DFS. After establishing a


strong Canadian account management framework and demonstrating sustained


execution, the successful candidate may have opportunities to contribute to Bulloch’s


longer\-term U.S. growth agenda.


What You Will Own


* Build the account management system. Design and implement a consistent

framework for account planning, customer governance, opportunity management,


executive engagement, and performance reviews across Bulloch Canada.


* Lead and grow strategic accounts. Develop multi\-year plans connecting customer

technology priorities with Bulloch capabilities, investments, and measurable


business outcomes.


* Become a trusted partner to enterprise technology leaders. Build credibility with

senior IT, technology, operations, and business stakeholders and understand their


roadmaps, integration requirements, risks, and priorities.


* Create disciplined customer governance. Establish executive business reviews,

account health assessments, stakeholder maps, opportunity pipelines, and clear


accountability for customer commitments.


* Drive retention, expansion, and lifetime value. Identify opportunities to deepen

relationships through additional deployments, software, services, and evolving


customer requirements.


* Win targeted new logos. Lead selective pursuits with Canadian retailers not

currently using Bulloch, recognizing the strategic and long\-term nature of these


opportunities.


* Lead regional selling directly. Take an active role in solution positioning, deal

shaping, qualification, negotiation, and closing with smaller regional and


independent retailers.


* Develop a high\-performing team. Coach direct reports in strategic account

management, commercial discipline, executive engagement, and opportunity


development.


* Orchestrate cross\-functional execution. Work across Product, Engineering,

Implementation, Customer Success, Support, Service, Marketing, and Finance to


remove obstacles and deliver a consistent customer experience.


* Bring the market into the business. Translate customer feedback, competitive

dynamics, and technology trends into actionable insights for product and business


leadership.


* Operate with commercial rigor. Own forecasting, pipeline quality, account KPIs,

quarterly planning, and transparent reporting of opportunities and risks.


What Success Looks Like


Within the first 12–18 months:


* A repeatable account management framework is operating across Canada and

actively used by the team.


* Strategic customers have clear account plans, governance cadences, stakeholder

maps, and documented growth priorities.


* Bulloch strengthens retention and share of wallet while building credible long\-term

pipelines with targeted new customers.


* Customer commitments are better coordinated across DFS, with clearer ownership

and fewer execution gaps.


* The team demonstrates stronger commercial discipline and executive\-level

customer engagement.


* Bulloch’s Canadian business is positioned to scale without relying on tribal

knowledge or individual relationships.


What You Bring


* 7\+ years of progressive B2B sales, strategic account management, or commercial

leadership experience, ideally in enterprise software, SaaS, POS, payments, retail


technology, or another complex technology environment.

jobs.title: Regional Executive Vice President
jobs.description:
Regional Executive Vice President

Detailed Job Description

Position Overview

The Regional Executive Vice President (Regional EVP) is responsible for leading and overseeing overall business operations, strategic planning, financial management, market expansion, and organizational development within a designated region. This role ensures that regional business strategies, operational objectives, financial targets, and execution plans are aligned with the company’s overarching corporate strategy and long-term goals, driving sustainable growth and enhancing overall operational performance.

The Regional EVP works closely with the CEO, COO, CFO, the senior executive leadership team, and regional management personnel to formulate regional development strategies, monitor business execution, optimize resource allocation, and foster cross-functional collaboration. This position plays a pivotal role in expanding regional market share, improving operational efficiency, strengthening organizational management, and achieving the company’s long-term commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

I. Regional Strategic Planning and Senior Leadership

Develop and implement regional business strategies that align with the company’s overall strategic objectives, market environment, and long-term development plans. Define the regional strategic direction, key development priorities, business targets, and execution roadmaps, ensuring that all regional activities remain consistent with the company’s broader strategy. Provide strategic guidance to the regional management team and report on regional market opportunities, operational challenges, and recommendations for major strategic decisions to the company’s senior leadership.

II. Regional Business Operations and Management Oversight

Exercise comprehensive oversight of daily operations across all business departments, branches, and business units within the designated region, ensuring that activities are conducted in accordance with corporate policies, operational standards, and established goals. Evaluate regional operational efficiency, management standards, and execution performance, identifying operational issues and driving their resolution. Coordinate with regional leaders to improve workflows, enhance productivity, and optimize service quality, ensuring stable and efficient operations throughout the region.

III. Financial Performance and Budget Management

Oversee the region’s overall financial performance, including annual budgeting, revenue targets, operating costs, profit metrics, and capital utilization. Collaborate with the CFO and the finance department to develop regional financial plans, monitor budget execution, and analyze variances between actual operating results and financial targets. Propose initiatives for cost control, resource optimization, and profitability enhancement based on financial performance to ensure the region achieves its established financial objectives. IV. Market Expansion and Business Development

Research and analyze regional market trends, industry competition, customer needs, and potential business opportunities to formulate plans for market expansion and business growth. Drive the development of new markets, build customer relationships, foster strategic partnerships, and expand business channels. Collaborate with sales, marketing, and business development teams to enhance the company’s brand influence, market competitiveness, and customer coverage within the designated region, thereby generating new revenue streams and long-term business value.

V. Organizational Leadership and Talent Development

Provide leadership, oversight, and performance management for the regional senior management team and department heads. Define the regional organizational structure, management responsibilities, departmental objectives, and performance standards for employees, ensuring that managers at all levels have a clear understanding of their duties and operational goals. Promote the development of management talent, leadership capabilities, and succession planning to build a high-performing regional management team, while fostering employee collaboration, professional growth, and overall organizational execution.

VI. Corporate Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance Oversight

Ensure that regional business operations comply with the company’s internal management policies, corporate governance guidelines, contractual obligations, and applicable laws and regulations. Identify and assess potential financial, legal, market, and operational risks, and develop appropriate preventive and control measures. Work with legal, finance, compliance, and risk management departments to refine internal control mechanisms, address potential risks in a timely manner, and safeguard the company’s legal rights and operational stability.

VII. Executive Communication and Cross-Departmental Coordination

Establish and maintain strong working relationships with corporate headquarters, the senior management team, other regional heads, key clients, business partners, and other stakeholders. Coordinate collaboration across functions—such as finance, human resources, operations, sales, marketing, and technology—to ensure the effective execution of the company’s strategic plans within the region. Represent the company in significant business meetings, strategic negotiations, and regional collaborative initiatives as required, and provide regular updates on regional business progress to the CEO and other senior executives.

VIII. Performance Monitoring and Continuous Improvement

Establish and monitor regional Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including revenue, profit margins, operational efficiency, market growth rates, customer satisfaction, and employee productivity. Regularly review regional operational reports, business data, and departmental performance to identify shortcomings in management and operations, and develop targeted improvement measures. Drive the optimization of operational processes, the refinement of management systems, and the enhancement of business models to continuously improve the region’s overall operational capability and long-term competitive advantage.

Qualifications

Education

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, Operations Management, International Business, or a related field is required. A Master of Business Administration (MBA), or a master’s degree in Strategic Management or International Business, is preferred. Professional certifications in project management, financial management, corporate operations, or senior management are also highly desirable.

Work Experience

Typically requires 15 to 20 or more years of progressively responsible experience in corporate management, regional operations, business development, strategic planning, or senior executive roles, with at least 8 years spent in a senior management or executive leadership position.

Must possess extensive experience in overseeing operations across multiple regions or business units, formulating regional development strategies, managing large-scale operational budgets, and leading senior management teams. Demonstrated ability to improve regional operational performance, achieve financial targets, expand market presence, manage complex business relationships, and coordinate cross-departmental strategic initiatives. Prior experience in regional market expansion, organizational transformation, managing multiple branches, or overseeing large-scale business operations is preferred.

jobs.title: Vice President of Business Development
jobs.description:
About Us

Agrocrop Exports Ltd. is a trusted leader in the processing and export of Pulses, Beans, Lentils, Peas, and Grains, specializing in Private Label consumer packaging. Based in Canada and backed by HACCP and BRC “AA” certifications, we ensure the highest standards of quality, safety, and reliability in every product.

Serving major retailers across North America and Europe, our modern processing and packaging facility, combined with deep industry expertise, has positioned us as the largest Private Label processor of packaged pulses in the Western Hemisphere. Our continued growth is driven by innovation, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to our customers and partners worldwide.

Position Summary

The VP, Commercial & Business Development is responsible for developing and leading Agrocrop's commercial strategy, driving profitable revenue growth and building a professional sales and business development organization capable of supporting the Company's long-term growth objectives.
This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role responsible for expanding Agrocrop's customer base, diversifying its product portfolio, identifying new market opportunities and strengthening its competitive position within the food manufacturing and private-label industry.
Working closely with the CEO, Operations and Finance, the VP will evaluate commercial opportunities against the Company's manufacturing capabilities, operational capacity, financial objectives and risk profile. The role will ensure that growth decisions are commercially attractive, operationally achievable and financially sustainable.
The VP will also be responsible for establishing the structure, talent, processes, systems and performance expectations required to professionalize the sales function and transition the business from an owner-led sales model to a scalable commercial organization.
The successful candidate will bring significant experience in food manufacturing and private-label sales, strong commercial and financial acumen, strategic vision and the ability to influence senior leadership and challenge existing business assumptions constructively.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy aligned with Agrocrop's objective of growing revenue from approximately $200 million to $500 million over the next three years.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, customer segments, product categories and revenue streams that support sustainable and profitable growth.
Assess Agrocrop's current market position, competitive landscape, customer relationships and manufacturing capabilities to identify opportunities for expansion.
Establish clear commercial priorities, growth targets and strategic initiatives, translating the Company's broader business strategy into actionable commercial plans.
Challenge existing business assumptions and bring forward new ideas, opportunities and commercial strategies to support the Company's next stage of growth.

Product Portfolio Diversification & Development

Lead the identification and evaluation of opportunities to diversify Agrocrop's product portfolio, with particular focus on adjacent categories and products that leverage existing manufacturing capabilities and market relationships.
Work closely with Operations, Finance and other stakeholders to assess the commercial viability, manufacturing requirements, capital investment, margins and risks associated with new product opportunities.
Develop business cases for new product categories, including market demand, competitive positioning, pricing, anticipated volumes, profitability and return on investment.
Identify opportunities to expand existing private-label programs, introduce new products and develop strategic customer partnerships.
Ensure product diversification decisions are driven by market opportunity, manufacturing feasibility and long-term financial return.

Customer Development & Strategic Account Management

Develop and strengthen relationships with key customers, retailers, distributors and strategic business partners.
Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships through additional products, categories, volumes and geographic markets.
Lead the development of strategic account plans for key customers, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and Agrocrop's commercial and operational capabilities.
Establish a disciplined approach to customer profitability, pricing, contract negotiations, commercial terms and account management.
Oversee the development of a qualified business pipeline and ensure opportunities are evaluated based on strategic fit, profitability, risk and resource requirements.
Establish a structured approach to customer retention, satisfaction and long-term relationship development.

Title:
Director, Software Engineering (Appointments)

Location:
Remote Canada (EST or CST). Occasional travel within the United States and Canada.

Why This Role Exists

At Phreesia, we’re transforming the healthcare experience through intelligent technology that helps patients connect with care sooner and helps healthcare practices make the most of their schedules. Our technology supports approximately 180 million patient visits annually.

As Director, Software Engineering (Appointments)
, you’ll lead the engineering organization behind our Appointments and Appointment Accelerator products and shape their next stage of development. As these products evolve from workflow-driven software toward agentic experiences, you’ll guide the use of AI agents to help patients find, book, and manage appointments and help practices keep their schedules full.

You’ll lead how these agents are designed, evaluated, deployed, and operated in a regulated healthcare environment. You’ll also partner closely with Product Management, Design, QA, Security, and customer-facing teams to turn the roadmap into reliable, scalable software.

This is a leadership role focused on engineering strategy, organizational design, and developing leaders. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to challenge designs, guide architectural decisions, and make sound tradeoffs.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior individual contributors, setting clear expectations and holding leaders accountable for results.
Own the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Appointments and Appointment Accelerator in partnership with Product Management.
Lead the design, deployment, and ongoing operation of production AI agents, including evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost management, and human-in-the-loop escalation.
Ensure AI features meet healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements, including appropriate handling of protected health information (PHI).
Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools, including team practices for reviewing and validating AI-generated code.
Enable predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple teams through planning, prioritization, and cross-team dependency management.
Set architectural direction with architects to ensure systems are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective on AWS.
Own the reliability and scalability of background processing, messaging, and electronic medical record and practice management (EMR/PM) integrations.
Own production health across the domain, including incident response, escalation management, and ongoing product maintenance.
Establish and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, CI/CD, and technical documentation.
Plan and manage headcount, hiring, and budgets, including contractors and vendors, while building a strong, inclusive hiring pipeline.
Build team structures and career paths that support growth for managers, architects, and senior individual contributors.
Use delivery, quality, and operational metrics to guide investment, surface risks, and communicate progress against product and engineering goals.
Communicate engineering strategy, investment needs, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
Set goals and objectives with team members, provide ongoing feedback, and lead performance management.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You don’t need to check every box — but this role will feel energizing if you have:
A track record of delivering complex, customer-facing SaaS products at scale with strong operational outcomes.
Demonstrated success developing engineering managers, architects, and senior individual contributors.
Experience owning technical strategy and roadmaps in partnership with Product Management.
Experience managing budgets, headcount plans, contractors, and vendors.
Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production AI agents, either hands-on or by leading the teams responsible.
Experience across the full agent lifecycle, including tool and API integration, prompt and context management, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and cost control.
Experience leading adoption of AI-assisted development tools and establishing practices for validating AI-generated code.
Experience with CI/CD, cloud-native architecture, and modern quality engineering practices.
The ability to explain engineering strategy and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership and build alignment across functions.
A pragmatic, self-motivated leadership style and comfort working with highly distributed teams.
Experience with background job processing, message-based architectures, idempotency, and concurrency — preferred.
Experience in healthcare technology, scheduling, patient access, or EMR/PM integrations using FHIR or HL7 — a plus.
Experience with SMS or patient communication platforms and messaging compliance, such as TCPA — a plus.
2+ years of experience applying AI agents to scheduling, conversational, or patient-facing workflows — a plus.
An advanced degree in a related discipline — a plus.

We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
12+ years of software engineering experience building and supporting highly distributed applications, including significant hands-on experience earlier in your career.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers and multi-team organizations.
Familiarity with the following technologies; hands-on depth is not required for every item:
Languages & Frameworks:
Ruby on Rails, C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript, React, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks.
AI & Agents:
LLM APIs and platforms, agent frameworks and orchestration, tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, evaluation, and AI observability tooling.
AI-Assisted Engineering:
Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, MCP servers, custom skills, and agent workflows.
Background Processing & Messaging:
Sidekiq, Redis, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Kinesis, and NServiceBus.
Data:
PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.
Integration:
RESTful APIs, OAuth2, and EMR/PM integrations using FHIR and HL7.
Cloud & Infrastructure:
AWS, including EKS, SQS, and Kinesis; Docker; Kubernetes; Helm; Argo CD; and Terraform.
CI/CD & Testing:
GitLab CI/CD, RSpec, NUnit, and automated test frameworks.
Observability:
New Relic, Rollbar, Grafana, and Prometheus.

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote position open to candidates located in Canada (EST or CST). You’ll lead highly distributed engineering teams and collaborate closely with Product Management, Design, QA, Security, and customer-facing teams. Occasional travel within the United States and Canada is required.

Why Phreesia

Phreesia is on a mission to make healthcare more human, connected, and efficient. Our SaaS platform powers digital check-in and engagement for healthcare organizations nationwide—helping patients feel informed and providers work smarter.

Total Cash Compensation:
Total Cash Compensation for Canada-based employees range from $240k -$280k inclusive of base salary and variable incentive and is dependent on qualifications.
A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work.

We’re proud to be:

A five-time Modern Healthcare Best Places to Work winner.
Recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index.
Deeply committed to inclusion, growth, and employee experience

Deep working knowledge of wood frames and woodshop operations, foam and suspension, cushions and pillows, cutting and sewing, upholstery, and design-to-fabrication.
Experience in a custom or made-to-order environment.
A track record of leading multiple supervisors and delivering measurable operational change.

About pH7 Technologies

Positioned at the intersection of sustainability, technology and critical resource recovery, pH7 Technologies is developing innovative processing solutions to transform how critical minerals are recovered and how mining projects are developed.

Through proprietary electrochemical technology, in-house metallurgical expertise and laboratory capabilities, pH7 is advancing specialized hydrometallurgical processes that offer new possibilities for metal extraction and recovery.

We're building more than a technology company. Our vision is to become a partner of choice for metallurgical project development, combining innovative processing technology with the engineering expertise and commercial capabilities required to advance complex mining projects from concept through implementation.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a commercially minded Director, Project & Commercial Development
to take ownership of pH7's growing portfolio of client opportunities and help establish the operating discipline required to scale the business.

This is a pivotal, hands-on role responsible for governing the full project development pipeline, managing key client relationships and ensuring opportunities progress through each stage of technical evaluation, testing, feasibility and commercial development.

You'll act as the central point of coordination between clients, technical teams and senior leadership, establishing clear priorities, milestones, accountability and processes to keep projects moving.

You'll bring visibility and accountability to a complex portfolio of projects, ensuring the right activities are happening at the right time, internal teams are aligned and clients remain engaged throughout the development process.

This is not a traditional business development or sales role. It's an opportunity to help build and lead the commercial project development function of a growing engineering and technology business. You'll be equally comfortable thinking strategically about project economics and commercial opportunities as you are coordinating meetings, following up on deliverables and resolving the practical challenges that keep projects moving.

What You'll Do

Commercial Pipeline & Project Governance
Take ownership of pH7's full portfolio of client opportunities, maintaining visibility into project stages, priorities, commercial potential, risks and next steps.
Establish and implement the governance, processes and reporting needed to manage opportunities from initial engagement through technical evaluation, testing, feasibility and commercial development.
Develop clear plans, milestones, timelines and accountability structures to ensure opportunities continue to progress.
Drive follow-through across internal teams, ensuring deliverables, commitments and milestones are met.
Coordinate resources, identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve issues that could delay project progression.
Establish regular project reviews and client engagement rhythms, providing leadership with clear visibility into progress, priorities and potential risks.

Client & Project Development
Own key client relationships throughout the project development lifecycle, acting as the primary commercial point of contact.
Build trusted relationships with mining companies, EPCMs, engineering firms and other strategic industry stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with metallurgical, engineering and laboratory teams to ensure client requirements are understood and translated into actionable project plans.
Manage client expectations, coordinate meetings and ensure timely communication and follow-through.
Understand each client's investment priorities, technical requirements, project economics and decision-making processes.
Guide opportunities through the various stages of development, including technical evaluation, testing, pilot programs, feasibility and commercial assessment.
Ensure clients remain informed and engaged, and that pH7 consistently delivers on its commitments.

Commercial Development & Growth
Represent pH7 at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events, actively building relationships with mining companies, EPCMs and other industry stakeholders to identify and cultivate future project opportunities.
Support the evaluation and prioritization of opportunities based on commercial potential, project economics, risk and strategic fit.
Work with senior leadership to evaluate project structures, develop commercial models and advance opportunities toward commercial agreements.
Support the development of business cases, financial evaluations and investment materials in collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
Identify new opportunities through industry relationships, networking, conferences and market intelligence.
Help position pH7 as a strategic engineering and project development partner within the global mining industry.
Bring market intelligence, customer feedback and emerging opportunities into the company's broader commercial strategy.

Building the Commercial Function
Establish the systems, processes and operating discipline required to scale pH7's project development capabilities.
Help organize the business around a consistent, client-focused project delivery model.
Develop repeatable approaches to managing client engagements, project progression, internal coordination and commercial reporting.
Identify gaps in processes, resources and capabilities and recommend improvements as the business grows.
Work collaboratively across the organization to establish accountability and ensure teams remain aligned around client and project priorities.

What We're Looking For

Approximately 10+ years of relevant experience in project development, commercial development, project management, engineering, EPCM, mining or a related industry.
Experience managing complex projects, client engagements or commercial opportunities through multiple stages of development.
Strong understanding of engineering and mining project lifecycles, including technical evaluation, testing, feasibility and capital investment processes.
Proven ability to establish structure, governance and accountability across multiple concurrent projects or opportunities.
Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to understand project economics, financial models, investment considerations and commercial risk.
Exceptional organizational and execution skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate roadblocks and ensure consistent follow-through.
Ability to build credibility with technical teams, senior executives and external stakeholders.
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and driving accountability without necessarily having direct reporting authority.
A proactive, hands-on approach. Comfortable moving between strategic planning and the practical details of day-to-day project execution.
Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where processes are still evolving and the ability to build structure from the ground up is essential.
Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
Willingness to travel internationally approximately 50% of the time.

Nice to Have

Experience within an EPCM, engineering consultancy, metallurgical or mineral processing environment.
Background in metallurgy, mineral processing, chemical engineering or a related technical discipline.
Experience with project finance, investment banking, private equity, corporate development or capital markets.
Experience developing commercial agreements, negotiating project structures or evaluating complex capital projects.
Spanish language skills.

Why pH7?

Help build a specialized engineering and project development business with the potential to reshape mineral processing.
Take ownership of a significant portfolio of international mining projects and strategic client relationships.
Play a pivotal role in establishing the commercial processes and operating model that will support pH7's next stage of growth.
Work at the intersection of innovative technology, engineering and commercial project development.
Enjoy significant autonomy, decision-making authority and the opportunity to shape how the business operates.
Join a growing technology company where your work will have a direct impact on the development and commercialization of new processing solutions.

Technology is one of the most important parts of Warner Music Group’s business. Whether it is supporting artists and songwriters, delivering accurate royalty and performance data to global partners, or giving creative and business teams modern data and AI tools, engineering makes it possible.

Experience with data and ML platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) and applying AI/agentic tooling in engineering workflows.
