Blacksmith Agency is an AI-first digital agency running websites, SEO, AI search and paid media for growing companies. As Director of Strategic Accounts for AI Search (AEO and GEO), you sell AI Search (AEO and GEO) (AI search programs (answer and generative engine optimization) that get brands cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews) into our largest multi-location deals, from the first meeting with ownership to the signed contract. No management. No team to build, hire or run.
Strategic accounts: companies with many locations, where one signed deal covers the whole group and opens the next.

The full cycle on large deals: discovery, proposal, negotiation and close, over 3 to 12 months.
Deals with owners, regional operators and marketing leaders all at the table.
Expansion: more locations and more services once a group signs.
Proposals built with our strategists and leadership for the deals that matter most.

A record of closing $1M+ a year selling AI search, AEO, GEO or SEO to large, multi-location or enterprise accounts.
Long, consultative cycles with several decision makers. If your background is high-volume, single-location or one-call transactional sales, this is a different job.
You would rather close business than manage people.

jobs.title: Associate Director or Director
jobs.description:
A career as an Associate Director or Director, Business Integrator on the New Products and Activities team at National Bank of Canada Capital Markets means acting as a strategic partner in delivering new products and business initiatives. In this role, you leverage your expertise in securities trading and financing to lead the assessment and integration of complex, high-impact initiatives by influencing key operating model design decisions, risk frameworks and integration strategies. This job allows you to have a direct impact on the organization by enabling business growth while ensuring strong operational, regulatory, and risk frameworks.

Your Job

Lead the assessment and integration of new securities trading and financing products and activities, including contributing to the definition of end-to-end operational, regulatory, and risk requirements.

Develop a strong understanding of trading structures, financing transactions, and business objectives to challenge assumptions, ensure robustness of solutions and influence decision-making.

Contribute to the definition of target-state operating models and provide strategic recommendations that support scalable and sustainable growth.
Apply an enterprise-wide lens to balance business objectives, operational efficiency, risk management, and regulatory requirements, while influencing partners and stakeholders to align on strategic direction and to deliver scalable, long-term solutions.
Drive alignment and collaboration across end-to-end key stakeholders; Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, Treasury, and other.

Establish and maintain robust governance, controls, implementation plans, and deployment strategies while proactively identifying and resolving risks and issues while escalating material concerns to senior stakeholders and governance committees.

Your Team

This position reports to the Managing Director responsible for transformation and evolution initiatives in the New Products and Activities team within the Capital Markets sector. Our team consists of around 45 highly experienced, talented, and dedicated individuals and stands out for its strong collaboration, agility, and deep understanding of capital markets activities and operating models.

You will work closely with trading, risk management, and functional experts across the organization, gaining end-to-end exposure to products, processes, and business strategies. We foster a dynamic environment where learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing are encouraged.

Our training approach is based on hands-on experience and exposure to complex initiatives. You will benefit from continuous learning opportunities, access to subject matter experts, and the chance to develop a broad perspective on capital markets. Career growth opportunities include expanding into leadership roles or deepening expertise across asset classes, products, and transformation initiatives.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field with 7–10 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets

Strong understanding of securities trading and financing products (equities, fixed income, repos, securities lending, ETFs, structured products)

In-depth knowledge of front-to-back processes including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, collateral management, and reconciliations

Understanding of market infrastructures (clearing houses, custodians, central securities depositories, triparty agents, payment systems)

Extensive experience leading large-scale, cross-functional transformational initiatives in complex capital markets environments.

Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 For the Toronto location only, proficiency in English is required. French is considered an asset, but it is not mandatory.
Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.
Required skills: Accountability, Capital Markets, Client-focused, Communication, Driving Results, Emotional Intelligence, Empathy, Humility, Influencing Skills, Initiative, Leadership, Learning Agility, Product Knowledge, Resilience, Teamwork

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Change Office
jobs.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

YOUR IMPACT
  
  

As the Senior Director, Change Office, you will establish and lead a global change management program supporting OpenText’s enterprise transformation, workplace strategy, real estate programs, and portfolio optimization.
  
You will own the change strategy, governance, and employee transition outcomes associated with new ways of working. Partnering with executive leadership and teams across HR, Workplace Experience, Corporate Communications, IT, Security, Legal, Finance, and regional Facilities, you will ensure major changes are supported by coordinated communications, clear timelines, and structured transition plans.
  
  

WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Define and lead OpenText’s Global Change Management Framework, establishing consistent standards, governance, escalation protocols, and decision\-making practices.
* Create a comprehensive Change Playbook with practical templates, readiness assessments, implementation checklists, and transition tools.
* Build, develop, and lead a small team of change management experts, establishing clear roles, regional coverage, and scalable ways of working.
* Serve as the central coordination point across senior leadership, business leaders, and functional partners, aligning responsibilities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Lead cross\-functional steering groups, drive accountability for commitments, and proactively escalate risks and issues.
* Partner with Corporate Communications and HR to develop integrated change and communication plans, including executive announcements, FAQs, and employee transition updates.
* Lead change planning for office openings, closures, consolidations, relocations, and internal team moves.
* Coordinate employee readiness activities with construction, technology, security, facilities, and operational schedules.
* Establish feedback channels, readiness assessments, and post\-transition reviews that improve employee adoption and future change programs.
* Identify and mitigate organizational, operational, and communication risks while supporting contingency planning and business continuity.
* Maintain a global change dashboard, define meaningful KPIs, and provide regular progress and performance reporting to executive leadership.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Communications, Real Estate, or a related discipline.
* 10 or more years of experience in change management, enterprise transformation, corporate real estate, or a related field, including leadership of complex global programs.
* Demonstrated experience establishing enterprise change frameworks, governance models, and scalable change management practices.
* Proven ability to build and lead a high\-performing team of change professionals.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive accountability without direct reporting authority.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives across multiple regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A strategic and employee\-focused approach, balanced with strong operational discipline and attention to execution.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and project management platforms.
* Familiarity with Power BI is an asset.
* Prosci, PMP, or an equivalent change management or project management certification is considered an asset.


ONE LAST THING
  
  

OpenText is more than just a corporation. It is a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. This is an opportunity to establish a global Change Office, influence enterprise\-wide transformation, and create a consistent, employee\-focused approach to how significant change is planned, communicated, and delivered.

We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.

Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.

What You'll Build

The Data and Applied Science team will build the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following:

Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets.
Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers.
Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes.
Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement.
Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems.
Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets.
Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready.

jobs.title: Vice President, Security & IT Operations
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Vice President, Security and IT Operations is responsible for establishing and leading Lassonde’s North American shared services function for infrastructure, IT operations, end-user support and cybersecurity. The incumbent will unify Canadian and US teams, tools and processes into one operating model, with one service desk, one set of service levels and one security posture across our 19 plants and offices.

This is a foundational executive role responsible for defining the strategy, operating model and governance required to support business growth, manufacturing modernization and enterprise technology transformation, while strengthening cybersecurity, operational resilience and risk management, while serving as a strategic partner to the Executive Leadership Team and business leaders. The successful candidate will also provide trusted counsel on cybersecurity, operational resilience and technology risk to the Audit Committee, the Board and our insurers.

Job advantages

A competitive salary with opportunities for advancement and career development.
Access to a group insurance plan & a pension plan with employer contributions.
Telemedicine & employee and family assistance programs.
Recognition & wellness programs for employees.

Key activities

Strategy And Stakeholder Engagement

Define the North American cybersecurity and IT operations strategy and multi-year roadmap in collaboration with the CIO.
Partner with functional leaders to understand their priorities and offer secure, practical solutions.
Own a single cybersecurity scorecard, and report on cyber risk, maturity and program progress.
Own the cyber insurance relationship, including renewals and the evidence underwriters require, and respond to customer security assessments.

Operating Model And Leadership

Stand up one North American Security and IT Operations shared services function: charter, operating model, RACI, service catalogue and KPIs.
Bring the Canadian and US teams together under one leadership, one way of working and one set of standards.
Recruit, develop and lead a team across infrastructure, network, cloud, IT service management, end-user support, security operations and identity.
Manage the function’s budget, vendor strategy and sourcing model, including managed services, security operations centre (SOC) and incident response partners, and consolidate contracts and tools across Canada and the US.

Infrastructure, Cloud And IT Operations

Own the North American infrastructure estate across plants, distribution centres and offices.
Define and execute the infrastructure roadmap to ensure the modernization, harmonization and evolution of the organization’s technology capabilities.
Ensure plant connectivity and infrastructure deliver the availability manufacturing requires, and are ready for plant digitalization, IoT and AI workloads.
Manage capacity, performance, lifecycle and cost, including cloud consumption and FinOps practices.
Run one North American service desk on one ITSM platform to ensure efficient and consistent service.
Establish ITIL-based incident, problems, change, request and asset management, with monitoring, automation and AI-assisted.
Deliver a consistent employee technology experience across North America.
Publish service levels the business can hold IT to, and report performance on a regular scorecard.
Provide 24/7 support coverage for manufacturing operations.
Organize field and site support to deliver reliable, responsive service across all locations and support the adoption of new tools and technologies throughout the organization, with service available in both English and French.

Cybersecurity, Operational Technology Security & Operational Resilience

Lead the security program, continuously assessing maturity, establishing a realistic target state, and strengthening the organization’s security posture.
Lead identity and access management, the 24/7 managed security operations centre (SOC), vulnerability and patch management, and security awareness for all employees.
Embed secure-by-design practices in transformation programs, cloud adoption and AI initiatives, and use AI for defence within the company’s AI governance.
Lead the OT cybersecurity program across our plants in partnership with Manufacturing and Operations: asset inventory, IT/OT network segmentation, OT monitoring and aligned controls.
Lead IT/OT network segmentation initiatives that enable plant digitalization, connected technologies and manufacturing modernization while protecting production uptime and operational safety.
Secure third-party and vendor remote access to plant networks.
Strengthen the organization’s resilience to limit the impact of cyber incidents and preserve operational continuity across all manufacturing sites.
Own one North American incident response model, including playbooks, out-of-band communications and crisis coordination with stakeholders.
Run recurring tabletop exercises with executives and teams, and drive their recommendations to completion.

Risk, Compliance And Trust

Lead cybersecurity and data protection components of regulatory obligation and compliance requirements in collaboration with key stakeholders.
Lead, in partnership with Legal, Privacy, Finance and Internal Audit, the cybersecurity and data protection aspects of the organization’s regulatory and compliance obligations, including IT general controls for financial reporting.
Manage third-party and supplier security risk and emerging threats, including AI-enabled fraud.
Ensure audit readiness and provide clear, reliable evidence for internal and external audits.

Required Training And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (computer science, engineering, information security or related field); an advanced degree (MBA, MSc or equivalent) is preferred.
CISSP, CISM or equivalent security certification preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, operations and cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role, and a meaningful portion in manufacturing, CPG or food and beverage.
Proven leadership of OT and plant-floor security across multiple industrial sites.
Proven track record building or transforming an infrastructure, IT operations and security function across multi-site, multi-country operations, ideally including Canada and the US, including consolidating service desks, tools and teams into one shared services model.
Experience leading the response to major cybersecurity incidents and running tabletop exercises with executive teams.
Experience operating in a publicly traded environment, including IT general controls, audit readiness, cyber insurance and reporting to an Audit Committee or Board.
Deep working knowledge of security frameworks (CIS Controls v8, NIST CSF, IEC 62443), security operations (managed SOC, SIEM, EDR, SOAR), identity and privileged access management, cloud and network security, and OT/ICS security.
Deep working knowledge of infrastructure, hybrid cloud, networks and IT service management (ITIL) in a 24/7 manufacturing environment, and current on emerging threats.

Skills sought

Bilingual (French/English), both written and spoken – essential for communication with English-speaking colleagues, clients, and suppliers across provinces and internationally.
A business-minded approach to security, with the ability to calibrate risk to the organization’s maturity and communicate complex trade-propose pragmatic solutions.
Executive presence and credibility to brief the Audit Committee, the Board, insurers and customers on cyber risk.
Leadership grounded in respect and trust, with the ability to build cohesive, engaged teams across two countries and work constructively with internal teams and external partners.
Calm, decisive leadership during incidents, crises and high-pressure situations.
Demonstrated ability to establish a new function, recruit and develop talent, and operate effectively in environments where structure and processes are still being built.
Demonstrated change leadership in complex organizations.
Strong knowledge of governance, compliance and privacy frameworks applicable in Canada and the United States, including Quebec Law 25, PIPEDA, U.S. state privacy regimes, and IT general control requirements.

Specific Conditions Regarding The Position

Based in Rougemont, with regular presence at offices and plants.
Ability and willingness to travel within Canada and the United States as required by the business.
Availability to lead the response to major security incidents and crisis situations outside regular business hours.

About Lassonde

At Lassonde, we believe that great achievements begin with passionate people working together toward a common goal.

For more than 100 years, we have been creating products that are part of the everyday lives of millions of consumers across North America. Behind our fruit juices, drinks and snacks, sauces, soups, broths, ciders and wines is a team of people who innovate, collaborate, and continuously strive to deliver the best for our customers and communities.

What sets us apart is our ability to grow while staying true to who we are. Today, more than 2,900 employees contribute to our success across Canada and the United States, in an environment where ideas are valued, talent is developed, and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Joining Lassonde means becoming part of a strong and ambitious organization that puts people at the heart of its success and is building the future with confidence, passion, and teamwork.

Together, we create products people love. Together, we make an impact that can be felt every day.

We thank all applicants for their interest in our company. Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted, however, we will retain all resumes on file for future opportunities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Indero has retained Pender & Howe to lead the recruitment initiative for their Vice President, Medical Affairs position.

For consideration, please email a copy of your CV in confidence to: Céline Chabée, Partner, celine.chabee@penderhowe.com or Oliver Kuehm, Associate Director, Executive Search, oliver.kuehm@penderhowe.com

The Vice President, Medical Affairs
is a newly defined executive mandate created to bring Indero's Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance (PV) functions under unified, senior physician leadership as the organization scales across a growing therapeutic and geographic footprint. This is a broader mandate than a Medical Monitoring leadership role: it carries P&L accountability for both functions, a direct hand in business development and client-facing bid defense, and a seat at the Operational Leadership Team table advising the Chief Medical & Scientific Officer (CMSO) on medical, scientific, and safety risk across the trial portfolio.

As Indero's study footprint extends from North America and Europe into Asia Pacific, this role will be central to ensuring medical and safety standards scale consistently with the organization's growth. Reporting to the Executive and leading the Global, Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance function, the VP will set strategic direction for both functions - from physician resourcing and medical monitoring SOPs to PV case processing, signal detection,aggregate reporting, and regulatory inspection readiness, while safeguarding the safety of trial participants, the integrity of clinical data, and the quality of every deliverable the organization produces. Because the two functions sit at different points in a trial's lifecycle but share a single safety and quality lens, the role calls for a leader equally comfortable adjudicating a complex protocol-level medical decision and defending a PV inspection finding to a health authority.

This is a global team of roughly 20 across Medical Monitoring, Pharmacovigilance, and medical project operations, with three functional leaders reporting directly to the VP. The role also carries meaningful external accountability.

The VP will partner with Business Development and Proposals on RFP responses and full-service Medical Affairs engagements, participate directly in client presentations and bid defenses, and serve as the senior medical point of contact for key sponsor accounts -- work that puts the VP's scientific credibility and executive presence in front of the clients Indero is working to win and retain.

This opportunity will appeal to a physician executive who has already led and scaled a Medical Monitoring or Pharmacovigilance function inside a CRO or pharmaceutical organization, who is comfortable owning a budget and revenue targets alongside patient safety and quality outcomes, and who wants a genuine seat at the table shaping Indero's next chapter of growth.

Responsibilities

﻿Strategic Leadership & Division Management

Partner with the CMSO to develop and execute the long-term strategic vision for the Medical
Affairs division, aligned with Indero's overall growth strategy and competitive positioning in
the CRO marketplace.
Own the operating budget and P&L for the Medical Monitoring and Pharmacovigilance
functions, ensuring financial discipline, resource optimization, and delivery against revenue
and margin targets.
Build short- and long-term capability roadmaps for Medical Monitoring and
Pharmacovigilance that keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements, sponsor needs,
and industry best practice.
Champion a culture of scientific excellence, patient safety, operational rigor, and continuous
quality improvement across Medical Affairs.
Represent Medical Affairs at the Operational Leadership Team level, serving as a key advisor
to the CMSO on medical, scientific, and safety risk matters.
Drive cross-divisional collaboration with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics,
Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Scientific Affairs and Business Development to ensure
integrated program delivery.

Medical Monitoring Oversight

Provide executive oversight of all medical monitoring activity across Indero's clinical trial portfolio, spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
Ensure medical monitoring teams deliver high-quality, protocol-compliant medical oversight.
Maintain and evolve Indero's medical monitoring model to meet diverse client needs and therapeutic complexity.
Lead physician resourcing strategy, including hiring, training, deployment, and performance management.
Ensure Medical Monitoring SOPs, work instructions, and quality standards are maintained, reviewed, and compliant with applicable regulatory guidelines.
Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk medical monitoring issues, including protocol-related medical decisions, safety signal identification, and sponsor-facing medical disputes.

Pharmacovigilance Oversight

Provide strategic and operational oversight of the PV function, ensuring robust, audit-ready systems for case processing, signal detection, aggregate reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Ensure the organization meets its pharmacovigilance obligations across global jurisdictions and country-specific PV legislation.
Oversee preparation and quality review of aggregate safety reports to meet sponsor and regulatory deadlines with accuracy and scientific integrity.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Content Strategy
jobs.description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.

At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.

If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.

About The Role

As we expand our Marketing Services practice, we are seeking an Associate Director, Content Strategy: a senior, client-facing content strategist who can lead enterprise content programs across discovery, design, build, migration, governance, AI search, personalization, and performance.

This role sits within the Marketing Services team and reports to the VP, Content Strategy. The Associate Director will help turn content strategy from a project deliverable into a governed content system that fuels discoverability, relevance, and measurable business impact across human and AI-driven journeys.

The ideal candidate is strategic and hands-on. They know how to build content strategy into complex digital programs, integrate it with design, technology, analytics, SEO, AI search, and personalization, and produce polished client-ready deliverables. They must also be AI fluent and ready to build practical solutions using AI tools, not simply experiment with them.

Verndale is fully remote enabled. This position can be remote, with a preference for candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities

Lead content strategy workstreams across discovery, design, build, migration, and optimization programs.
Oversee and execute editorial content strategy, including content inventories, content assessments, transformation strategy, message planning, and editorial planning.
Oversee and execute UX content strategy, including content audits, gap analyses, taxonomies, content hierarchies, copy planning, and content planning for design and migration.
Oversee and execute delivery content strategy, including content matrices, governance models, workflows, guidelines, migration support, and authoring guidance.
Facilitate client workshops, stakeholder interviews, content working sessions, and alignment meetings that connect content decisions to business goals and audience needs.
Present polished deliverables, recommendations, project updates, and decision points to marketing, digital, technology, and executive stakeholders.
Design content approaches that support AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, personalization, site search, related content, filtering, and content reuse.
Develop structured, governed, machine-readable content strategies, including taxonomy, metadata, schema guidance, content models, prompt-ready source content, and reuse patterns.
Use AI tools to improve content inventories, audits, gap analyses, taxonomy exploration, migration mapping, content QA, prompt testing, answer testing, and content performance review.
Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, prompts, QA routines, documentation, and review protocols that improve speed and quality without sacrificing judgment, accuracy, or governance.
Influence the pilot, adoption, and improvement of content-related AI tools in partnership with Strategy, SEO and AI, Personalization, Analytics, Experience Design, and Technology teams.
Help clients understand where AI can improve content operations, where human review is required, and how to govern AI-enabled content workflows responsibly.
Define and improve content lifecycle processes across planning, creation, review, approval, publishing, optimization, maintenance, and retirement.
Set content quality standards, review criteria, performance indicators, and documentation practices that can be used consistently across programs.
Identify process gaps, quality risks, content ownership issues, and workflow blockers, then recommend practical improvements.
Create content governance models that clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, approval paths, editorial standards, and maintenance cadences.
Support compliance-aware content processes for clients in regulated, brand-sensitive, or multi-stakeholder environments.
Use analytics and performance data to assess content effectiveness and inform future content planning, optimization, and governance decisions
Develop taxonomies, metadata models, tagging strategies, and structured data approaches that help power navigation, search, personalization, content relationships, and reporting.
Guide information architecture work including navigation strategy, sitemaps, content hierarchy, page-level content planning, and content inputs for wireframes and visual design.
Lead content migration strategy, including inventories, keep/edit/kill analysis, migration mapping, content matrices, content models, authoring requirements, and migration readiness.
Help establish repeatable methods and level-of-effort guidance for taxonomy, information architecture, and migration work so these activities can be scoped and delivered consistently.
Partner with Business Development, Client Services, and Practice Leads to shape content strategy solutions for proposals, pitch meetings, and active accounts.
Scope and estimate content strategy activities across discovery, redesign, migration, AI search, personalization, content operations, and optimization programs.
Contribute to packaged content strategy offerings, delivery standards, internal templates, case studies, POVs, and thought leadership.
Serve as a senior content strategy voice on strategic accounts and as an escalation point for content strategy delivery and quality.
Help identify opportunities to grow content strategy revenue within broader Marketing Services and Experience engagements.
Coach cross-functional teammates on content strategy methods, client facilitation, deliverable quality, and content decision-making.
Create enablement materials that help internal teams understand content strategy, AI-ready content, taxonomy, migration, and governance.
Lead through example, advocacy, and mentoring while supporting a collaborative, high-performing team culture.
Help build fluency in AI-assisted content workflows across the practice, including prompt development, source evaluation, quality review, and responsible tool use.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, content operations, digital strategy, or a closely related discipline.
3+ years of experience leading workstreams, mentoring content strategists, enabling cross-functional teams, or guiding client stakeholders.
Deep experience across editorial content strategy, UX content strategy, delivery content strategy, content governance, and content operations.
Strong knowledge of digital redesigns, platform implementations, CMS programs, content migrations, and enterprise digital transformation activities.
Experience with content management systems and digital platforms such as Sitecore, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentstack, Drupal, WordPress, or similar systems.
Demonstrated ability to create taxonomies, metadata models, content models, information architecture inputs, content matrices, migration plans, and governance documentation.
AI fluency, including practical experience using generative AI and LLM-based tools to support content strategy, content operations, research synthesis, content QA, taxonomy development, migration planning, and optimization.
Readiness to build AI-assisted tools and workflows, including reusable prompts, review protocols, QA checklists, source-of-truth practices, and team enablement materials.
Working knowledge of how content strategy supports AI Search, AEO, GEO, site search, personalization, structured content, and measurable experience performance.
Experience defining content quality standards, performance measures, review criteria, and lifecycle processes for complex content programs.
Comfort using analytics, search data, content performance data, and qualitative research to inform recommendations.
Proven ability to facilitate workshops, lead client conversations, influence stakeholders, and present executive-ready recommendations.
Experience scoping and estimating content strategy work for proposals, statements of work, and active engagements.
Strong writing, storytelling, documentation, and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in an agency, consulting, enterprise, healthcare, financial services, higher education, or other complex stakeholder environment preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Digital Strategy, UX, Information Science, or a related field preferred, or commensurate experience

Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale

We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients’ complex business problems through technology, data, and design.
We foster a culture that enables every person in the organization to do the best work of their career.
We offer regular training and professional development to move careers forward.
Client and employee satisfaction are our two most important business metrics.
We celebrate and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion.
We offer generous paid company holidays, vacation, and paid sick time to every employee starting on day one.
We offer top-of-the-line Health Insurance, plus monthly perks customized to meet individual employees’ needs.
We support a healthy work/life balance.
We are fully remote enabled and embrace the evolving definition of the workplace

Verndale is proud of the fun, diverse, and respectful company environment we enjoy on a daily basis. jobs.description:
Role Impact:

The Director, Lease Administration & Revenue Services provides leadership and operational oversight for the organization’s financial systems (Yardi/Voyager). This role acts as the primary custodian of lease data integrity, execution level “lease-to-cash” automations, and the end to end recovery reconciliation processes. Focusing on portfolio execution and compliance, the Director establishes internal audit frameworks, manages the “Precedent lease” library, and builds institutional knowledge through standard operating procedures. By delivering executive-ready operational dashboards and leading due diligence for new property acquisitions, the Director partners closely with Legal, Leasing, and Property Operations to manage account receivable escalations, and eliminate recovery leakage.

What you will deliver:

Lead and mentor Managers and Analysts providing services to the business in Lease Administration and Revenue Services. Foster a culture of excellence by setting KPIs and performance standards for both direct and indirect reports.
Drive the adoption of new technologies and methodologies (eg: automation of lease review, recovery workbook, components of deal manager reporting). Act as the primary change agent for inter-departmental policy shifts that impact lease administration and data flow.
Identify and implement "Lease-to-Cash" automation to reduce manual errors and shorten the billing-to-collection cycle.
Partner with Legal, Leasing and Property Operations to consult on standard lease language, ensuring operational feasibility, minimizing landlord financial exposure and maintaining accounts receivable per company objectives.
Develop and maintain good working relationships with our clients to help ensure rent is collected and disputes are resolved on a timely basis.
Serve as the functional Lead for Yardi/CF Voyager/Deal Manager, overseeing system architecture, validations, and the integration of new modules.
Identify and implement automation opportunities within the recovery and billing cycles to reduce manual intervention and error rates.
Oversee the creation and maintenance of sophisticated training curricula and system "Standard Operating Procedures" (SOPs) to ensure institutional knowledge remains current
Architect and oversee the annual and monthly recovery process, ensuring complex, multi-layered property expenses are reconciled accurately and in accordance with diverse lease structures.
Lead the Lease Administration portion of the due diligence process for new property acquisitions, identifying "hidden" financial shortfalls and ensuring seamless data migration into Yardi.
Establish and monitor a robust internal audit framework. Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors, ensuring 100% compliance with certification processes and financial controls.
Maintain the "Precedent Lease" library and advise on major tenant negotiations to ensure consistency in language and financial treatment across the portfolio.
Design and deliver high-level executive-ready dashboards and reporting packages that provide visibility into leasing velocity, recovery leakage, and operational bottlenecks.
Oversee advanced escalation protocols for Accounts Receivable to proactively address defaults and prevent portfolio-wide AR growth.
Manage recovery accuracy for complex structures (CAM, Tax, Insurance) in accordance with diverse lease terms.
Partner with Legal, Leasing and Property Operations to advise on major tenant queries that may have significant financial implications for the Landlord.

What your strengths are:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to influence and partner with Senior Leadership
High degree of tact and diplomacy when handling sensitive tenant disputes or internal departmental misalignments.
Ability to manage high-pressure deadlines and large-scale projects (e.g., system migrations or year-end reconciliations) without compromising accuracy.
Demonstrated ability to make high-stakes financial decisions and interpret complex lease clauses that have significant bottom-line implications.
Sophisticated problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights.

What you need to succeed:

University degree in Business, Commerce, or Law. Advanced certifications in either CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant), RPM (Real Property Administrator) or CPM (Certified Property Manager).
Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Property Management and Lease Administration.
Minimum of 5–7 years in a Senior Manager position or leadership capacity with a proven track record of managing management-level reports.
Expert-level mastery of the Real Estate industry and commercial leasing life cycles.
Deep understanding of accounting principles and practices as they relate to CAM and Tax recoveries.
Advanced proficiency in the interpretation of complex lease documents and legal terminology.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel/Word) and Yardi/Voyager (CTI/Voyager).

jobs.title: Senior Director, Growth Marketing SVOD
jobs.description:
TELLING CAPTIVATING STORIES TO AUDIENCES EVERYWHERE
  
**Blue Ant Media (TSX:** BAMI) is an international streamer, production studio, advertising sales and rights\-management business. The company operates a diverse portfolio of free streaming and pay TV channels internationally, including Love Nature, Cottage Life, Smithsonian Channel Canada, BBC Earth Canada, HauntTV, Homeful, and Love Pets, as well as the subscription streaming service MagellanTV. Its studio business produces and distributes a wide range of premium content across key genres for streaming and broadcast platforms worldwide. Blue Ant Media is headquartered in Toronto, with a presence in Los Angeles, New York, Miami, Singapore, London, Washington, Sydney, Halifax, and Ottawa. blueantmedia.com⼁Instagram⼁LinkedIn
  
Our employees are passionate experts in all of our business areas. They are fanatical about creating outstanding content and experiences, and about delivering them on new and evolving platforms. We actively seek new employees who embody our core values. We want them to think big, act with purpose, celebrate creativity, do the right thing, respect one another, and succeed together. We attract creative talents who are optimistic about the evolving future of content and who take pride in recognizing opportunities where others see challenges. At Blue Ant Media, we give them the flexibility to think like entrepreneurs, take ownership of their projects, take risks, and embrace innovation in a rapidly evolving media landscape. Our team members excel at collaborating with internal and external partners by building trusting, respectful working relationships.
  
  

Senior Director, Growth Marketing, SVOD
  
Blue Ant Media is looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded and performance\-driven Senior Marketing Director to lead performance marketing across the business.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a growth\-oriented marketing leader to help accelerate our SVOD growth, primarily in the US, while supporting expansion into new international markets and lines of business.
  
The Senior Director, Growth Marketing will own the end\-to\-end marketing function, with a mandate to drive subscriber acquisition, define and optimize marketing investment, improve customer conversion and maximize subscriber lifetime value. This role will oversee the full subscriber marketing funnel, from awareness and acquisition through conversion, engagement, retention and winback.
  
**We are looking for a true performance marketing expert:** someone who is exceptionally analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and passionate about translating insights into measurable business results. They will bring a test\-and\-learn mindset, a deep understanding of digital acquisition and subscription economics, and the ability to balance short\-term performance with sustainable long\-term growth.
  
While performance marketing is at the heart of this role, experience developing brands and building integrated marketing strategies will be a valuable asset.
  
This new role will report to the SVP, Marketing, Consumer Brands and is a hybrid position requiring in\-office attendance at our head office in Toronto for a minimum of three (3\) days per week.
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000 per year, with final compensation determined by experience and qualifications.
  
Core Responsibilities \& Duties
  
Growth and Performance Marketing
  
* Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy and growth plan, with subscriber growth and revenue as primary objectives.
* Own the subscriber acquisition strategy, driving efficient and scalable growth through paid media, digital channels and other acquisition opportunities.
* Establish and manage key performance metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), subscriber lifetime value (LTV), retention and churn.
* Drive continuous optimization of marketing investment, ensuring budgets are allocated to the channels, audiences and campaigns delivering the strongest business results.
* Identify opportunities to improve the full acquisition funnel, from initial engagement through trial, subscription conversion and ongoing customer value.
* Lead a rigorous test\-and\-learn approach across creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages, offers, channels and campaign strategies.
* Use data, analytics and customer insights to identify growth opportunities, understand performance drivers and inform strategic decisions.


Customer Journey, Engagement and Retention
  
* Oversee the customer lifecycle marketing strategy, ensuring a cohesive and effective journey from prospect to subscriber to loyal customer.
* Drive the development and optimization of CRM initiatives, including email and push notifications, to improve conversion, engagement, retention and reactivation.
* Leverage customer segmentation, behavioural insights and performance data to deliver relevant, personalized communications.
* Identify opportunities to reduce subscriber churn, increase engagement and maximize customer lifetime value.
* Ensure acquisition and lifecycle marketing strategies work together to deliver sustainable subscriber growth.


Marketing Strategy and Brand Development
  
* Develop a cohesive marketing strategy that supports positioning, audience growth and commercial objectives.
* Ensure brand strategy, creative development and campaign messaging are informed by audience insights and performance data.
* Partner with internal programming, creative, product and commercial teams to develop compelling campaigns that drive awareness, consideration and subscription.
* Identify opportunities to build brand awareness and strengthen our competitive position in the US streaming market.
* Support the development and execution of marketing strategies for new international markets, adapting channel mix, audience targeting and messaging to local market dynamic

jobs.title: Head of Data & Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
Department IT
Location Montreal
At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a growing company, a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment?


We are looking for a **Head of Data \& Business Intelligence** to join our Data \& Business Intelligence team. This position reports to the **Director of Software Development Unit – Internal Tools.**


As Head of Data \& Business Intelligence, you will drive the technical data vision and strategy for the entire organization. A deeply technical leader, you will have an in\-depth command of the systems, architecture, and automations that power our data. Your role will be to keep growing the strategic value of our data, maintaining alignment between our technological capabilities and business objectives. You will act as a key leader in the continued evolution of our culture and practices, connecting technical teams and leadership.


### **Your day\-to\-day**


* **Define the strategic vision:** Develop and drive the roadmap for data architecture, technology, and warehousing
* **Champion data culture:** Promote the importance of data quality, standardize definitions, and implement clear processes to shift the organization toward a predictive approach
* **Guide and unify teams:** Lead, mentor, and ensure effective collaboration between local and remote data teams, prioritizing high\-impact business initiatives
* **Ensure technical excellence:** Oversee the design of a reliable and high\-performing data ecosystem, while directly contributing (approximately 30%) to the design of systems, architectures, and automations to stay connected to ground\-level realities
* **Agentic leadership:** Guide a team already working with agentic development as it migrates our processes onto our in\-house agentic platform, putting in place what makes those automations trustworthy: validation, observability, guardrails, and governance
### **Your qualifications**


* Over 10 years of experience in data, business intelligence, and analytics, including team management
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business objectives into a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap
* Strong leadership experience, with a talent for mentoring, change management, and aligning multidisciplinary teams, including data science and data engineering
* Proficiency in data architecture concepts (Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, ETL/ELT, streaming, Pub/Sub) and Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* In\-depth command of systems and architecture concepts, with the ability to design end\-to\-end solutions and assess their robustness
* Mastery of agentic development and automated software production pipelines (agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, guardrails), and a proven ability to lead a team working this way
* Ability to build well\-founded trust in automated systems: measuring their reliability, understanding their limits, and keeping human judgment where it matters
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
* Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken, with strong spoken fluency in both languages
### **Nice\-to\-haves**


* Hands\-on experience managing the merger of technology stacks and teams
* Knowledge of data ecosystems and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Apache Beam, DBT, Google Cloud Dataflow, Tableau, etc.)
* Experience with the advertising data industry (SSAI, SSP, DSP)
* Ability to design business intelligence strategies tailored to different business models (e.g., subscription services, advertising)
* Knowledge of various programming and database languages (Python, Java, Rust, SQL, etc.)
### **The Team You Will Join**


* A technical Data \& Business Intelligence team of 8 people, including a technical lead and a project manager in Montreal
* Collaboration with a remote data science team \& a remote data engineering team
* Collaborative work with leaders across the entire company
### **Life at Stingray**


* A cool office in Montreal with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays
* Stingray café with breakfasts, lunches and snacks offered every day
* A subsidy for your OPUS card to make your commutes easier
* Shares purchase plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
* Full access to the Dialogue virtual healthcare platform
* Free fitness classes offered weekly
* Access to private consultations on nutrition and wellness
* Free language classes, training and access to the latest AI technologies and platforms to boost your productivity and creativity
* Summer hours
* Milestones celebrated with our loyalty program
* 5@7 and vibrant social events
* And much more!
We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.


Montreal\-based Stingray Group is a leading music, media and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. Our offices are located in the **Old Port of Montreal** just minutes from the Lachine Canal bike path, a prime location for picnics or a jog at lunch time.


Stingray supports the principles of Employment Equity and is committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve and in which we operate. Women, Aboriginal peoples, persons with disabilities and visible minorities are encouraged to apply and to self\-identify so we can work towards full representation of those groups within our company.

jobs.title: President
jobs.description:
Serv, a global executive recruitment partner, is hiring on behalf of our client ZEN Residential for a President.

Join the Team
Netflix didn’t build a better video store. FedEx didn’t build a faster delivery truck. They changed the operating model underneath an old industry. ZEN Residential is doing the same to residential property management.

Residential buildings are still run the way they were decades ago: a generalist on site doing a little of everything, and costs that rise with every door added. Owners pay for that inefficiency, and residents feel it.

ZEN Residential is a fee-based residential property management and brokerage company with roots back to 1991. We manage approximately 6,500 multifamily doors, from new high-rise and low-rise buildings to vintage walk-ups, across Edmonton, Calgary, Saskatoon and Regina. Our clients are institutional and private-equity owners, private family investment funds and developers.

We are rebuilding property management from the ground up as an AI-first, centralized operating model: one front door for every resident and owner, specialist teams behind it, and lean teams in the field. AI and automation take on the repetitive work, so our people spend their time on judgment, relationships and results. Every decision runs on data.

Technology is how we get there, not an end in itself. AI, automation and data are enablers of operational excellence, client service and profitability. They support sound business judgment and personal relationships; they don’t replace them.

The design is complete, the leadership team is in place, and the rollout begins in 2027. The ambition is national.

Why this is an exciting opportunity: Few people get to rebuild the operating model of an entire industry. This role starts with more than three decades of client relationships, a model already designed and a leadership team ready to execute, and it comes with the mandate to take ZEN across Canada. It is not a caretaker role and it is not a turnaround. It is the chance to turn a new model into a system that scales. If you want to build the company that changes an industry, rather than defend the old way of doing things, this is the role.

To learn more please visit: zenresidential.ca

Position Responsibilities
The President leads ZEN Residential day to day and reports to the Board of Directors. The role exists to turn ZEN’s new AI-first, centralized model into a disciplined, repeatable operating system, and to scale it.

The President owns execution: leading the leadership team, owning the P&L, growing profitability, and building the playbook that lets ZEN open new markets and absorb new portfolios the same way every time. As ZEN’s founder moves from running the business to chairing the Board, the President becomes the company’s most senior executive. There is no CEO or CFO role: the President leads the leadership team, which includes the Vice President, Marketing, Leasing & Revenue Growth; Director, Client Relations; Director, Maintenance & Procurement; Director, People & Culture; Director, Business Development & Growth; and the Controller.

This role includes:
Running the business and owning the P&L: build the annual operating plan and budget with the Board, then deliver or exceed it, with clear spending authority to run the business. Grow EBITDA and margin as the portfolio grows.
Rolling out the AI-first, centralized model: lead the 2027 rollout across all four markets, on time and on budget, with measured gains in service, speed and cost per door.
Building the ZEN operating system: turn the model into a franchise-grade playbook of standard processes, roles, training and KPIs, so every building, market and new portfolio is run the same way and delivers the same result.
Putting AI to work across operations: personally lead the use of AI and automation in leasing, resident and owner service, maintenance, finance and reporting, and hold every leader accountable for measured efficiency gains.
Leading through measurement: run the company on a scorecard of clear KPIs and accountabilities, and lead the leadership team through real change.
Leading sales and business development: own ZEN’s business development strategy, lead ZEN’s larger deals as the face of the company, and build a disciplined sales organization, with clear targets for gross new doors, net door growth and recurring management revenue, and new contracts that meet our pricing and profitability standards.
Driving profitable growth: retain and grow ZEN’s client base, build strong relationships with institutional owners, developers and private investors, absorb new portfolios, and prepare the business to expand into new markets across Canada.
Building the team: lead, develop and hold accountable a leadership team of A-players, and build bench strength so the business never depends on one person.

Qualifications
Required
A proven track record of building and operating businesses with full P&L accountability, and of growing their profitability, whether as a founder, owner-operator, franchisor, multi-unit franchisee or business-unit leader.
Franchise-grade operating discipline: you have built or run a systematized, multi-location business where the same outcome is delivered the same way everywhere, through operating manuals, standards, training and unit-level KPIs.
A record of scaling a multi-site service business, including opening new locations, markets or territories, or integrating acquired operations.
A commercially driven operator: a proven record of growing revenue, managing people, building scalable systems and delivering strong financial performance.
A track record of building and leading a sales or business development function, including strategy, pipeline, conversion and targets.
AI is table stakes. You use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and similar) every day in your own work, you build tools and workflows with it to make work more efficient, and you can show how you used it to improve operating processes in a business you led. Understanding AI in theory is not enough; ZEN’s senior leaders use it every day.
Demonstrated experience leading technology-enabled business transformation with measurable results.
A history of leading through measurement (scorecards, KPIs and clear accountability) and of leading an organization through significant change.
Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, pricing and reporting to owners or a board. As there is no CFO, you will be the senior financial leader, supported by ZEN’s Controller.
Eligible to work in Canada and based in, or willing to relocate to, Edmonton or Calgary.

Preferred
Experience in real estate, property management, hospitality or another high-volume service business. Industry experience is an asset, not a requirement.
Experience running a business on EOS (the Entrepreneurial Operating System) or a similar operating framework.
Experience with private-equity, institutional or family-office owners, or reporting to a board.
Experience in Alberta and Saskatchewan.
A real estate broker’s licence, or the willingness to obtain one. An asset, not a requirement.

Our Ideal Teammate Is Someone Who:
Is proactive and accountable
Thinks strategically and executes consistently
Communicates with clarity and confidence
Brings a positive, growth-oriented mindset
Is highly organized and dependable
Embraces learning and feedback
Cares deeply about doing great work

What matters most at ZEN:
A builder of systems. You would rather design the repeatable way of doing something than do it yourself a hundred times.
An owner, not an administrator. You see what the business needs, bring the Board a recommendation, and own the result.
Commercially driven. You grow revenue, win clients and protect margin, and you hold a sales team to its numbers.
AI every day. You use AI daily and build tools with it. You don’t talk about AI; you use it.
Numbers-driven. You know your unit economics and you hold people to measurable outcomes.
Willing to challenge. You push back on the Board, the founder and your own team when the facts say so, and it lands.
A developer of A-players. You hire people better than you, set a high bar and act quickly when someone isn’t meeting it.
Integrity without exception. We look after our clients’ assets and money and our residents’ homes. Trust is the business.

Hiring Process
We take our hiring process seriously and evaluate candidates based on both capability and culture fit. Our goal is to ensure you step into a role where you feel genuinely excited and fulfilled. That’s important for you, and it’s equally important for us. Below is a snapshot of what you can expect throughout our hiring process.
Please note that steps may vary slightly depending on the position.
Initial video interview with the Serv recruitment team.
Video interview with Zen Residential’s HR Director of People & Culture
Video interview with Zen Residential leadership
Final selection and offer

Location: Edmonton, Alberta (preferred) or Calgary, Alberta. In-office, with travel to ZEN’s markets in Calgary, Edmonton, Saskatoon and Regina.

Salary: Starting at $260,000 CAD base salary, plus an annual performance bonus equal to 20% of the growth in company profit.

All enquiries are handled in confidence through Serv.

Serv uses AI tools in our recruitment process, including developing job postings and note-taking during interviews. AI is not used to screen, assess, or select candidates. All resumes are reviewed by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. Any AI-generated output used during the recruitment process is reviewed by a human before action is taken.

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As VP of Growth Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

About CSPC:

The Canadian Science Policy Centre (CSPC) , established in 2009, is a non-profit, non-partisan organization, operating as a national HUB dedicated to fostering connectivity, building capacity in science and innovation policy in Canada. CSPC envisions a dynamic and inclusive science, technology, and innovation (STI) policy ecosystem that maximizes Canada’s socio-economic potential for all Canadians. 

VISION:
An interconnected, dynamic, and inclusive science, technology, and innovation policy ecosystem that unlocks Canada’s full socio-economic potential for the benefit of all Canadians.

MISSION:
CSPC’s mission is to serve as an inclusive and national hub that connects sectors, regions, and communities, mobilizes and disseminates knowledge, and develops human competencies in pursuit of a more effective and efficient STI policy ecosystem

Website: https://sciencepolicy.ca

As CSPC continues to expand its national reach and programming, we are seeking an experienced and highly organized Director of Programs and Operations to lead the execution and delivery of our growing portfolio of activities.

Position Overview:

jobs.description:
Start Date: ASAP

Work Model: Hybrid

Location: Downtown Toronto

(outside Union Station – TTC & GO accessible)

Dress Code: Business Casual A Great Place to Work

Who We Are

Founded in 1993, Kinross is a Canadian-based senior gold mining company with operations and projects in the United States, Brazil, Mauritania, Chile and Canada. Our focus on delivering value is based on our four core values of Putting People First, Outstanding Corporate Citizenship, High Performance Culture, and Rigorous Financial Discipline.

Mining responsibly is a priority for Kinross, and we foster a culture that makes responsible mining and operational success inseparable. Our values-based approach ensures that sustainability and our environmental, social and governance commitments are a core part of our strategy and plans for future growth. In line with our values, we also aim to build meaningful partnerships with all of our stakeholders, including communities, shareholders, employees, governments and suppliers.

Kinross maintains listings on the Toronto Stock Exchange (symbol: K) and the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: KGC).

Job Summary

The Director, Geological Data & Database Management is a senior technical leadership role accountable for designing, implementing, and governing a company-wide database management system across all exploration, project, and operating sites. This is a hands-on leadership position: the Director is responsible for maintaining and updating company standards and ensuring sites adopt/adhere to them, ensuring standardization of database software and structures across all sites, and building and managing a team of database administrators and analysts.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure standardization of the company geologic database platform across all exploration, project, and operating sites, including migration of legacy and existing site databases where required.
Maintain database standards for structure, content, and required tables at each project maturity point (Setup, Initial Drilling, Infill, Scoping, PFS, FS, and Operations), and ensure sites are equipped to meet them.
Lead selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of database software and related tools, in partnership with IT.
Ensure QA/QC protocols are implemented and auditable per internal standards.
Establish and audit data security controls across all sites: layered/restricted access by user type, edit tracking and audit trails, and automatic, regular backups including offsite storage.
Define and enforce the separation between dynamic project databases and frozen, dated resource-model databases used for reserve/resource work.
Lead systematic, scheduled reviews of database quality across all sites and drive corrective action plans ahead of each project maturity point.
Initiate and lead internal and external audits as required.
Build, lead, and develop the company database management function, including hiring and mentoring site and project database administrators and analysts.
liase with exploration management, KTS, and site geology teams to ensure database structures support geological, resource, and reserve modelling requirements.
Develop and deliver training and documented procedures for database administrators, geologists, and technical staff on data entry standards, QA/QC execution, and system use.
Maintain and continuously improve governing documentation (standards guides, database structure references.)
Report on database health, compliance, and risk to senior technical and executive leadership.

Qualifications And Skills

Education and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in mineral exploration or mining geology, including significant experience in geological database design, administration, or data management.
5+ years in a senior or leadership role managing database systems, technical teams, or data governance programs across multiple sites or projects.
Demonstrated experience implementing or administering industry-standard geological database platforms (e.g., acQuire, Fusion, Datashed, or comparable systems) at a multi-site scale.

Technical & Leadership Skills

Deep understanding of relational database structures as applied to drill hole data (collar, survey, lithology, assay, QA/QC, geotechnical, geometallurgical, density, and related tables).
Strong knowledge of QA/QC protocols, chain-of-custody procedures, and data security/access-control best practices in a geological or mining context.
