jobs.title: Director, Systems & Data Transformation
jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada’s premier engineering-driven specialty insurer—bringing deep technical expertise to help clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We blend specialty insurance with inspection, engineering, and technology-enhanced services to redefine what risk protection can be, with leading capabilities across areas such as cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, and IoT technology services.

Backed by Munich Re, one of the world’s most experienced and financially stable insurance and reinsurance groups, HSB Canada combines global strength with deep knowledge of the Canadian market. Building on a long legacy of innovation and technical excellence, we continue to evolve our capabilities to address modern and emerging risks—from cyber and artificial intelligence to connected technologies.

Primary Objectives

The Director, Systems & Data Transformation is accountable for shaping and executing HSB Canada’s enterprise systems, data, and digital transformation agenda. Acting as a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director translates business priorities into an integrated multi-year roadmap, leads complex cross-functional programs, and delivers measurable improvements in growth, customer and broker experience, operational effectiveness, decision-making, and risk management.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership for the transformation and optimization of the Guidewire ecosystem and its surrounding applications, integrations, data platforms, and controls, ensuring reliable and scalable support for policy, billing, claims, underwriting, and insurance operations.

The Director also leads the delivery of major business-facing capabilities, including Quote, Bind and Issue (QBI), underwriting workflow, digital experiences, enterprise data products, analytics, and responsible AI solutions, in close partnership with business, technology, operations, risk, and global stakeholders.

Success requires an enterprise-minded leader who can connect strategy, architecture, data, delivery, change management, and operational execution; build high-performing multidisciplinary teams; and establish the governance, partnerships, and performance disciplines needed to sustain transformation outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Portfolio Delivery
Define and maintain an integrated, multi-year systems, data, and digital transformation strategy aligned with enterprise priorities and target business outcomes
Own the transformation portfolio from business case and prioritization through delivery, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations
Establish portfolio governance, roadmaps, investment plans, budgets, resource capacity, milestones, benefits, and executive reporting
Manage cross-program dependencies, delivery risks, organizational constraints, and competing priorities; escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations
Define measurable outcomes and key performance indicators, using performance insights to continuously improve delivery and business value
Core Systems Transformation & Guidewire Leadership
Set the strategy and roadmap for the specialty insurance technology ecosystem, balancing modernization, resilience, scalability, security, cost, and speed to market
Provide accountable leadership for the Guidewire platform and surrounding applications, including architecture, configuration, integrations, data flows, environments, releases, and lifecycle management
Lead major core-platform initiatives, including ClaimCenter transformation, while maintaining service continuity, production stability, support readiness, and effective control design
Digital Insurance & QBI Transformation
Lead end-to-end delivery of Quote, Bind and Issue capabilities and underwriting workflow improvements in partnership with underwriting, product, operations, distribution, and technology teams
Establish a scalable, reusable QBI architecture that supports multiple specialty products, distribution channels, evolving underwriting models, and integration with core platforms
Champion underwriter-centered design, process simplification, automation, and adoption to improve experience, quality, and cycle time
Data Science & Responsible AI
Define and mature HSB Canada’s enterprise data and data science capabilities, including data strategy, governance, quality, architecture, platforms, and reusable data products
Partner with business leaders to identify and deliver AI use cases across underwriting, claims, operations, finance, and distribution
Ensure data and AI solutions are explainable, secure, measurable, and embedded into business processes and decisions
Operating Model & People Leadership
Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning business systems analysis, product and application leadership, data engineering, analytics, and data science
Define clear mandates, decision rights, accountabilities, delivery standards, and career pathways; create a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning
Develop workforce and sourcing strategies that balance internal capability, global partnerships, and external expertise while managing capacity and succession risk
Advisory, Change Leadership & Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor translating complex system and data topics into clear choices, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions
Build alignment across Canadian and global stakeholders, facilitate executive governance, and communicate progress, risks, investment needs, and realized outcomes with clarity
Lead organizational change and adoption for new capabilities, and bring external perspective, emerging practices, and market insight to continuously evolve HSB Canada’s business and technology environment

Qualifications

University-level education in computer science, business administration, risk management, or equivalent professional experience
8–12 years demonstrated experience in business, technology, or product roles; insurance or broader financial services
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving: ability to frame ambiguity, develop options, assess trade-offs, and drive to clear decisions.
Strong analytical capability: extracting insights from data and market research and translate them into strategy and action.
Multi-workstream leadership: proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel while maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder alignment.
Executive communication: ability to produce crisp, compelling materials and present complex topics simply and persuasively to senior audiences.
Strong P&C insurance (or broader financial services) product knowledge—coverage/wordings, underwriting appetite, pricing fundamentals, and regulatory considerations is an asset
Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

At Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services (CFMWS), we’re more than just a workplace; we’re a proud community dedicated to supporting Canadian Armed Forces members, veterans and their families in their daily lives.  Director of Business Analytics & Insights 

 CI Financial is seeking a dynamic and visionary leader to join our D&A team as the Director of Business Analytics and Insights. Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Technology & Data, you will provide practical, outcome-focused direction on architecture, technical debt, technology lifecycle management and engineering excellence.  Accountabilities 
 Define and maintain the enterprise technology architecture, capability model and capability roadmap aligned to CPP Investments’ mandate, One Fund strategy, and long-term business objectives.
 Provide clear architectural direction that balances innovation, resilience, security, and cost efficiency across the enterprise.
 Lead lightweight, decision-oriented architecture governance focused on unblocking teams and resolving trade-offs, rather than enforcing rigid controls.
 Provide timely, well-reasoned guidance on complex design choices, ensuring alignment across platforms while enabling local autonomy where appropriate.
 Act as a senior problem solver for the enterprise, engaging directly in the most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact business problems and technology challenges.
 Bring systems thinking and deep technical judgement to diagnose root causes, shape options, and guide decisions that balance near-term outcomes with long-term sustainability.
 Own the enterprise approach to technology lifecycle management, including currency, obsolescence, and vendor dependency risk.
 Define strategies to identify, prioritize, and systematically reduce technical debt, improving platform stability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership over time.
 Set enterprise expectations for software development lifecycle, engineering excellence, and ways of working including agile practices. 
 Drive continuous improvement in how technology is designed, built, tested, and released, enabling predictable delivery, higher quality outcomes, and faster time to value 

 What You Bring 
 Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required

 Deep expertise in engineering, enterprise architecture, modern technology platforms, and large-scale system design 
 Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, modern data achitecture, and security principles 
 Proven experience establishing and governing software development lifecycle, engineering standards, and agile practices 
 Expertise in technology lifecycle management, vendor strategy, and technical debt remediation 
 Understanding of financial services or large, complex enterprises and their regulatory and risk environments 
 ​

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Reporting into the Head of Creator, North America, this role is ideal for a senior leader who understands both the opportunity and complexity of creator marketing in regulated environments. You will help clients harness the credibility, reach and influence of creators while navigating the regulatory, legal, reputational and compliance considerations unique to Health and Financial Services.

 Develop sophisticated creator strategies that balance audience relevance, creative effectiveness, trust, accuracy and regulatory requirements.

 A trusted senior client partner who can confidently navigate complex organizations and bring together marketing, communications, legal, regulatory, medical, compliance and risk stakeholders.

 Curious, future-focused and continuously learning.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Managing Director of AI
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor 

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 The Opportunity 

 Most AI consultants are good at one of two things: writing the strategy or doing the work. We need someone who refuses to separate the two. This role exists because our clients don't just need a roadmap - they need someone who will build the road, navigate the detours, and still show up to the steering committee with a clear-eyed point of view on where they're headed next.

 You'll lead AI transformation engagements end-to-end, from diagnosing what's broken and what's possible to rolling up your sleeves and building the thing alongside the client's team. That might mean designing an AI-enabled workflow on Monday, pressure-testing a product decision with a C-suite on Wednesday, and shipping a working prototype by Friday. The client doesn't see the seams. You own the outcome.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 What You'll Own 

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Internal Contribution — As a senior member of a flat, growing team, you'll help shape how Human Agency delivers, what we learn, and who we become.

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 Mindset & Traits 

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You manage yourself completely. No one will check on your progress, remind you of a deadline, or coach you through a hard week. You are the accountability structure.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You can hold the big picture and the small detail simultaneously, and you know when to zoom in and when to zoom out without being told.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible. 

 Travel: Occasional travel required for client engagements, company offsites, and key strategic meetings.

 Application Note: Attach proof of something you've built with AI — a product, a workflow, a tool, a result. If you don't have something to show, this is not the right role.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

Who We Are 

 At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we’re the team behind Money Mart—Canada’s largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

 From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

 At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

 We’ve Got You Covered 

 Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

 Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

 Retirement Plans: Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you’re set for the long haul.

 Hybrid Work Environment: Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

 Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

jobs.description:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
 
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

 Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

 Computer Vision

 Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling

 3D Perception & Scene Understanding

 Inference and Reasoning

 Machine and Deep Learning

 Human Computer Interaction (HCI)

 Natural Language Processing

 Position Summary: 

 Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

 The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

 Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap

 Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams

 Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams

 Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,

 Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities

 Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships

 Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

 10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.

 Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.

 Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus

 Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning

 Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment

 Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders

 Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills

 This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.
 What you'll do 
 Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

 What you'll bring 
 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

 Even better... 
 Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

 Our values 
 Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

 Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

 Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

 Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits

 Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

 Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 Free alphorn lessons

 These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
 Be you, with us 
 We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.
 Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.
 We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

 Position Summary 

 The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

 The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Technology Strategy & Delivery 
 Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;

 Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;

 Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;

 Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets

 Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

 Product Strategy & Delivery 
 Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;

 Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;

 Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and

 Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

 Data, Analytics & AI Enablement 
 Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.

 Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.

 Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable data management capabilities that enable high-quality clinical insights, operational intelligence, performance measurement, forecasting, and the responsible use of AI.

 Oversee enterprise data and analytics for the Canadian business, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

 Governance, Risk & Compliance 
 Partner with legal, privacy and compliance teams to ensure technology solutions meet applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, security, and clinical quality requirements, relevant market standards and clinical-quality expectations (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA, provincial health and privacy regulations, virtual care standards, responsible AI practices);

 Establish and oversee technology governance, including enterprise architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), cybersecurity, and cloud governance frameworks and processes, while partnering with the legal, privacy and compliance teams on enterprise data and AI governance and technology vendor risk management; and

 Identify, assess, and manage technology and cybersecurity risks by implementing appropriate controls, monitoring, and mitigation strategies to support the organization’s enterprise risk management framework, business resilience, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

 Technology Operations & Cybersecurity 
 Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure IT operations that support business continuity, organizational growth, and compliance with applicable organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements;

 Oversee the performance, availability, and reliability of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem through proactive monitoring, incident management, issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent recurrence and improve system resilience;

 Provide executive oversight of Teladoc Health Canada's cybersecurity program, including information security operations, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, and continuous enhancement of security controls.

 Lead technology support services for clinicians, clients, and internal users, while coordinating with Global/International teams on shared platforms, infrastructure, devices (e.g., HHS, GSD), escalation management, and operational support.

 People, Culture & Capability Building 
 Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology organization;

 Strengthen organizational capabilities across product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and AI, cloud and infrastructure, and technology operations;

 Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, security-by-design, and user-centred product development.

 Supervisory Responsibilities 
 Yes

 Salary Range 
 $230,000 to $250,000/year

 Position Type 
 Backfill

 Qualifications Expected for Position 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, Business or related field (advanced degree preferred);

 12+ years of progressive senior leadership experience in technology, product management, digital transformation, and/or data and analytics, within healthcare, virtual/hybrid care, or a highly regulated sector;

 Demonstrated ability to develop and execute technology strategies that align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business outcomes;

 Deep understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, data and analytics, AI, and emerging technology trends;

 Demonstrated experience leading technology modernization, digital transformation, and enterprise technology operations;

 Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, and compliance functions, and global counterparts;

 Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary, distributed, and high-performing teams within a complex, multinational corporate structure; and

 Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing technology portfolios, product roadmaps, budgets, vendors, and delivery outcomes.

 Work Environment 
 ☐ Office ☐ Remote ☒ Hybrid (Office & Remote)

 Travel: up to 10% 
 Travel percentage reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

 Physical Requirements 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Teladoc Health will make reasonable accommodations for the known
 physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual in line with company policy.

 About Us 
 Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering the only comprehensive virtual care solution spanning telehealth, expert medical, and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve
 their healthcare needs with confidence.

 Job Description Acknowledgment 
 This job description is a general overview of the nature and level of work performed by employees with this job designation. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of this position. Management reserves the right to add, delete, and/or modify any
 of the job duties or requirements at any time. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above job description. By signing this job description, I understand the duties that are expected of me.

 Why Join Teladoc Health? 

 Impactful, Connected Healthcare: Support millions of Canadians across the country with accessible care within rural regions & provincial health systems, at no cost to patients. 

 Focus on Quality & Safety: Upholding the highest excellence of clinical quality standards is paramount to Teladoc Health. 

 Collaborative, Supportive Network: Our diverse community is dedicated to transforming healthcare in Canada. Be a part of a growing team across Canada, that thrives on engagement, learning and growth. 

 Our Work Truly Matters: Recognized as the world leader in whole-person virtual care, Teladoc Health uses innovative platforms to provide accessible care across the full continuum of care, at every stage in a person’s health journey. 

 Growth and Innovation: We are growing rapidly - Come grow with us and support our expanding mission to make healthcare more accessible. 

 Diversity and Inclusion: At Teladoc Health we believe that personal and professional diversity is the key to innovation. We hire based solely on your strengths and qualifications, and the way in which those strengths can directly contribute to your success in your new position. 

 Teladoc Health Canada, Inc. uses artificial intelligence-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process, including to screen and evaluate candidates. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. Our hiring team makes all final decisions.

 At Teladoc Health we thrive on difference and individuality. Teladoc Health is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.  

 At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

 Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization.

 This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure.

 The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

 A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance.

 Role and Responsibilities 
 Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model.

Position Summary... 
The Senior Director, Business Intelligence Strategy & Media Insights (Canada) is responsible for leading Walmart Connect Canada’s analytics, measurement, and media intelligence capabilities. This role ensures data driven insights are embedded across media planning, investment decisions, performance measurement, and executive reporting.

Working in close partnership with the International Business Insights & Analytics organization, this role implements and operates global measurement, reporting, and data governance frameworks within the Canadian market, ensuring alignment to global standards while delivering insights tailored to Canadian business needs.

This position plays a critical role in driving omnichannel measurement excellence, commercial performance, and operational insight across Walmart Connect Canada.  

 What you'll do... 
 Business Intelligence & Analytics 
 • Lead the strategy and execution of business intelligence, analytics, and performance measurement for Walmart Connect Canada.
 • Ensure analytics and insights inform media planning, optimization, and investment decisions.
 • Oversee omnichannel attribution and media effectiveness measurement across digital and in‑store channels.

 Global Measurement & Reporting Alignment 
 • Implement global measurement, reporting, and data governance frameworks within the Canadian market.
 • Partner with International Business Insights leaders to support consistent adoption of global standards.
 • Provide ongoing feedback related to framework effectiveness and local market considerations.

 Reporting & Performance Management 
 • Deliver Canada‑level executive reporting, including WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and leadership reviews, aligned to global standards.
 • Ensure timely, accurate, and actionable reporting for senior stakeholders.
 • Ensure Canadian performance insights are incorporated into international reporting processes.

 Commercial Performance & Optimization 
 • Partner with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance teams to identify growth opportunities and quantify impact.
 • Support advertiser performance measurement and ROI accountability frameworks.

 Cross‑Functional & Cross‑Market Collaboration 
 • Serve as the primary point of contact between Walmart Connect Canada and the International Business Insights organization.
 • Collaborate with Walmart Connect U.S., MAP, and internal Canada teams to enable aligned decision‑making.
 • Support shared priorities while representing Canadian business requirements.

 People Leadership 
 • Build, lead, and develop a high‑performing Canada‑based analytics and insights team.
 • Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans.
 • Foster a culture of analytical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

 Minimum Qualifications 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
 • 12+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, data strategy, or related disciplines.
 • Experience leading analytics or insights teams in a complex, cross‑functional organization.
 • Experience supporting executive‑level reporting and decision‑making.
 • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.

 • Experience working with global or regional analytics organizations.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

In this role, you will help drive the growth of EY's Managed Services business by leading strategic pursuits, supporting opportunity conversion, and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships. You will work closely with Managed Services leaders, client-serving professionals, Service Delivery Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to support the pursuit lifecycle, enhance opportunity quality, and contribute to the continued growth of the Managed Services portfolio.

As a key member of the team, you will help shape and execute growth strategies, support major business development opportunities, review strategic managed services pursuits, and coach teams on identifying and capturing additional revenue opportunities within existing accounts. This role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and high-profile opportunities across sectors, service lines, and managed services offerings.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and support strategic Managed Services pursuits and business development opportunities across sectors and service offerings
Drive the pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal support, client presentations, negotiations, and contract execution.
Partner with account teams and client-serving professionals to identify, shape, and advance Managed Services opportunities.

Support the review and management of existing managed services engagements to ensure delivery commitments are being achieved and growth opportunities are identified.
Coach and support Service Delivery Managers in identifying, developing, and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts.
Contribute to the development and execution of managed services growth strategies and account expansion plans.
Monitor and report on pursuit activity, pipeline performance, opportunity progression, and key growth metrics.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Managed Services, Clients & Industries, service lines, Risk Management, Finance, and other support functions.
Facilitate pursuit discussions, opportunity reviews, and stakeholder meetings to drive alignment and decision-making.
Manage multiple strategic opportunities and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Contribute to team, practice, and firm initiatives as part of continuous improvement objectives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong business development, sales, and relationship management capabilities.
Proven ability to lead complex pursuits, strategic opportunities, and growth initiatives.
Strong project management skills with the ability to establish priorities, manage multiple deadlines, and navigate competing demands.
Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks, and business outcomes.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior leaders and client-serving teams.
Sound judgment and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential information.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high-quality deliverables

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in a related discipline.
Approximately 10+ years of progressive experience in managed services, business development, account management, strategic pursuits, consulting, or related disciplines.
Proven experience leading complex pursuits, large opportunities, or strategic growth initiatives.
Demonstrated success in developing and expanding client relationships and driving revenue growth.
Experience reviewing and shaping strategic opportunities from qualification through deal execution.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across multiple service lines and business functions.
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders and influencing decision-makers.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to work independently and effectively navigate a complex, matrixed organization.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience within a professional services environment.
ITIL certification.
Bilingualism in English and French would be considered an asset

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.

Unit8's mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and "engineering for good" causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.

Are You the Leader We're Looking For?

As a Managing Director
at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:

Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard

What You'll Do

Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them

Requirements

Who You Are

You've run complex, tech-enabled transformations — perfectly from a top-tier global consultancy or a specialist data & AI firm. You have navigated high-stakes, complex engagements from ambiguity to delivery — and have the results to show for it.

You have significant experience in Data & AI consulting
, with a clear and verifiable track record of personally originating and closing major client relationships
You are currently at Principal
or Associate Partner / Director
level — or equivalent — with the commercial track record and client ownership, looking for the next step in your career

You don't need to write code, but you must "speak Tech."
You understand data architecture and AI well enough to raise our delivery bar and earn the respect of world-class engineers
You bring an established network of senior client relationships in the Canadian market
, ideally in financial services
Fluent in English.

Comfortable with traveling, including on-site engagements

Benefits

What's In It For You

At Unit8, we don't just "turn data into value" — we empower the people who make it happen. If you are looking for a place where you can say, "I am independent and I take ownership", your next chapter starts here.

Trust from Day One:
We believe in your expertise, and trust is a core part of our culture
Work that Matters:
You will do things that matter, and together we will facilitate the work of others
Passion-Led Projects:
We create an environment where you can pursue your passion alongside great talent. If the future makes you excited, you belong here
Impact:
You will be part of our leadership team and have a direct hand in shaping how Unit8 grows in Canadian market — defining our commercial approach, influencing which industries and clients we focus on, and setting the standard for how we deliver. This is not an execution role inside a fixed strategy; you help write it
Competitive compensation package.

Flexibility & Growth:
Above-the-norm flexibility on where and when you work, with up to 10% of your time dedicated to learning and pro-bono projects
Connection & Fun:
Whether it's our cross-office off-sites, online events, or a dedicated quarterly team budget for after-work activities, we make sure we stay connected

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you meet the qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

What We Offer

Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Trulioo is seeking a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy & Development to help shape the company’s strategic direction and translate it into coordinated action across the business. Working closely with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer, this leader will own the continued evolution of Trulioo’s strategic blueprint, strengthen alignment between corporate strategy and functional priorities, and guide execution of the company’s most important strategic initiatives.

This role will build the intelligence, governance, and execution capabilities that allow Trulioo to anticipate market change and make informed choices about where and how to compete. The Senior Director will bring together customer, competitive, regulatory, economic, industry, and product insights to test strategic assumptions, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and inform decisions across organic investment, partnerships, and acquisitions.

This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role at the intersection of strategy, product, transformation, capital allocation, and corporate development. The ideal candidate combines forward-looking strategic judgment with the ability to operationalize ideas—building roadmaps, mobilizing accountable leaders, guiding complex programs, and creating the governance needed to turn strategy into measurable results.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, working remotely.

What You'll Be Doing

Corporate Strategy and Strategic Blueprint Support

Co-lead recurring strategy reviews and recommend when elements of the strategic blueprint should be accelerated, refined, reprioritized, or recast.

Strategy Alignment and Execution

Translate the strategic blueprint into enterprise priorities, functional goals, measurable outcomes, and clear execution roadmaps.
Partner with executive and functional leaders to align their strategies, investments, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and/or incentives with the company’s strategic direction.
Define the scope, activities, sequencing, investment requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, and measures of success for major strategic programs.
Establish and chair governance forums that track progress against strategic priorities and create clear paths for decision-making and escalation.
Partner with the Transformation Office and accountable workstream leaders to mobilize initiatives, resolve cross-functional blockers, measure progress and performance, and redirect execution when outcomes move off course.
Create recurring feedback loops, including shared metrics reviews and strategy check-ins, to identify misalignment early and improve execution.
Communicate the strategy across the organization in ways that build understanding of Trulioo’s direction, strategic choices, and highest-priority activities.

MAPS and Capital Allocation Governance

Lead MAPS—Trulioo’s quarterly Market Aligned Product Strategy program—to connect corporate strategy and market intelligence with product strategy, investment decisions, and roadmaps.

Support market mapping, opportunity screening, target identification, strategic fit assessments, and ongoing target monitoring.
Coordinate cross-functional due diligence, including workstream planning, information synthesis, issue escalation, decision support, and executive reporting.

Develop scalable models, AI agents, and analytical tools that strengthen opportunity screening, target intelligence, diligence, and transaction decision-making.

Produce forward-looking insights, including market landscapes, competitive positioning, opportunity sizing, thematic investment perspectives, regulatory outlooks, and voice-of-the-customer analysis.

Translate complex signals into clear strategic implications, executive-level reporting, and actionable recommendations.

What You'll Bring

Nice To Have
