With this in mind, we act with objectivity and always remember that we are not our work. There's no perfect science to growing a team or business, but we trust everyone at Replicant to point out our blind spots and humbly admit their own.

Replicant is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. jobs.description:
Are you looking to join one of Greater Toronto’s Top 2026 Employers?

The Ontario Medical Association (OMA) advocates for and supports doctors, seeking to strengthen their leadership role in caring for patients. We continually seek to be the trusted voice in transforming Ontario’s health-care system by courageously pursuing best practices, new ideas, solutions, and opportunities to improve.

Job Summary

This role plays a key leadership role in ensuring organizational policies, workforce design, workforce readiness, change management and people practices evolve in step with modern best practices including AI-enabled ways of working, integrating EDIA, wellness and human centric principles.

This role serves as the organizational steward for human, behavioural, and process change associated with modernization, ensuring people, roles, workflows, and capabilities evolve intentionally as technology and people practices maturity increases. Working at the nexus of People & Culture and Technology teams, the role enables an intentional, human-centred approach to transformational change, with an emphasis on adoption, behaviour change, capability uplift, and sustained value realization in support of a future-ready workforce. The role leads organizational development through workforce data, behavioural insights, staff feedback and stewardship of policies and procedures to strengthen equity, inclusion, engagement, wellbeing, adaptability and performance.

How You Will Make a Difference

Organizational Development & Effectiveness

Supporting the design and execution of organizational health and design strategies that leverage workforce data to align structure, roles, policies, culture, staff programs and ways of working with OMA’s strategic priorities.
Drive modernization and continuous improvement across P&C systems, practices, and policy frameworks, positioning the OMA workforce for future readines

Workforce Modernization & Change Enablement

Leading enterprise-wide change enablement for digital transformation, ensuring roles, workflows, decision-making, and ways of working evolve alongside advancing AI capabilities.
Design and steward a structured change management approach for digital/AI and other people initiatives (including readiness, stakeholder mapping, change impacts, communications, reinforcement, measurement, and iteration) in partnership with Technology team and business leaders.
Establish and address current and future skill gaps arising from adoption of new technologies and processes, partnering with Talent Development & Learning team and business leaders to deliver upskilling, reskilling, that enables safe, effective, and confident use.
Steward leaders and teams to adapt human judgment, accountability, and oversight as AI becomes more prevalent in the workplace. Champion human-centred adoption that balances productivity, wellbeing, equity, accessibility, and trust. Measure adoption, capability uplift, and behavioural change over time.

Data Informed Workforce Strategy

Advance maturity in the use of metrics and analytics, including emerging people analytics, while ensuring appropriate interpretation, governance and use of qualitative and quantitative data to inform risks and recommendations.
Translate workforce analytics and insights into practical workforce actions.

Culture, Employee Experience & EDIA Integration

Champion culture, equity, diversity, inclusion, accessibility, wellbeing, and engagement as core organizational design principles, ensuring they are embedded across leadership practices, people systems, policies and decision-making frameworks.
Ensuring EDIA considerations are systematically integrated into workforce design, policy development, and change initiatives through standards, tools, and decision checkpoints.

Strategic Advisory

Leading P&C’s role in organizational readiness for digital transformation and new technologies, partnering with Technology and teams to align workforce preparedness with the AI roadmap to advance maturity.
Advise and support senior leaders on workforce risks & opportunities related to organizational change, adoption of new technologies, culture, and policy decisions, grounded in a deep understanding of human behaviour and organizational dynamics, and equity impact.
Serve as a P&C advisor within AI governance forums, ensuring workforce, behavioral, ethical, and equity implications are considered in policy and deployment decisions.

Team Leadership & OD Portfolio

Lead the Organizational Development team, setting priorities, allocating capacity, fostering an inclusive and high-performing environment, coaching and developing direct reports.
Collaborate with P&C team leads to co-lead delivering P&C objectives, ensuring alignment across organizational design, systems, and culture initiatives.

Requirements That Are Important To Us

Demonstrated experience operating at a systems level, not just program delivery.
10+ years of progressive experience in systems thinking, org-wide diagnostics and change management (e.g. culture and engagement, organizational design, change leadership and adoption, advising senior leaders on org-wide data informed strategies).
Facilitation of complex, multi-stakeholder processes
OD specific certification (e.g., Organization Development Certification Program) is an asset
Change Management certification (e.g., Prosci) is an asset
Chartered Professional/Leader in Human Resources (e.g. CHRP, CHRL) is an asset
Senior level experience in organizational design, organizational development, change management, or related fields
Demonstrated success leading enterprise transformation and advising executives
Strong grounding in EDIA and inclusive organizational practices
Advanced experience leading multidisciplinary teams and complex portfolios

The OMA has moved to a permanent hybrid work environment. As such, the individual in this position will be required to work a minimum number of days in our Toronto office.

What do we have to offer you?

A work environment whose values are to be respectful, bold, responsive, and transparent in our work and our behaviours
A fantastic opportunity to grow with the team and help shape the strategic direction of the OMA, its members and the health-care system
An organization that is committed to the equity, diversity and inclusion principles of humility, accountability, collaboration, courage and integrity

Exceptional group benefits package, including a spending account and a robust wellness program
An organization that has been recognized as a Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for six consecutive years.

jobs.title: Director, UI/UX Design
jobs.description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

The opportunity

WELLSTAR, a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health Technologies Corp, is a high-growth SaaS company with a focused objective of reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline care delivery, integrate healthcare systems and improve patient outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Product Management, we are hiring a Director, UI/UX Design to lead the design function for the Clinical Platform Group. As our new Director, UI/UX Design, you will lead and develop an established team of designers while owning the quality, consistency, and evolution of the end-to-end product experience. You will set the design direction for a modern, AI-first EMR platform, strengthen user research and design practices, and ensure the needs of clinicians remain central to how the product evolves. Working as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership, you will bring greater structure and consistency to how teams collaborate from problem definition and discovery through design, development, and release.

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with occasional travel for team on-sites and clinic visits.

What’s in it for you

Leadership and influence. You will step into an established design team with the opportunity to make a strong team even better. You will have the scope to develop designers, raise the bar on craft and consistency, and shape how the design function evolves as the product and organization grow. Working alongside Product and Engineering leadership, you will have a voice in decisions that influence both the product experience and how teams work together.

Shape an AI-first healthcare experience. You will help define how clinicians interact with AI in a product they rely on to deliver care. From how AI-generated suggestions are presented to how confidence, transparency, and clinician control are built into the experience, you will influence some of the most important design questions facing Nexus AI™ EMR as the platform evolves.

Build better ways of working. You will have the opportunity to strengthen and mature an existing design practice rather than build one from the ground up. You will refine research, design processes, cross-functional collaboration, and the design system, creating the structure that helps designers do their best work and enables Product, Design, and Engineering to move forward together.

What you will do:

Lead and develop the design team.
You will coach and support an established team of designers, creating clear ownership, providing meaningful feedback, and helping each person build on their strengths and grow. You will foster a collaborative critique culture and create the conditions for the team to consistently deliver high-quality work.
Own the end-to-end product experience.
You will be accountable for the quality, consistency, and coherence of the Clinical Platform Group product experience across clinical and administrative workflows. You will establish and uphold a high design standard, incorporating accessibility and clinical safety considerations into how experiences are designed and delivered.
Shape AI-assisted experiences.
You will set the design direction for how AI is integrated into clinical workflows, including how suggestions are surfaced, confidence and provenance are communicated, and clinicians remain in control. You will help ensure AI-enabled experiences are practical, intuitive, and designed around the realities of clinical care.
Strengthen how Design, Product, and Engineering work together.
You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to bring design into problem definition, discovery, refinement, and delivery. You will improve handoffs and feedback loops so requirements, designs, edge cases, and intended experiences are clearly understood and carried through to what is released.
Evolve design practices and systems.
You will refine the design process from intake and discovery through critique, handoff, and design QA, keeping it structured without creating unnecessary complexity. You will champion the design system, patterns, documentation, and tools that help the team work efficiently and deliver a consistent experience.
Bring users closer to product decisions.
You will establish a sustainable approach to user research, including interviews and engagement with clinics, and ensure insights are shared effectively across Design, Product, and Engineering. You will help turn what the team learns from clinicians and customers into meaningful improvements to the product and roadmap.

What you bring:

The design leadership experience.
You have experience leading and developing product designers, including coaching, providing meaningful feedback, supporting career development, and managing performance. You know how to assess the strengths of an established team, build trust, and create the clarity and support people need to do their best work.
The product design expertise.
You have designed and shipped complex, workflow-heavy software where usability, accuracy, and attention to detail matter. You bring strong design judgment and can critically evaluate work, challenge assumptions, and raise the quality and consistency of the user experience without imposing a rigid design philosophy.
The ability to evolve a design practice.
You have improved how a design team operates, whether through stronger discovery and research practices, critique and review, design systems, handoffs, or design QA. You can introduce structure without unnecessary process and understand how to measure whether changes are making the team and the product better.
The cross-functional approach.
You have worked closely with Product and Engineering teams in an agile product environment and understand how design fits into discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, development, and release. You can influence peers and senior stakeholders, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and build alignment around the user experience.
The curiosity for AI-enabled design.
You are comfortable exploring AI-assisted design tools and bring a thoughtful perspective on where they can improve speed and effectiveness without compromising craft or consistency. Experience designing AI or LLM-powered products, including human-in-the-loop experiences, would be an asset.
The adaptability.
You design for the needs of the people using the product rather than following a single definition of what good UX should look like. You can work with complex, information-dense experiences and balance user needs, accessibility, technical constraints, and the realities of the environment in which the product is used. Experience in healthcare, EMR/EHR products, or another regulated environment is an asset.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services.

What you can expect from our interview process:

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
A virtual interview with the VP, Product Management focused on your design leadership experience, approach to developing and supporting a design team, and experience strengthening collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering.
A final interview with the team focused on team dynamics, collaboration and how you would contribute to the broader team.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $120-150K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELLSTAR, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

Apply now.

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELLSTAR, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

WELLSTAR is committed to supporting a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and perspective. We strive to create an inclusive workplace where differences are celebrated and fuel our success. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process.

Highly skilled leader with extensive experience leading and coaching large teams

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient- centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. The organization also delivers some province-wide health services and supports centralized administrative and business functions for Manitoba health organizations.

Position Overview

The Supply Chain Management Shared Service (SCMSS) is a new organization that supports healthcare delivery across Manitoba by contracting, procuring and distributing supplies, equipment, and services to service delivery organizations (SDOs) across the Health sector. Additionally, the SCMSS leads the category management Health and Population Cluster for the Government of Manitoba and is responsible for establishing contracts for in-scope items that can be used by stakeholders across the Government of Manitoba and other public sector partners.

The Director Provincial Contracting Services
will play a key role in establishing and leading the new Supply Chain Management Shared Service within Shared Health and provide on-going leadership to drive innovation, mitigate supply risk, and improve supplier performance.

Main Function

This role will establish and lead a Category Management approach for team of approximately 35 responsible for contracting approximately $900 million in annual spend on behalf of Shared Health, its service delivery organizations, and other partners in the Manitoba public sector. The Director Provincial CM assumes a leadership role in managing a Category Cluster aligned with the provincial collaborative procurement governance model and in support of meeting the needs of pan-governmental stakeholders. The Director Provincial CM works closely with the Government of Manitoba Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE), line departments and key suppliers to drive successful category initiatives and procurements.

The Director Provincial CM is responsible for managing the end-to-end supply chain process to ensure the effective delivery of category-managed procurement while attaining the best value, in compliance with all relevant trade agreements, legislation, policy, processes and directives. Working collaboratively with other SCM Shared Service Leads and other provincial stakeholders, the Director Provincial CM conducts demand planning across all Health service organizations and the broader government public sector organizations for the categories within the Cluster.

The Director Provincial CM provides leadership and advice on category management matters and represents Shared Health on provincial and national initiatives and committees such as the national group purchasing organization HealthPro and other pan-Canadian initiatives

Experience

7 years of experience managing a client service focused team in the delivery of enterprise-wide supply chain management functions including contracting and procurement in a large publicly funded multi-enterprise network, preferably in the public sector and/or health, with 5 years of experience:

Managing supply chain within a category management environment, developing strategic approaches in a multi-facility / entity organization
Creating and leading collaborative teams, mentoring and building individual and team capacity to support full staff and engagement and performance
Leading business transformation programs in supply chain management
Developing and implementing customer-focused annual operating plans and leading strategic sourcing plans, contracting and procurement
Influencing executive and senior management, key stakeholders, and negotiating and managing vendor contracts for outsourced materials and services
Working with enterprise resources planning systems in contracting and procurement (e.g. SAP)
Creating metrics and quantitative reporting of organizational performance against established targets
In public sector procurement (tenders, RFXs, etc.)

Other combinations of work experience and qualifications may be considered.

Education (Degree/Diploma/Certificate)

Post-secondary degree in supply chain management, business administration, commerce or a related field from an accredited education institution
Additional specialized training in supply chain management, particularly category management and strategic sourcing is preferred

An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Certification/Licensure/Registration

Active member in good standing of an associated regulatory body as appropriate
Supply Chain Management Professional (SCMP); or related designation in logistics or supply chain are assets

Qualifications And Skills

Demonstrated mid- level leadership capabilities. The provincial health system in Manitoba has adopted the LEADS in a Caring Environment framework

Physical Requirements

Must be able to work safely in a typical computerized office environment with frequent meetings at multiple client sites, and to lift and carry items of up to approximately 10 kg.
Interruptions to respond to questions are common dedicated and focused time for planning and concentration can be scheduled
Travel throughout the province requiring a valid Manitoba driver’s license and use of a personal motor vehicle

Vacant Position

Our client is a high-growth technology company looking for a Director, Media Advertising to lead the evolution of its media strategy and drive the next phase of brand awareness and customer acquisition.

With a strong foundation in performance marketing, the company is investing in a more sophisticated, full-funnel approach to advertising. The opportunity is to move beyond reaching customers who are already actively searching for a solution and build demand among audiences earlier in their decision-making journey.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic, commercially minded media leader who understands how to balance brand building with measurable business outcomes.
You'll inherit a capable team of senior marketers, established media investments and dedicated analytics support, allowing you to focus on elevating strategy, scaling high-performing channels and demonstrating the impact of media investment to executive leadership.

What You'll Do

Lead Media Advertising Strategy
Own the strategy, planning and optimization of a multimillion-dollar media portfolio across connected TV (CTV), OTT, online video, programmatic display, digital audio and emerging channels.
Evolve the company's media strategy from predominantly direct-response advertising toward a more sophisticated, full-funnel approach.
Identify opportunities to reach new audience segments, build brand awareness and generate demand earlier in the customer journey.
Evaluate and scale new advertising channels, platforms and inventory sources while continuously improving media efficiency.
Lead audience segmentation, targeting, bidding strategies and budget allocation across channels.
Oversee programmatic media strategy and platform relationships, including The Trade Desk and other demand-side platforms.
Partner with performance marketing leaders to ensure upper-funnel media investments complement and strengthen customer acquisition efforts.

Drive Measurement & Business Impact
Own the measurement strategy for media advertising, connecting investment to brand awareness, customer acquisition and revenue outcomes.
Lead brand health tracking initiatives, working with research partners to measure awareness, consideration and brand perception.
Partner with Analytics and Data teams on incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling (MMM), attribution and brand lift studies.
Establish clear performance targets and measurement frameworks that demonstrate the incremental impact of advertising.
Translate complex media performance data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Build compelling business cases for media investment, confidently communicating results and recommendations to senior executives.

Lead & Develop the Team
Lead and coach a team of three experienced marketers spanning programmatic media, online video and media strategy.
Provide strategic direction while empowering a highly capable team to own execution.
Identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities, improve processes and scale the function.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance environment that encourages experimentation, innovation and accountability.

Collaborate Across the Business
Partner closely with Brand, Creative, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing and Analytics teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
Work with in-house creative teams to develop effective media briefs, audience strategies and creative testing plans.
Use performance insights to inform creative direction, messaging and production priorities.
Help shape the company's evolving approach to brand storytelling and demand generation.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in media advertising, integrated media strategy, programmatic advertising or related disciplines.
Significant experience owning upper- and mid-funnel media strategies across channels such as CTV, OTT, online video, programmatic display and digital audio.
Deep understanding of programmatic buying platforms, particularly The Trade Desk, with exposure to DV360, Amazon DSP or similar platforms considered an asset.
Demonstrated ability to balance brand-building initiatives with performance marketing and measurable acquisition outcomes.
Experience managing significant 7 figure media budgets, with accountability for investment efficiency and business results.
Strong understanding of brand measurement, incrementality testing, brand lift, attribution and marketing mix modeling.
Proven ability to translate complex media data into clear, commercially grounded recommendations for executive leadership.
Experience leading and developing teams, with a collaborative, empowering leadership style.
Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence senior decision-makers

Nice to Have

Experience in a high-growth SaaS, technology or subscription-based business.
Background in both brand advertising and performance marketing.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Position:

Director of FP&A

Company:

Solen Software Group

Location:

Hybrid/On-site - Salt Lake City or Park City, New York, Toronto

Employment Type:

Full-time

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates proven software businesses that have significant growth potential in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be market leaders in their niche industry. Solen owns several software companies in various market spaces: Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions in a variety of industries. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors that have built software businesses of material scale (10-100M in ARR) and advised many.

About The Role

The Director of FP&A will own how Solen plans, forecasts, measures, and makes decisions across our portfolio of 20+ software companies and the holding company. Reporting to the CFO, this role partners as a peer with the Controller: the Controller owns the close, books, and consolidated actuals, while the Director of FP&A owns the budget, forecast, KPIs, Monthly Business Review, and the models behind capital allocation and acquisitions.

This is a build-as-you-go role. Our businesses run with real autonomy and span recurring SaaS, usage-based fees, professional services, and hardware. You will design the planning and reporting engine that replaces today's manual, company-by-company reporting, build the team that runs it, and support the CFO in raising debt and equity capital.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership role working directly with the CFO, CEO, Portfolio Leaders, and General Managers of our operating companies (OpCos).

Key Responsibilities

Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

Own the annual budget, quarterly re-forecast, rolling forecast, and long-range plan across all OpCos and the HoldCo, with one planning calendar and standard templates.
Build driver-based models suited to each revenue model: ARR, retention and churn cohorts, usage volumes, utilization and billable hours, hardware and license sales, and headcount.
Produce a consolidated, scenario-ready outlook for the CFO, CEO, and board.
Own forward cash forecasting and liquidity and covenant-headroom modelling in partnership with the Controller.
Track forecast accuracy, explain material misses, and continuously improve the process.

Portfolio Performance & KPIs

Define and deploy a consistent KPI framework across the portfolio, benchmarked against Solen's investment thesis.
Track unit economics, retention cohorts, customer profitability, and cost structure by function to benchmark OpCos against each other and best-in-class.
Support OpCo leaders on pricing, customer profitability, cost optimization, and financial turnarounds.

Monthly Business Review & Reporting

Own the MBR cadence, structure, KPI package, and follow-through on action items, raising the quality of insight in every review.
Partner with divisional controllers who run OpCo-level MBRs, equipping them with better data, tools, and insight.
Standardize and automate management reporting and dashboards in Power BI, and develop digital, real-time, and AI-native reporting.
Own the reporting roadmap, defining every metric once and building core reports such as the ARR bridge, budget-versus-actual, organic versus inorganic growth, EBITDA bridge, free cash flow, 13-week cash forecast, and return on invested capital.

Capital Allocation, Capital Raising & M&A

Build the models that guide capital allocation across reinvestment, bolt-on acquisitions, and cash returned to the HoldCo.
Support the CFO and deal team with acquisition models: valuation, diligence, pro formas, and synergy cases.
Support the CFO on debt and equity raises and refinancing with models, projections, scenario analysis, and lender and investor materials.
Track post-acquisition performance against the underwriting case and onboard new acquisitions into planning and KPIs from day one.

FP&A Team Build-Out

Design the FP&A operating model for a lean, decentralized portfolio.
Recruit, hire, and develop a best-in-class FP&A and business partner team.
Establish clear ownership between FP&A, the Controller, divisional controllers, and OpCo finance leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, candor, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, or a related field; MBA or CFA preferred.
8+ years of progressive FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance experience.
Direct ownership of budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning for a multi-entity or decentralized business (e.g., PE-backed platform, roll-up, or multi-brand company).
Experience building, leading, and developing an FP&A or business partner team.
Excellent financial modelling skills, including driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis; advanced Excel.
Experience designing KPI frameworks and running recurring business reviews with operating leaders.
Experience building management reporting and dashboards in a BI tool.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for a CEO, board, or non-finance operator.
Willing to work on-site in Salt Lake City or Park City, UT, or in New York, NY with regular travel to Utah, and occasional international travel to Lisbon, Portugal.
Legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in B2B or vertical market SaaS, including ARR, GRR/NRR, and cohort analysis.
Experience modelling mixed revenue streams: subscription, usage-based, professional services, and hardware.
Background in private equity, permanent capital, investment banking, or Big-4 transaction advisory.
Experience supporting debt or equity raises or refinancing.
Experience using AI tools to automate manual finance work.
Working knowledge of Power BI and Sage Intacct or a comparable multi-entity ERP.
Experience with multi-currency planning and teams based outside the U.S.

Not every candidate will meet every requirement. If you have shown real trajectory and results, we encourage you to apply.

What Success Looks Like

One planning and forecasting engine is live across all OpCos and the HoldCo, with a full budget cycle and rolling forecast completed and forecast accuracy improving.
A consistent KPI framework is adopted by every OpCo, with each company viewed on one comparable scorecard against Solen's investment thesis.
The MBR runs on a predictable cadence with a standardized, automated package, and the highest-priority reports are live.
The FP&A function is defined, first hires are ramping, and manual reporting has come off the accounting team.
Capital allocation, acquisition, and financing models exist and have informed real decisions.
The CFO, CEO, Portfolio Leaders, and GMs seek FP&A's view before major decisions.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Account Director, Travel and Banking Engagement
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Scene+, we foster an entrepreneurial spirit that drives our mission: making tomorrow even more rewarding for our members. As a unique joint venture between Cineplex, Empire, and Scotiabank, and a network of partners, we have spent almost 20 years delivering unparalleled rewards and experiences.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director, Partnerships & Marketing, we are hiring an Account Director, Travel and Banking Engagement to lead the strategy, growth, and performance of the Scene+ travel vertical and strengthen financial services engagement across the broader Scene+ partner ecosystem.

As our new Account Director, you will have end-to-end accountability for Scene+ Travel, powered by Expedia. You will lead the partnership from strategy through execution, developing annual and quarterly plans that drive gross booking value, revenue, conversion, first-time bookers, repeat booking, and overall member engagement. Working directly with Expedia, you will align marketing campaign planning, investment priorities, product and feature roadmaps, member experience enhancements, and operational requirements to create a best-in-class travel experience for Scene+ members.

You will also lead strategies that deepen engagement among Scotiabank credit and debit card members as well as Tangerine credit card members across the Scene+ ecosystem. You will identify opportunities to increase member activity, overall spend, share of wallet, and cross-shopping across two or more Scene+ partners. Bringing together partnership management, marketing strategy, product thinking, and data-driven decision-making, you will shape campaigns, targeting, value propositions, and member journeys that deliver measurable growth.

You will lead one direct report, a Manager, Marketing & Partnerships, providing strategic direction, coaching, and support while creating the conditions for strong performance and professional growth.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy that is a full-time, hybrid role working three days per week on site in our Toronto office.

What’s in it for you:

Ownership and influence. You will have end-to-end ownership of the Scene+ travel vertical, with the opportunity to operate as a business owner rather than simply execute campaigns. You will shape the annual strategy, product and feature roadmap, investment priorities, campaign design, targeting, and member journeys. You will have the autonomy to make recommendations, align stakeholders, and move high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.

High-profile partnerships and broad exposure. You will lead the Scene+ Travel partnership powered by Expedia, working directly with one of the world’s most recognized travel brands. You will also collaborate with Scotiabank, Tangerine, and partners across the Scene+ ecosystem to create connected experiences that bring together travel, loyalty, financial services, retail, entertainment, and partner marketing.

A mandate grounded in measurable growth. You will establish clear performance frameworks and use member, transaction, and campaign data to identify meaningful growth opportunities. Your work will directly influence travel bookings, revenue, member activity, partner cross-shopping, and share of wallet.

An opportunity to lead and build. You will join a growing team and help shape how the travel and banking engagement mandates evolve. You will lead and develop a Manager, Marketing & Partnerships while establishing effective planning, governance, and ways of working across internal teams and external partners.

As our new Account Director, Banking and Travel you will:

Lead the integrated travel and banking engagement strategy.
You will develop annual and quarterly plans that align Scene+, Expedia, and financial institution partners around shared growth priorities, investment decisions, performance targets, and member experience objectives. With approximately 60% of your mandate focused on travel, you will prioritize opportunities to grow Scene+ Travel while developing complementary strategies that deepen banking engagement across the partner ecosystem.
Own and grow the Scene+ Travel partnership.
You will serve as the Scene+ business lead for Expedia, cultivating a trusted, strategic relationship and driving alignment on priorities, growth ambitions, and performance accountability.
Drive travel growth and member engagement.
You will develop integrated strategies, campaigns, and member journeys that encourage members to plan and book travel through Scene+. You will identify opportunities to increase gross booking value, revenue, conversion, first-time bookers, repeat booking, and overall member engagement.
Strengthen banking engagement across the Scene+ ecosystem.
You will lead strategies for Scotiabank and Tangerine credit card members and Scotiabank debit card members that increase activity, overall spend, share of wallet, and cross-shopping across two or more Scene+ partners.
Own performance monitoring and optimization.
You will establish KPI frameworks and performance governance for the travel and banking engagement mandates. Working closely with Data Science and Analytics, you will translate member, transaction, and campaign data into strategic direction and identify risks, growth opportunities, and optimization levers across targeting, offers, messaging, channels, CRM strategies, product features, and member journeys.
Lead cross-functional alignment and disciplined execution.
You will bring together Marketing, Data Science and Analytics, Finance, Digital, Product, Operations, Member Experience, and external partners around shared objectives and roadmap priorities.
Lead, coach, and develop your team.
You will provide strategic direction and ongoing coaching to a Manager, Marketing & Partnerships. You will empower them to deliver exceptional work, build trusted partner relationships, apply data to decision-making, and develop expertise across travel, loyalty, and financial services engagement.

You bring:

The experience.
You have 7+ years of progressive experience in marketing, strategic partnerships, account leadership, or strategy, ideally within loyalty, travel, financial services, retail, ecommerce, or another complex, multi-partner ecosystem. Travel experience is preferred but not required.
The strategic and commercial leadership.
You have demonstrated experience developing integrated account strategies, annual plans, marketing strategies, business cases, strategic briefs, and executive presentations that align stakeholders around shared growth objectives.
The partnership expertise.
You have managed complex, high-profile partnerships and built trusted relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
The marketing and member engagement expertise.
You know how to translate business objectives into campaigns and experiences that drive measurable results. You understand how audiences, segmentation, targeting, messaging, offers, CRM strategies, and connected member journeys can increase conversion, frequency, spend, cross-shopping, and long-term member value.
The analytical and financial acumen.
You are comfortable working with complex member, transaction, and campaign data. You can establish KPI frameworks, evaluate performance, develop forecasts, assess investment trade-offs, and translate insights into clear strategic recommendations and executive-ready materials.

Compensation

At Scene+, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and market competitive. Our salary ranges are designed to represent the progression from learning the role to truly mastering it.

This role has a minimum base salary of $105,000 and a maximum base salary of $125,000. Our approach to compensation supports each person’s unique knowledge, skills, and abilities, and balances it with internal equity to ensure a fair and competitive salary. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise, while offers closer to the minimum reflect strong potential with room to develop.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package which also includes health and wellness benefits, employer-matched RRSP savings, a performance-based bonus program, and many more perks including free movies and free grocery delivery.

What you can expect from our interview process:

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
A virtual interview with the Hiring Manager. This is a chance to share how your experience aligns with the needs of the team and to learn more about the day-to-day responsibilities.
An virtual interview with the Director, Partnerships & Marketing and the Director, Data Science & Analytics to gain insights into the overarching accountabilities of the role and who you will be working with.
A final in-person interview with the Executive Director, Partnerships, to grow your understanding of the strategic impact of this role and how it aligns with the growth strategy of Scene.

Apply now.

At Scene+, we're committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to integrate these values into everything we do, from our partners and offers to our teams and interactions. We welcome and appreciate candidates from diverse backgrounds, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), the LGBTQ2SIA+ community, and other equity-seeking groups.

jobs.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

Who We Are:

SOTI is a proven leader at creating innovative solutions that reduce the cost and complexity of business-critical mobility. Thousands of companies around the world depend on us to secure, manage and support their mobile operations. SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. These relationships give us unparalleled insight into new technology and industry trends before they happen. SOTI is a proven innovator — clear vision, laser focus and a commitment to R&D has made us the market leader at delivering exciting, new business mobility solutions. SOTI helps businesses take mobility to endless possibilities.

The Role

SOTI is seeking a Director, Sales Best Practices to strengthen how our global sales organization sells, operates and scales. This leader will define and drive the sales standards, best practices, operating rhythms and performance programs that help our teams execute a consistent, high-quality enterprise sales motion.

Working closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Finance and People teams, you will translate go-to-market priorities into practical sales processes, playbooks, coaching frameworks, onboarding programs and performance insights. You will use data and field feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and build targeted solutions that improve seller productivity, pipeline quality, win rates, forecast discipline and time-to-productivity.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines strategic thinking, strong field credibility, analytical judgment and disciplined execution, and who can build scalable Sales Excellence practices that support SOTI's continued global growth.

What We Are Looking For

A strategic, hands-on Sales Excellence / Best Practices leader who understands complex enterprise sales organizations and can turn strategy into repeatable field execution.
A strong business partner who can work with senior sales leaders, challenge constructively, build alignment and influence across a global matrixed organization.
A data-driven operator who can identify performance gaps, determine root causes and translate insights into practical actions that improve sales outcomes.
A leader with strong knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies, pipeline management, opportunity qualification, manager coaching, onboarding and seller productivity.
Someone who can define what good looks like, build scalable best practices and create the governance and reinforcement required to drive sustained adoption.
A collaborative people leader who can build, coach and develop a high-performing Sales Excellence / Sales Enablement team.

What You Will Do

Define and lead the global Sales Excellence / Best Practices strategy, operating model and roadmap in partnership with senior Sales Leadership.
Establish and continuously improve sales standards, best practices and repeatable ways of working across regions, segments and sales motions.
Own the enterprise sales methodology and ensure consistent adoption across discovery, qualification, value articulation, multithreading, executive engagement, negotiation and close.
Define and govern opportunity stage criteria, exit criteria, qualification standards and deal-health expectations in partnership with Revenue Operations.
Build and maintain the enterprise sales playbook, including discovery frameworks, account and opportunity planning, executive engagement, competitive positioning and negotiation guidance.
Establish structured pipeline inspection, deal review and sales-manager coaching cadences that improve opportunity quality and reinforce accountability.
Use CRM, conversation intelligence and performance data to identify sales gaps, top-performer behaviors and opportunities to improve win rate, conversion, sales cycle, forecast accuracy and quota attainment.
Develop scalable manager coaching frameworks, call-review standards and targeted performance-improvement programs.
Own the global onboarding and ramp framework for core sales roles, including curriculum, certification, readiness milestones and manager checkpoints.
Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to embed competitive positioning, messaging, sales plays and product readiness into everyday field execution.
Lead or support major sales-readiness programs including Sales Kickoff, QBR enablement, manager forums and ongoing reinforcement initiatives.
Partner with Revenue Operations on CRM workflows, dashboards, leading indicators, forecasting discipline and sales-process governance.
Translate sales performance data into clear executive insights, recommendations and action plans.
Lead complex cross-functional Sales Excellence initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption and measurement.
Drive change management and field adoption so new sales processes, tools and programs are understood, applied and sustained.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Sales Excellence / Enablement team with clear priorities, accountability and measurable outcomes.

Required Skills & Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise software / SaaS sales, Sales Excellence, Sales Effectiveness, Revenue Enablement, Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations or a closely related function.
5+ years of leadership experience in Sales Excellence, Sales Effectiveness, Revenue Enablement or a related commercial function, including people leadership and executive-level stakeholder partnership.
Strong understanding of complex enterprise sales motions and how deals progress from prospecting and discovery through qualification, solution alignment, negotiation and close.
Deep practical experience with enterprise sales methodologies and qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC / MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, Command of the Message / Sale or equivalent.
Demonstrated experience improving measurable sales outcomes such as win rate, quota attainment, stage conversion, ramp time, forecast accuracy, pipeline quality or sales-cycle duration.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently interpret CRM, conversation-intelligence and business-intelligence data and convert findings into actions.
Experience designing and scaling sales operating rhythms, manager coaching programs, onboarding / certification programs, playbooks and field-adoption frameworks.
Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform, conversation-intelligence tools and BI / analytics platforms.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives in a global or matrixed organization.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for leaders, managers and sellers.

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

Reporting to the Managing Director, Subsidiary and Sustainability Reporting, you will lead CPP Investments’ group company financial reporting, legal entity management, subsidiary audits, and corporate accounting activities.

You will oversee financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and internal controls across global group companies, while strengthening governance, financial integrity, and operational efficiency. Working collaboratively with stakeholders, you will lead strategic initiatives, develop a high-performing team, and support scalable processes that enable CPP Investments’ investment activities.The role is responsible for strong governance, regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and operational risk management across CPP Investments’ global group companies, while enabling scalable, efficient, and well-controlled structures that support investment activities.

The Team

The Finance function supports CPP Investments’ financial integrity through accounting, reporting, governance, and effective financial controls. Within Finance, the Subsidiary and Sustainability Reporting team supports group company financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and audit management, working with stakeholders across the organization to maintain accurate and timely financial information.

Accountabilities

Lead and develop a collaborative team of finance and accounting professionals, providing coaching, performance feedback, and opportunities for professional growth.
Oversee the preparation and delivery of annual financial statements, regulatory filings, and periodic compliance reporting for CPP Investments’ global group companies, including Canadian and U.S. surveys.
Manage external audit relationships, coordinate annual subsidiary audits, and resolve complex accounting and financial reporting matters.
Strengthen financial governance, internal controls, and reporting processes to ensure the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of financial information.
Oversee corporate accounting activities, including capital assets, intercompany service level agreements, prepaid expenses, and other corporate assets.
Lead the monthly general ledger close process, collaborating with stakeholders to deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
Lead strategic projects and process improvements, integrating stakeholder needs, managing change, and supporting scalable and efficient operations.

What You Bring

An undergraduate degree or college diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline, and a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation.
8+ years of financial reporting experience within investment management, pension funds, financial services, or a related industry.
Advanced knowledge of corporate, financial, and regulatory reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and internal controls over financial reporting; knowledge of U.S. GAAP is an asset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop diverse teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project leadership capabilities; experience using generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Copilot, and automation is an asset.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

 Clio is the global leader in legal AI, trusted by hundreds of thousands of legal professionals across 130+ countries and having surpassed $500M ARR in 2026.  What you'll work on: 

 Set Vision & Multi-Year Strategy

 Build a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and AI curiosity — and lead the organization through significant role and workflow change with credibility and care. 

 Design the career architecture, competency frameworks, and enablement systems required for a support organization whose work is fundamentally changing. 

 Own the AI-First Support Architecture 
 Own the strategy and execution to evolve support into an AI-first model — elevating Clions to the complex, high-judgment work while AI agents handle routine inquiries at scale. 

 Evaluate, select, and drive enterprise adoption of AI support platforms (e.g., Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent), owning the build-versus-buy decisions and vendor relationships.

 Build AI-assisted agent tooling — agent assist, real-time suggestions, auto-summaries — that measurably improves time to resolution and first-contact resolution. 

 Establish the accuracy, compliance, and quality standards that AI-delivered support must meet in a high-trust, regulated vertical, and own accountability for them.

 Build PLG-integrated support motions — in-product nudges, proactive outreach triggers, self-service optimization — that reduce friction at critical conversion and adoption moments. 

 Partner with Revenue, Marketing, and Post Sales to make support a measurable input to net revenue retention, not an adjacent function. 

 Lead Multi-Product Support Excellence 
 Own the end-to-end support lifecycle for Clio's core practice management platform and for Clio Work (Legal AI drafting, research, and intelligence).

 Build proactive partnerships across Post Sales (Onboarding, Professional Services, CSM) to deliver a seamless customer experience across the lifecycle. 

 Serve as the escalation executive for critical customer and product incidents, owning resolution and the durability of the customer relationship afterward.

 Own the Support Systems architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, CCaaS platforms (e.g., Talkdesk), knowledge management, and AI support tooling. 

 Lead Workforce Management to forecast demand across traditional and AI channels, enabling intelligent staffing decisions and intraday optimization in a rapidly shifting volume mix. 

 Establish the operating cadence, data infrastructure, and reporting that allow support performance to be understood and trusted company-wide. 

 Market Leadership 
 Serve as the executive face of Clio's support organization externally, representing Clio at industry events and thought leadership forums. 

 Build Clio's reputation as the reference case for what AI-first support looks like in a high-trust vertical. 

 What you bring: 
 12+ years in customer support, service, or CX leadership, including 5+ years managing managers in high-growth B2B SaaS environments. 

 Proven experience leading global support or CX organizations of 150+ people across multiple geographies, with full budget or P&L ownership. 

 A demonstrated track record deploying AI support technologies at scale — you have actually done this and lived with the results, not advised on it. 

 Direct, hands-on experience with modern AI support platforms such as Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent, including vendor selection and enterprise rollout.

 Technology:

jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As Director, Valuations, you will lead the oversight of day-to-day valuation activities, including the development of valuation models, implementation of key controls, and delivery of insightful portfolio-level reporting.

Working closely with global investment teams and key stakeholders, you will manage the valuation of private investments across multiple asset classes (with a focus on Infrastructure and Sustainable Energies investments), providinge guidance on complex valuations, enhancinge valuation practices, and delivering analysis to support informed decision-making. You will also lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

 The Team 

 CPP Investments' Finance department plays a critical role in supporting the integrity of the Fund's financial reporting and investment valuations, providing independent oversight of valuation processes, controls, and results across a globally diversified investment portfolio.
 Within Finance, the Valuations team brings specialized expertise in assessing the fair value of complex investments through rigorous valuation methodologies, financial modelling, and independent judgment. Working closely with global investment teams, external valuation specialists, and governance stakeholders, the team strengthens valuation practices, delivers portfolio insights, and supports transparent, consistent, and well-governed investment valuations.

 Accountabilities 
 Lead the planning and execution of private investment valuations, identifying material valuation movements and delivering insightful analysis across the portfolio, with a focus on Infrastructure and Sustainable Energies.
 Partner with global investment teams and cross-functional stakeholders on valuation activities, including the onboarding of new investments, while fostering strong relationships and sharing valuation expertise across the Fund.
 Oversee external valuation specialists, services, and relationships, ensuring effective controls, rigorous methodologies, and consistent valuation practices.
 Direct the preparation and review of valuation reports and portfolio-level insights for investment teams, the Valuation Committee, Audit Committee, and other Board-level stakeholders.
 Provide guidance on complex financial models, critically assessing key assumptions, valuation sensitivities, and risks to support sound decision-making.
 Drive enhancements to valuation methodologies, policies, reporting, and processes, including the adoption of AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and insights.
 Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team through recruitment, mentorship, regular feedback, and professional development, fostering collaboration and accountability.

 What You Bring 
 8+ years of relevant experience in professional valuation services, pension funds, private equity, and/or investment banking.
 An undergraduate degree or college diploma in a related field, such as Business or Economics; a relevant professional designation is considered an asset.
 Advanced knowledge of valuation standards and methodologies, with strong financial modelling, research, and analytical capabilities.
 Sound professional judgment, with the ability to assess complex financial models, challenge assumptions, evaluate sensitivities, and identify key risks.
 Experience leading complex projects, improving processes, and collaborating effectively with investment teams, cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders.
 Demonstrated ability to lead inclusively, mentor and develop professionals, and communicate complex valuation insights clearly to senior stakeholders.
 Strong relationship management and communication skills; advanced experience with Tableau, VBA, Python, or SQL is considered an asset.

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Inclusion & Accessibility 
 CPP Investments is committed to  equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.   

 Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud 
 CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.  

 CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. 
 At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

 We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

 So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

 The Adventure Ahead 🚀
 As our Vice President, Information Security, you will step up as the de facto security leader owning Docebo’s global security strategy across product, cloud, GRC, and AI. This is not an advisory tower role; you will operate at executive altitude while staying close to real architecture, engineering decisions, threat modeling, and control execution. You will drive hard, measurable risk reduction while pioneering AI-first security practices that empower our business to move fast with complete confidence.

 The Day-to-Day 🗓️
 Architect Global Strategy: Own and evolve Docebo’s enterprise security roadmap across product security, cloud hardening, GRC, privacy, and incident response to achieve measurable control maturity.

 Embed Security by Design: Partner deeply with Product and Engineering to integrate threat modeling, secure SDLC, CI/CD security, identity controls, and vulnerability remediation into core engineering workflows.

 Pioneer AI-First Security: Build robust governance and controls for AI products and internal tooling while harnessing AI to automate detection, vulnerability management, and threat response.

 Champion Customer Trust: Lead compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001) backed by real controls, and represent Docebo with executive credibility in board updates, audits, and enterprise customer due diligence.

 Elevate Defense Operations: Strengthen security telemetry, threat intelligence, and detection across cloud and corporate environments to protect against emerging modern attack patterns.

 Empower High-Impact Teams: Lead and coach a talented security team, building a high-accountability culture focused on clear outcomes, rapid execution, and continuous learning.

 Your Superpowers ⚡
 Proven Executive Leadership: Significant experience leading information security programs in a software, SaaS, or tech product environment with a track record of executive and board collaboration.

 Deep Technical Foundations: Hands-on mastery of application security, cloud security (AWS), infrastructure, identity systems, secure SDLC, and modern vulnerability management.

 Mandatory Certification: Active CISSP credential backed by a deep understanding of SOC 2, ISO 27001, privacy regulations, and enterprise SaaS security standards.

 Collaborative Business Driver: Exceptional ability to forge trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales, acting as an enabler who balances security with business velocity.

 Outcome-Focused Execution: A clear track record of using metrics and business risk language to make decisive, risk-informed choices in complex, ambiguous environments.

 Bonus Points 🎯
 AI Security Expertise: Hands-on experience securing AI-enabled products and LLMs, or utilizing AI tools to scale security operations and automated testing.

 Advanced Technical Certifications: Additional credentials such as CISM, CISA, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or GIAC, combined with offensive security or red teaming experience.

 Enterprise & Public Sector Reach: Proven experience navigating FedRAMP standards, public-sector requirements, and high-growth global SaaS expansion.

 Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 
 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

 Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉
 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:
 Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

 Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

 Our Promise to You 😍
 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

 Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

 Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

 Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

 Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

 About Docebo 💙
 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Hi, Future Homie! 
 At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.
 We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?

  📍Your Impact Starts Here 
 As our Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Homebase wins small business owners. That means the story we tell, how we price and package, which industries we go after, and what sales and support say on every call. Homebase has grown from a suite of tools for hourly teams into AI that takes care of an owner's least favorite work for them. More than 150,000 businesses already run on it. Most owners who would love Homebase have never heard of us, and your work decides how fast that changes.
 You will report to our CMO, lead our Product Marketing team, and work daily with Growth, Creative, Product, Sales, and Support. Every campaign, landing page, sales script, and support conversation starts from what your team learns and builds.
 This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll write the first draft of the narrative yourself and run the team with AI built into its work.
 These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role: 
 The Homebase story 
 Own the company narrative and the testing system behind it. New messages go into market with frequent testing and are judged on conversion.

 Make sure Growth, Creative, Sales, Support, Product, and PR tell one story with the outcome owners care about up front and our product as the proof.

 Pricing and packaging 
 Own how we price and package Homebase so an owner understands it in seconds, and it grows revenue per customer.

 Ship pricing and packaging changes, and measure each one on conversion and revenue.

 Industry go-to-market 
 Use data to choose the industries we go after first, then run a cross-functional pod to execute vertical growth campaigns.

 Build the kit every channel runs on, including owner insights, competitor maps, ad and landing page messaging, creator briefs, and Sales and Support scripts.

 Sales, support, and customer growth 
 Give Sales and Support the scripts, plays, bundles, and offers they use on every call, and refresh them regularly from what reps hear and why deals are lost.

 Products and customer insight 
 Partner with Product so Team App, Payroll, Cash Out, and Hiring are positioned to win with the story carried through sign-up, trial, and an owner's first 30 days.

 Build a customer insight engine with regular owner conversations, a panel you can hear from in days, and a running read on the market.

 Team leadership 
 Decide how the team is organized and what it works on each quarter, and say no to work that doesn't move revenue.

 Grow the people on your team into bigger roles, and run the team on the same weekly cadence as Growth with AI built into research, briefs, testing, and analysis.

 What success looks like 
 In your first 90 days, you've talked with dozens of owners and our new narrative and first industry kits are running in market. Your team has a clear plan for the next two quarters.

 By month 6, you know within two weeks which message is winning, and industry campaigns are beating general ones. Your first pricing and packaging changes are live and measured.

 By month 12, Sales and Support run your plays on their calls, and revenue per customer is growing. Growth and Creative start new campaigns from your team's story and owner insight.

 🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:
 8+ years in Product Marketing or go-to-market roles. You have led a team of Product Marketers and grown people into bigger roles.

 You have built a company narrative from customer insight and got a leadership team with strong views behind it. You can show what it did to growth once it shipped.

 You have owned pricing and packaging decisions with real data behind them and a measurable result on revenue or conversion.

 You have worked side by side with growth teams in a self-serve or high-velocity business and judged messaging on conversion.

 You have built industry or segment go-to-market programs that marketing and sales actually ran.

 You use AI in your own work every day and can show how you check what it produces.
