jobs.description:
Job Description:  
 CLUB CADDIE
 Every course, one move ahead
 Head of Enterprise Sales (MCO)
 Sales & Marketing  |  Reports to: President/Chief Revenue Officer  |  Travel: ~50%  |  Full-Time

 ABOUT CLUB CADDIE
 Club Caddie is a fast-growing golf course management software (GMS) company and a member of the Jonas Software family, a division of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). Our platform is the operating system for golf — unifying point of sale, tee sheet, member management, food and beverage, and payments into a single connected system for public, semi-private, and multi-course operators.
 We are built by operators, for operators, and our brand is anchored in four commitments: Unified Operations, Intelligent Action, Revenue Momentum, and Hospitality Memory. As Club Caddie scales its footprint with the country's largest multi-course operators (MCOs), we're investing in the enterprise sales leadership to match that ambition.

 THE ROLE
 The Head of Enterprise Sales owns Club Caddie's go-to-market motion for Multi-Course Operators (MCO) — management companies and ownership groups operating multiple golf facilities across the country. This is a hunting, value-building, and relationship-building role for a seasoned enterprise sales leader who knows how to navigate long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close large agreements.
 You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and work in close partnership with Marketing, Product, Implementation, and Customer Experience to build a durable pipeline of MCO logos, from first conversation through signed agreement and a clean handoff to post-sales. The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 - $120,000. 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 Own the MCO Sales Motion
 Build and execute a strategic account plan targeting the top multi-course operators in the U.S. and Canada, prioritizing accounts by fit, size, and strategic value.
 Manage a complex, multi-stakeholder sales pipeline in the CRM with rigor — accurate staging, next steps, forecasted close dates, and clear next steps on every opportunity.
 Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design, ROI/business case development, procurement, contracting, and close through an enterprise level sales methodology.
 Build Executive Relationships
 Develop value-based relationships with C-suite and operations leaders (CEO, COO, VP of Golf Operations, CIO) at management companies and ownership groups.
 Represent Club Caddie at industry events — NGCOA, the MCO Retreat (MCOR), and other regional and national golf industry gatherings — to build pipeline and deepen existing relationships.
 Act as a trusted advisor, bringing a point of view on how technology can solve real operational and financial challenges across a multi-course portfolio.
 Negotiate and Close Complex Deals
 Lead commercial negotiations on multi-year, multi-property agreements, balancing win rate, margin, and long-term account health.
 Partner with Finance, Legal, and Implementation to structure deals that are commercially sound and operationally deliverable.
 Manage competitive displacement deals against incumbent point-of-sale and tee sheet providers with a clear, defensible value narrative.
 Drive Cross-Functional Alignment
 Partner with Marketing and the Director of Digital on MCO-specific campaigns, collateral, and messaging that support the pipeline.
 Work closely with the Executive, Product, Customer Experience, and Sales teams to translate enterprise buyer feedback into product improvements, market awareness, and competitor insights.
 Ensure a clean, well-documented handoff from sales to implementation for every closed account, protecting the customer experience from contract to go-live.
 Forecasting & Performance 
 Own MCO segment forecasting and pipeline reporting, contributing accurate inputs to company-wide revenue scorecards and QBRs.
 Track and report on key metrics: pipeline coverage, deal velocity, win rate, average contract value, and sales cycle length.
 Manage deals through a formal sales methodology e.g. MEDDIC, MEDDPIC, etc… to ensure internal and external alignment.
 Continuously refine MCO sales playbooks, pricing strategy, and competitive positioning based on what's working in the field.
 Achieve or exceed the annual targets for MCO sales including new logo and back-to-base revenue targets.

 WHAT YOU BRING
 7+ years of enterprise or complex B2B sales experience, with a track record of closing large, multi-stakeholder agreements; SaaS, hospitality, or golf/club industry experience strongly preferred.
 Demonstrated success selling into complex organizations with long sales cycles and layered decision-making (procurement, ops, IT, finance, executive) leveraging enterprise sales methodologies. 
 Previous success creating value and desire across an entire organization including decision makers and deal champions.
 Strong commercial negotiation skills, with experience structuring multi-year, enterprise-wide contracts.
 Exceptional value-building instincts — comfortable and credible in a room with C-suite executives and front-line operators alike.
 Highly organized and data-driven; disciplined about CRM hygiene, pipeline accuracy, and forecasting.
 Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time for industry events, on-site customer meetings, and prospect visits.
 Self-directed and resilient — comfortable building a territory and a pipeline largely from the ground up.
 Genuine interest in or connection to the golf industry is a strong plus, but not required.

 WHY JOIN CLUB CADDIE
 Own a high-impact, high-visibility segment of the business, with a direct line to the CRO and executive team.
 Sell a genuinely differentiated, unified platform into an industry that is actively consolidating around modern technology.
 Competitive base plus uncapped commission, benefits, and the backing of Jonas Software and Constellation Software's scale and stability.
 Be part of shaping the next chapter of Club Caddie's MCO strategy, not just executing an existing playbook.

 Club Caddie is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

 Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

 Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Job Description:  
 About Computrition 

 Computrition, Inc. is a leading provider of enterprise foodservice, nutrition management, and retail technology, trusted by hundreds of organizations across North America, including healthcare systems, military installations, correctional facilities, and higher education institutions. For more than 44 years, we’ve built technology in partnership with our customers, helping them improve operational efficiency, strengthen financial performance, and deliver better nutritional care.

 We’re investing in the future of our platform by adopting modern technologies and working closely with customers to solve complex operational challenges. Our solutions have real-world impact by driving performance enhancement and show up directly in how hospitals, military installations, and other institutions operate every day.

 Computrition offers the stability of an established industry leader and the momentum of a company accelerating growth through innovation. We invest in our people and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and professional growth where employees can make a meaningful impact. You’ll join experienced professionals who are passionate about solving meaningful problems and delivering measurable outcomes for customers.

 With team members across the U.S. and Canada, and as part of a growing portfolio of technology companies owned by Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU.TO), we are well-positioned to continue advancing the future of foodservice and nutrition technology.

 If you’re looking to build technology that makes a meaningful impact while growing your career with a stable, innovative company, we’d like to hear from you.

 The role 
 VP, Marketing owns how Computrition is understood in the market and how that understanding turns into pipeline, revenue and retention. This is a player-coach role: you set direction and personally build a meaningful share of the work.

 Reports to: President and CEO 
 Location: Fully remote, United States 
 Travel: Up to 25 percent: industry conferences, customer visits, company events 

 You will work hand in hand with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and you are expected to know our products well enough to demo them and explain their business impact to a buyer.

 What you will deliver in your first 90 days 
 Baseline metrics: a marketing scorecard with current funnel performance and a first report of marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline 
 Team alignment: match each team member's strengths to our growth initiatives, so their skills are applied where they create the most impact 
 Spend review: a review of marketing vendors and tools, with savings identified 
 Agreed priorities: Marketing's priorities validated with each department leader 

 What you will deliver in your first 12 months 
 A marketing plan and scorecard: an annual plan and budget with an investment case per program, and a monthly scorecard tying marketing activity to pipeline, bookings and retention. 
 Attributed pipeline: agreed marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline targets with Sales, reported monthly from our marketing automation platform and Salesforce. 
 A refreshed brand and website: a brand refresh and a rebuilt website, delivered on time and on budget. 
 Sales-ready materials: a current, consistent library of product, ROI and competitive materials that Sales and Customer Success actually use. 
 Events with measured return: every major conference run against meeting, pipeline and cost targets, with a post-event ROI report. 
 Customer proof: at least 10 quantified customer stories and an active reference program. 
 Higher output with AI: measurably more content and campaign throughput from the same team. 

 What you will own 
 Growth engine and measurement 
 Own Marketing's operating system: annual plan, budget, vendor management, and a weekly and monthly operating rhythm 
 Build and run the marketing scorecard, with leading and lagging KPIs and targets 
 Own attribution across our marketing automation platform and Salesforce, lead scoring, lead handoff to Sales, and data quality 
 Report Marketing's performance in executive and quarterly business reviews 
 Rationalize the marketing technology stack and vendor spend, and keep every marketing account and asset under company ownership 
 Agree Marketing's priorities and service levels with each department every quarter 
 Revenue support: new business and existing customers 
 Run campaigns and account-based programs that create qualified pipeline for new-business sales 
 Run expansion, adoption and retention programs with Customer Success for the installed base 
 Turn Product's value model into seller-ready business-case tools, and maintain a database of customer outcomes that proves value delivered 
 Maintain a proposal and RFP content library, including support for public-sector and government responses 
 Run win/loss analysis and feed the findings to Sales, Product and messaging 
 Product and sales marketing 
 Partner with Product on positioning, naming, packaging input and launch readiness for new products and releases 
 Produce and maintain product sheets, presentations, demo stories, case studies and competitive battlecards 
 Govern messaging so every customer-facing asset is consistent and current 
 Run co-marketing with technology and channel partners 
 Events: in person and virtual 
 Build the annual event calendar with an investment case and ROI target for each event 
 Run national and regional conferences end to end: pre-booked meetings, booth, customer receptions, follow-up and ROI reporting 
 Run webinars, virtual events and our customer user conference 
 Support internal company events, including our annual employee conference 
 Brand and communications 
 Lead the brand refresh and protect brand standards across every channel 
 Own social media strategy, PR, thought leadership, industry awards and customer recognition programs 
 Keep our external profiles (directories, analyst and data sites) accurate 
 Support employer branding and the careers page for recruiting 
 Website and digital 
 Lead the website refresh and own the site's performance: traffic, conversion and lead quality 
 Own SEO and visibility in AI search tools 
 Run the customer newsletter and email programs 
 Internal communications 
 Own the company intranet and its content 
 Produce the company-wide leadership newsletter and internal announcements 
 Run customer surveys through one tool and one intake process, so results are coordinated and acted on 
 Market sensing 
 Turn Product-led competitive and market insights into battlecards, messaging and sales enablement 
 Produce intelligence reports from every major conference 
 With Product and Sales, define ideal customer profiles and segments across healthcare, military, corrections and higher education 
 Bring the voice of the customer into product and pricing decisions 
 AI-enabled marketing 
 Lead AI adoption across the team: AI-first workflows for research, content, campaigns, personalization and reporting 
 Build and deploy practical AI tools and agents, including automation inside our marketing automation platform and CRM 
 Set quality, brand-safety and data-privacy standards for AI-generated content 
 Measure and report the productivity and performance gains AI delivers 
 Grow our visibility in AI search and answer engines 
 What you bring 
 7+ years of B2B marketing in software or technology 
 Proof of delivered results: pipeline, revenue, conversion or retention gains you can quantify and attribute to your own work, and strategic initiatives you took from plan to completion 
 Demand generation and attribution: you have personally built demand programs and pipeline attribution in a marketing automation platform and Salesforce, or comparable platforms 
 Hands-on execution: you personally write, build campaigns, run the marketing automation platform and analyze the data, rather than only directing agencies or delegating 
 Decisiveness: you bring recommendations backed by numbers and own decisions within your authority 
 Deep product fluency: you have learned complex enterprise software well enough to demo it and model the ROI it creates for customers 
 AI literacy in practice: you use generative AI tools daily in production work, have built or deployed AI workflows or agents, and can show measurable gains in speed, quality or results 
 Transformation experience: you have led a brand refresh, a repositioning, a major launch or a rebuild of a marketing function 
 Event ROI: you have run conferences as measured investments, not just logistics 
 Tools: a marketing automation platform, Salesforce (or comparable CRM), a website CMS, web and campaign analytics 
 Remote collaboration: you drive cross-functional work effectively across locations and time zones 
 Preferred 
 Prior experience managing a marketing team 
 Experience marketing both on-premise and cloud software 
 Healthcare technology, healthcare foodservice or clinical nutrition background; a registered dietitian credential or close work with dietitians is a strong plus 
 Marketing to health systems, government or military buyers through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles 
 Experience in a private equity-backed or holding-company software environment 
 Internal communications experience alongside external marketing 

 How to apply and compensation 
 With your resume, please include: 
 A one-page summary of two or three results you personally drove, with the numbers 
 One sample of work you created yourself (a campaign, page, deck or content piece) 
 A short description of an AI workflow you use in your marketing work today 
 After applying online, also send your resume, with attachments to careers@computrition.com 

 Finalists will prepare a marketing plan from a case study we provide, present it live, and meet with Product and Sales leaders. 

 Compensation: base salary of $115,000 to $140,000, depending on experience, plus an annual performance bonus and benefits. Final title depends on experience. 

 Computrition is an equal opportunity employer.

developed and/or launched 3+ products to market, including AI-powered products or capabilities Ownership of product vision, roadmap and P&L, and of strategic roadmap alignment across a portfolio Portfolio analysis and strategy formulation; prioritizing spend by ROI and supporting financial models — including AI business cases and build/buy/partner decisions Track record aligning product strategy with new technologies, assessing and adopting emerging AI capabilities responsibly SME across multiple (3+) business domains; deep grasp of consumer trends, technological disruption and competitive factors — including how AI is reshaping the domain AI literacy sufficient to lead — understands AI concepts, capabilities and limitations well enough to make sound portfolio and investment decisions and to challenge technical proposals credibly. ML-engineering / data-science depth is not required Able to shape company product strategy, convey difficult messages to senior stakeholders and own key initiatives and business KPIs Leads, develops and champions a team of Product Managers across a multi-product portfolio; identifies and plans for performance improvement Sets the operating model for how the team applies AI, and raises its proficiency through enablement, coaching and a clear hiring bar AI-informed product/portfolio strategy — advantage vs commoditization, build/buy/ partner, AI business cases and ROI, roadmap sequencing against AI capability Responsible-AI governance across the portfolio — privacy, bias, security, transparency, human oversight, audit trails/incident response and relevant regulation Ownership of AI-feature economics and lifecycle — cost, latency, unit economics, pricing, drift/versioning/vendor decisions Setting AI standards and review gates for how the team builds AI features and uses AI Raising team AI capability — enablement, coaching, playbooks, shared tooling, hiring bar Ability to evaluate AI outputs, prototypes and technical proposals and fund the right bets Working AI literacy — concepts, capabilities and limitations sufficient to lead and challenge Continued practical use of AI in own work and adaptability as AI evolves Ability to direct effective collaboration across engineering, data, design and AI/ML teams Not required: building, training, fine-tuning or deploying ML models; data-science, MLOps or AI-research depth. jobs.title: Managing Director
jobs.description:
AI & Data Consulting | Office Leadership & Growth

Calgary, AB (Hybrid)
Full-time, permanent position
C$175,000–C$200,000 annually
Opportunity to establish and lead a new Calgary office

Raise has partnered with a growing, AI-first data and engineering consulting firm that helps mid-market and enterprise organizations leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, data analytics, and intelligent automation to solve complex business challenges and drive measurable results.

Combining deep business expertise with modern technology platforms, our client delivers practical, scalable solutions that create meaningful business impact.

Now, they're looking for someone to build and lead their Calgary operation.

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced technology consulting professional who brings together technical expertise, proven people leadership, strategic thinking, and strong client relationships.

We're looking for someone who understands what it takes to build a successful consulting business, from developing a thoughtful market strategy and recruiting the right talent to leading client engagements and establishing a high-performing local team.

This is not a traditional sales or business development role.

Success requires more than an established network or the ability to generate new business. You'll need the technical credibility to engage directly in client solution discussions, the leadership experience to build and manage a team, and the strategic mindset to turn a new market opportunity into a sustainable business.

You'll work directly with the founders and executive leadership, with significant autonomy and accountability for establishing the Calgary office and shaping its long-term success.

Whether you've previously helped build a practice or are ready to take the next step into broader business leadership, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact.

What You'll Be Doing

Client Relationships & Market Strategy

Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with senior executives and business leaders across Calgary's business community.
Develop a clear, actionable go-to-market strategy that identifies target industries, priority accounts, service opportunities, and measurable growth objectives.
Establish strategic partnerships and build credibility within Calgary's technology and business communities.
Identify opportunities to expand client relationships while maintaining accountability for service quality and successful delivery.

Office Development, Planning & Operations

Collaborate with the founders and executive leadership to align the Calgary operation with the company's broader strategic objectives.
Develop and execute a comprehensive plan to establish, operate, and grow the Calgary office – balancing sales and client relationships, people leadership, project delivery, and business performance
Define the organizational structure, resource and hiring priorities, service development, and operational processes needed to build a successful local consulting practice.
Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of consulting and technical professionals – fostering a team environment that enables exceptional client delivery
Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs, and measurable milestones across client engagement, consulting delivery, team development, and commercial performance to guide the office's development.

Consulting & Technical Leadership

Lead and contribute to client engagements, bringing practical experience in technology consulting, solution development, and project delivery.
Conversant with technical discussions involving AI, data engineering, analytics, cloud technologies and solution architecture.
Translate complex business challenges into practical technology solutions, collaborating with engineering and delivery teams to determine appropriate solutions.
Oversee consulting engagements to ensure projects are delivered effectively, client expectations are met, and business outcomes are achieved.
Serve as a credible bridge between executive stakeholders, technical teams, and consulting delivery resources.

What You'll Bring

7+ years of progressive experience in technology consulting, IT professional services, or a related technical consulting environment.
Proven people leadership experience, with responsibility for managing, developing, and mentoring technical or consulting teams.
Previous hands-on experience in software development, data engineering, solution architecture, or technical implementation.
The ability to independently participate in technical discovery and solution discussions, understand engineering approaches, and collaborate effectively with technical specialists.
Experience developing and executing business plans, go-to-market strategies, or consulting practice growth initiatives.
Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of services-based consulting, including project scoping, resource planning, delivery accountability, and client relationship management.
Experience building relationships with senior executives and translating business needs into actionable consulting opportunities.
Excellent communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to facilitate productive discussions and engage diverse stakeholders.
Strong organizational and decision-making skills, with the ability to establish priorities, develop actionable plans, and hold teams accountable.
An entrepreneurial mindset, sound judgment, and the confidence to lead an operation with significant autonomy.
Experience establishing a new office, launching a consulting practice, or expanding a regional operation is a nice to have.
An established professional network within Calgary or Alberta's business community.
Experience delivering consulting services to Oil & Gas, Energy, Financial Services, or large enterprise clients.
A degree or professional background in computer science, engineering, information technology, data science, or a related discipline.
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, or modern AI and data platforms preferred but not required.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

We're looking for a well-rounded consulting leader who can see the big picture while understanding what it takes to execute.

Someone who can build strong relationships with executive stakeholders, confidently participate in technical discussions, and lead a team through the successful delivery of complex consulting engagements.

You'll Be Successful Here If You

Lead by example: You bring meaningful consulting and technical experience, allowing you to guide teams and contribute to client solutions.
Think strategically: You can develop a thoughtful business plan, establish meaningful KPIs, and articulate how you'll build a successful operation.
Build great teams: You have experience identifying talent, developing people, and creating an environment where teams can succeed.
Understand the technology: You don't need to be the most technical person in the room, but you can independently engage in engineering and solution conversations.
Build relationships through trust: You value listening, collaboration, and understanding client needs over transactional selling.
Take ownership: You're comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and being accountable for the success of a growing business.
Balance vision with execution: You can set a strategic direction while remaining actively involved in the work required to achieve it.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Build a business. Build a team. Make your mark.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful leadership role within a growing technology consulting organization, with the freedom to influence how an entirely new office is established and developed.

Rather than inheriting an existing team and predetermined business model, you'll have the opportunity to shape the Calgary operation, from its market strategy and client relationships to its hiring priorities and consulting capabilities.

You'll work directly with the founders and executive leadership, combining the support and expertise of an established organization with the autonomy and ownership of an entrepreneurial venture.

For an experienced consulting professional ready to step into broader leadership, this could be the career-defining opportunity you've been looking for.

And for someone who has already built and led a successful consulting practice, it's an opportunity to bring that experience to a growing organization operating at the forefront of AI and data transformation.

If you're ready to combine your technical consulting expertise, leadership experience, and entrepreneurial ambition to build something meaningful, we'd love to connect.

Looking for Meaningful Work? We can help.

Raise is an established hiring firm with over 65 years of experience. We believe strongly in making the world a better place through work, which is why we’re a certified B Corporation and donate 10% of our profits to charity.

We strive to build teams that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply, including people from traditionally underrepresented groups such as women, visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, people identifying as LGBTQ2SI, veterans, and people with visible/nonvisible disabilities.

We have a dedicated webpage for accommodations where you can learn more about what we offer, and request accommodation: https://raise.jobs/accommodations/

jobs.title: Director of Asset Management
jobs.description:
Description

Director of Asset Management

FirstService Multifamily delivers integrated property and asset management services to owners, developers, and institutional investors across Canada. The platform supports the full rental housing lifecycle, including development advisory, marketing & lease-up, property management, asset optimization, and operational execution across multifamily residential and mixed-use assets.

Through a fully integrated operating model, FirstService Multifamily partners closely with internal service lines and industry partners to deliver operational excellence, portfolio performance, resident satisfaction, and long-term asset value creation.

As the platform continues to expand nationally, FirstService Multifamily is focused on building scalable operational infrastructure, strong regional leadership, and institutional-quality service delivery across all markets it serves.

As part of the Executive Leadership Team, the Director of Asset Management is responsible for maximizing the financial performance and long-term value of a national portfolio of multifamily investment properties. Working across Operations, Leasing, Sales, Finance and Consulting, this role develops portfolio-wide strategies that improve net operating income, reduce operating costs, and optimize capital investments for a diverse portfolio of properties.

The Director of Asset Management is not responsible for the day-to-day management of individual properties. Instead, they serve as a strategic partner and subject matter expert for Property Managers and Operations.

In addition to overseeing portfolio performance, this role provides leadership to the Consulting Team, National Procurement Program and Capital Projects Team, ensuring strategic initiatives deliver measurable value to clients.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Performance & Asset Strategy

Monitor and evaluate the financial and operational performance of a national portfolio of multifamily investment properties.
Develop and implement portfolio-wide asset management strategies that align with client objectives and corporate business plans.
Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve operating efficiency, reduce expenses and enhance long term asset value.
Establish performance benchmarks and monitor key portfolio metrics to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
Develop strategic recommendations that balance financial performance with resident satisfaction and long-term asset preservation.

Financial Analysis & Portfolio Optimization

Develop sophisticated financial models to evaluate asset performance, investment opportunities and operational initiatives.
Analyze monthly financial statements, operating reports and budget variances across the portfolio.
Evaluate key performance indicators including:
Net Operating Income (NOI)
Occupancy
Rent Growth
Leasing Velocity
Delinquency
Turnover
Operating Expense Ratios
Utility Consumption
Capital Expenditures

Perform scenario analysis and forecasting to support strategic planning and investment decisions.
Partner with Finance during annual budgeting and forecasting processes.

National Procurement Strategy

Lead the organization's national procurement strategy.
Develop and maintain strategic vendor partnerships.
Identify opportunities to standardize procurement practices, consolidate vendors and negotiate national agreements.
Collaborate with Operations and Finance to implement procurement initiatives that optimize operating costs.

Capital Planning

Work with Operations on developing a National Capital Planning Team.
Develop long term capital investment strategies based on asset lifecycle planning and financial performance.
Evaluate capital improvement opportunities and prepare investment analyses and return on investment models for clients.
Monitor capital project performance against approved budgets and expected financial outcomes.

Consulting Services

Provide leadership, mentorship and direction to the National Consulting Team.
Oversee the development of operating budgets for consulting clients.
Provide operational expertise and best practice recommendations for:
Operating cost and efficiencies
Building system and equipment selection
Unit finish specifications
Community development strategies
Building and suite design

Business Development

Support business development efforts by providing insights and strategic recommendations for prospective clients.
Collaborate with Business Development and Operations to demonstrate the value of FirstService Multifamily's asset management expertise.

Risk Management

Identify financial, operational and market risks that may impact portfolio performance.
Develop mitigation strategies to minimize risk and improve long term investment performance.
Monitor compliance with internal financial controls, investment strategies and operational standards.
Evaluate insurance, reserve planning and major operational risks in collaboration with internal stakeholders.

Required Skills & Abilities

Minimum five years of experience in real estate and asset management.
Demonstrated experience supporting large, diverse real estate portfolios.
Strong financial background.
Exceptional analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities.
Experience leading a team.
Willingness and ability to obtain and maintain real estate licensing in Alberta and British Columbia, as required.
Willingness to travel to sites and regional offices.

The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $160,000
, along with a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a targeted annual incentive plan.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., quantitative finance, mathematics, statistics, engineering, actuarial sciences, economics or related)

Strong understanding of model risk management best practices (model lifecycle: development, implementation, validation, monitoring)

Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to synthesize and explain complex quantitative topics to non‑quant partners and senior management

Step into the driver's seat and help shape the future of mobility in Canada.

YOURS TO OWN

You support senior executive leadership by developing and executing a comprehensive Canada fleet strategy aligned with the company's growth objectives, operational priorities, and financial goals
You lead the company's remarketing strategy to maximize asset value, accelerate inventory turnover, and expand the regional dealer network across Canada, executing remarketing strategies that optimize returns by balancing direct-to-dealer sales with wholesale auction channels
You manage the end-to-end fleet lifecycle, including vehicle procurement, demand and capacity planning, utilization, inventory optimization, fleet allocation, asset performance, vehicle disposition, and remarketing across Canadian markets
You liaise with senior leaders, OEM partners, auction providers, transportation vendors, dealerships, digital marketplaces, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen strategic partnerships and maximize commercial and financial outcomes
You maintain operational and financial excellence by establishing performance metrics, strengthening governance and controls, ensuring compliance with federal and provincial regulatory requirements — including provincial vehicle registration, safety standards, and Transport Canada requirements — mitigating risk, and implementing scalable, data-driven processes across fleet operations
You receive and leverage market intelligence, financial performance data, forecasting models, and operational insights to optimize fleet decisions, manage residual value risk, anticipate market trends, and identify opportunities to increase profitability across the Canadian fleet portfolio
You assist in advancing SIXT's Canada growth strategy by building, developing, and leading a high-performing Fleet organization while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

Experience
You have 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in fleet management, vehicle procurement, remarketing, automotive finance, asset management, mobility, transportation, or a related industry, including significant experience leading complex business functions and geographically dispersed teams across the Canadian market

You have a bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Automotive Management, Operations, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred, and you are legally authorized to work in Canada without sponsorship

You are a results-oriented leader with a proven ability to develop scalable strategies, optimize financial and operational performance, lead organizational transformation, build high-performing teams, and deliver measurable business results

You are flexible and willing to travel domestically across Canada and internationally, up to 25%

WHAT WE OFFER

Paid Time Off:
Enjoy a generous vacation policy that increases with tenure
Comprehensive Healthcare & Life Insurance:
Access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with life insurance for added security

: Save for your future with our company-matching RRSP program
Exclusive Benefits:
Access to a company car as well as special rental rates for family and friends

Access to the Employee Assistance Program for personal and professional support when needed

Financial Services is responsible for accounting and reporting on the financial transactions of the University including specifically accounting and financial reporting; external audits; treasury, debt management and investing services; procurement, payables, shipping and receiving; research and special project accounting and reporting; budget administration and advisory and support services; finance systems and training; accounts receivable and collection services, university pension plan audit and the insurance management program.

The Opportunity

The Assistant Controller and Associate Director, Accounting & Reporting provides financial management expertise and strategic advice to the University community by leveraging in depth knowledge of accounting, auditing and internal control practices and principles, standards and information systems, as well as solid understanding of tax and legislative compliance in Canada and other jurisdictions.

Develops options through the oversight of complex financial analysis and modelling. Reviews and analyzes organizational financial performance to provide advice to the leadership that enables effective decision making.
Develops financial procedures with the Controller and implements them in a complex and dynamic environment.
Acts as functional lead on projects to develop or redesign processes and procedures to increase efficiencies and to ensure effective internal controls for enterprise risk management.
Represents the Controller in their absence.

Summary Of Responsibilities

Assists the Controller in providing strategic leadership to the university community on financial and process related issues, including the application of professional judgement in situations where clear direction is not available or interpretation is required.
Provides financial advice and oversight on matters of internal controls, operational risk management and compliance assurance.
Develops plans for the effective scheduling and management of quarter-end unaudited and annual year-end audit activities, to manage preparation of various financial statements, filing of extensive external reporting and surveys and to ensure readiness for various external audits. Plans and manages appropriate resource allocation in order to meet conflicting deadlines while ensuring data integrity. Collaborates with senior management and various stakeholders to ensure milestones and reporting deadlines are achieved in a timely manner.
Evaluates outcomes from previous cycles and adjusts planning strategies to address recurring challenges and improve effectiveness.
Leads the external audit process for university financial statements and TMU pension plan financial statement audit and other special purpose audits, acting as first level of contact for questions from staff and auditors.
Actively manages overall completion of all external auditor Prepared By Client (PBC) list status and ensures effective management of internal staff time during the audit process.
Manages special projects from planning to implementation under the general direction of the Controller by formulating project scope, resource requirements, key deliverables and designs feasible work plans to ensure successful delivery of operational targets.
Develops complex financial models, what if scenarios and sensitivity analysis, providing comprehensive analysis and recommendations to support sound decision-making across the organization.
Monitors legislative changes and assess their impact on university financial activities, advising the Controller and CFO. Leads the implementation of required updates to policies, procedures, and financial systems in collaboration with external tax advisors and university networks to ensure compliance with all applicable tax laws.
Plans and aligns departmental staffing structures and workflows to support operational effectiveness and evolving workforce planning needs. Conducts strategic reviews of team composition, role alignment, and resource allocation to ensure efficient use of human resources and adherence to budgetary parameters.

Leadership Competencies

Leaders at TMU are required to demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies:

Acts with Integrity: Demonstrates behaviors aligned with high ethical standards and personal integrity and acts in accordance with TMU values.
Builds Relationships of Trust & Collaboration: Actively builds a culture of trust and fosters meaningful relationships.
Leads Inclusively: Creates an inclusive environment where everyone is respected, recognized, empowered to achieve their potential, and valued for their differences.
Demonstrates Organizational Acumen: Understands and respectfully navigates complex internal and external environments using sound judgment, diplomacy, and tact.
Drives Vision & Results: Creates and implements a vision grounded in sound decision-making to achieve desired outcomes.

Qualifications

To help us learn more about you, please provide a cover letter and resume describing how you meet the following required qualifications:

Completion of a post-secondary degree in Finance, Accounting or Business-related field with Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation
A minimum of five (5) years of relevant financial management experience with the following requirements:
Previous experience in financial compliance, audit and advisory services, tax compliance, oversight of financial processes and controls, financial transaction oversight and/or financial closing and reporting.
Demonstrated experience in analyzing complex financial analysis, modelling, financial statement preparation, including note disclosures and presentation.
Experience supervising staff in a unionized environment.
In-depth knowledge of Canadian accounting standards i.e. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (“GAAP”), auditing methods and principles for not-for-profit organizations.
Demonstrated expertise in preparation of financial statements and reporting, financial analysis and planning,finance information systems, technology database and complex process designs and auditing techniques and internal controls.
Advanced knowledge of tax legislation, rules, and procedures (Income Tax Act and Excise tax Act).
Experience in a post-secondary environment, or another large and complex public-sector organization, with an understanding of institutional governance, compliance requirements, and decentralized operations, would be an asset.
Knowledge of accounting systems management, financial modeling techniques and not-for-profit accounting and experience using accounting software / applications.
Ability to understand and accurately interpret operational and functional indicators that impact customer service.
Strong relationship management skills in order to communicate with all management levels and external stakeholdersStrong (oral, interpersonal, written) communication skills including ability to read, write and comprehend complex documents (e.g. policies, contracts, regulatory guidelines, audit reports ).
Strong negotiating skills, organizational and planning skills.
Strong computer proficiency and knowledge of computers and various software application packages (e.g. Word, Excel, Access, Microsoft Project, e-mail, PowerPoint, Google Apps, etc.).
Ability to multi-task and meet tight deadlines;
The ability to lead and navigate change effectively while cultivating a transformative and supportive environment for staff;
Strong strategic-thinking skills with an ability to identify, recommend and collaborate with team members on process improvements and best practices;
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask and prioritize as necessary.

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is hiring a Permanent, Full-time Senior Director, Commercial Finance & Performance Management (CFPM), based in either Edmonton or Calgary.

Reporting to the Vice President, Finance & Supply Chain, this role represents one of the most senior and influential finance leadership positions within Finning Canada. As the senior commercial finance leader for a ~$6B revenue business, the Senior Director, CFPM plays a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, optimizing capital deployment, and strengthening commercial governance across the organization. Partnering closely with Canadian Operations, this leader oversees the Commercial & Financial Business Partnering team and serves as a trusted advisor to senior and executive leadership, translating strategy into actionable financial insight.

Leading a high-performing team of finance leaders, the role champions strong commercial acumen, best-in-class budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning, and delivers insightful financial and operational reporting to enable data-driven decision-making and effective performance management. With significant exposure to the Canadian leadership team and the broader Finning Executive, this role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact initiatives, influence enterprise-wide strategy, and shape the financial future of the business. Positioned as a key succession role to the VP, Finance & Supply Chain, this role provides a clear pathway to broader executive accountability and long-term leadership growth within Finning.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platform, Web & eCommerce
jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Director, Digital Experience Platform, Web & ECommerce

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms, Web & eCommerce provides senior leadership for Four Seasons’ web and eCommerce digital platforms, overseeing platform engineering, platform management, DevOps, release quality, compliance, and security operations.

The role balances strategic platform ownership with hands-on team leadership, ensuring that digital platforms, including FourSeasons.com, microsites, eCommerce, and related digital properties, operate with excellence, stability, and continuous improvement.

The Director partners closely with Brand & Marketing Technologies, Hotel Digital Operations, Digital Analytics, Quality Assurance, and the broader Technology Innovation & Data organization.

The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, technically curious, and comfortable working with both business users and developers.

What You’ll Be Doing

Platform Leadership & Strategy

Provide strategic direction and oversight for all web-based digital experience platforms, including FourSeasons.com, eCommerce platforms, and microsites.
Manage platform roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and delivery standards across web and eCommerce to ensure alignment with project delivery and other company initiatives.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align platform investments with business objectives, ensuring platforms support luxury guest experience goals.
Lead vendor relationship management and technology evaluations (e.g., platform providers, CDN partners, analytics and monitoring tools).
Establish success measures for AI-enabled capabilities, including guest adoption, conversion, content efficiency, service quality, operational performance, and risk indicators.
Evaluate when to build, buy, configure, or integrate AI capabilities, ensuring decisions align with enterprise architecture, data, security, privacy, and procurement standards.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers and platform management analysts.
Establish clear goals, expectations, and performance frameworks aligned to Four Seasons career progression models.
Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Manage hiring processes, including role definition, interviews, and onboarding for platform-focused roles.
Develop and coach technical leaders, establishing clear ownership, succession planning, talent development, and career growth strategies.

Platform Engineering & Operations

Oversee platform engineering practices including monitoring, alerting, infrastructure oversight, and release coordination.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, integration patterns, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, and AI/LLM Ops practices.
Ensure robust observability across web platforms using tools such as Elastic, Dynatrace, and Adobe Analytics.
Govern platform release cycles, change advisory board (CAB) processes, and production deployment standards.
Drive incident management, escalation handling, and SLA compliance across all web platforms.
Oversee the integration and operational readiness of AI services within digital platforms, including APIs, data flows, observability, performance, resilience, cost management, fallback behaviours, and incident response.
Ensure AI-enabled production capabilities are appropriately tested and monitored for availability, latency, output quality, unexpected behaviour, security events, and changes introduced by vendors or underlying models.
Support the responsible use of AI-assisted engineering, testing, documentation, observability, and incident analysis tools, with appropriate review and secure software delivery controls.
Experience delivering AI-enabled products, intelligent automation solutions, and data-driven digital experiences across DXT domains including CRM, marketing, e-commerce, loyalty, customer service, and digital experience platforms.

Platform Management & Compliance

Oversee the management and compliance of digital microsites and specialized platform properties, including sites supporting property functions.
Lead platform security reviews, vulnerability assessments (including CVE triage), PCI DSS compliance, and accessibility (WCAG) remediation efforts.
Manage platform vendor relationships related to infrastructure and compliance tooling (including, AWS, ObservePoint, Akamai, Alibaba).
Coordinate platform transitions and retirement, migration, and lifecycle activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Digital team to support business roadmap.
Partner with Mobile, QA, Analytics, and CI/CD teams to deliver consistent cross-platform standards.
Support eCommerce platform initiatives including enhancing shopping cart and booking flows, digital profile capabilities and white-label site deployments.
Experience integrating enterprise platforms and business systems including Salesforce, Oracle, marketing technologies, data platforms, and third-party SaaS solutions.
Represent the platform team in leadership forums, technology governance bodies, and cross-functional planning cycles.
Collaborate with Brand, Content, Marketing, Hotel Operations, Legal, Privacy, Security, and Digital teams to define acceptable AI use cases, guest experience standards, human review requirements, and escalation paths.
Represent web and eCommerce platform requirements in enterprise AI governance, architecture, investment, and prioritization forums.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Digital Product Management, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in digital platform management, platform engineering, or digital product leadership roles.
Proven track record leading high-performing technical teams, including Platform Owners, Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, SRE, QA, DevOps, and vendor resources.
Expert in building and operating enterprise-scale technology platforms in cloud-first environments, including application development, reliability engineering, observability, performance optimization, and operational excellence.
Proven experience leading the strategy, delivery, and operation of platforms supporting guest-facing digital experiences, e-commerce capabilities, digital compliance requirements (accessibility, security, PCI DSS), and commercial business functions.
Experience translating AI opportunities into prioritized use cases, business cases, implementation roadmaps, and measurable outcomes, with appropriate consideration for data readiness, privacy, security, intellectual property, responsible AI, and organizational change.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders and influence at a senior level.
Experience in luxury hospitality, travel, or another guest-centric digital environment is an asset.
Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
Certifications considered an asset: ITIL 4; AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps certifications; PMP; CISSP or CISM; TOGAF; or equivalent certifications in digital platform leadership, cloud operations, security, privacy, enterprise architecture, strategic planning, organizational leadership, or people management. Executive leadership or strategy certificates from institutions such as Rotman, Ivey, or Kellogg are also considered assets.
Deep understanding of enterprise web platforms, eCommerce ecosystems, and digital experience technologies.
Knowledge of CMS, DAM, personalization, search, content delivery, and customer journey platforms.
Experience managing large-scale, customer-facing digital platforms with high availability and performance requirements.
Understanding of digital product management, platform roadmaps, and lifecycle management.
Strong understanding of modern cloud-based web architectures, APIs, microservices, headless and composable platform concepts.
Deep knowledge of front-end and back-end technology ecosystems and integration patterns.
Familiarity with CDN technologies, web performance optimization, caching strategies, and global content delivery.
Understanding of system architecture, scalability, resilience, and platform modernization approaches.
Knowledge of application security practices and secure software delivery principles.
Understanding of privacy regulations and digital compliance requirements.
Incident management, problem management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning
Vendor management, technology evaluation, and enterprise platform governance.
Working knowledge of prompt design and AI evaluation techniques, with an understanding that production solutions require structured testing, governance, monitoring, and human oversight beyond prompt development.
Working knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and tools including Jira, Confluence, and Monday.com.

Key Skills/Who You Are

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Identifies emerging trends, risks, and opportunities to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
Builds, inspires, and develops high-performing teams.
Creates an inclusive and psychologically safe environment where team members can thrive.
Holds individuals and teams accountable while providing support and guidance.
Builds strong relationships across business and technology functions.
Influences decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
Effectively navigates competing priorities and stakeholder interests.
Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.
Leads organizational change associated with AI adoption, including role clarity, capability development, new workflows, and responsible-use expectations.
Makes sound decisions in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments.
Maintains focus on quality, operational excellence, and measurable business results.
Helps others understand and embrace change by providing context and direction.

Salary Range: $140,000 - $170,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week in the Four Seasons York Mills Office located at 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario

jobs.description:

26WD100769 Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy and Analytics

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing
Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth
Drive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomes
Define Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomes
Drive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programs
Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes
Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight
Drive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teams
Demonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectiveness
Strong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environments
Experience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioning
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendations
Proven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teams
Demonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisions
Ability to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impact
BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

_________________________________________________________________________

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entreprise
Diriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talents
Favoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affaires
Définir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clients
Optimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmes
Établir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affaires
Faire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriée
Favoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèle
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou dispersées
Une expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketing
Une solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affaires
Une expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA
Capacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètes

jobs.description:
About The ALDO Group

Specializing in stylish and accessible footwear, handbags, and accessories, the ALDO Group has been around for more than 50 years. With over 1,500 stores in more than 100 countries, we operate under two signature brands, ALDO and Call It Spring, and we are the core footwear partner for Sperry in North America. The ALDO Group is also an industry-recognized wholesale licensed partner, specializing in the design, sourcing, and distribution of fashion footwear, handbags, and accessories. Our diverse portfolio includes household brands such as ROXY, Brooks Brothers, Ted Baker, Hunter, and G.H.BASS. In addition to our head office in Montreal, the ALDO Group maintains international offices in Europe and Asia. For more information, visit www.aldogroup.com.

Enjoy meaningful recognition, flexible work options, great on‑site perks, generous discounts, and the pride of being part of a brand that leads with people, the planet, and its partners at heart.

Overview

The Account Director, Franchise Markets is responsible for the overall business performance, growth strategy, and profitability of ALDO Group’s franchise business across international markets. The role partners closely with franchise owners, CEOs, and senior leadership teams to drive revenue growth, margin improvement, market expansion, and long-term brand success while ensuring alignment with ALDO Group’s commercial and brand objectives.

This role leads the Account Management team and works cross-functionally with Product Development, Merchandising, Planning, Retail Buying, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance to optimize business and product performance. The position has direct accountability for sales targets, assortment strategy, buying, pricing, inventory productivity, and in-season business management.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute regional business strategies that drive revenue growth, profitability, market share, and long-term expansion across franchise markets.
Lead and grow strategic relationships with franchise owners and executive leadership teams, aligning partners around shared business objectives and market opportunities.
Own the planning and execution of the four annual Market Week sell-in cycles, maximizing partner investment, sell-in results, and financial performance.
Lead regional product, assortment, and buying strategies to optimize revenue, margin, sell-through, and inventory productivity.
Identify consumer, product, and fashion trends across key markets and translate insights into market-relevant assortments, regional initiatives, and exclusive product opportunities.
Drive in-season business performance through replenishment strategies, inventory optimization, pricing, markdown management, and continuous performance analysis.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Managers and related professionals while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative culture.
Influence cross-functional stakeholders and represent franchise market needs in key product, commercial, and strategic business decisions.

Key Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Merchandising, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in account management, buying, merchandising, franchise, wholesale, retail, or international business.
5+ years of people leadership experience with responsibility for coaching, performance management, and talent development.
Significant experience managing international franchise or multi-market businesses, ideally across multiple international markets.
Proven track record of driving revenue growth, profitability, and margin improvement in complex international environments.
Strong buying, merchandising, assortment planning, and product management expertise.
Demonstrated experience leading seasonal buy and sell-in cycles and influencing senior stakeholders and strategic partners.
Strong financial acumen, analytical capability, and understanding of retail, franchising, and international market dynamics.

Building a culture of belonging

We firmly believe that the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and identities is a fundamental strength of the ALDO Group. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to providing a safe, respectful, and equitable work environment where everyone can reach their full potential and find their fit.
