jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 About Float 
 Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 Our Product 
 Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

 AI Use in Our Hiring Process 
 We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

 About the Role 
 Float’s partnerships channel is one of our newest growth motions, and the one with the most room to run.

 Accounting firms, affiliates and technology platforms already use Float as one place to manage their clients’ financial operations while growing their own. The foundation is strong. The playbook is still unwritten.

 As Head of Partnerships, you’ll report into our SVP of GTM and own the partnerships channel end to end: how we find and win partners across all three types, how we build a community that makes them want to stay, and how what they tell us shapes the product roadmap. You’ll take partnerships from promising to a meaningful share of Float’s growth.

 What You’ll Do 
 Write the partnership playbook 
 Build a multi-year partnership strategy with clear milestones tied to revenue and strategic value.

 Create the processes, playbooks and infrastructure to scale from a handful of partners to dozens.

 Set the targets and reporting. You define what a great channel looks like, then hit it.

 Win and grow partners 
 Find, win, activate and grow partners across accounting and bookkeeping firms, fractional finance teams and investor networks.

 Own the full deal cycle, from first conversation to signed partner.

 Design one-to-many distribution and enablement programs so one partner relationship reaches hundreds of clients.

 Start with the firms that bring the most reach, then widen from there. Once a partner is live, work with Sales to accelerate revenue through them.

 Build the community 
 Run the programs, events and community that make partners better at their jobs and make serving clients easier.

 Track what each partner type delivers, and double down on what works.

 Own how Float shows up for partners, in their language, alongside Marketing.

 Bring the outside in 
 Carry market intelligence and partner feedback back into company strategy and roadmap.

 Work with internal stakeholders to clear whatever slows partners down.

 Build the team 
 Grow a small team, shape it around where the channel is today, and decide where you stay hands-on.

 What You'll Bring 
 8+ years in partnerships, channel or ecosystem growth in B2B SaaS, fintech or payments, including building a partner program from the early stage

 Proven ownership of a partner funnel end to end (sourcing, conversion, activation, expansion) and fluency in the numbers behind each stage

 Comfort being the public face of a program: building community and representing us with external partners

 A marketer’s instinct for positioning a product for a specific audience, ideally professional-services firms

 Experience leading a small team

 Working knowledge of how accounting and bookkeeping firms operate

 Willingness to travel regularly across Canada for events and partner visits

 Strong command of AI tools, as both a user and a builder

 Nice to haves 
 A network in Canadian accounting, bookkeeping, VC or PE circles, or a background as an accountant or bookkeeper

 French proficiency (an asset, not a requirement)

 This May Not Be the Role for You If
 You need an established playbook and a large team before you can do your best work.

 You would rather manage a channel from the sidelines than meet partners yourself.

 You prefer a narrow, single-function remit. This role spans marketing, sales and product.

 You're not energized by feedback or fast-paced change.

 Our Hiring Philosophy 
 We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

 Why You Should Join 
 Be part of an award winning company: we're one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2026 according to Report on Business, and Deloitte’s Technology Fast50 2026

 Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 Hybrid work model: we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 In Short 
 At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you. 

 Protect yourself from recruiting scams. Float only contacts candidates from @ floatfinancial.com addresses and schedules interviews through Ashby or Float calendar invites. We will never ask you to install software, pay a fee, buy equipment or share bank or card details. If something looks off, don't engage. 

 We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic ( victoria@floatfinancial.com ), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

jobs.title: Creative Director - 12-Month Contract (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who we are: 

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 

  

 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 

  

 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our  blog  and follow us @InsideGeotab on  Instagram.  

 Who you are: 

 We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Creative Director who will serve as the visionary leader and principal steward of the company's global visual brand identity system. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

 What you'll do: 

 As a   Creative Director, your key area of responsibility will be establishing and governing the visual brand identity, directing the creative strategy for global campaigns and flagship events, and leading the internal Creative Services team to ensure consistent excellence and maximum brand impact worldwide. You will need to work closely with internal stakeholders, the Global Marketing organization, external creative agencies, and freelance partners. 

 To be successful in this role, you will be a visionary leader with exceptional problem-solving and conflict resolution skills who thrives with significant latitude in creative decision-making. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong expertise in enterprise brand stewardship, budget management, workflow optimization, and a proven ability to coach and mentor high-performing creative teams. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Own, evolve, and govern the global visual brand identity system, including comprehensive style guides, asset libraries, and creative standards for all marketing and sales touchpoints. 

 Direct the creative strategy and execution for major global campaigns, product launches, and growth initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives. 

 Lead the visual design and production for high-profile assets related to major flagship company events and global industry events. 

 Serve as the principal creative consultant and brand systems expert for internal stakeholders. 

 Optimize creative production workflows and processes to ensure efficiency, scalability, and high-quality delivery from the hybrid creative team of in-house and vendor resources. 

 Manage and optimize efficiency of Creative Solutions annual budget. 

 Manage and evaluate external creative agency and freelance relationships, overseeing contracts, budgets, and project quality. 

 Develop and implement measurement and value framework for Creative Solutions to effectively manage and continuously improve functional performance 

 Direct, coach, and mentor the Creative Services team (including Art Directors, Graphic Designers, and Production Managers), guiding their performance, feedback, KPIs, career development, and resource prioritization to align with Geotab's global strategic initiatives. 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

 15+ years of experience in graphic design, comprehensive brand identity development, and brand stewardship across agency-side and in-house creative environments. 

 8+ years of leadership experience managing, mentoring, and coaching multi-disciplinary creative teams (including Art Direction and Production). 

 Expertise in developing and maintaining complex, scalable brand identity systems for global organizations. 

 Prior experience working for a B2B or B2C SaaS company with a complex global marketing footprint. 

 Advanced proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite and knowledge of enterprise-level project management and Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems. 

 Proven ability to effectively lead, mentor, and coach a centralized, multi-disciplinary in-house creative team (including Art Direction and Production). 

 Skill in fostering a high-performance, innovative, and collaborative creative culture. 

 Exceptional skill in identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex creative and strategic problems, translating business insights into visual solutions. 

 Strong communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation) to articulate creative rationale and defend strategic choices. 

 Strong conflict resolution skills to manage differing opinions and promote positive, collaborative working relationships across departments. 

 Demonstrated ability to operate with significant latitude in creative decision-making, setting the bar for brand quality with minimal daily oversight. 

 If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. 

  

 Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. 

  

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

  

 Why job seekers choose Geotab: 

 Flex working arrangements 
 Baby bonus & parental leave top up program 
 Online learning and networking opportunities 
 Electric vehicle purchase incentive program 
 Competitive medical and dental benefits 
 Retirement savings program 

 *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only 

 #LI-Remote 

 How we work: 

 At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! 

  

 We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.  

 The annual base salary for this position is the expected annual salary for this role, and may be subject to change. Geotab offers various perks and benefits and other compensation components that an individual may be eligible for. The actual base salary for this position depends on a variety of factors such as but not limited to skills, qualifications, education and overall experience, including the location the applicant lives while performing the job. This also includes equity with other team members and alignment with local market data. All offers of employment are contingent upon proof of eligibility to work and the individual's ability to pass a background check.

 Hiring Range 
 $116,200 — $155,000 CAD

 Who you are:

Geotab is seeking a Head of Insurance Solutions who will own the customer-facing insurance product and partnership outcome, connecting Geotab fleet data and safety solutions to insurers so that fleets earn measurable premium savings, and Geotab grows direct carrier relationships, insurance program adoption, and the retention of insurance-acquired customers. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

 What you'll do: 

 As a Head of Insurance Solutions, your key area of responsibility will be product strategy, roadmap, and outcome ownership; customer value delivery and external customer engagement; people leadership, development, and organizational health; business performance, investment prioritization, and KPA attainment; and cross-domain coordination and practitioner community participation. 

 You will need to work closely with platform domain teams as internal technical partners, Heads of Segment Domain as distribution partners, peer Heads of Solution Domain (Driver Risk & Safety, Driver Coaching, Altitude), Sales, Marketing, Alliances, and department board leadership. To be successful in this role, you will be a hands-on, product-oriented leader with deep customer empathy, high accountability, excellent stakeholder management, and a Geotab First mindset. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong commercial instincts, product leadership capability, P&L literacy, and expertise navigating the insurance, telematics, and insurtech landscape. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Drive Product Strategy & Outcome Ownership: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Insurance Solutions; lead carrier partnership strategy, make principled build/buy/partner decisions, and define delivery standards to drive key KPAs like program adoption, retention, active carrier partnerships, and program-attributed MRR. 

 Deliver Fleet Customer Value: Treat fleet operators, managers, and drivers as primary customers by prioritizing a demand-driven roadmap, defining customer experience metrics, optimizing the end-to-end insurance journey, and ensuring compliance with data-sharing consent, privacy, and regulatory requirements. 

 Lead & Scale People and Teams: Build and mentor a high-trust, customer-obsessed domain—starting as a hands-on leader and scaling product, design, and engineering capacity as program traction grows while managing interim borrowed capacity and resource trade-offs. 

 Manage Business Performance & Investment: Act as the business owner for Insurance Solutions outcomes by translating board-level strategy into execution, managing the investment portfolio, leading annual planning, and presenting revenue contribution and growth trajectory to executive leadership. 

 Coordinate Across Domains & Build Strategic Alliances: Partner with Platform and Segment Domain leads, peer Solution leads, and go-to-market teams to align dependencies, package solutions, leverage shared infrastructure, participate in discipline practitioner communities, and champion a "Geotab First" mindset.

 The Head of MyG Core Workflows owns the MyGeotab workflows every customer depends on and is accountable for their usability, reliability, and evolution, both as customer-facing product and as shared capability other domains build on. The scope spans driver messaging; notifications (types, templates, recipients, and delivery channels, including reliability and latency); exception rules, stock rules, and how exceptions appear across reports and the map; system settings; the group hierarchy and its UI; and investigations that reconstruct what happened in context. This leader sets the vision for these workflows and how other domains build on rules, notifications, and groups, and answers to MyGeotab customers, the domain's primary customers, and the product domains that depend on it. 

 Key Accountabilities: 

 People leadership, development, and organizational health. 

 AI-native product development lifecycle, including AI-assisted modernization of legacy MyGeotab workflow pages. 

 Cross-domain communication and coordination. 

 Product ownership and engineering standards for MyGeotab core workflows 

 Customer outcomes and reliability, with MyGeotab customers as primary customers and dependent product domains as internal customers 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Product Engineering & Technical Standards 

 Define, maintain, and evolve the technical standards, architectural patterns, and shared components for the domain's workflows. 

 Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of messaging, notification, rules UI, and exception services; accountable to customer-facing SLOs for notification delivery success and latency. Own regression protection and VIP-customer test coverage so no release silently breaks customers' rules or notifications. 

 Lead the identification and resolution of technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements in the domain, including the integrity of group-based data visibility, in coordination with Core API and Security. 

 Shape and communicate the vision for core workflows to solution and segment domains; publish and maintain the capability contract for rules, notifications, and groups — intended use patterns, integration standards, and system constraints — so consuming domains can build on reusable platform capability correctly and confidently; keep platform tooling decisions aligned with the needs of consuming domains. 

 Modernize legacy MyGeotab workflow pages to the Zenith/React stack, using AI-assisted conversion where practical, while preserving the behaviour customers depend on. 

 Customer Outcomes & Enablement 

 Treat product domain teams as internal customers of rules, notifications, and groups; proactively understand their evolving needs and remove blockers. MyGeotab customers remain the domain's primary customers. 

 Own product discovery and the domain roadmap with the domain's product manager and designers; prioritize transparently based on customer impact, reliability, and the needs of dependent domains. 

 Define and measure customer and product metrics as primary success indicators: notification delivery success and latency, exception-to-notification time, rules-related incidents and PMIRs, support ticket volume per feature, feature adoption and usage, and investigation escalation accuracy. 

 Establish feedback loops with peer Heads of Domain to capture platform gaps and translate them into actionable improvements. 

 Provide technical consultation and guidance to product domain teams on the capabilities and constraints of rules, notifications, and groups. 

 Manage external delivery dependencies (email, SMS, voice, and webhook providers) and internal dependencies (Gateway/embedded for in-vehicle feedback, Drive and in-cab devices for messaging, the rules engine, Video, and Safety) — integration standards and the risk each dependency creates for reliability and roadmap. 

 People Development 

 Provide career development support. 

 Conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations. 

 Support employees through KPA goal-setting and development planning. 

 Oversee the hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management of a cross-functional team consisting of product managers, designers, and product engineers or other skills as required. 

 Support company-wide strategic initiatives including AI adoption, security posture, accessibility, and compliance programs as directed. 

 Identify growth opportunities and training aligned to domain needs. 

 Foster a high-trust, high-accountability team culture that values craftsmanship, documentation, and service mindset. 

 Manage team capacity and resource allocation across roadmap initiatives, customer commitments, and support obligations. 

 Domain Strategy & Roadmap 

 Translate board-level strategic direction into a coherent domain roadmap and execution plan. 

 Own the domain investment portfolio within approved parameters; make principled trade-offs between new capability, reliability, and technical debt reduction. 

 Lead annual planning processes including headcount, budget, and OKR input to department leadership. 

 Track and report on domain health, customer outcomes, and team delivery through defined KPIs; surface risks and recommendations to board leadership. 

 Cross-Domain Coordination 

 Contributes domain expertise to cross-domain initiatives when assigned. Maintains clear, documented ownership boundaries with adjacent domains — notably the rules engine (evaluation and processing), Safety (collision reconstruction and post-collision workflows), and Geospatial (zones). 

 Collaborate with product domain leads to align core workflow capabilities with product roadmaps and delivery timelines. 

 Participate in department planning forums as a subject-matter authority for MyGeotab core workflows; represent domain constraints and opportunities clearly to board leadership. 

 Board Relationship & Accountability 

 Own and execute the domain strategy within board-set direction. 

 Make investment cases to the board for resourcing, headcount, and capability investment. 

 Operate under structured board coaching with increasing autonomy. 

 Geotab First Mindset 

 Champions a Geotab First approach to leadership by putting the success of the broader organization ahead of siloed or individual domain wins. 

 Beyond leading their own domain, actively fosters collaboration, builds consensus, and works effectively across diverse internal and external teams. 

 Seeks out different perspectives before decisions are made, shares credit and information openly, and treats other domains' priorities as shared priorities. 

 Drives collective success through strong interpersonal relationships, shared goals, and a willingness to flex personal or domain agendas in service of the company's broader objectives. 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

 Equivalent combination of education and work experience in a related field may be substituted. 

 5+ years of relevant industry experience. 

 5+ years of experience in SaaS or web product engineering or product management, ideally on configuration-heavy, multi-tenant products. 

 3+ years in technical leadership roles. 

 3+ years of leadership experience. 

 1+ years leading a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and engineers. 

 Deep technical and product expertise in configuration-heavy, multi-tenant B2B SaaS workflows; experience with event, alerting, and multi-channel notification systems (delivery, templating, rate limiting). 

 Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed or shared-services organizational model. 

 Strong product sense and UX judgment — able to make complex configuration (rules, groups, notifications) powerful for large fleets yet simple for small ones. 

 Strong systems thinking — ability to anticipate how platform decisions ripple across multiple consuming teams. 

 Proficient in defining and tracking SLOs, customer-facing product metrics, and reliability indicators. 

 Ability to shape and evangelize a vision for core workflows across consuming domains — communicating intended use patterns, constraints, and trade-offs of reusable capability so solution and segment teams adopt it correctly. 

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to translate technical concepts into customer and business impact for non-technical peers and leadership. 

 Experience operating in evolving organizational structures with ambiguity and shifting priorities. 

 Familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, and agile delivery. Knowledge of telematics or fleet management is an asset. 

 AI Nativity: Ability to redesign the domain's workflows around AI to compress effort. 

 Change Readiness: Lead change through a larger domain; manage resistance and sustain momentum.

 Job Summary 

 he Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP) is a defined benefit pension plan serving members and employers in Ontario's healthcare sector. The Pension Services division supports the delivery of HOOPP's pension promise through accurate and reliable service to members and employers.
 Reporting to the Director, Actuarial Solutions, the Associate Director provides technical leadership to ensure the accuracy and integrity of pension calculations and pension-related data across HOOPP's administration system, member-facing solutions, and off-system tools.

 The Associate Director is a senior resource for pension calculations, pension data, system functionality, testing, defect management, and modernization of calculation capabilities. The role helps ensure that on- and off-system solutions using pension data or calculations are accurate, well controlled, and aligned with HOOPP's administration practices and member service objectives. The Associate Director works with various teams to translate plan provisions, legislation, policy, and administration practices into practical solutions through requirements, testing, implementation, and operational controls.

 What You Will Do 

 1. Calculation Accuracy and Technical Leadership
 Provide leadership to ensure the accuracy of pension calculations and member-facing pension information across HOOPP’s administration system, digital services, and off-system tools.

 Act as a senior subject matter expert for complex pension calculations and pension administration concepts, including escalated, precedent-setting, and high-risk cases.

 Identify inconsistencies among plan provisions, policy, administration practices, system logic, member communications, and calculation tools, and lead their resolution or escalation.

 Advise senior leaders on calculation risks, member impacts, and recommended courses of action while balancing calculation integrity, efficiency, and member experience.

 Promote consistent, explainable, and sustainable calculation logic across member-facing solutions.

 2. Cross-Functional Delivery and Strategic Initiatives
 Act as the actuarial lead for cross-functional initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, influencing project direction, identifying risks and dependencies, and helping ensure solutions involving pension calculations or pension data are delivered successfully.

 Ensure calculation- and data-related considerations are incorporated early in discovery, design, requirements, delivery, testing, and implementation.

 Assess proposed solutions for calculation accuracy, appropriate use of data, alignment with plan provisions, and member impact.

 Lead or support implementation of plan, legislative, policy, or administration-practice changes affecting calculations or pension data.

 Build effective relationships and influence decisions without direct authority, including challenging proposals where calculation integrity may be at risk.

 3. Calculation Requirements, Tools, and Modernization
 Lead the development of calculation requirements, implementation planning, testing strategies, and business readiness activities for calculation engine capabilities and other calculation solutions.

 Establish standards for and develop calculation requirements, including business intent, formulas, data inputs, dependencies, exception handling, auditability, and outputs.

 Ensure requirements are complete, maintainable, and sufficiently detailed for business analysts, developers, and end-users.

 Identify and lead opportunities to automate exception processing and recurring activities while maintaining appropriate controls and human oversight.

 Set standards for calculation tools and other off-system solutions, including testing, approval, version control, access, monitoring, and change management.

 4. Release Delivery, Testing, and Calculation Quality
 Lead the Actuarial Solutions team’s work on calculation-related changes to HOOPP’s pension administration system, from early design and requirements through to testing, implementation, and production monitoring.

 Set and execute testing approaches, ensuring they cover regression testing, complex cases, and data storage.

 Assess release readiness and ensure identified defects and required controls are documented and escalated.

 Coordinate and participate in production validations of calculation functionality, rate tables, and calculation controls after a release is deployed.

 Lead the review and resolution of calculation defects and production incidents, including impacted-member analysis, interim controls, correction methods, and validation of fixes.

 Act as the point of contact for external vendors and stakeholders as it relates to discussions involving calculations or pension data storage. Lead discussions and find resolutions that prioritize calculation and data accuracy in HOOPP’s pension administration system.

 Lead audits of HOOPP’s pension administration system and related tools to ensure consistent quality.

 5. Pension Data and Calculation Controls
 Provide oversight for the interpretation and appropriate use of pension administration data in calculations, member-facing solutions, and internal processes.

 Ensure the correct data fields and transformations are used where the results could affect pension amounts or related information shown to members, employers, or internal staff.

 Define data requirements for initiatives involving pension calculations, reporting, or the presentation of pension information.

 Partner with Pension Technology, Product & Delivery Management, Member & Employer Services, and other Pension Services teams to ensure pension data is used consistently and accurately across solutions.

 Recommend new pension data health checks, calculation controls, or monitoring activities where issues are identified.

 Recommend updates to existing pension data health checks based on changing needs.

 Assess and communicate risks arising from pension data quality issues or control gaps.

 What You Will Bring 

 University degree in actuarial science

 An ASA or ACIA designation is required; progress towards FCIA designation is preferred

 Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in pensions consulting, actuarial work, pension administration, pension systems, or a related field.

 Several years of experience leading complex technical initiatives, establishing standards, making or recommending high-impact technical decisions, and influencing cross-functional project delivery.

 Deep knowledge of defined benefit pension administration, pension calculations, applicable legislation, plan provisions, and administrative policy.

 Demonstrated ability to interpret complex pension provisions and translate them into clear calculation requirements and business rules.

 Experience leading calculation-related system implementations, testing strategies, and defect resolution

 Ability to understand, review, and challenge complex system calculations, Excel-based calculation tools, and other off-system calculations.

 Ability to communicate complex actuarial and technical matters clearly to various teams and senior leaders.

 Strong judgment and decision-making ability where errors could affect member benefits, financial outcomes, regulatory compliance, or member experience.

 Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, prioritize competing demands, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver outcomes through influence rather than direct authority.

 Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues and influence decisions across various teams and initiatives.

 Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across various teams and leaders.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is: $103,000 - $153,000 CAD  
 The actual base salary offered to the successful candidate may vary based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, individual's expertise and level of experience applicable to the role they are being offered.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 This is not a traditional chief of staff role. At Human Agency, the chief of staff is the prototype for every person we hire. You're someone who wants to be running a company — a dynamic C-suite leader — but you're choosing to ride shotgun alongside an executive because you know it's the fastest path to getting there. What makes us different is that we actually give you that shot. Today. Not in three years.

 You are floor to ceiling. You will take out the trash, sweep the floors, and then walk into the board meeting and run it. Nothing is beneath you. There is no ceiling above you. You are a garbage disposal for problems — every food scrap, every random piece of metal gets thrown your way, and you figure out how to handle it without breaking.

 What You'll Do 

 Rather than being hired for a predetermined set of tasks, you will be brought on to solve complex, evolving challenges. Success in this role requires self-direction, proactive value creation, and the ability to thrive without constant oversight. Over the coming year, your responsibilities will be tailored to both organizational needs and your individual strengths, potentially including:

 Leading AI transformation projects with clients

 Leading fundraising efforts for funds or clients

 Managing investment funds

 Managing CEOs at client organizations

 Driving sales initiatives at Human Agency

 Partnering closely with recruiting to help grow our team

 Serving as CEO of a venture studio company

 Managing client project delivery

 Driving value through data and analytics for clients

 Leading go-to-market initiatives for clients

 Own and solve ambiguous, high-stakes problems that don't fit neatly into any department

 Manage yourself entirely — no hand-holding, no coaching, no check-ins about how your day is going

 Move between strategic work (board prep, investor materials, business development) and ground-level execution (scheduling, research, client fires) without blinking

 Deploy AI tools daily to amplify your output — you are not doing the work of one person, you are doing the work of five

 Identify opportunities, inefficiencies, and threats before anyone asks you to

 What We're Looking For 

 A fundamentally good human. Table stakes.

 Mission-driven operator with deep commitment to Human Agency's values and vision

 No ego. No job description. You do whatever the job requires.

 Self-managing problem solver — the last thing a CEO or Founder wants is someone they have to manage

 AI-first mindset — you use AI as a force multiplier across everything you touch

 Builder mentality — you've shipped something. Attach proof of something you've built with AI to either your application or cover letter. 

 Generalist with range — you don't need to be an expert in any one thing, but you need to be dangerous across many things

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in high-performing environments such as management consulting, venture capital/private equity, business development, or startup leadership positions

 Demonstrated success in taking ambiguous, complex initiatives and driving them to completion, you're the person who makes hard things happen

 Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable briefs for different audiences

 Bonus: Experience in high-growth startups, venture studios, or AI/tech companies

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; top-tier programs and/or an advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus

 Ethics:  Commitment to ethical practices and responsible business operations

 Travel:  Occasional (10–25%) for company offsites, key events, and leadership meetings

 Location:  Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs and strong preference for overlap with EST business hours

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 The Opportunity

 This is not a traditional sales role. We are not calling on mid-level executives to sell packaged service engagements. We are becoming the AI entrepreneur embedded inside the biggest companies in America — the team that gets carte blanche from the owner to go build the future of their business.

 That requires owner-level access. It requires trust that takes years to build. It requires a network of relationships at the very top of the market — founders, family office principals, PE partners, and the executives who actually control capital allocation and strategic direction. You have that network. You open the doors. We close together.

 You will be responsible for building the commercial engine that takes Human Agency from a high-performing consultancy to the strategic AI partner for the 5,000 most important companies in North America. You will create the relationships, design the outreach strategy, and represent us in rooms where decisions get made. This is your opportunity to prove what you're capable of at the highest levels of business.

 What You'll Own

 Build and activate your network. You will systematically identify and engage owners, founders, family business leaders, and PE partners who control strategic decisions at target companies. You get us the meeting with the person who can say "yes, go build the future of my company."

 Design and execute strategic outreach. You will create a disciplined, relationship-driven go-to-market motion targeting enterprise owners and family businesses. This is not volume-based prospecting — this is high-touch, high-trust relationship development at scale.

 Represent Human Agency at the highest levels. You will be the face of the firm in boardrooms, private events, conferences, and executive forums. You will carry the mission, articulate the vision, and build the credibility required to win at this level.

 Collaborate on deal structure and closing. You open the door, but you stay in the room. You will work directly with leadership to shape the conversation, design the engagement, and close the partnership. This is a team sport, and you play offense.

 Own the revenue trajectory.  You will be accountable for pipeline development, relationship velocity, and ultimately the growth of Human Agency's client base. You will build the systems, rituals, and discipline required to scale this motion without losing the quality of the work or the relationships.

 Who You Are

 Experience & Skills

 You have an established, high-quality network of owners, founders, family office principals, PE partners, or C-suite executives at large enterprises. Your rolodex opens doors that most people spend years trying to access.

 You graduated from an elite MBA program — Harvard Business School, Stanford GSB, Wharton, Booth, Kellogg, or equivalent — and you've built on that foundation with real-world credibility and relationships.

 You have 10+ years of experience operating at senior levels in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or enterprise sales — environments where trust, reputation, and relationship capital matter more than product demos.

 You have a track record of opening and closing high-stakes relationships. You know how to navigate complex organizations, multi-stakeholder decision processes, and long sales cycles without losing momentum.

 You are comfortable in any room. You can hold a conversation with a third-generation family business owner, a PE Managing Director, and a Fortune 500 CEO — and you know how to adjust your approach without losing authenticity.

 Mindset & Traits

 You have integrity and seriousness. You are not coasting on your pedigree or your last name. You are building something, and you want this role to be the proof of what you are capable of.

 You see this as your opportunity, not a stepping stone. You are here to build the revenue engine for a company that is going to matter, and you want to be the person who made that happen.

 You are entrepreneurial and resourceful. You do not wait for a playbook. You figure out what works, you test it, you refine it, and you scale it.

 You have sales instinct. You may not describe yourself as the world's best closer, but you know how to move a conversation forward, read a room, and create the conditions for a yes.

 You operate with clarity and discipline. You manage your time, your pipeline, and your relationships like an investor manages a portfolio — with rigor, intentionality, and a long-term view.

 You care about the work, not just the deal. You want to sell something that matters, to people who will use it to build something great. You believe in what Human Agency is doing, and that belief shows up in every conversation.

 Compensation & Logistics

 This is a remote role based in the United States or Canada. You will work closely with leadership and collaborate across time zones as needed.

 This is a full-time role with significant upside and equity participation for the right person.

 Occasional travel required for client meetings, conferences, and company offsites.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

 Commercially rigorous and data-driven.

 The Opportunity 

 You are an entrepreneur. That's the ground-level truth. We're hiring someone who is mostly going to be building and running their own venture within Human Agency's studio — and who also sets the rules for how ventures flow across the entire studio. You run the weekly studio meetings. You are the lead critique. You own the accountability. You convince us that something is working or tell us it's not.

 What You'll Own 

 Build and operate your own venture from zero to one within the Human Agency studio

 Set the framework and cadence for how ventures are evaluated, funded, and scaled across the studio

 Run weekly studio syncs — you are the point of accountability across all active ventures

 Sell. Whether it's selling the vision to partners, customers, or investors — you close.

 Deploy AI and agents as core infrastructure in everything you build — not as a feature, as the foundation

  

 Who You Are 

 Proven experience as a founder, CEO, or product leader who shipped real products

 Sales DNA — you can get in a room and move people

 AI-native builder — you've built with AI, not just used it. Show us. 

 Comfort with ambiguity at every level — from "what should we build?" to "this thing is on fire"

 Zero interest in process for process's sake. You build. You ship. You iterate.

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Overview

 Instacart's Enterprise Solutions team partners with Global grocery and retail chains to power their digital commerce through StorefrontPro, Enterprise API (Fulfillment and Ads), CarrotAds, and adjacent Enterprise Solutions  products. We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the  Customer Success organization — accountable for post-live value realization  across the enterprise software portfolio.

 In this highly visible role, you will lead senior managers and Customer Success Managers who serve as the strategic advisor of Instacart to retailer executives. You'll own retailer value realization, measured through adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score coverage, at-risk portfolio management, CSAT, and QBR quality across the portfolio. You'll partner closely with Business Development, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness. You'll also partner with Enterprise Solutions Delivery, Technology leadership, and Product on portfolio strategy, retailer signal, and roadmap adoption.

 This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Solutions, and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

 About the Job

 Lead the Customer Success organization for the Enterprise Solutions  portfolio — owning value realization,  outcomes end to end, and partner closely with BD, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness.Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping Customer Success Managers  who engage with retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.

 Manage senior managers leading segments, setting standards for what good looks like across the CSM’s  — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.

 Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.

 Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team ( CS + Technical Account Managers (TAM’s) ) functions as one team to the retailer despite the functional ownership, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.

 Define and enforce the CSM/TAM boundary based on segmentation — CSM’s lead retailer-executive engagement, value realization, and growth planning, while TAM’s own technical delivery, configuration, and issue resolution, so that CSM capacity stays focused on strategic advisory, not technical execution.

 Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function.

 Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.

 Operationalize the retailer segmented  model in CS — applying high-touch coverage and scaled/digital-first models, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.

 Build a structured retailer-signal feedback loop into Product — using CS engagements to surface durable patterns (not anecdotes), instrument adoption of roadmap items, and hold CS accountable for adoption outcomes.

 Apply AI augmentation to scale CS coverage and quality without linear headcount growth — including health monitoring, account-prep automation, QBR/insight generation, and signal triage — partnering with the Technical org on tooling roadmap and adoption.

 Track record of managing managers with demonstrated ability to set standards and develop senior leaders without micromanagement.

 Ownership of a CS book of business or post-sale P&L of meaningful scale (e.g., $1000M+ ARR) with documented outcomes on Adoption, NRR, GRR, or expansion.

 Proven success operating in a BD- or Sales-led commercial environment — clear instinct for where the CS lane begins and ends, comfort with shared standards rather than rigid RACI/process.

 Demonstrated executive presence with enterprise customer counterparts (VP / SVP / C-level), including the ability to deliver hard news, navigate escalations, and rebuild trust after issues.

 Experience designing and operating segmented  CS coverage models (high-touch for strategic accounts, scaled/digital for the long tail), including capacity planning and exception handling.

 Hands-on experience hiring senior CS  talent — with a clear point of view on profile, comp, and ramp.

 Strong background  having operated in an  end to end post sales service delivery ecosystem with strong CS interaction with Business Development/Sales, Delivery, Technical and Product teams. Preferred Qualifications

 Experience transforming a CS function from reactive enablement into proactive business advisory, including the talent, comp, operating-model, and tooling changes required (not a renaming exercise).

 Track record of building or scaling seasoned strategist roles inside a CS org — including hiring profile, ramp, comp design, and integration with the rest of the account team.

 Experience operating with a separate technical TAM function on shared enterprise accounts — including co-authoring cross-org protocols and managing escalations across an org boundary.

 Background applying AI to CS workflows — health monitoring, account preparation, QBR generation, signal triage — with measurable impact on coverage, throughput, or quality.

 Familiarity with the BD/CS interface in commercially complex enterprise sales motions, including renewals, multi-product expansion, and shared-account operating norms.

 Deep familiarity with enterprise retail, grocery, ecommerce platforms, retail media, or adjacent complex B2B domains — including how large retailers evaluate, adopt, and scale technology solutions.

jobs.title: Director of Growth Marketing (SMB & Self Serve)
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 Hi, I'm Dan Davidow, Chief Marketing Officer at Jane. I joined Jane because I have a real passion for helping small businesses succeed, and our customers run some of the most impactful small businesses there are. When I'm not doing that, you'll usually find me planning my next trip.
 Jane has built strong momentum, and our next phase of growth will be driven by deeper relationships, trusted partnerships, and a strong presence in the healthcare community. We have also found success in our demand gen programs, and now is the time to build on what's already working.
 That's where you come in. As our Director of SMB & Self Serve Demand Generation, you'll own a core part of how Jane generates demand: our paid media program, our website (including SEO and AEO), and our lifecycle marketing. You'll work alongside the teams who own events, partnerships, and community, so that together it all adds up to one cohesive motion. AI is central to how you'll do this: from how practitioners discover Jane through AI-driven search, to how we use AI to plan, build, and optimize our own programs. You’ll also partner closely with our growth product team who works on onboarding and optimizing user flow.
 You'll lead a team of three channel experts today, with room to grow the team as the program scales, and partner closely with our Marketing Analytics & Operations team on measurement and infrastructure.
 This is a role for a leader who can balance strategy and execution. Part of this job is hands-on; you're comfortable working directly in the campaigns, data and tools, and building AI-assisted workflows yourself, not just directing from above. Success looks like building trust with our market and driving real business impact.

 What Impact We’re Looking for You to Make 
 Own paid media. Lead our paid media budget and team across channels, including paid search, paid social, direct mail, and more - deciding where we invest, how we measure it, and when we shift.

 Partner with Growth Product. You’ll work directly with designers, developers, and product managers building the future of onboarding and activation at Jane, designing and executing thoughtful tests.

 Deliver on web experience. Manage the marketing side of jane.com - the front door to Jane for practitioners, patients, and the broader healthcare community. Partner closely with design and engineering, and own site strategy, conversion rate, and our organic presence across both traditional search (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AEO).

 Own lifecycle marketing. Design and run the programs that guide practitioners from first touch through trial, signup, and expansion, working closely with product marketing and sales on what happens at each stage.

 Put AI to work. Make Jane easy to find in an AI-first world, and use AI across the demand program itself - research, creative testing, campaign optimization, reporting - so a small team can operate like a much bigger one.

 Sharpen our measurement. We have a solid measurement foundation today. You'll define what the demand program needs next - KPIs, attribution, reporting - and partner with our Marketing Analytics & Operations team to build it.

 Align with Sales and Support. Work deeply with our sales and support teams to design demand programs that support revenue outcomes, not just top-of-page metrics.

 Build the team. Lead, coach, and grow a team of channel experts, and raise the bar on how we plan, test, and learn together.

 What Experience We Need 
 A strong track record in demand gen or growth marketing. 5-7 years driving tangible business impact, ideally with experience managing and scaling multi-million-dollar budgets.

 Deeply analytical. Exceptional at translating numbers into marketing strategy, and comfortable operating in a constrained, highly data-driven environment. Deep expertise across marketing analytics, web optimization, lifecycle, and paid acquisition.

 AI-forward. You're already using AI tools in your day-to-day marketing work, you have a point of view on how AI is changing search and discovery, and you're excited to keep experimenting.

 High-velocity SMB experience. Proven success in high-velocity business models, ideally SMB or consumer. We're not looking for someone whose experience is only account-based marketing or traditional enterprise SaaS.

 A strong collaborator. You know how to work with design, development, and product teams to drive results.

 A builder of teams. A track record of hiring and developing high-caliber growth marketing talent.

 If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

 More About Jane 
 Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

 Compensation & Benefits 
 At Jane, we're committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. You'll see that our salary ranges are quite large - this is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence. Most new hires join at the accomplished stage. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.
 🇺🇸 For candidates based in the United States, the annual salary range is $187,200 - $265,000
 You can explore our benefits package here: US Benefits 

 🇨🇦 For candidates based in Canada, the annual salary range is $177,600 - $288,600.

 Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @ jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
As Director of Marketing and Communications, you will lead the organization's integrated marketing and communications strategy, develop a high-performing team, and ensure that all initiatives contribute to its broader mission and long-term objectives. Your key responsibilities will include:

 Build and lead a high-performing team: Recruit, coach, and develop senior leaders responsible for Media, Brand and Content, and Marketing, empowering them to build effective teams and deliver outstanding results.

 Define the department's organizational structure, capabilities, priorities, and performance expectations while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust, and continuous development.

 Develop and execute an integrated strategy: Establish an ambitious marketing and communications strategy that strengthens brand positioning, advances organizational priorities, and increases awareness and understanding of the movement and its principles.

 Identify opportunities to reach new audiences, develop creative campaigns and initiatives, and convert awareness and interest into meaningful engagement and action.

 Shape public narratives and protect organizational reputation: Guide external communications and ensure messaging is accurate, accessible, compelling, and appropriate for different audiences.

 Exercise independent editorial judgment, oversee high-profile communications, and manage sensitive topics, public scrutiny, and potential reputational challenges.

 Maintain trust and credibility with existing communities, major donors, senior leadership, and other important stakeholders.

 Build strategic relationships across the ecosystem: Collaborate with leaders and communications teams at aligned organizations to identify shared opportunities, coordinate initiatives where appropriate, and strengthen public understanding of the movement.

 Contribute to organizational leadership: Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and senior leadership team, helping shape organizational direction and ensuring communications priorities align with broader business and mission objectives.

 Challenge established approaches, identify opportunities to build new capabilities, and introduce innovative initiatives that increase the organization's reach and impact.

 Communicate strategic risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly to senior stakeholders while ensuring alignment across functions.

 Requirements

 The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with deep expertise in at least one major marketing or communications discipline and the ability to lead specialists across complementary areas. You should bring:

 Significant professional experience and a strong track record in at least one of the following areas: marketing, communications, media relations, or brand strategy.

 Broad expertise across marketing and communications disciplines, with the ability to develop integrated strategies and recruit, guide, and empower specialists with complementary skills.

 Substantial experience leading teams through managers or senior leaders, including coaching, developing talent, building alignment, and delivering results through others.

 Demonstrated experience building and scaling teams or organizational functions in startups or similarly fast-growing environments.

 Proven ability to attract exceptional talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and develop high-performing teams.

 Strong editorial judgment and the ability to independently assess the accuracy, clarity, and appropriateness of communications across different audiences.

 An entrepreneurial and ambitious mindset, with the ability to challenge assumptions, develop new initiatives, operate without a predefined playbook, and translate strategic ideas into execution.

 Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to keep senior leaders informed about progress, risks, and strategic trade-offs.

 Strong alignment with the organization's mission and core principles, together with the ability to engage thoughtfully with effective altruism's ideas, arguments, and debates. Previous employment in or long-standing membership of the effective altruism community is not required.

 Excellent communication, leadership, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance strategic direction and operational execution.

 Additional assets that would strengthen your application:

 Direct experience managing crisis communications, public controversies, or significant reputational challenges.

 Experience leading communications strategies for mission-driven organizations, global communities, or complex multi-stakeholder environments.

 Ability to navigate sensitive public narratives while maintaining credibility and strong relationships with diverse audiences.

 Benefits

 International compensation adjusted from the US salary using a fixed exchange rate and converted into the candidate's local currency.

 Private health insurance.

 Flexible working hours and a fully remote working environment.

 Annual professional development allowance of $6,000.

 Annual mental health support allowance of $6,000.

 Extended parental leave.

 Ergonomic equipment to support a comfortable and productive working environment.

 At least 25 days of paid vacation annually, or the applicable country-specific entitlement if greater.

 Access to an office in Oxford, United Kingdom.

 Opportunities to collaborate with an international team and attend approximately 4–6 annual trips, including team retreats and international events.

jobs.title: Director of Technical Support Engineering
jobs.description:
Build and lead the Technical Support Engineering function: Recruit, develop, and manage a high-performing team of technical support engineers, establishing strong technical standards across SQL, APIs, debugging, and cloud data systems while remaining directly involved in complex customer investigations. 

 Develop a distributed support organization: Expand and manage geographically distributed teams, initially focusing on India, and establish sustainable staffing models, coverage strategies, and resource allocation based on workload, industry benchmarks, and operational economics. 

 Build an AI-native support organization: Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for issue intake, triage, investigation, and diagnostics, leveraging approved knowledge bases, logs, telemetry, and authorized customer information to improve resolution speed and consistency. 

 Ensure responsible AI implementation: Evaluate AI-powered support solutions against real customer cases, establish privacy controls, permissions, human approval processes, and escalation procedures, and progressively expand automation based on measurable improvements in quality and productivity. 

 Own the end-to-end customer support experience: Oversee the entire support lifecycle, from initial intake and prioritization through technical investigation, escalation, resolution, and customer communication, ensuring clear ownership and seamless handoffs between support levels and other teams. 

 Manage service levels and incident response: Establish and maintain service standards, including reliable 24/7 critical incident coverage, structured escalation paths, sustainable on-call rotations, backup coverage, and effective recovery practices following overnight incidents. 

 Strengthen knowledge management and automation: Modernize customer documentation, internal knowledge bases, and technical runbooks, managing version-controlled resources through GitHub and establishing clear review, validation, and publishing standards. 

 Improve technical diagnostics and self-service: Turn recurring investigations into reusable documentation, diagnostic scripts, and automated tools that improve visibility into customer workloads, integrations, and infrastructure while reducing repetitive support requests. 

 Partner with Product and Engineering: Establish shared escalation processes, improve incident ownership, support root cause analysis, and drive permanent product and infrastructure improvements while minimizing unnecessary engineering interruptions. 

 Drive operational performance: Monitor response times, resolution rates, SLA attainment, customer outcomes, and team workload, using support trends and operational insights to inform product reliability, observability, and customer experience improvements. 

 Requirements: 

 Proven experience building, scaling, or transforming technical support engineering organizations, including recruiting, managing, and coaching distributed technical teams. 

 Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting experience across SQL, APIs, authentication, data schemas, synchronization processes, and data exports. 

 Demonstrated ability to develop diagnostic scripts, internal tools, and automation that improve investigation efficiency and support outcomes. 

 Experience designing, implementing, and evaluating AI-enabled support systems, including grounded AI responses, permission management, failure analysis, risk controls, and human escalation workflows. 

 Experience developing structured, version-controlled technical documentation, knowledge bases, and operational runbooks with clear review and publishing processes. 

 Strong customer-focused judgment and the ability to prioritize complex issues according to business impact, severity, and contractual commitments, even when the underlying cause is unclear. 

 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to manage customer expectations, communicate uncertainty transparently, and coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, operational benchmarking, and support economics, with the ability to build sustainable and scalable support models. 

 Strong leadership and coaching capabilities, with a hands-on, accountable approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement. 

 Ability to collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Services, Customer Architects, and other customer-facing teams to improve the overall customer experience. 

 Nice to have: 

 Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, cloud data warehouses, or marketing technology solutions, including audience activation and destination integrations. 

 Experience scaling technical support teams based in India. 

 Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) methodologies. 

 Experience safely expanding internal AI assistants into customer-facing support operations. 

 Previous experience building support functions for complex, data-intensive enterprise software products.

 Competitive annual base salary:

 Equity compensation and additional variable compensation opportunities. 

 Fully remote, flexible-first working environment with teams distributed across North America and beyond. 

 Flexible, goal-oriented working arrangements. 

 Flexible paid time off. 

 Monthly company-wide Recharge Days to support rest and well-being.

 Comprehensive health coverage, including: 

 100% employer-paid individual medical coverage, with strong dependent contributions.

 Retirement savings program through an RRSP in Canada or 401(k) in the United States, with generous company matching. 

 Annual professional development stipend. 

 Quarterly hackathons offering opportunities to explore innovative ideas and personal projects. 

 Opportunity to work directly with an experienced executive team and collaborate with talented professionals across multiple disciplines.

jobs.description:

 Synthesize learning across programs and regions into strategic insights for senior leadership and the Board.
