Director, Legal Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, enterprise change, commercial judgment and client leadership.

As Director, Legal Engineering, your mission is to make Legal Engineering the commercial and delivery engine for Canada, anchored in our Toronto office. Reporting to the Head of Legal Engineering, North America, you will set the craft bar, build the Canadian team and its Team Lead layer, partner closely with Go-to-Market and Engagement, lead selectively on the highest-stakes clients, and turn local learning into playbooks that scale across the Canadian market.

This is a Director-level leadership role. Your primary output will be the quality and performance of the team and system you build. You will stay close enough to the product and the work to coach credibly, while moving your own time toward hiring, leadership development, senior relationships, market strategy and cross-functional execution.

You will have the autonomy to shape how Legal Engineering runs in a strategically important market, together with the responsibility to keep that model connected to Legora's North American and global standards.

What You'll Do

Lead the Legal Engineering function for Canada from the Toronto office, including its operating rhythm, quality bar, capacity model and local partnership with Go-to-Market and Engagement.
Hire exceptional Legal Engineers and future leaders. Own the quality bar from sourcing and interview calibration through closing, onboarding and ramp.
Build a manager layer of Team Leads who each own and develop a group of Legal Engineers. Delegate real decision rights and create clear succession paths so the function becomes stronger and less dependent on you over time.
Give direct, evidence-based feedback. Coach hard, set clear expectations and act decisively when the performance or values bar is not met.
Partner with Canadian commercial leadership on priority accounts, pilots, rollouts and escalations. Connect Legal Engineering activity to conversion, adoption, usage, expansion and revenue.
Act as the lead legal architect on selected enterprise engagements. Translate a real legal problem into a concrete Legora workflow, then turn successful delivery into a reusable playbook others can run.
Oversee complex, multi-stakeholder programs with clear governance, owners, outcomes, leading indicators and risk management.
Build trusted relationships with Managing Partners, General Counsels, Heads of Innovation, Legal Operations leaders and other senior stakeholders.
Represent the market's voice inside Legora. Translate recurring client patterns and product gaps into clear, actionable input for Product.
Shape Legora's point of view on AI and legal work in Canada. Contribute through executive client forums, events, writing and practical market insight grounded in first-hand work.
Create clean handoffs across Go-to-Market, Legal Engineering and Engagement so that commercial momentum, delivery quality and long-term adoption reinforce one another.

How You Lead

Strong leadership in this role looks like this:

Hiring judgment and partnership. You treat hiring as company-building work. You own open seats end to end, partner closely with Talent and keep the bar high when growth pressure rises.
Talent development and accountability. Your team knows where they stand. Feedback is early, written and specific. You create stretch, develop future leaders and distinguish coachable gaps from persistent underperformance.
Ownership, delegation and operating rhythm. You own the market outcome while giving others real authority. Priorities, decision rights, leading indicators and dependencies are clear. The team runs well without you in every room.
Team-first leadership and culture. You give the team credit, absorb accountability for misses and create enough trust that bad news travels early. People grow faster because they worked for you.
Performance bar and decisive judgment. You protect the standard with speed, fairness and evidence. Strong performers trust you to address mediocrity, and difficult decisions remain humane and unambiguous.
The practical test is simple: the Canadian team should produce better work, stronger leaders and more repeatable customer outcomes because of the system you built, not because you personally carried every important engagement.

What You Bring

You may come from a leading law firm, an in-house legal function, legal operations, legal innovation, professional services, legal technology, or a combination of those worlds. The common thread is that you have moved beyond advising on change and have built the people, systems and client outcomes that make change real.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:

You may come from a leading law firm, an in-house legal function, legal operations, legal innovation, professional services, legal technology, or a combination of those worlds. The common thread is that you have moved beyond advising on change and have built the people, systems and client outcomes that make change real.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:

Are a qualified lawyer, licensed (or eligible to be licensed) in Ontario or another Canadian jurisdiction, with substantial legal, legal-operations or legal-technology experience, and a strong understanding of how sophisticated law firms and in-house legal teams make decisions.
Have built a team, function, market or new operating model from a low base, with clear evidence of what you personally decided and what continued to work without you.
Have managed and developed strong people, ideally including managers or Team Leads, and can point to people whose careers accelerated under your leadership.
Are deeply curious about generative AI and product. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be able to learn the platform, challenge use-case design and coach credible client work.
Can hold your own with a Managing Partner, General Counsel or executive team while remaining practical with the people doing the work.
Understand the commercial realities of legal services and enterprise software. You can connect Legal Engineering to pipeline, client value, adoption, usage and revenue.
Bring structure to ambiguity without creating process for its own sake. You build operating systems that improve speed and quality.
Have strong hiring and performance judgment. You can attract high-calibre people, develop them directly and protect the standard when a seat is not working.
Communicate fluently in English, in writing and in person. French is a strong plus.
Are based in the Greater Toronto Area and able to work from our Toronto office five days per week, with travel across Canada for strategic clients, market development and team leadership.

What’s In It For You

Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients domestic and internationally.
Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.
Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.
In-person environment: Toronto office designed for ambitious builders.
Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 Responsibilities:

 Qualifications:

 Proven leadership experience in technology procurement, strategic sourcing, and vendor management at a senior level.

The base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
 Studies have shown that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.  We welcome and employ people regardless of race, color, gender identity or expression, religion, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ethnicity, family or marital status, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, disability, Veteran status, or other protected characteristics. Vantage is looking for a Director, Customer Support and Enablement (CSE) to lead our support and enablement team within Solutions & Delivery. Reporting to the VP of Solutions & Delivery, you will own service reliability and platform adoption for our enterprise retail media partners. You'll set the strategy for support and enablement, hire and develop the team, own the operating metrics, and partner with your peers in Account Management, Launch, Ad Operations, Product and Engineering. Your goal is that every retailer and brand gets fast, reliable help and keeps getting more value from Vantage after go-live.

You need to have built or owned a support function and managed teams in SaaS or ad tech. You fix the pattern, not just the ticket, and you enjoy building and refining the processes a growing team relies on. You champion a consistently great client experience at every touchpoint.

Key Job Responsibilities

Define the CSE charter, service catalog and operating model, including what CSE owns, what it supports, and where it hands off to Account Management, Launch and Ad Operations.
Run a pooled service model: one shared queue and cross-training so PTO or attrition never leaves an account uncovered.
Build a multi-year plan for headcount, coverage and tooling as we add retail partners and regions, and plan staffing, schedules and coverage so service levels hold through growth.
Build a team culture that owns problems end to end, documents what it learns, and treats every ticket as a chance to prevent the next one.
Set and report on SLAs, time-to-resolution, backlog and quality standards for platform tickets, and own ticket triage, escalation paths and runbooks across all accounts.
Lead Sev-0/1 incident communications and make sure every one gets a root-cause analysis (RCA) shared with clients and internal teams.
Partner with Ad Operations on a clear coverage model for urgent and after-hours issues.
Lead client training, demos, FAQs and platform-change communications after launch, and own the Help Center (FreshDesk setup, articles, guides and publishing), built to reduce ticket volume.
Monitor feature adoption after launch and escalate low usage to the Account Manager and Product. Own weekly pacing, campaign and advertiser reporting, plus monthly ticket-trend reporting.
Partner with Launch and Account Management to ensure every new partner is set up for success, with a smooth transition from launch into ongoing support.
Own decisions on the support stack (FreshDesk, Jira and related tools) and the data flowing between them.
Run feature-request intake, turn ticket trends into prioritized input for Product and Engineering, and partner with Product on supportability reviews so new features are ready for clients before release.
Use AI and automation to raise team capacity without lowering quality.
Work as a peer to the Account Management, Launch and Ad Operations leaders on shared outcomes like account health, renewals and launch quality, and bring support and adoption data into QBRs and executive conversations with our largest retail partners.

Required Qualifications

10+ years in customer support, customer success, technical account management or platform operations in SaaS or ad tech.
3+ years managing teams, including hiring, performance management and career development.
A track record of building or managing a support function: charter, SLAs, escalation paths, runbooks and reporting.
Hands-on experience running a support stack (FreshDesk, Zendesk or similar, plus Jira) and making tooling decisions.
Experience leading major incident communications and RCAs with enterprise clients.
Strong analytical skills: you use ticket, SLA and adoption data to make decisions and influence peers.
Experience running a pooled or follow-the-sun support model.
Experience building or running a customer education program or Help Center.
Comfort using AI tools to improve team efficiency, reporting and client communications.
Clear, calm communication with executives, both internal and client-side.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in retail media, commerce media or programmatic advertising, and familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Criteo or DV360.

About Vantage

Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

For a closer look at what we do, our culture, and our benefits, check out our about us and careers pages.

Remote-First, Based in Toronto

Vantage is proudly headquartered in Toronto, but we’re a remote-first team spread across North America (and beyond). Our flexible work philosophy means team members can thrive from wherever they do their best work—whether that’s from a home office, a local café, or while adding stamps to their passport. With a remote-friendly setup, home office support, and annual company retreats, we stay connected, collaborative, and energized—no matter the time zone.

Vantage’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Vantage Analytics is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment. We encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

We promote equality and strive to provide all current and prospective employees with support and opportunities. Reasonable accommodations are available to job applicants on request and throughout the application process.

How Vantage Uses AI In The Recruitment Process

At Vantage, we use AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. This may include using AI to help organize, screen, and assess applications. We are committed to using these tools responsibly, and ensuring every candidate is treated fairly throughout the process.

All hiring decisions at Vantage are made by our team. Who we invite to work at Vantage is a decision we only trust ourselves to make.

What's Next?

We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of the final stages of our hiring process, all candidates will be required to successfully complete a criminal background check.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
THE ROLE 

We are looking for a highly motivated and organized Strategic Account Director to join our Client Experience team. In this critical role, you will act as the linchpin connecting presales strategy with post-sales execution, fostering collaboration across sales, customer success, data and analytics teams. You will leverage your expertise to build deep client relationships, deliver actionable insights, and develop strategic roadmaps to drive measurable outcomes. If you are motivated about using data to tell compelling performance stories and enhance marketing strategies, we want to hear from you.
This role is remote out of Toronto, Ontario in Canada.

Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

English Description:

Mistplay is the category creator and leader in the 'play-and-earn' mobile loyalty space, built to reward gamers for playing.

LoyaltyPlay is our B2B monetization platform, a powerful Gaming Reward Hub designed for mobile app Publishers. We partner with app owners (e.g., utility, commerce, or entertainment apps) to help them unlock a new, consistent revenue stream and boost user engagement. By integrating LoyaltyPlay, publishers can offer their users rewards (in-app currency) for installing and playing mobile games from our vast advertiser network. This creates a deep engagement loop and a powerful monetization channel for the publisher.

This is a high-impact role selling a differentiated, performance-based monetization solution to a global mobile app audience.

The Opportunity

Mistplay is looking for a seasoned North American sales leader to provide hands-on leadership for our growing, distributed team. This is a pivotal "player-coach" role designed for a leader who excels at operational excellence, performance management, and high-level deal strategy.

We aren't looking for a traditional executive to sit behind a dashboard; we need a practitioner who can credibly coach senior sellers, dive into complex enterprise negotiations, and instill a culture of accountability and consistent execution across the region.

What you’ll do at Misplay

Lead & Coach:
Manage a distributed team of experienced Account Executives, providing the prioritization and day-to-day support they need to win.

Deal Strategy:
Act as the "executive sponsor" on major enterprise deals, joining high-value meetings to provide strategic weight and help navigate complex procurement and legal cycles.

Operational Rigor:
Partner with leadership to design realistic goals and commission plans that drive the right behaviors.

Performance Management:
Maintain deep visibility into the North American pipeline, identifying bottlenecks and providing thoughtful coaching to help reps over-perform.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Serve as the bridge between Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure our "win" in the market is supported by a seamless internal experience.

Process Architecture:
Create structure and consistency across the sales motion without adding "bureaucracy for bureaucracy's sake."

Who You Are

Proven Leader:
10–15 years of experience in enterprise B2B sales, with a significant portion dedicated to managing high-performing, senior-level reps.

Credible Coach:
You’ve been a top-tier individual contributor in the past and can hold your own in a 7-figure deal room. You lead through respect and expertise, not micromanagement.

Pragmatic & Low-Ego:
You are a "doer" who is comfortable in a broad, collaborative role. You care more about the team’s success than title or hierarchy.

Operational Mindset:
You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to build incentive plans and sales workflows that actually work in the field.

Remote-Fluent:
You have experience leading distributed teams across various time zones and know how to maintain team culture and performance from afar.

Ideal Experience

Background in Gaming, AdTech, or high-growth SaaS
partnerships.

Experience managing "full-cycle" motions, including both net-new acquisition and existing account expansion.

Proven ability to work effectively with C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500-level organizations.

What Success Looks Like

Immediate Impact:
The team feels more supported locally with clearer day-to-day guidance and prioritization.

Deal Velocity:
Strategic opportunities move through the funnel faster due to your direct involvement in deal architecture.

Consistency:
The North American region becomes a "predictable engine" for the company, with high visibility into pipeline and consistent quota attainment.

Description en Français: 

Mistplay est le créateur de la catégorie et le leader dans l'espace de fidélisation mobile « jouer-pour-gagner » ( play-and-earn ), conçu pour récompenser les joueurs.

LoyaltyPlay est notre plateforme de monétisation B2B, un puissant Centre de Récompenses de Jeu ( Gaming Reward Hub ) conçu pour les éditeurs d'applications mobiles. Nous travaillons en partenariat avec les propriétaires d'applications (par exemple, des applications utilitaires, commerciales ou de divertissement) pour les aider à débloquer un nouveau flux de revenus constant et à stimuler l'engagement des utilisateurs. En intégrant LoyaltyPlay, les éditeurs peuvent offrir à leurs utilisateurs des récompenses (devise intégrée à l'application) pour l'installation et le jeu d'applications mobiles provenant de notre vaste réseau d'annonceurs. Cela crée une boucle d'engagement profonde et un puissant canal de monétisation pour l'éditeur.

Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact qui consiste à vendre une solution de monétisation différenciée et axée sur la performance à un public mondial d'applications mobiles.

L'opportunité

Mistplay est à la recherche d'un leader des ventes nord-américain expérimenté pour assurer un leadership concret auprès de notre équipe croissante et distribuée. Il s'agit d'un rôle central de « joueur-entraîneur » ( player-coach ), conçu pour un leader qui excelle en matière d'excellence opérationnelle, de gestion de la performance et de stratégie de transactions de haut niveau.

Nous ne cherchons pas un dirigeant traditionnel pour siéger derrière un tableau de bord; nous avons besoin d'un praticien qui peut entraîner de manière crédible des vendeurs chevronnés, plonger dans des négociations d'entreprise complexes et insuffler une culture de responsabilisation et d'exécution constante dans toute la région.

Ce que vous ferez chez Misplay

Diriger et encadrer:
Gérer une équipe distribuée de Directeurs de comptes expérimentés, en leur offrant la priorisation et le soutien quotidiens dont ils ont besoin pour réussir.

Stratégie de transactions:
Agir en tant que « parrain exécutif » sur les transactions majeures avec les entreprises, en participant à des réunions de grande valeur pour apporter un poids stratégique et aider à naviguer dans les cycles complexes d'approvisionnement et juridiques.

Rigueur opérationnelle:
Travailler en partenariat avec la direction pour concevoir des objectifs réalistes et des plans de commissionnement qui incitent aux bons comportements.

Gestion de la performance:
Maintenir une visibilité approfondie sur le pipeline nord-américain, identifier les goulots d'étranglement et fournir un encadrement réfléchi pour aider les représentants à se surpasser.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle:
Servir de pont entre les ventes, la réussite client ( Customer Success ) et les opérations pour garantir que notre « victoire » sur le marché est soutenue par une expérience interne fluide.

Architecture de processus:
Créer une structure et une cohérence pour l'ensemble du processus de vente sans ajouter de « bureaucratie pour le plaisir de la bureaucratie ».

Who you are

Leader éprouvé:
10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans la vente interentreprises (B2B), dont une partie importante dédiée à la gestion de représentants de haut niveau et très performants.

Entraîneur crédible:
Vous avez été un contributeur individuel de premier plan par le passé et vous pouvez vous affirmer lors d'une transaction de 7 chiffres. Vous dirigez par le respect et l'expertise, et non par la microgestion.

Pragmatique et sans égo:
Vous êtes une personne d'action (« doer ») à l'aise dans un rôle vaste et collaboratif. Vous vous souciez plus du succès de l'équipe que du titre ou de la hiérarchie.

Mentalité opérationnelle:
Vous possédez un excellent jugement commercial et savez comment élaborer des plans d'incitation et des flux de travail de vente qui fonctionnent réellement sur le terrain.

Habitué au travail à distance (
Remote-Fluent ): Vous avez de l'expérience dans la direction d'équipes distribuées à travers différents fuseaux horaires et savez comment maintenir la culture et la performance de l'équipe à distance.

Expérience dans les partenariats de jeu (
Gaming
), AdTech, ou SaaS à forte croissance
.

Expérience de la gestion des cycles de vente complets (« full-cycle »), y compris l'acquisition de nouveaux comptes et l'expansion des comptes existants.

Capacité éprouvée à travailler efficacement avec des parties prenantes de niveau C dans des organisations de type Fortune 500.

L'équipe se sent plus soutenue localement grâce à une orientation quotidienne et une priorisation plus claires.

Deal Velocity

Les opportunités stratégiques progressent plus rapidement dans l'entonnoir grâce à votre implication directe dans l'architecture des transactions.

We are driven to do more. More for our customers and the financial professionals who offer our products. If you are driven to do more and love the challenge of pursuing more, Athene is your kind of company. You will find we offer more than the basics to create an inclusive and dynamic work environment at our various locations.

 Purpose & Impact: 
The VP of Actuarial Modeling will lead the design, execution, and governance of Athene's actuarial model production processes supporting quarterly and monthly closes across GAAP and Statutory financial reporting. Reporting to the Vice President of Corporate Actuarial Modeling, this role is responsible for ensuring timely, controlled, and auditable model runs that feed financial reporting, risk metrics, and business planning cycles. The role requires deep operational expertise in actuarial production environments combined with the ability to partner across Actuarial IT, Financial Reporting, FP&A, External Audit, and actuarial leadership to continuously improve production infrastructure and controls.

 Key Deliverables: 
 Production Leadership & Process Execution 
 Own end-to-end model production for quarterly and monthly closes for GAAP and Statutory financial reporting. 
 Oversee and maintain the production schedule across all reporting workstreams, including Risk Metrics, CFT, EBS, FP&A, and financial close processes. 
 Drive execution discipline, ensuring model runs are completed on time, with full traceability and auditability. 
 Serve as the primary escalation point for production issues, coordinating rapid resolution across technical and business teams. 

 Controls & Governance
 Establish and enforce governance standards for model inputs, run configurations, output validation, and version control.
 Partner with Financial Reporting, Internal Audit, and External Audit to support controls documentation, testing, and sign-off processes.
 Serve as a key actuarial point of contact for external auditors, facilitating walkthroughs, providing documentation, and responding to audit inquiries related to model production processes and controls.
 Ensure production processes meet regulatory and internal audit standards, with clear control ownership and evidence retention.

 Process Design & Continuous Improvement
 Lead the design and ongoing improvement of production workflows, tooling, and scheduling infrastructure.
 Partner with Actuarial IT and the broader organization to modernize production pipelines, reduce manual touchpoints, and improve run efficiency and reliability.
 Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements that reduce close cycle time without compromising control quality.
 Document production processes, run books, and control procedures to support scalability and knowledge transfer.

 Cross-Functional Partnership
 Collaborate with Financial Reporting, FP&A, Risk, and Capital teams to align production outputs with downstream reporting and analytics needs.
 Partner with Actuarial IT on system upgrades, infrastructure changes, and platform enhancements that impact the production environment.
 Engage with actuarial leaders across the organization to anticipate model changes and incorporate them into production schedules with appropriate lead time.
 Communicate production status, issues, and capacity constraints clearly to senior leadership.

 Leadership & Talent Development
 Lead and manage a team of analysts and actuaries, building a culture of operational excellence and accountability.
 Build cross-functional relationships that position the production team as a trusted partner across the actuarial organization.
 Promote a continuous improvement mindset and invest in team capability around automation, controls, and actuarial systems.

 What You Need to Bring: 
 ASA (or equivalent: ACIA, AIA) required; FSA (or equivalent: FCIA, FIA) preferred.
 Deep familiarity with GAAP and Statutory valuation processes and the model production environments that support them.
 Experience designing or executing SOX and/or MAR controls in an actuarial or financial reporting context.
 Experience interfacing with external auditors on model-related controls, documentation, and walkthroughs.
 Strong understanding of actuarial systems and production infrastructure; experience with MG-ALFA, Aon PathWise, and/or Python preferred.
 Proven ability to manage complex, multi-workstream production schedules under tight close deadlines.
 Proven people management experience, with the ability to develop and retain actuarial and analytical talent.
 Strong communication skills with experience engaging senior stakeholders across actuarial, finance, IT, and audit functions.
 Bachelor's degree (or equivalent professional experience), with 10+ years of actuarial experience, including direct involvement in model production, financial reporting, or actuarial operations, and 5+ years of direct or indirect leadership experience.

 We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Engineer to join the Data Cognition Team at BMO Capital Markets. You will build and ship AI-enabled products used across Investment & Corporate Banking and Global Markets. The role combines strong software engineering, applied AI experience and end-to-end ownership of secure, reliable applications at enterprise scale.

 Our Team 
 The Data Cognition Team builds reusable AI and user-centric products that solve high-value business problems across BMO Capital Markets. We work in small, delivery-focused teams and partner closely with colleagues across business, product, user experience, data, risk and technology to move solutions from idea to production.

  Key Responsibilities 

 - Design, build and ship full stack applications for Investment & Corporate Banking and Global Markets, owning them end to end from technical design through testing, deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement.
 - Apply practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows to build production-ready, AI-enabled features into our applications.
 - Build secure APIs, MCP servers and services that integrate our applications with enterprise systems and data.
 - Work closely with our User Experience team to turn user needs into simple, intuitive and polished experiences.
 - Partner with business stakeholders, product, data science, risk and technology teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 - Write clean, maintainable code supported by automated tests, code reviews and CI/CD, using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve speed and quality.
 - Build for reliability, security and scale through strong observability, performance management and production support.
 - Contribute to architecture decisions, engineering standards, reusable components and best practices for applying AI across the team.

 Must Have 

 - 3+ years (Associate) or 6+ years (Vice President) of professional software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 - Strong software engineering experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, building modern web applications with frameworks such as React and backend services using FastAPI or Flask.
 - Hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications, including the use of large language models, model APIs, MCP servers and agents.
 - Experience designing APIs, microservices and scalable applications, working with SQL and NoSQL databases, data pipelines and real-time or messaging systems such as WebSockets, Redis or message queues.
 - Strong understanding of containerization with Docker, automated testing, CI/CD, application security, observability and production operations.
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems from concept to production iteratively, with clear communication across technical, business and control teams.

 Nice to Have 

 - Experience taking AI-enabled applications into production, including monitoring, evaluating and improving them with real users.
 - Experience designing application-level authentication and permissioning, including token-based access and role-based entitlements across multiple services.
 - Experience with vector databases, embeddings and retrieval techniques that improve the quality of AI responses.
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, and to container orchestration such as Kubernetes.
 - Knowledge of financial markets and Investment & Corporate Banking workflows.

 What We Offer 

 Join BMO Capital Markets to build AI-enabled products that solve meaningful business problems at enterprise scale. You will work with modern technology, experienced colleagues and business partners to ship solutions that improve how our teams serve clients and operate. You will work across the full stack and collaborate with specialist teams throughout the organization, often contributing to the shared platforms and infrastructure our applications are built on.
 Please note the base salary for this role at the Associate level is $120,000 CAD / at the Vice President level is $160,000 CAD.

jobs.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

Technical Solutions is the technical arm of Gorgias for our biggest merchants. The team covers the full enterprise lifecycle with 2 groups of Solutions Engineers: pre-sales Solutions Engineers, who partner with Account Executives to win complex Enterprise and Named deals, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who embed with our highest-value merchants after signature to deploy, integrate and scale our AI Agent. The team is distributed across North America, Europe and Latin America, and works hand in hand with Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Finance.

Our biggest merchants bring complex tech stacks, custom order systems, multi-store setups and high expectations. This team closes the gap between what they need and what works in production.

About The Role

As our Head of Technical Solutions
, you will own the technical side of Gorgias for enterprise merchants, from the first demo to production. You will lead both the pre-sales and post-sales Solutions Engineering teams, make sure what we sell is what we can deliver, and turn forward deployed engineering into a scalable, profitable professional services business. You will own the P&L of professional services, including pricing and gross margin.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the COO. You will scope deals, build prototypes, review code and sit in customer Slack channels next to your team, especially in your first months. The perfect fit is an AI builder and a commercial operator in one person: someone who has already led a comparable transformation, turns constraints into an execution plan, and is as credible with an enterprise COO as with their engineers.

What You’ll Do

Lead and build the team

Lead, hire and coach a distributed team of pre-sales Solutions Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical quality, customer judgment and speed, and give direct, useful feedback.
Stay hands-on. Lead discovery on key deals, build proofs of concept, review architectures and code, and jump into debugging when a deployment is at risk.
Build the operating cadence: OKRs, capacity planning, engagement reviews and dashboards that show the team’s impact on revenue, automation and retention.

Win enterprise deals (pre-sales)

Own the technical win on Enterprise and Named deals. Partner with Account Executives on discovery, technical qualification, tailored demos, proofs of concept and solution design.
Help close. Build mutual close plans with Sales, map technical stakeholders and success criteria, and handle technical objections, security reviews, integration reviews and RFP responses.
Drive enterprise win rate and deal velocity. Make Solutions Engineer coverage on every qualifying deal, pipeline hygiene and win and loss reviews standard practice.
Make sure what we sell is what we can deliver. Timelines are realistic, scope is written down before signature, and trials or proofs of concept that behave like production deployments get the same rigor.

Deploy and scale our AI Agent (post-sales)

Define and productize standard deployment offers: packaged Forward Deployed Engineering engagements with clear scope, hours, deliverables and success measures, so most merchants can buy a standard package instead of a bespoke project.
Lead custom deployments for our most complex merchants: custom actions, integrations with order, warehouse and ERP systems, multi-store rollouts and bespoke builds, designed against real customer APIs.
Own the handoff from pre-sales to post-sales. Once a deal is scoped, one technical owner carries the action plan and delivery, with clear rules of engagement with Implementation Managers and CSMs so the customer never sees a gap.
Decide where capacity goes. Set eligibility rules for new and existing customers, and balance new deployments against re-optimizing existing accounts based on revenue, churn risk and automation upside.
Drive measurable outcomes on covered accounts: higher AI Agent automation rate, faster time to value, shorter custom action cycle time, and lower churn and contraction, with no drop in CSAT or resolution quality.

Run professional services as a business

Own the P&L of professional services: bookings, revenue, cost of delivery, utilization and gross margin. Set the targets and hit them.
Own pricing and packaging with Finance, Sales and RevOps: rate card, fixed price packages, statements of work and priced change requests. Protect margin by pushing back on waived fees and silent scope creep.
Enable the sales team. Train Account Executives to position, qualify, scope and sell professional services, and build the playbooks, pitch materials and qualification criteria they need. Partner with Product Marketing to take offers to market.
Enable the broader CX organization. Make Implementation Managers and CSMs self-sufficient on standard configurations, basic custom actions and first-line troubleshooting, so engineers stay focused on complex builds.

Build leverage

Productize the field. Every custom build has to make the next deployment cheaper: when we solve something for one merchant, it becomes a template, a reusable action, a playbook or a product update for the next 10. Track custom work per deployment and drive it down every quarter.
Automate the team’s own work. Use AI coding tools, agents and evals to speed up discovery, scoping, configuration, QA and reporting, so impact grows faster than headcount.
Be the voice of the enterprise merchant in Product and Engineering. Turn field signals into clear, prioritized requests and help shape the roadmap.
Represent Gorgias with leaders at enterprise brands, from strategy conversations to technical deep dives.

Who You Are

10+ years in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, professional services or technical consulting, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
5+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, ideally both pre-sales and post-sales, with a record of hiring and growing strong engineers and managers.
A proven pre-sales leader. You have helped win complex six and seven figure enterprise deals, and you know how to run technical discovery, proofs of concept and mutual close plans alongside Sales.
A professional services operator. You have owned a services P&L or a large part of it: you have priced and packaged services, managed utilization and gross margin, and turned custom work into standard offers.
A transformation leader. You have taken a reactive technical team and built a scalable, productized deployment motion, and you show up with a plan rather than a list of blockers.
An AI builder. You have shipped LLM-powered agents, workflows or integrations into production and know how to test them with evals and real data. You can show us something you built recently.
Technical enough to do the work. You can write and review code in Python or JavaScript and TypeScript, and work with REST APIs, webhooks and SQL.
Commercially sharp. You connect technical work to revenue, retention and margin, and you can say no to scope that does not make sense.
Calm and clear with customers. As comfortable presenting to an enterprise COO as debugging with their engineers.
Energized by ambiguity. You like building a function, and you write down how it works so others can run it.

Nice to have

Ecommerce or CX tech experience: Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, helpdesks, OMS or WMS platforms.
Experience at an AI customer service company or with conversational AI.
Experience leading teams across North America, Europe and Latin America.

Perks & Benefits

🏖️ 5-week vacation (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

🤕 Paid sick leave

🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

💻 MacBook or equivalent PC

🏥 Health insurance with Sunlife and RRSP matching with Wealthsimple

💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to $900 CAD to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

📚 Get up to $2600 CAD of learning material per year (includes books, courses, training sessions that are easily identified and linked with your job scope. This also covers individual coaching!)

🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

The opportunity

Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine
Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer
Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot
Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own
Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them
Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets
Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it
Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead
Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

What You Bring

Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms
Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room
Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them
Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap
Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces
Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds
Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

Nice to haves

Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them
Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each
Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations
Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

At Gore Mutual, we've always set ourselves apart as a modern mutual that does good. Now, we're proudly building on that legacy to transform our company—and our industry—for the better.



Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country's largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property \& Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva's Ontario\-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long\-term stability.



Every decision and investment remains anchored in long\-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.


We are looking for a Director, Data Engineering to lead a critical capability within Gore's Enterprise Data \& Analytics organization. You will lead the teams responsible for turning enterprise data into trusted, reusable data products and building the engineering capabilities that enable Data, Insights and AI across Gore.



You will shape how we build and manage data products, evolve our Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, and ensure our Databricks and Azure ecosystem provides the foundation needed for Analytics, Data Science, GenAI and emerging AI solutions.



This is a visible leadership role for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, people leadership and the ability to turn data and technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.


**What will you do?**


**Build Enterprise Data Products**


* Lead the development of trusted, reusable data products that combine business meaning, data quality and strong engineering to support operational, analytical, Data Science and AI use cases.
* Establish and mature our data product discipline, partnering with business and technology leaders to turn high\-value data needs into scalable capabilities.
* Improve the accessibility, consistency and value of enterprise data while reducing fragmentation and duplication.


**Advance Data Engineering \& AI Enablement**


* Lead and mature Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, creating repeatable paths to move data, machine learning, GenAI and emerging AI solutions into secure, reliable production.
* Raise engineering standards across integration, APIs, orchestration, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, data quality and production operations.
* Partner across Data, Analytics and technology teams to provide the engineering capabilities needed to scale Data Science and AI.


**Evolve Our Data Technology Foundation**


* Guide the evolution of Gore's Databricks and Azure ecosystem to provide a scalable, resilient, secure and cost\-effective foundation for Data, Insights and AI.
* Partner with IT and Architecture to shape architecture patterns, integration approaches and technology standards.
* Evaluate emerging Data and AI technologies based on business value, scalability, security and long\-term sustainability.


**Build and Lead a Strong Engineering Organization**


* Lead, coach and develop high\-performing teams across Data Products, Data Platforms, Data Engineering and MLOps.
* Develop strong managers and technical leaders with clear accountability for products, engineering quality and production outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.


**Provide Visible Enterprise Leadership**


* Represent Data Engineering with senior business and technology leaders, vendors and strategic partners.
* Translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, trade\-offs, risks and recommendations.
* Provide clear leadership across priorities, investments, delivery and significant operational challenges.


**What will you need to succeed?**


* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* Significant leadership experience across Data Engineering, data products, data platforms, MLOps or related enterprise technology functions.
* Proven experience building enterprise data products and translating business needs into reusable, scalable data capabilities.
* Proven experience building and operating enterprise\-scale data platforms and production data workloads.
* Direct production experience with Databricks, including data engineering, lakehouse architecture, governance and optimization.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud data architectures.
* Strong technical knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, data integration, orchestration and distributed processing.
* Experience with technologies such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and MLflow, or comparable capabilities.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevOps, DataOps and modern production engineering practices.
* Practical MLOps experience enabling Data Science, machine learning and AI workloads in production.
* Experience enabling GenAI or emerging AI capabilities in secure enterprise environments.
* A strong track record of coaching and developing engineers, managers and technical leaders.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior business, technology and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Director Category Management and Promotions
jobs.description:
**At Chatters, beauty is more than what we do, it's how we connect, create, and build confidence every day. From professional hair services to must\-have beauty products, we bring passion and expertise together to create inspiring spaces where customers feel welcome, empowered, and excited to explore their personal style. We are seeing a Senior Director of Category Management \& Promotions to lead our team, drive strategic initiatives, and elevate our category and promotional strategies.**


**Position Overview**  

The **Senior Director, Category Management and Promotions** will lead the category management function to deliver profitable growth across retail, salon, ecommerce and franchise channels. This role is accountable for category strategy, assortment performance, promotional strategy, sales and gross margin delivery, vendor partnerships and inventory productivity. **Leading a team of four Category Managers and one Category Assistant**, the Senior Director will be responsible to translate business objectives and customer insights into clear category plans, compelling promotional activity and disciplined execution. This leader determines where to invest, expand, rationalize or exit, ensuring the assortment remains relevant, competitive and commercially productive.  

The Senior Director will work closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Ecommerce, Operations and Franchise Support to align priorities, resolve issues and deliver initiatives accurately and on time.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**1\. Category Strategy \& Financial Performance**

* Own category sales and gross margin performance against plan, identifying risks early and implementing corrective actions.
* Lead annual and seasonal category plans that define growth opportunities, brand priorities, assortment direction and sales, margin and inventory objectives.
* Guide Category Managers in developing strategies grounded in customer needs, stylist insights, market trends, competitive activity and business performance.
* Evaluate category, brand and SKU productivity to guide investment, space allocation, assortment expansion and rationalization.

**2\. Assortment Strategy \& Planogram Execution*** Lead assortment decisions across channels and store formats, balancing customer demand, brand positioning, differentiation and profitability.
* Establish a disciplined approach to new brand and product evaluation, including business cases, launch plans and performance reviews.
* Oversee planogram strategy and reviews, ensuring product selection and space allocation reflect sales potential, margin contribution and inventory productivity.
* Ensure discontinued and underperforming products have timely exit plans that minimize markdowns, write\-offs and disruption to sales.

**3\. Inventory Productivity \& Product Lifecycle Management*** Partner with Supply Chain to align purchasing, forecasts, replenishment and inventory allocation with category plans and demand.
* Drive improvements in inventory turnover, sell\-through and working capital productivity while supporting strong product availability.
* Lead commercial action plans for excess, aging and discontinued inventory, including vendor returns, transfers, promotional support and markdown strategies.
* Anticipate inventory risks and coordinate actions to protect sales, margin and the customer experience.

**4\. Promotional Strategy \& Vendor Funding*** Establish promo schedule and events for the year to help meet sales and margin targets.
* Work with vendors to develop compelling events and negotiate funding, promotional allowances, gifts, exclusive offers and other support.
* Evaluate promotional opportunities for incremental sales, gross profit, inventory impact and customer value.
* Partner with Marketing and Ecommerce to align offers, featured products, messaging and channel execution.
* Ensure promotional commitments, forecasts, funding agreements and execution requirements are finalized within established deadlines.

**5\. Vendor Negotiation, Pricing \& Margin Management*** Negotiate commercial terms, cost changes, rebates, promotional funding, returns and other support that strengthen overall profitability.
* Challenge proposed cost increases and evaluate their impact on retail pricing, competitiveness, demand and margin.
* Guide pricing decisions across the assortment, balancing customer value, competitive positioning and financial objectives.
* Ensure vendor commitments are documented, communicated and fulfilled, with approved changes implemented accurately and on time.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Execution*** Serve as the central commercial partner connecting category priorities with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Ecommerce, Operations and Franchise Support.
* Establish shared plans with clear deliverables, owners, dependencies and deadlines for promotions, launches, planograms and assortment changes.
* Resolve competing priorities and execution barriers, escalating decisions early when timelines or business results are at risk.

**7\. Team Leadership \& Development*** Lead, coach and develop four Category Managers and one Category Assistant, building commercial judgment, analytical capability and negotiation skills.
* Set clear objectives and hold the team accountable for business performance, quality of work and adherence to timelines.
* Establish consistent standards for category plans, vendor reviews, promotional analysis and performance reporting.

jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
Careers that make a difference

We work to build and maintain an accountable government that motivates, inspires, and provides opportunities for Vuntut Gwitchin Citizens. Our employees have the opportunity to make meaningful connections and work on initiatives that make a real difference in people’s lives.

“With boundless pride in our ancient cultural heritage and ancestral homelands, we exercise our inherent right to self-government, to take the responsibility for the general welfare of our Citizens, and to provide for the good government of our community, lands and resources.”

—Preamble, VGFN Constitution

About The Role

The Executive Director is the senior administrative leader of the Vuntut Gwitchin First Nation (VGFN) and is responsible for the effective administration, management and day-to-day operations of the government. The Executive Director translates the priorities and directives approved by Chief and Council into operational plans, budgets, policies, programs and services. The position ensures that VGFN resources are managed responsibly, employees are effectively supported and supervised, and operations are carried out in accordance with VGFN laws, policies, approved budgets and applicable legislation and agreements. Reporting to the Chief, some of the responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to;

Administration and Operational Leadership
- Leads and oversees VGFN’s day-to-day administration and operations, establishes departmental priorities and performance expectations, and ensures Chief and Council directives and strategic priorities are effectively implemented.

People Management and Human Resources
- Provides leadership, supervision, coaching and performance management to Directors and Managers while overseeing recruitment, employee relations, labour relations, staff development and the implementation of HR policies and practices.

Financial Management and Resource Stewardship
- Leads organizational budgeting and financial planning, monitors financial performance and expenditures, oversees procurement and contract administration, and ensures responsible and accountable use of VGFN resources.

Program and Service Delivery
- Oversees the administration and delivery of VGFN programs and services, ensuring departmental plans, service standards and performance measures align with approved priorities and available resources.

Policy, Compliance and Corporate Governance Administration
- Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of organizational policies, procedures and administrative systems while ensuring compliance with VGFN governance frameworks, agreements, applicable legislation and regulatory requirements.

Management Committee and Organizational Planning
- Chairs and leads the Management Committee, coordinates departmental planning and resource allocation, monitors organizational performance, and provides regular operational updates and recommendations to Chief and Council.

Communications and Stakeholder Coordination
- Ensures effective internal and external communication on administrative and operational matters, coordinates relationships with stakeholders and service providers, and works with the Political & Governance Affairs Director to align political commitments with operational implementation.

Emergency and Business Continuity Management
- Oversees administrative emergency response, business continuity and employee safety arrangements, ensuring organizational readiness and coordinated operational responses to emergencies.

What We Offer

Working Hours: 80 hours bi-weekly.
4% Northern Community Remoteness Allowance for employees residing in Old Crow full-time.
4% Northern Travel Allowance for employees residing in Old Crow full-time.
4 weeks’ vacation to start plus two weeks paid time off over the Christmas season.
A very healthy extended benefits package.
12 days management leave per year
10 days sick pay per year.
10 days paid special/personal leave per year.
A matched pension plan.
Subsidized Housing may be available.
Relocation Allowance.

‍

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in business, management, public administration, Indigenous governance or related field, as well as continued personal and professional development. A professional designation is an asset.

Significant (15+ years) leadership experience developing, implementing, and evaluating organizational strategic visions.
Considerable (10+ years) experience motivating and managing staff, overseeing finance (budgets and procurement), policy, and governance, to translate political direction into operational strategy and business plans.
Considerable experience in stakeholder management and negotiations to navigate and advance organizational political positions and interests.
Leadership experience in the public sector and/or an Indigenous organization possessing a final/self-governing agreement is an asset.

‍

Supporting You Along The Way

We believe that a rewarding career is not only good for our employees, but it also leads to better outcomes for our clients, workplace and the community. That’s why we are committed to providing you with a competitive salary, health benefits, and a retirement plan. Beyond compensation, you will have the opportunity to make meaningful connections and work on initiatives that make a real difference in people’s lives.

‍

To Apply

Please send your resume and a cover letter to: jobs@vgfn.ca. In accordance with the Canadian Human Rights Act (CHRA, Section 16(1)), hiring preference will be given to Vuntut Gwitchin First Nation Citizens. Following this, preference will be extended to Indigenous candidates, and then to those with experience and knowledge of First Nations customs and practices.

‍

❖ While we appreciate all applications, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

‍

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), the role ensures reliable, responsive, Member-centred services aligned with AIC’s strategic plan and Board-approved priorities. The role provides executive oversight to the Head, Information Technology and works with the other Directors, the Manager, Governance, Provincial Affiliate Associations, and external partners to deliver coordinated services.

Chief Executive Officer
Direct reports:

Head, Information Technology,
Senior Manager, Member Services
Events Specialist
Location:
Ottawa, ON

Permanent. 37.5 hours per week. Hybrid.

Strategic Leadership

Advise the CEO and Senior Leadership Team on service performance, digital systems, events, capacity, vendor performance, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Product Officer builds and leads Jaza’s product function and owns product strategy across two verticals: Consumer, which is what our customers get (packs, charging, hubs, energy systems, pricing, and the customer app), and Enterprise, the tools Jaza runs on (Star App, Site App, our Dashboard and data platform, and our payments infrastructure).

Jaza has been engineering-led. Product decisions have been made by the people building the product. We are now creating Product as its own function, so that what we build is driven by customer outcomes and unit economics. We define our product by the customer’s energy outcome, not by the delivery mechanism. Battery swap is how we deliver that outcome today. You will hold that line, decide with evidence when the product should change, and own Jaza Lab, where we test new products and new ways of delivering energy before we commit capital to them.

Success in your first year: a product strategy and a single roadmap across both verticals tied to the company plan and unit economics; product practice running in both verticals; the product team built around the two Product Leads; and Jaza Lab running as a portfolio with a ring-fenced budget and clear stage gates.

Roles And Responsibilities

The Chief Product Officer responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Product strategy and outcomes (35%)

Own Jaza’s product strategy and the cross-vertical roadmap.
Own product outcomes. For Consumer: active customers, revenue per customer, cost per kWh delivered, and capital cost per customer. For Enterprise: operating cost per customer, uptime, and data coverage.
Run the gates on capital-heavy decisions (pack and hub specifications, pricing, and major releases) with engineering and finance, including a financial and technical risk check before capital is committed. A hardware specification commits capital across thousands of sites; a software release can stop revenue in the field.
Make safety, regulatory, and certification requirements a criterion at every stage gate, working with Quality, HSE, and Legal.

Product leadership and team building (30% )

Lead and develop the Product Leads for Consumer and Enterprise and the Jaza Lab Lead, and build the product organization beneath them.
Get product practice running in both verticals: discovery, product requirements, stage gates sized to capital at risk, and post-launch reviews that change decisions.

Jaza Lab (15%)

Own Jaza Lab, our R&D and pilot engine for new products and new delivery mechanisms: take ideas from concept to proof of concept to pilot, set its budget with the CEO and CFO, and kill what does not work quickly and cheaply.

Customer voice, board, and leadership (20%)

Own customer voice and employee voice across the company.
