As Director, Cyber Security Operations, you will provide strategic leadership for Global Relay's operational cyber defense capability, ensuring the organization can effectively detect, respond to and, recover from cyber threats. You will define the vision, operating model and strategic direction for the function while building a high-performing organization focused on operational excellence and continual capability maturity.

You will serve as a trusted security leader, partnering with executive leadership, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Governance, and Security Architecture & Technology to align operational capabilities with business priorities, reduce cyber risk and enable secure business growth.

Working within the Information Security leadership team, you will oversee the evolution of Global Relay's Security Operations & Threat Management capability, establishing operational governance, performance measures, and strategic priorities while driving continual improvement across incident response, threat management and technical vulnerability prioritization.

Your responsibilities:

Define and execute the strategy, roadmap and maturity plan for Security Operations
Lead the Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence Operations, and Technical Vulnerability Prioritization capabilities.
Establish operational governance, performance measures and executive reporting.
Provide executive leadership during significant cyber incidents and crisis events.
Ensure enterprise security technologies are effectively operated to achieve business outcomes.
Partner with Security Architecture & Technology to establish operational requirements for new capabilities and technology enhancements.
Develop workforce strategy, succession planning, and organizational capability.
Lead operational risk reduction through continual improvement, metrics and service maturity.
Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, Engineering, Operations, Product, and other business areas.
Support customer assurance, audits and regulatory commitments.
Promote a culture of operational excellence, collaboration, and accountability.

About you:

8-10+ years in Cyber Security, including significant leadership experience overseeing enterprise Security Operations, Incident Response and Threat Management capabilities.
CISSP required, or must be obtained within 12 months of start date.
Demonstrated experience building, leading, and maturing modern Security Operations functions within complex, highly available enterprise environments.
Proven ability to develop strategy, operating models, and capability roadmaps that strengthen cyber resilience while enabling business objectives.
Deep understanding of modern Security Operations disciplines including incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, technical vulnerability prioritization, security monitoring, and operational resilience.
Strong understanding of enterprise security technologies including SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, vulnerability management, cloud security, identity services, and security analytics, with experience overseeing their operational use in partnership with Security Architecture & Technology.
Experience establishing operational governance, executive reporting, performance metrics, and continual improvement programs.
Working knowledge of industry frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, SOC 2, and MITRE ATT&CK.
Additional Information Security certifications are highly desirable and may include CISM, GIAC certifications, or equivalent industry-recognized credentials.
Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to communicate cyber risk and operational performance to both technical and executive audiences.
Strategic, outcome-focused leader with demonstrated success influencing organizational priorities and leading through change.
Strong organizational, financial, and people leadership skills with experience building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.
Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across the organization and align security operations with broader business and technology objectives.

We provide a comprehensive extended health benefits program, including virtual healthcare and a wellness allowance. Employees also receive annual allotted vacation days, which increase based on tenure. Other benefits include: Paid sick days, maternity/parental enhancement program, bonus, and an RRSP contribution matching program.

For Vancouver-based employees, we provide a subsidized meal program, courtesy of our talented in-house culinary team!

$180,000—$220,000 CAD

At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. jobs.title: Director, Partner Retention
jobs.description:
The role / impact

At Xero, we are here to make running a business beautiful by helping small businesses thrive and building a stronger economy. As Director of Partner Retention for Xero Canada, you will guide our Enterprise and Field Partner channel and the people within it, shaping our post-sales growth, utility, expansion, and account management strategy across Canadian regions.

In this role, you will coach a team of Partner Success Managers (PSMs) and Enterprise PSMs to deliver meaningful outcomes for our accounting and bookkeeping partners while hitting revenue, subscription, and activation targets. By nurturing strong relationships with key enterprise and field stakeholders, refining our sales motions, and mitigating churn, you will directly expand recurring revenue and strengthen Xero's market presence across Canada.

The Team / How They Connect

You will manage a dedicated team of Partner Success Managers and Enterprise PSMs who look after our existing field and enterprise accounting and bookkeeping partners across Canada. Together, your team supports partner onboarding, product adoption, account expansion, and long-term retention through regular business reviews and tailored territory planning. You will also collaborate closely with the Director of Partner Services, the Post PDR team, and cross-functional colleagues across sales enablement, product, marketing, legal, and operations to create a seamless partner experience.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

Maintaining strong CRM discipline and using operational tools for accurate month-over-month forecasting, pipeline coverage, and sales execution.
Delivering quarterly and bi-annual business reviews with key enterprise and field partners across Canada to uncover growth opportunities and retention levers.
Spending time in the field coaching team members throughout the retention and growth cycle to lift activation velocity, upsell and cross-sell revenue, and conversion rates.
Partnering with the Director of Partner Services and the Post PDR team to refine post-sales motions, expand key enterprise accounts, and build repeatable processes that protect market share.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Canada and supports partners and team members across Canadian regions. We offer a flexible hybrid working approach that blends remote work with in-person connection days at our Canadian offices, alongside regular time in the field coaching your team and attending partner channel events.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

You bring proven experience in sales or relationship management with field and enterprise clients, alongside a strong track record of achieving revenue, retention, and growth targets.
Coaching and mentoring people comes naturally to you, with a people-focused mindset that builds accountability, product knowledge, and a supportive team culture.
Your background includes shaping repeatable sales processes, managing pipeline forecasting with strong CRM habits, and guiding long enterprise sales cycles.
Collaborating across departments is one of your strengths, allowing you to work smoothly with product, marketing, legal, customer success, and sales operations teams.
Clear, empathetic communication and confident public speaking skills help you build trust with senior partner stakeholders and represent Xero at industry events.

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - ensuring your value is recognized through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is $136,000 to $175,000

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Development, you will own the proactive sourcing and origination of independent pharmacy acquisition opportunities within an assigned Canadian territory. You will build trusted, long-term relationships with pharmacy owners and their advisors, understand owners’ business and succession objectives, and ensure Shoppers Drug Mart is a credible, reliable and ethical acquisition partner. You will qualify and advance opportunities in collaboration with Finance, Operations, Real Estate, Legal and other internal partners. This is an origination-led, mixed office/field based role with relationship ownership throughout the transaction process.

Originate opportunities and develop owner relationships

Develop and execute a territory-level acquisition sourcing plan, including mapping independent pharmacy targets, assessing strategic fit, and prioritizing high-potential prospects.
Proactively create proprietary and off-market opportunities through field visits, direct outreach, referrals, industry events and thoughtful use of sourcing technology.
Build consultative, multi-year relationships with pharmacy owners; understand succession timelines, motivations, business priorities and circumstances that could lead to a sale.
Cultivate a network of trusted referral sources and intermediaries, including relevant advisors, brokers, accountants, lenders and pharmacy industry contacts.

Qualify and advance acquisitions

Assess prospective acquisitions against strategic, commercial and operational criteria, including prescription trends, store economics, location, lease considerations, competitive dynamics and execution risks.
Gather and validate information needed for preliminary screening and valuation; partner with Finance and other teams to develop recommendations and support investment decisions.
Lead owner-facing discussions and negotiate approved commercial terms and offers, including letters of intent where appropriate, within established approval parameters.
Remain the principal relationship contact for owners as opportunities progress through diligence, internal approvals, negotiation and closing; coordinate closely with Legal, Operations, Real Estate and Finance.
Coordinate a smooth handoff to the teams responsible for transition and integration, maintaining effective seller communication as appropriate.

Manage the pipeline and territory

Maintain a current, well-qualified acquisition pipeline in the CRM, with accurate contact histories, next steps, deal stages, risks, anticipated timing and forecasts.
Track sourcing effectiveness using measures such as target coverage, meaningful owner engagement, qualified opportunities, offers, conversion and completed acquisitions; share market intelligence with leadership.
Monitor local industry developments and competitor activity, refine territory priorities, and use data, automation and other tools responsibly to improve sourcing effectiveness.

Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy .

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

jobs.description:
Company Description
  
Purpose Unlimited is an independent financial services company with an unrelenting focus on customer\-centric innovation, delivered through technology\-driven solutions. Led by entrepreneur Som Seif, the company is developing a diversified product platform aimed at addressing historically underserved segments of the market. Purpose Unlimited’s businesses include Purpose Investments, Advisor Solutions by Purpose, and Driven.
  
  

Who is Advisor Solutions by Purpose?
  
Advisor Solutions by Purpose, a subsidiary of Purpose Unlimited, is an innovative financial technology firm providing modern client and practice management technology and services for independent portfolio management and financial advisory businesses in Canada. Recognized by Wealth Professional Magazine as 2023 Wealth Tech Service Provider of the Year and one of Canada’s Top 2023 Small and Medium Employers, Advisor Solutions by Purpose’s end\-to\-end solution simplifies the advisor practice and makes it easier for clients to access better services to achieve their financial goals. For more information, please visit https://www.purposeadvisors.com
  
**Vacancy Status:** This is for a current opening.
  
**Compensation:** $140,000 \- $180,000
  
Job Description
  
The Opportunity
  
Advisors across Canada are rethinking how they build their practices. The tools are better. The expectations are higher. The old platform models are showing their age. Purpose Unlimited is building the alternative – an advisor platform that combines investment product manufacturing, practice management intelligence, and AI\-powered support into something genuinely useful.
  
  

Who You are
  
We are looking for a VP, Advisor Development Sales to lead advisor acquisition for our Advisor Solutions Platform. This is not a role where you manage a pipeline and wait for inbound. You will be the person who finds the right advisors, earns their trust, helps them see what their practice could become on Purpose’s platform, and brings them in.
  
You will own the full advisor acquisition lifecycle – from strategic prospecting through to close – and you will do it with AI tools that handle the routine so you can focus on what actually wins deals: relationships, judgment, and the ability to help an advisor envision something better.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

What You Will Deliver
  
* Drive net new advisor acquisition revenue, converting high\-potential advisors to the Purpose platform through consultative, trust\-based engagement
* Build and execute a strategic acquisition plan targeting specific advisor segments, geographies, and competitive displacement opportunities across Canada
* Architect complex platform transitions for established advisory practices – navigating compliance, technology migration, book transfers, and change management
* Serve as the strategic voice of the advisor to Purpose’s product, technology, and leadership teams – translating field intelligence into platform improvements that matter
* Develop deep market intelligence on competitive platforms, advisor sentiment, and industry shifts – using AI tools to surface insight and your judgment to act on it
* Deliver practice management consulting to prospects and platform advisors – helping them grow, modernize, and future\-proof their businesses
* Collaborate across product, compliance, marketing, and operations to remove barriers and accelerate advisor onboarding


What AI Does So You Don’t Have To
  
Purpose is an AI\-forward organization. In this role, AI handles:
  
* Prospect research, lead scoring, and prioritization – AI surfaces the highest\-value advisor targets from market and CRM data
* First\-draft proposals, pitch materials, and personalized advisor communications
* Pipeline forecasting, activity tracking, and real\-time competitive intelligence monitoring
* Meeting preparation – advisor profiles, practice analytics, and talking points assembled before every conversation


You direct the AI. You validate the output. You bring the judgment and relationship that no tool can replicate.
  
What Only You Can Do
  
* Build the trust that makes an advisor willing to move their life’s work to a new platform
* Read a room – understand what an advisor is really asking for beneath the surface\-level objection
* Navigate the emotional complexity of a platform transition – fear, inertia, loyalty, ambition
* Structure creative deal terms and partnership models that work for the advisor and for Purpose
* Translate what you hear in the field into product and strategy insight that makes Purpose better


**Qualifications:**  

What You Must Bring
  
* Deep experience in advisor\-facing roles within Canadian wealth management – you understand how advisors think, what they value, and what drives their decisions
* A consultative sales approach grounded in trust\-building, not transactional closing – demonstrated track record of complex, multi\-stakeholder advisory transitions
* Strong familiarity with the Canadian advisor landscape – platforms, dealers, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics
* Comfort working with AI tools as part of your daily workflow – you are already using AI for research, content creation, or sales preparation, or eager to start


What Will Set You Apart
  
* Experience leading advisor transitions from competing platforms – you’ve navigated the compliance, technology, and emotional complexity of moving a book
* Practice management consulting experience – you can help an advisor redesign their business, not just switch providers
* Entrepreneurial instinct – you’ve built something in a fast\-growing environment and know how to create structure without bureaucracy
* A genuine perspective on how AI will reshape wealth management and advisor practices in the next 3–5 years
* Existing relationships in the Canadian advisor community that you can mobilize from day one

jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention \& Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post\-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.


We're doing $50M\+ a year and scaling to $100M\+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A\-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands\-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**


Own retention A\-Z to fuel the growth to 9\-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**


We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space – $50M\+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M\+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**


Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post\-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**


If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands\-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**


90\-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12\-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win\-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post\-purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell, win\-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post\-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  

**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands\-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Director - Canada
jobs.description:
### **About Us**


At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD\-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next\-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.


We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward\-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.


At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast\-paced, cutting\-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

### **Job Summary**


Versa Networks is seeking an accomplished, highly motivated Director of Channel Sales – Canada to drive the expansion of our Service Provider, Managed Service Provider (MSP), and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) business across the Canadian market.


This is a strategic, revenue\-generating role responsible for developing and expanding relationships with Canada's leading Tier 1 telecommunications providers, including Rogers Communications and Bell Canada, while identifying, recruiting, and enabling high\-potential MSP and MSSP partners throughout the country.


The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable partner ecosystem, driving adoption of Versa's networking and cybersecurity solutions, and generating sustainable recurring revenue through partner\-led go\-to\-market strategies.


This position requires an entrepreneurial, hands\-on sales leader with strong executive relationship skills, deep knowledge of the Canadian telecommunications and managed services landscape, and a demonstrated track record of developing new business.


The role is remote and must be based in Eastern Canada, preferably within Ontario or Quebec, to facilitate engagement with strategic partners and their leadership teams

### **Responsibilities**


Strategic Service Provider Account Development

* Own and execute Versa's channel sales strategy for Canada's Tier 1 telecommunications and service provider market, with particular emphasis on Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, and other strategic providers.
* Establish and expand executive\-level relationships across partner product management, managed services, cybersecurity, network engineering, sales, and business development organizations.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Versa's SD\-WAN, SASE, SSE, and security technologies into partners' managed networking and cybersecurity portfolios.
* Develop joint business plans, technology roadmaps, and go\-to\-market strategies with strategic service provider partners.
* Navigate complex partner organizations, commercial negotiations, procurement processes, and long\-term technology evaluations.
* Drive strategic agreements and commercial commitments that create sustainable recurring revenue for Versa.


MSP \& MSSP Ecosystem Development

* Identify, recruit, and develop high\-potential MSP and MSSP partners across Canada.
* Prioritize partners with established enterprise and midmarket customer bases and the ability to deliver managed networking and security services.
* Develop relationships with partner executive leadership, sales organizations, and technical decision\-makers.
* Build and execute partner business plans with defined revenue targets, pipeline commitments, and joint sales activities.
* Drive partner onboarding, technical enablement, sales readiness, and go\-to\-market execution.
* Expand existing partner relationships through additional Versa solutions and new managed service offerings.
* Establish a scalable and productive partner ecosystem focused on measurable revenue contribution.


Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Management

* Own and deliver assigned annual bookings and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for the Canadian Service Provider, MSP, and MSSP business.
* Proactively generate new business opportunities through strategic partner development and joint selling.
* Build, maintain, and accurately forecast a qualified pipeline of partner\-led opportunities.
* Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue enterprise and midmarket customer opportunities.
* Drive opportunities through technical validation, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
* Establish measurable quarterly business objectives and conduct regular partner business reviews.
* Maintain strong accountability for pipeline conversion, partner productivity, and recurring revenue growth.


Solution Positioning \& Go\-to\-Market Execution Position Versa's integrated networking and cybersecurity portfolio, including:

* Networking Solutions
* + Secure SD\-WAN and Advanced SD\-WAN
	+ Software\-Defined LAN (SD\-LAN)
	+ Secure routing and network transformation
	+ Branch and distributed enterprise connectivity
	+ Network segmentation and infrastructure modernization
* Cybersecurity Solutions
* + Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
	+ Security Service Edge (SSE)
	+ Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
	+ Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
	+ Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
	+ Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW)
	+ DNS Security and Filtering
	+ Advanced Threat Protection and Data Loss Prevention
* Translate these capabiliti

As Director of Partner Retention for Xero Canada, you will guide our Enterprise and Field Partner channel and the people within it, shaping our post\-sales growth, utility, expansion, and account management strategy across Canadian regions.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Citi:**


Our vision is for Citi to be the pre\-eminent banking partner for institutions with cross\-border needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in our home market.


Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have set expectations for how we must act to bring our mission to life.


Our Leadership Principles are at the heart of what we do: We take ownership. We deliver with pride. We succeed together.


For more about Citi, please visit www.citigroup.com (opens in new window).


**About the Group:**


The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and CBNA Risk Management Group sits within Independent Risk Management in the second line of defense. ERM includes programs such as risk frameworks and policy, risk identification, risk appetite and limits, and stress testing. CBNA Risk Management includes key credit and regulatory programs that support bank\-wide safety and soundness.


**About the Role:**


The Senior Vice President within the CBNA Risk Management team will focus primarily on portfolio credit risk management activities. This involves providing effective oversight and periodic review and challenge of first line of defense portfolio management processes and outcomes so that credit risk is effectively managed, protecting Citi’s financial stability and support safety and soundness while supporting overall business strategy.


**Key Responsibilities**:


* Lead second line of defense oversight and review of key bank credit and regulatory programs, focused initially on an intra\-firm credit instrument program. This program enables bank legal entities to efficiently manage their capital while meeting local regulatory requirements related to concentrations of credit. Risk management activities include:
	+ Providing independent review and challenge and recommending required approvals within the program. This includes reviewing requests from the first line of defense for extensions of credit under the program and periodic limit / program approvals.
	+ Overseeing and monitoring portfolio health, leveraging portfolio reporting and engagement with internal stakeholders. Developing improvements to portfolio monitoring and escalation tools and routines for proactive risk management.
	+ Partnering with internal stakeholders for improved connectivity between bank credit and regulatory programs and business\-as\-usual risk management, inclusive of operating models, limit methodologies, reporting and technology, and governance and controls.

  

* Support other bank credit and regulatory programs as needed, which include limit and portfolio management activities, driving governance discussions, monitoring risk mitigation efforts, and supporting deal\-based limit and program assessments so that risk\-taking remains within approved risk appetite and other constraints.
  

  

* Promote and drive a strong governance control environment supporting bank credit and regulatory programs. This includes:
	+ Driving adherence to firm policies, processes, and controls aligned to regulatory requirements, inclusive of designing and implementing enhancement opportunities.
	+ Supporting compliance, internal audit, and regulatory engagements that touch in\-scope bank credit and regulatory programs.

  

* Embed Citi’s risk culture throughout day\-to\-day activities as an individual contributor. This includes being an enthusiastic and early adopter of change, proactively identifying opportunities to streamline work, and taking accountability for identifying, escalating, and managing potential risks in a proactive way.
  

  

**Qualifications**:


* 10\+ years of experience, preferably in a credit\-related role and with an understanding of banking regulation regarding key risk management and control concepts.
* Solid knowledge and hands\-on experience in risk management, especially with credit portfolios, inclusive of risk assessment, credit analysis, and portfolio monitoring.
* Prompt and efficient in responding to ad\-hoc transaction requests with a keen ability to identify, mitigate and challenge trade\-specific risks and forecast potential risk scenarios.
* Skilled communicator with the ability to explain complex financial concepts and risks for stakeholders and to document review and challenge accordingly.
* Strong project management skills, with the capability to oversee multiple projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.

**Education**:


* Bachelor's degree required. Master's degree preferred. Focus areas may include finance, economics, business administration.

Nymbus **employs an experienced team of portfolio managers, scientists, researchers and engineers** to provide institutions, family offices, and financial advisors with access to truly differentiated investment solutions. **We’ve become known as “the nerds of the street” and proudly wear that tag**.



Since our founding, we’ve grown to manage **over $****2** **billion in assets, an achievement driven by consistent top\-percentile performance**. For a driven sales professional, this is an opportunity to represent the future of investing, backed by a compelling story of performance and innovation.

  

For more information, please visit www.nymbus.ca.

  

The Role: Elevating Our Private Wealth Segment



We are seeking an entrepreneurial and high\-energy Regional Vice\-President, Business Development to help supercharge our retail segments. In this role, you will be the face of Nymbus Capital, across the Greater Toronto Area and Beyond, reaching out to financial advisors at Canada’s largest financial institutions and independent wealth management firms to introduce the "future of investing".

  

What will your typical day look like?


* **Business Development:** Cultivate and manage relationships with financial advisors and select family offices, to enhance our footprint and generate new business opportunities
* **Strategic Communication:** Work closely with the Director, Business Development to simplify complex technical concepts into digestible, compelling narratives for advisors.
* **Client Engagement:** Coordinate and lead meetings, ensuring advisors are well\-informed and comfortable with our systematic approach and performance.
* **Market Intelligence:** Provide consistent feedback to internal teams regarding investor sentiments and the competitive landscape.
* **CRM Excellence:** Utilize CRM as a daily tool to log interactions and optimize the investor journey through automation.

  



Qualifications:


* **Experience:** 10\+ years of proven success in business development or investor relations within investment management.
* **Network:** An established, active network within the financial advisor segments of big banks and independent firms.
* **Technical Proficiency:** A strong understanding of financial markets, systematic strategies, and portfolio management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional presentation skills with the ability to "de\-nerd" complex strategies for a diverse audience.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or Business; an investment designation (CFA, CIM, or equivalent) is highly advantageous.
* **Language:** Full fluency in **English** is required, French is an asset but not required.

  



What Nymbus offers:


* **Competitive Compensation:** Tailored for an entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on performance consisting of base \+ uncapped bonus structure.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Medical, dental, life, and disability insurance for you and your dependents.
* **Remote Flexibility:** We facilitate remote work to help you manage family and obligations.
* **Growth Environment:** A high\-performance, collaborative scientific culture that celebrates innovation, individual ownership, and continuous learning.

  



Our culture :

  

At Nymbus, we pride ourselves on cultivating a workplace where:


* **Innovation Drives Us:** We are relentless in our pursuit of fresh ideas and groundbreaking solutions. We encourage out\-of\-the\-box thinking and celebrate creativity.
* **Collaboration is Key:** Our teams are built on mutual respect, open dialogue, and collaborative spirits. We believe that by working together, we can achieve greater outcomes.
* **Continuous Learning:** We are committed to the professional growth and development of our team. Whether it's attending industry conferences, internal training, or informal knowledge\-sharing sessions, we strive to stay at the forefront of the tech and finance worlds.
* **Agility and Adaptability:** In a rapidly changing industry, we prioritize agility. We adapt to challenges and are always ready to pivot our strategies to stay ahead.
* **Individual Ownership:** While we thrive as a team, we also celebrate individual achievements and give everyone the autonomy to take ownership of their work.
* **Diversity and Inclusion:** Different perspectives enrich our company. We are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute.


Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to join our mission in building a next\-generation investment management firm.

  

We thank all applicants.

  

Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

  

No phone inquiries, please.

jobs.title: Head of CRM & Retention
jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention \& Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post\-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.


We're doing $50M\+ a year and scaling to $100M\+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A\-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands\-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**


Own retention A\-Z to fuel the growth to 9\-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**


We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space – $50M\+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M\+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**


Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post\-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**


If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands\-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**


90\-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12\-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win\-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post\-purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell, win\-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post\-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  

**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands\-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**


What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on\-site and post\-p

jobs.company: Canada Revenue Agency - Agence du revenu du Canada
jobs.title: Director (EX-02), Various Positions in the Finance and Administration Branch and the Information Technology Branch
jobs.description:
For a description of key terms used on CRA job notices, go to Definitions for job seekers.

About The Job

The CRA is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free work environment with a diverse workforce that reflects the Canadians we serve. It starts with the hiring process. To find out more about the CRA's actions in support of Employment Equity (EE), diversity and inclusion (DI), and read testimonials from our employees and executives, please visit the following CRA web sites: Employment equity, diversity and inclusion and Our workforce testimonials - Canada.ca.

We encourage you to complete the EEDI Staffing questionnaire as part of your application if you wish to be considered for appointments using the EE and/or DI staffing requirement in this process. Also, ensure that you have provided consent in the EEDI staffing questionnaire for your EEDI information to be used for screening or selection. If you do not complete the questionnaire, you will not be considered for any appointments using the EE and/or DI staffing requirement in this process. If you decide to modify your response or fill out this questionnaire at a later date, please notify the contact listed at the bottom of this notice of job opportunity.

Have you ever wanted to make a difference to the lives of millions of people and influence how government interacts with Canadians? Are you inspired by the possibility of delivering results in a people-centric environment and in an organization that encourages innovation? Do you want to be part of a team that is engaged, collaborative and respectful?

If you answered yes to the above, THIS
is the job for you and CRA is THE
organization for you.

At the CRA, we recognize the importance of creating a healthy and respectful workplace, where our employees are empowered to be themselves and realize their full potential. We value integrity, respect, professionalism and collaboration. At the core of our values is our deep commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility. Through experience we know that diversity and inclusion foster innovation and leads to greater engagement, richer discussions, and better results for the people and communities we serve. Learn more about the CRA from an executive's perspective.

We are looking for dynamic, collaborative and strategic leaders with a proven track record to contribute to the People First vision and take the delivery of services to Canadians to the next level while demonstrating character leadership. The CRA is elevating character leadership alongside competencies, as "leading from who you are" is recognized as an important part of the CRA leadership practice.

The Intent Of This Staffing Process Is To Create a Pre-Qualified Pool (PQP) Of EX-02 Qualified Individuals With Specialized Expertise To Fill Current And Future Vacancies Within The Following Headquarters Branches:

Finance and Administration Branch (FAB) (Stream 1)
Information Technology Branch (ITB) (Stream 2)

Who Can Apply
:

Employees of the CRA who occupy a substantive position. If you are an eligible veteran or a Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) member, you may also apply.

For each stream, if the number of applicants is insufficient, the following may be considered: Persons who occupy a substantive position within the Federal Public Service, including Crown corporations and agencies.

Essential Requirements:

Education

For Stream 1 (FAB), have a degree (see note 1) from a recognized post-secondary institution.

For Steam 2 (ITB), have a degree (see note 1) or diploma in computer science, information technology, software/computer engineering, management information systems or a combination of career long IT experience and relevant education.

Experience

For both streams, have recent and significant experience
(see note 2) at the EX-01 group and level (or equivalent or above) in the following:

EXP1
:

Stream 1 (FAB):

Managing human and financial resources (Please be specific: indicate the number of direct reports, subordinates and the dollar figures of the budgets you directly managed for each position in the questionnaire); and

EXP2:

Providing strategic advice and briefings to senior officials (see note 3) on a large and complex (see note 4) program, major project (see note 5), policy or operational issues of a regional or national scale; and

EXP3:

Establishing and maintaining relationships with multiple internal or external stakeholders, which could include other government departments and agencies in order to deliver on government priorities; and

EXP4: (choose one of the following)

(4.1):
Leading, developing and implementing policies, programs, systems, or strategies related to Project and Portfolio Management in the financial field.

OR

(4.2):
Leading, developing and implementing policies, programs, systems, or strategies related to the finance functions such as (but not limited to): Resource Management and Budgeting, Accounting Operations, Financial Policy and Internal Controls, Financial Systems, Financial Reporting, Financial Management Administration, Costing, Internal Audit, Materiel Management or Procurement.

Stream 2 (ITB):

EXP1:

Managing significant human resources (40 FTEs or more) and financial resources ($5M or more); and

EXP2:

Leading complex (see note 4) and innovative services or solutions related to Information Management/ Information Technology (IM/IT) initiatives through subordinate supervisors in a large decentralized organization (see note 6) OR business transformation initiatives enabled by IT in a large decentralized organization; and

EXP3:

Collaborating and maintaining partnerships, and building consensus around issues with both colleagues and a variety of internal and external stakeholders; and

EXP4:

Experience in providing strategic advice and recommendations related to IT programs, major IT projects (see note 5) or IT-related issues to senior officials (see note 3).

This Experience Would Be Considered An Asset:

Steam 1 (FAB):

Providing leadership on corporate services, programs or operational service delivery.
Experience in leading a major complex and horizontal transformation initiative.
Possess or be eligible for a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, including CA, CMA or CGA).
Experience interacting with central agencies; e.g., the Treasury Board Secretariat or the Department of Finance, on resource management matters.
Experience managing a major project investment or providing oversight of a portfolio of projects.

Stream 2 (ITB):

Broad and deep knowledge of current and emerging technologies (e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, Quantum), technology directions and strategic application of technologies to support business needs.
Experience in modern IT development practices and methodologies such as DevSecOps, decoupling applications through Application Programming Interfaces (API), Product Management and cloud.
Experience delivering excellent results (projects and operations) in a large complex environment with a mix of emerging, current and legacy technologies.
Experience in the planning, delivery and/or management of IT security programs, services or projects, including in cybersecurity.
Experience in leading more than one IT program (at the executive level) in a large scale organization (see note 6).
Experience providing leadership in information technology within a large organization responsible for the administration of tax and/or benefits programs.

Notes:

Degree: is defined as a baccalaureate or higher level degree.
Recent and significant experience is defined as the depth and breadth of the experience normally associated with having performed a broad range of related activities at the EX-01 group and level or equivalent and above, for a period of two (2) cumulative years in the past five (5) years.
Senior officials are defined as Director General, Assistant Commissioner/Deputy Assistant Commissioner (Assistant Deputy Minister) or equivalent and above.
Complex is defined as having at least three (3) of the following characteristics: multidimensional, sensitive, affecting many partners or stakeholders, precedent setting or having major impact on the organization, or having a potential for significant media coverage.
A major project would normally be an initiative under the oversight of the Agency's Major Project Investment Oversight Process (MPIOP), or other governmental organization equivalent.
A large decentralized organization is defined as a geographically decentralized organization with more than 5,000 employees whose operations are spread over a very large territory.

Conditions Of Employment Required At The Time Of Appointment:

Secret security clearance level
Willingness to travel
Willingness to relocate to the National Capital Region (NCR)
For Steam 1 (FAB), candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application will result in being screened out of the staffing process.
For Stream 2 (ITB), relocate to the NCR may be required for some positions. Candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application may result in not being considered for some positions.

All appointments (except acting appointments) to and within the Executive (EX) Group at the CRA are subject to the Agreement to be laterally moved provision as a mandatory condition of employment. This provision is included in the CRA's Directive on Terms and Conditions of Employment for the EX Group

Languages Requirements:

Bilingual – CBC levels
Candidates must have valid Second Language Evaluation test results at the CBC level at the time of application in order to be considered further in the staffing process. Should your SLE results not be transferable to the CRA, you will be assessed and must meet to be considered further in this staffing process.

To apply

Please submit your curriculum vitae via the CRA's career portal.

A Curriculum Vitae
that Includes:

group and level of your substantive position;
current security clearance level;
education;
for each position occupied/listed:
position titles with the group and level;
name of organization;
duration (years and months); and
the number of direct and indirect reports, and the dollar figures of the budgets you directly managed and were accountable for.

In addition, please complete the following questionnaires, which are part of the application process:

Generic Questionnaire:
Mobility:
For Steam 1 (FAB), candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application will result in being screened out of the staffing process.
For Stream 2 (ITB), relocate to the NCR may be required for some positions. Candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application may result in not being considered for some positions.

Substantive Group and Level: You will be asked to indicate your substantive group and level.
Second Language Evaluation (SLE): You will be asked to indicate your SLE Results with the expiration dates.
Security Clearance: You will be asked to indicate your current security clearance.
Job Performance and Talent Management: You will be asked to indicate your performance rating and talent map placement for the last two years, if applicable.
Essential Requirements:
Education: For Stream 1 (FAB), you will be asked to identify if you have a degree from a recognized post-secondary institution. For Stream 2 (ITB), you will be asked to identify your educational credentials and, where applicable, provide a copy of your degree or diploma in computer science, information technology

jobs.title: Director, People Platform & Self-Service Experience
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Director, People Platform & Self-Service Experience

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Experience (PE) Technology Systems, you will own the end-to-end experience across People Experience products and services. You will partner across PE, IT, and the user community to develop a vision and prioritized roadmap for opportunities to create PE technology experiences that meet EA employees where they are. One of your major initial focuses will be on establishing the experiences that integrate EA's new PE AI Assistant.

This is not a traditional HR operations or technology role. We are looking for someone who thinks like a product and service designer: You are curious about users, able to simplify complex systems, and are comfortable working across technology, process and organizational boundaries. You will work in a hybrid work model 3 days in office based in out of Los Angeles, CA, Kirkland, WA, or Vancouver, Canada
.

Responsibilities

End-to-end ownership of PE digital experiences

Define the PE digital experience strategy that will transform how employees and managers interact with digital PE products and services.
Design experiences around what employees and managers are trying to accomplish rather than around PE's internal organizational structure.
Launch the manager and employee experience product roadmaps.

Integrate AI Into PE Digital Experiences

Establish the vision for how PE can unify AI experiences across disparate EA core and PE platforms (Workday, Google Gemini, and others) into a uniform experience.
Lead the user experience design for the PE AI Assistant (AIA), from initial launch through continued expansion.
Define and drive implementation of digital journeys that optimize the use and adoption of the AI-enabled digital experiences.
Use interaction data and user feedback to continuously improve PE's digital products.

Launch & Own Manager and Employee Experience Products & Journeys

Lead the end-to-end design, launch, and ongoing management of core manager and employee experience products and journeys.
Partner with PE teams to redesign priority journeys across the talent lifecycle to bring together policy, process, technology, data and service delivery into satisfying user experiences.
Establish and track product success metrics, defining how we measure PE experience quality through measures such as employee effort, task completion, adoption, AI resolution, human handoffs, and satisfaction.
Use data from the AIA, People Services, technology platforms, and direct user feedback to identify improvement opportunities and create a continuous feedback loop into PE's product and process roadmap.

Build User-Centered Design Into How PE Works

Establish practical approaches for user research, prototyping and testing across PE.
Bring employees and managers into the design process early and regularly.
Partner with transformation teams and workstream leads to embed experience design into design sprints.
Create reusable design patterns and standards that allow teams to move quickly while maintaining a consistent experience.
Act as the voice of the user in major PE product, process and technology decisions.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in service design, UX, product management, or customer or employee experience in a global enterprise.
Experience designing end-to-end user journeys across digital products, operational processes, and service delivery.
Experience integrating AI capabilities to improve the efficacy and quality of employee or customer experiences

Core Skills And Experience

Translate complex policies and cross-functional workflows into simple user journeys using research and prototyping.
Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify friction and prioritize product backlogs.
Establish design principles, accessibility standards, and governance models across technical and operational teams.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$160,700 - $224,700 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$182,600 - $276,300 USD
Washington (depending on location e.g. Seattle vs. Spokane) *$175,600 - $233,600 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with your new child, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and long-term cash programs.

In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of paid sick time, company top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, and retirement benefits to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and long-term cash programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.description:
At Gore Mutual, we’ve always set ourselves apart as a modern mutual that does good. Now, we’re proudly building on that legacy to transform our company—and our industry—for the better.
Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country’s largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property & Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva’s Ontario-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long-term stability.
Every decision and investment remains anchored in long-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.
We are looking for a Director, Data Engineering to lead a critical capability within Gore’s Enterprise Data & Analytics organization. You will lead the teams responsible for turning enterprise data into trusted, reusable data products and building the engineering capabilities that enable Data, Insights and AI across Gore.
You will shape how we build and manage data products, evolve our Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, and ensure our Databricks and Azure ecosystem provides the foundation needed for Analytics, Data Science, GenAI and emerging AI solutions.
This is a visible leadership role for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, people leadership and the ability to turn data and technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.
What will you do?

Build Enterprise Data Products

Lead the development of trusted, reusable data products that combine business meaning, data quality and strong engineering to support operational, analytical, Data Science and AI use cases.
Establish and mature our data product discipline, partnering with business and technology leaders to turn high-value data needs into scalable capabilities.
Improve the accessibility, consistency and value of enterprise data while reducing fragmentation and duplication.

Advance Data Engineering & AI Enablement

Lead and mature Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, creating repeatable paths to move data, machine learning, GenAI and emerging AI solutions into secure, reliable production.
Raise engineering standards across integration, APIs, orchestration, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, data quality and production operations.
Partner across Data, Analytics and technology teams to provide the engineering capabilities needed to scale Data Science and AI.

Evolve Our Data Technology Foundation

Guide the evolution of Gore’s Databricks and Azure ecosystem to provide a scalable, resilient, secure and cost-effective foundation for Data, Insights and AI.
Partner with IT and Architecture to shape architecture patterns, integration approaches and technology standards.
Evaluate emerging Data and AI technologies based on business value, scalability, security and long-term sustainability.

Build and Lead a Strong Engineering Organization

Lead, coach and develop high-performing teams across Data Products, Data Platforms, Data Engineering and MLOps.
Develop strong managers and technical leaders with clear accountability for products, engineering quality and production outcomes.
Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Provide Visible Enterprise Leadership

Represent Data Engineering with senior business and technology leaders, vendors and strategic partners.
Translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, trade-offs, risks and recommendations.
Provide clear leadership across priorities, investments, delivery and significant operational challenges.

What will you need to succeed?

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Significant leadership experience across Data Engineering, data products, data platforms, MLOps or related enterprise technology functions.
Proven experience building enterprise data products and translating business needs into reusable, scalable data capabilities.
Proven experience building and operating enterprise-scale data platforms and production data workloads.
Direct production experience with Databricks, including data engineering, lakehouse architecture, governance and optimization.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud data architectures.
Strong technical knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, data integration, orchestration and distributed processing.
Experience with technologies such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and MLflow, or comparable capabilities.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevOps, DataOps and modern production engineering practices.
Practical MLOps experience enabling Data Science, machine learning and AI workloads in production.
Experience enabling GenAI or emerging AI capabilities in secure enterprise environments.
A strong track record of coaching and developing engineers, managers and technical leaders.
Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior business, technology and external stakeholders.

This posting pertains to an existing vacancy that is actively being filled.

jobs.title: VP, Consulting & Transformation
jobs.description:
Domaine is a global digital commerce and transformation partner for ambitious and beloved brands. We are the world’s largest independent Shopify partner. We are also a growing team of strategists, designers, engineers and specialists who help brands decide where to invest, build what comes next, and run it at scale across platforms, channels and AI. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

The VP, Consulting leads Domaine’s Consulting practice and holds a seat on the Craft Leadership team. The practice brings together multiple disciplines: Strategy, AI and Transformation Advisory, CRM and Lifecycle, Conversion Rate Optimization, and SEO/GEO/AEO. This role owns consulting as a commercial function as well as an advisory one. It is how Domaine moves from being chosen for a platform build to being chosen for the business outcomes.

This role does not receive a brief and execute it. It takes in a conversation with a prospect or existing client, specific or vague, and discerns the goals, the real needs, the gaps, the path, and the teams and skills required to get there. It then builds the plan and the trust to see it funded. It works in lockstep with Client Partners, Creative, Sales and Engineering, and brings commercial instinct to every recommendation: what should change, why it will grow the client’s business, what it will cost, and what it will return.

Responsibilities

Consulting Leadership

Lead senior engagements for clients including digital and AI transformation, platform and replatforming decisions, international expansion, B2B, retail and POS, loyalty, marketplace, data, and operating model.
Run structured Discovery across business objectives, customer insight, data, technology, organization and operating model. Translate it into goals, needs, gaps, a sequenced path, and the capabilities and skills required.
Build the business case that turns a roadmap into funded work and prioritization by business impact, customer impact, level of effort, and dependency.
Produce multi-year roadmaps to show the art of the possible and how they get there.
Recommend what Domaine should and should not do. Where a client’s best path goes beyond our delivery, build the partner or co-delivery model rather than shrinking the recommendation.

Retention, Account Expansion, and Commercial Growth

Own the 1, 3 or 5 year plan for every top-tier retained client, tied to their stated business goals. A launch is the beginning of our relationship with the client, not the end.
Chair or co-chair Growth Councils and QBRs with the Client Partner, run as forward-looking conversations with explicit ROI accountability rather than a retrospective of work delivered.
Support the orchestration of a unified team for every retained client, synthesizing strategy, AI and transformation, CRM and lifecycle, Conversion Rate Optimization, SEO/GEO/AEO, Design, and Technology perspectives into a single narrative. Help evolve accounts from single-threaded delivery to multi-service relationships.
Provide the strategic input and human judgment layer on client health and monthly intelligence reporting, on top of AI-generated analysis.
Ensure consulting hours are named, scoped, and priced into retainers and new builds rather than absorbed into the account.
Join pursuits for strategic accounts, bringing senior transformational thinking into the room alongside Sales and Client Partners.
Help shape scope before pricing on complex or multi-discipline engagements, so the approach differentiates the proposal rather than reading as a deliverable list.
Own the strategic spine of Domaine’s pitch narrative, positioning Domaine as a digital services partner and not only a platform implementer, and keep it current as the market moves.

Practice Leadership and Partner Advisory

Fluent in every discipline they lead. Knows Strategy, CRO, CRM and Lifecycle, SEO/GEO/AEO and our emerging AI services from the inside: the KPIs that run each one and how each should be applied to project and retained work.Own quality, methodology and playbooks, team structure, performance management, and day-to-day operation.
Carry practice margin and utilization targets.
Build the documentation, frameworks, and evaluation criteria that let each discipline scale past the people currently doing the work.
Turn proven pilots, including managed services and Domaine Labs and AI Commerce capabilities, into standard offerings with defined scope and pricing.
Help shape Domaine’s point of view on the digital commerce stack beyond the storefront: search and discovery, personalization, lifecycle and messaging, loyalty, subscription, PIM, ERP, OMS, DAM, data, and the AI tooling layer around them.
Advise clients on whether their current stack supports their goals and competitive needs, and where to reinvest. Consulting evaluates whether the investment holds up against the client’s growth plan.

Practice and People Leadership

Support the enablement of applied AI so it shows up in client roadmaps as measurable, and bring AI-differentiated capability into sales conversations, including AI discoverability, agentic commerce operations, and partner stack advisory.
Redefine consulting and discipline deliverables for an AI-native workflow, with measurable impacts.
A leader the practice leads trust. Mentors the discipline leads, earns their confidence, and pushes each practice toward continual improvement and revenue growth.Set performance standards and build a bench that can operate without you in the room.
Hold the layer below accountable as leaders owning outcomes.

Qualifications

10+ years in consulting, strategy, or senior client leadership, with meaningful time in a client-facing senior role at an agency, digital consultancy, or consulting firm.
Track record of leading digital transformation engagements from an ambiguous problem to a funded roadmap to a delivered outcome.
Experience running a consulting or strategy function and a multi-discipline group: defining the offering, setting methodology, carrying a commercial number, and building and leading leaders.
Demonstrated experience building and defending a business case for a digital transformation initiative, including ROI modeling and prioritization frameworks.
Track record of growing retained or recurring revenue relationships, not only winning net-new business.
Strong command of the digital commerce growth model: demand generation, conversion, lifecycle and retention, merchandising and AOV, and the data that connects them. Enough depth to make credible recommendations and lead discipline leaders.
Fluency in the commerce ecosystem and the surrounding partner, app, and enterprise systems landscape.

Perks & Benefits

Competitive Healthcare with Dental & Vision
Retirement savings plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy with paid time off at end of year
Flexible working schedule
Remote-first culture
Home office stipend
Apple gear
Continued education and personal development opportunities

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
