Own the roadmap and rollout sequencing for core agentic solution, and identify adjacent products to grow around the core solution.
Roadmap Prioritization:
Establish clear prioritization criteria for roadmap decisions, balancing client demand, product feasibility, commercial potential, and strategic fit.
Business-to-Technical Bridge:
Set the high-level product vision and desired user experience, then partner with the Product Lead to translate it into an executable plan with Delivery & Technology.
Adoption & Impact
: Define what successful rollout looks like: identifying the adoption signals, client outcomes, and repeatable use cases that indicate potential for scale.
Feedback Loop Management:
Capture friction and adoption signals from clients and agencies, feeding them back into business roadmap prioritization.

Growth and Market Positioning.
Identify & shape growth opportunities within existing and prospective client relationships.
Storytelling & Demos:
Shape and present the business narrative for internal and client-facing moments, translating solution capability into a compelling story that stakeholders, clients, and agencies can act on. Represent Connected Solutions in pitches, senior presentations, demos, and strategic growth conversations.
Client Support:
Support account leads with rollout across priority Publicis Groupe clients. Serve as primary point of escalation for product-related issues, concerns, or strategic pivots; coordinating resolution in partnership with Product Lead.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep understanding of the agency ecosystem, ideally with experience across creative, media, and CRM disciplines.
Skilled at translating strategic priorities into terms technical leadership can act on, and vice versa.
Comfortable owning business strategy and rollout sequencing without owning or dictating technical architecture.
AI-fluent; understands where and how agentic AI and automation actually drive efficiency in marketing and media workflows.
Commercially-minded: thinks in terms of packaging, adoption, and client/agency value, not just features.
Strong communicator who can align business stakeholders, clients, agencies, and technical leadership at once.
Comfortable in front of C-level clients and internal executives.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS in Business, Marketing, or a related strategy discipline.
8+ years in product or marketing strategy, ideally within marketing/media agency environments.
Demonstrated expertise in marketing workflows and where AI/agentic solutions create efficiency (e.g., campaign optimization, insight generation, audience planning).
Experience building business roadmaps and rollout strategies for external clients or agency networks.

Preferred / Stand-Out Experience

Experience rolling out agentic AI or automation solutions within marketing or media organizations.
Familiarity with client and agency commercial models (licensing, packaging, service tiers).
Background partnering with technical/engineering leadership without owning technical delivery.
Experience running product advisory boards or structured client workshops.
New business / growth experience.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

 À propos du poste

 McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.
 Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

 Ce que vous ferez
 Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
 Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
 Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
 Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
 Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
 Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
 Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
 Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

 Exigences de base
 13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique. 
 Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
 Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
 Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
 Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
 Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
 Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
 Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
 Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

 Compétences et expériences privilégiées
 Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
 Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
 Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
 Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
 Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
 Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
 Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
 Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

 Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques
 Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
 Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
 Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

jobs.description:
**Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce**

**BARBECUES GALORE \| Full\-time \| Senior leadership \| Reports to President**

Barbecues Galore is a specialty retailer with eight store locations and a growing e\-commerce business. We help customers explore barbecues, outdoor kitchens, patio furniture, fireplaces, accessories and related products through knowledgeable in\-store service and convenient online shopping.

We are looking for a Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce to lead our entire marketing and e\-commerce operations. You will own the website and digital content, build our brand, bring more customers into our showrooms and grow profitable online revenue. This is a hands\-on leadership opportunity for someone who can turn strategy into measurable retail and digital sales results.

**Key Areas of Responsibility** 

· Retail traffic and sales: Create local and company\-wide campaigns that increase qualified visits and sales at all eight stores; lead local SEO, Google Business Profiles, geo\-targeted advertising, signage and store\-specific promotions.

· E\-commerce growth: Own online sales strategy, revenue targets, merchandising, customer acquisition, conversion, checkout improvements, average order value, retention and profitability.

· One connected customer journey: Make the website a powerful research and store\-visit tool as well as a high\-performing online shop; connect promotions, product information and customer experiences across channels.

· Website and digital content: Direct website strategy, design, navigation, mobile experience, development roadmap and optimization; maintain accurate product descriptions, specifications, pricing, imagery, videos, buying guides and landing pages.

· Marketing and brand: Lead brand positioning, seasonal campaigns, paid search and social, SEO, email, social content, creative production, product launches and customer loyalty initiatives.

· In\-store cooking demos and vendor events: Plan and schedule demonstrations across stores, delivered by our own teams and vendor representatives; coordinate products, staffing, logistics and promotion to generate attendance, engagement and sales.

· Team and partner leadership: Lead and develop marketing and e\-commerce employees; manage agencies, developers, vendors, projects and collaboration with store management, Purchasing, Operations and IT.

· Budgets, systems and results: Manage marketing budgets and digital tools; coordinate with IT on e\-commerce, CRM, inventory and POS integrations; track performance and improve marketing return on investment.

**How success will be measured**

Growth in store traffic and retail sales; profitable online revenue; website conversion and average order value; customer acquisition and retention; local search visibility; successful in\-store events; campaign return on investment; and strong team execution.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Required**

* Significant leadership experience in marketing, digital commerce, and retail\-related business operations.
* Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies that drive both physical store traffic and online sales.
* Strong understanding of omnichannel retail marketing and customer purchasing behavior.
* Experience managing e\-commerce platforms and delivering measurable online revenue growth.
* Proven ability to lead marketing teams, manage budgets, and oversee external agencies.
* Experience with website management, digital content, SEO, paid advertising, and analytics.
* Strong knowledge of digital customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies.
* Experience planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect marketing initiatives to revenue and profitability.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in multi\-location retail environments.
* Experience in specialty retail, home improvement, outdoor living, appliances, or other product\-focused retail categories.
* Experience with large online product catalogues and complex product information.
* Familiarity with retail point\-of\-sale, inventory, CRM, ERP, and e\-commerce integrations.
* Experience developing local store marketing programs alongside national or company\-wide campaigns.
* Experience managing seasonal retail promotional calendars.
* Demonstrated success leading website improvements and digital transformation projects.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader who understands that the ultimate objective of marketing is to generate profitable business growth.

This individual understands the importance of physical retail stores and recognizes that a strong digital presence should not only generate online sales but also bring more customers into our showrooms.

They will have the ability to develop a cohesive strategy across marketing, e\-commerce, and retail operations while maintaining strong attention to execution, detail, and measurable performance.

They will be comfortable leading a team, managing external partners, working closely with store management, overseeing website development, and making data\-driven decisions.

Most importantly, they will take ownership of results and demonstrate the ability to translate marketing strategy into increased store traffic, stronger online sales, and sustainable company growth.

Interested? Apply with your résumé and examples of measurable retail and/or e\-commerce growth you have led.

Pay: $110,000\.00\-$150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* Store discount
* Vision care

Work Location: In person

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

About The Role

We are seeking a results-oriented Section Chief, Engineering to lead a team of project managers responsible for Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and engineering tools and ways-of-working improvement initiatives.

Ensure milestones and expected outcomes are achieved; act promptly to remove obstacles, arbitrate priorities, and implement recovery plans when required.
Align CAD, PLM, and engineering tools roadmaps with Engineering, IT, and Program priorities as well as enterprise architecture and standards.
Act as the primary liaison with leadership, functional owners, program teams, and IT partners to communicate portfolio status and facilitate decisions.
Oversee requirements definition, solution design, testing, deployment, and transition to operations to deliver robust, integrated, and sustainable solutions.
Champion structured change management, including communications, training, user readiness, adoption, and benefits tracking.
Support digital continuity and the integration of engineering data and processes across CAD, PLM, and related systems.
Ensure compliance with applicable security, quality, configuration management, and aerospace product development requirements.
Drive continuous improvement, standardize project management practices, and promote lessons learned across the team and its partners.

Key Competencies:

Engaging leadership, coaching, and talent development
Portfolio management, prioritization, and resource allocation
Results orientation, accountability, and business acumen
Strategic and systems thinking
Proactive management of risks, issues, and dependencies
Influence, communication, and stakeholder management
Complex problem-solving and decision-making
Change leadership and continuous improvement

How to thrive in this role?

You hold a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
You have at least ten years of relevant experience in aerospace product development, digital transformation, or engineering tools deployment.
You have demonstrated experience in people management, coaching, or leading teams of professionals and project managers.
You have led a portfolio or multiple complex projects involving cross-functional dependencies, suppliers, and stakeholders at various levels.
You understand Product Development Aircraft (PDA) processes, engineering data, configuration management, and CAD and PLM environments.
You are proficient in planning, governance, risk management, financial tracking, and project performance measurement practices.
You demonstrate sound judgment, strong influencing skills, and excellent communication abilities in both French and English.
You can operate effectively in a matrix environment, manage competing priorities, and mobilize teams through change.

Preferred Qualifications:

Certification in project or portfolio management (PMP, PgMP, or equivalent), Agile methodology, or systems engineering (INCOSE).
Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, CAD solutions, or comparable platforms.
Knowledge of MBSE, digital twins, the digital thread, and model-based product development.
Experience in organizational change management, digital solution adoption, or process improvement.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, export control, and compliance requirements applicable to the aerospace industry.

Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Job Description 

 Senior Director, AI Product Management 

 What's the opportunity? 
 We're looking for a product leader who can turn a strategic product vision into shipped reality at scale. As Senior Director, AI Product Management, you will own user-focused product success for RBC's internal Agentic AI platform, defining the product vision and translating it into a tangible roadmap, community, and ecosystem. You will build discipline around ensuring relentless customer focus and a business-strategy lens on what we build and why. You will lead a team of Product Managers and own Voice of the Customer, feature prioritization, adoption and community building around the product across RBC.
 You will be expected to set the operating rhythm, make the hard tradeoff and resourcing calls, and hold a quality bar — bringing the credibility that comes from having built and shipped AI products at scale, not just managed roadmaps.

 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Team leadership: Leading and developing Director-level leads (across Product Strategy & Roadmap, Community & Adoption, Ecosystem & Partnerships) and the teams beneath them, with clear career paths and succession

 Integrated delivery: Owning a single execution plan that aligns roadmap delivery, community programs, and partnership milestones to one cadence

 Operating cadence: Establishing and running sprint reviews, quarterly planning, and OKR setting and tracking

 Tradeoff and escalation ownership: Serving as the primary escalation point for cross-pillar dependencies, tradeoffs, and resourcing decisions

 Product quality: Maintaining acceptance criteria, release gates, and documentation standards across the squad

 Adoption and outcomes: Using analytics, telemetry, and adoption measurement to drive decisions and report progress, risks, and resource needs

 Ecosystem health: Ensuring the community and partnership programs sustain engagement and healthy adoption across the RBC user base

 You're our ideal candidate if you: 
 Have 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading multi-team product organizations as a manager of managers

 Have a track record of customer discovery and translating user needs into product strategy and prioritization

 Have hands-on experience delivering end-user facing AI products — ideally generative or agentic AI — at production scale

 Have run large-scale internal or enterprise product launches with measurable adoption outcomes

 Bring strong operational discipline: agile delivery, OKR frameworks, and release management

 Are data-driven, comfortable with analytics, telemetry, and adoption metrics as the basis for product decisions

 Have financial services experience, or the ability to rapidly develop it  - understanding how banking employees work and the regulatory constraints on internal tooling

 Have a working knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, or RAG architecture — sufficient to shape product decisions and engage technical teams

 Nice to have: 
 MBA or Master's in a technical or business discipline

 Product management certification (CSPO, SAFe, AIPM, or Pragmatic Institute)

 Background in platform engineering or developer experience teams

 Experience in a major bank's technology or digital transformation function

 What's in it for you: 
 Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC

 Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders

 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable

 Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

 About the AI Group: 
 RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations.

jobs.description:
“Join us in building Careers and shaping Experiences Beyond the Box” 

 About Us 

 At Atlantic Packaging, every box tells a story and yours begins here. As a proudly Canadian-owned company with over 80 years of excellence in the corrugated packaging industry with operations within North America (Ontario, Quebec and United States), we’re committed to sustainability, customer excellence and community impact. Since 1945, we’ve supported local jobs and built a legacy of trust with our clients and team members. At Atlantic, your ideas matter, your growth is supported and your work makes a real impact.

 The Opportunity 

 The Director of Planning & Inventory will lead the Ontario Corrugated team’s supply and inventory planning function to ensure customers receive their desired product at the service level they expect. Reporting to the Vice President of Supply Chain & Strategy, this role is critical for building organizational planning capability to support sustainable, profitable growth.  It ensures alignment between business strategy and operational execution across production, procurement, and distribution. 

 The Director of Planning & Inventory leads a team of managers, planners and analysts with a focus on driving structure, establishing best practices for planning tools and processes, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance forecast accuracy, machine utilization, inventory efficiency, and overall supply chain responsiveness. 

 What You’ll Do 

   Oversee the development and execution of the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP) process, ensuring alignment between demand, capacity, and financial plans across the organization 

   Direct inventory strategy to balance customer service levels with working capital objectives, minimizing excess/obsolete stock while preventing stockouts 

   Oversee supply planning and production scheduling alignment, ensuring plans reflect realistic capacity, lead times, and material availability 

   Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing planning team, including senior managers, plant-floor schedulers and inventory analysts 

   Partner with Sales and Business Performance teams to ensure the demand forecast can be utilized most effectively for capacity planning 

   Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Mills, and Sales to resolve supply-demand imbalances and support integrated business decision-making 

   Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) — including forecast accuracy, scheduling compliance, inventory turns, fill rate, and on-time in full delivery — and drive corrective action where targets are not met 

   Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning maturity, process efficiency, and responsiveness to demand volatility 

   Provide senior leadership with visibility into planning risks, opportunities, and trade-offs to support strategic decision-making 

 What You Bring 

 The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and leadership skills, deep expertise in demand and supply planning methodologies, and a track record of driving results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 Required 

 Undergraduate degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field

 Certificate in Supply Chain Management considered an asset; APICS/ASCM,CPIM, CSCP or CPF

   Experience building tools in PowerBI considered an asset 

 8+ years of progressive experience in demand planning, supply planning, or inventory management, including 3–5+ years in a leadership role

 Strong track-record of developing high-performing teams while overseeing day-to-day operations

 Proven experience leading S&OP/IBP processes in a manufacturing environment

 Proven experience in improving capacity/demand planning processes, inventory efficiency, and service levels in a complex, fast-paced environment

 Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority

 Knowledge/Skills/Abilities 

   Excellent analytical skills with an ability to manipulate large data sets and present analyses in a clear, concise manner 

   Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights for various groups of stakeholders 

   Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify metrics related to business processes, improving results through effective processes 

 Demonstrated proficiency in time management 

 What We Offer 

 Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage (dependents included)

 Teamwork-focused culture with sustainability initiatives and social events

 A culture of appreciation through a point-based recognition

 Opportunities for advancement and internal movement

 Education assistance for continuous skill development

 Academic scholarships for employees’ children

 Safety equipment and PPE support program

 Retirement savings and wellness initiatives

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

 Inclusion and Accessibility 

 Atlantic Packaging is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible and respectful environment for all candidates. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team—we’re here to support you.

 We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in joining Atlantic Packaging. While we appreciate the time and effort invested, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Please note 

 Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal and background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

jobs.title: Director SMB Digital Growth - B2B Payments
jobs.description:
Description

At Xe, we live currencies
. Founded in 1993, Xe is a global leader in currency exchange and international money transfers. What began as a simple currency converter has grown into a platform trusted by over 300 million people each year. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our real-time exchange rates, Currency Converter, Market Analysis and Currency Data API, supporting 130+ currencies across 190+ countries with quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app, and by phone. Backed by Euronet, we process more than $115 billion in global payments annually. Xe is profitable, product-led, and focused on building reliable, user-first tools that make moving money across borders easier for everyone.

Our Principles

At Xe, we value people who take initiative, think big, and follow through. We’re curious by nature and not afraid to ask what if or try something new. Everyone’s voice matters here. We expect people to speak up, bring ideas, and take ownership of their work. We don’t micromanage. We trust each other to make good calls, take responsibility, and move fast when it counts. And we care about community. Not in a vague corporate way, but in the sense that we have each other’s backs, stay open to feedback, and build a culture of trust and real collaboration.

Ambition. We dream big, try things out, and always ask “why not?” and “what if?” We’re ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.
Responsibility. We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.
Community. We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other, and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

The Role.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and scaling Xe’s SMB acquisition and lifecycle engine. Combining Account-Based Marketing (ABM), digital sales leadership, funnel optimization, and modern go-to-market (GTM) technologies, you will drive scalable customer acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth. This is a strategic yet hands-on leadership role, ideal for a commercially driven growth leader who thrives on building scalable acquisition systems, leveraging data and automation, and translating innovative GTM strategies into measurable business results.

Owning the full SMB customer lifecycle — from inbound lead generation and qualification to activation, retention, and upsell.
Managing a digital sales team (1 BDM and 2 SDRs).
Using smart sales tech, intent data, and personalization at scale to improve efficiency and revenue growth.

Growth, Funnel Optimization & ABM

Lead the SMB digital growth strategy, focusing on Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and high-intent inbound sales.
Design and optimize inbound lead flows — from content and paid campaigns to qualification and activation.
Build and execute personalized outbound and inbound workflows using modern GTM tools (e.g., Instantly.ai, Clay, RB2B, Vector, HeyReach.io, Findymail, Trigify.io, ChatGPT).
Develop ABM campaigns that integrate ads, website intent data, and outbound engagement to improve relevance and timing precision.
Own the SMB funnel from lead to first transaction — optimizing conversion, activation, and LTV through testing and experimentation.
Partner with Marketing and Product teams to enhance onboarding UX and reduce friction for new SMB customers.

Strategy & Execution

Define and track SMB KPIs: acquisition, activation, ARPU, churn, NPS, and inbound/outbound ROI.
Align tightly with marketing to ensure lead quality, content alignment, and campaign targeting.
Collaborate with analytics to identify performance levers and test new acquisition hypotheses.
Feed SMB insights into the product and growth roadmap to influence future innovation.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and customer-centric growth.

Digital Sales Leadership

Manage the SMB digital sales team (BDM + SDRs) and align them around a hybrid inbound + account-based outbound model.
Implement smart outbound systems using signals, lead scoring, and automation to prioritize outreach.
Build scalable playbooks for lead nurturing, personalization, and cross-channel engagement.
Create repeatable, measurable sales workflows that balance automation and human connection.

What You’ll Bring

You have 5–8+ years of experience in B2B growth, digital sales, demand generation, revenue growth, or go-to-market roles, preferably within fintech, SaaS, financial services, or other digitally driven B2B environments.
You also have 2+ years of people management experience, including direct leadership of SDRs, BDRs, BDMs, or digital sales teams, with demonstrated success in coaching, performance management, and revenue delivery.
You bring a proven track record of scaling B2B inbound lead generation and optimizing sales funnels to improve lead qualification, conversion, customer activation, and revenue growth.
You have proven experience developing and executing Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and targeted outbound sales strategies, leveraging customer segmentation, intent data, personalized outreach, and multichannel engagement to generate qualified pipeline.
Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and optimize B2B acquisition funnels, from lead generation and qualification through conversion, activation, and revenue generation.
Hands-on experience with modern GTM technology, sales automation, and prospecting tools, such as Clay, Instantly.ai, RB2B, HeyReach, Apollo, or comparable platforms.
Strong analytical capabilities, including experience measuring and improving conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), activation, retention, and campaign ROI.
Experience implementing lead scoring, automated workflows, CRM integrations, and personalized sales engagement sequences to improve sales productivity and conversion.
Strong leadership experience managing cross-functional sales or growth teams. Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Analytics teams to execute growth initiatives and improve customer experiences.
Excellent communicator who thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate customer insights and performance data into measurable revenue growth.
Entrepreneurial, curious, and motivated by measurable impact. A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset, with demonstrated success testing new growth strategies, building scalable processes, and operating in fast-paced environments.

Preferred

Background in fintech, payments, FX or cross-border money movement.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).
Experience building sales playbooks and scaling an inbound plus outbound hybrid model.
Familiarity with product-led growth or improving digital onboarding flows.

Why Xe

Global brand with 100M+ monthly users and a fast-growing B2B business.
Opportunity to build a cutting-edge inbound and ABM engine from the ground up.
Collaborative, innovative, and customer-first culture.

Perks & Benefits (Canada)

Competitive salary and incentive.
Vacation+ personal days + day off for your birthday + sick time + holidays
Volunteering day for a charity of your choice
Healthcare
Life & Disability insurance
Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
Matched employer RRSP contribution (subject to limits)
Discounted Euronet Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
A chance to grow your career in a mission-driven global company.

Why Join Us?
You'll be part of a fast-moving team where your contributions directly impact growth. We invest in our people with tools, mentorship, and opportunities to level up fast-whether that's moving into closing roles or leadership paths.  Job Description: 
 The Head, Technology Portfolio Management, Transaction Banking is the accountable executive for the integrated management and delivery oversight of the full Transaction Banking technology portfolio spanning digital channels, ledger and payments. The role converts business and technology strategy into a prioritized, funded and executable portfolio; oversees multiple concurrent programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives; and provides a single, trusted view of portfolio health, value, risk, dependencies and decisions to senior executives. 

 The role leads a significant, high-complexity, multi-year portfolio with substantial regulatory and risk oversight; manages aggregate portfolio financials, including budget, forecast, actuals and variances, and benefits realization; operates portfolio governance and controls; and leads senior program and project management talent. The current portfolio scale is approximately $235 million for 2026, with a similar level anticipated for 2027, subject to annual planning and approval. 

 ·       VCP technology portfolio across Transaction Banking digital channels, client connectivity and servicing capabilities; modern ledger and ledger integration; and wholesale payments platforms and rails.
 ·       Multiple concurrent, interdependent transformation programs and technology initiatives, including high-complexity and Tier 1 work, with material enterprise dependencies.
 ·       Accountability for integrated portfolio planning, prioritization, financial management, delivery governance, risk and control oversight, benefits realization, executive reporting and talent leadership.
 ·       Portfolio headcount, vendor spend, geographic mandate and committee memberships are to be confirmed through role evaluation and annual planning; the 2026 technology portfolio budget is approximately $235 million, with a similar scale anticipated for 2027.

 1. Portfolio strategy and prioritization
 ·       Define and maintain the integrated Transaction Banking technology strategy, investment thesis and multi-year roadmap across digital channels, ledger and payments, translating business strategy into executable technology priorities in partnership with Product, Operations and Architecture.
 ·       Translate business priorities, architecture visions, regulatory obligations and platform health needs into a sequenced portfolio with clear outcomes, dependencies and funding requirements.
 ·       Recommend portfolio investment, sequencing, capacity and scope trade-offs; stop, defer or redirect work where value, readiness, risk or strategic alignment is insufficient.
 ·       Ensure the portfolio balances transformation, modernization, resilience, regulatory and mandatory commitments, and sustainable run-state outcomes.

 2. Integrated delivery and dependency management
 ·       Oversee end-to-end delivery performance across all in-scope, multi-year programs and projects and multiple agile teams, with accountability for coherent execution against approved scope, milestones, budget, quality and benefits.
 ·       Own the integrated portfolio plan, critical path and cross-domain dependency view, resolving conflicts across channels, ledger, payments and shared enterprise platforms.
 ·       Establish clear intervention and escalation mechanisms; identify emerging slippage early and drive timely corrective action and executive decisions.
 ·       Ensure disciplined transition from design and build through testing, implementation, stabilization and hand-off to accountable run-state owners.

 3. Financial, capacity and benefits management
 ·       Own aggregate portfolio financial management, including annual planning, forecasts, actuals, variances, vendor commitments and investment transparency.
 ·       Align funding and capacity to the highest-value and highest-obligation priorities, while maintaining traceability from investment to deliverables, outcomes and benefits.
 ·       Establish benefits baselines and oversee realization of client, financial, operational, resilience and risk outcomes; address benefit leakage and underperformance.
 ·       Optimize the deployment of senior program, project and specialized resources across the portfolio.

 4. Governance, risk and control
 ·       Operate portfolio governance as a decision system, with clear accountabilities, decision rights, escalation thresholds, KPIs, executive reporting and disciplined follow-through.
 ·       Maintain an integrated view of delivery, technology, operational, cyber, data, regulatory, third-party and change risks, including assumptions and dependencies.
 ·       Ensure risk and control requirements are embedded from design through implementation and that portfolio evidence supports audit, regulatory and governance expectations.
 ·       Provide strategic guidance to business and functional leaders on material portfolio issues and ensure concerns are managed within enterprise risk appetite.

 5. Executive leadership and talent
 ·       Provide a single, credible executive narrative on portfolio status, value, financials, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
 ·       Lead and develop senior program managers, project managers and portfolio specialists; build succession, capability and disciplined performance management across the function.
 ·       Create a culture of accountability, transparency, constructive challenge, inclusion and continuous improvement.
 ·       Act as the senior portfolio management advisor to Transaction Banking Product, Technology, Operations, Architecture, Finance, Risk and Compliance leaders.

 Skills, Education & Experience:

 ·       15+ years of progressive experience in financial-services technology, portfolio, program or transformation leadership, including significant executive-level accountability in a complex regulated institution.
 ·       Demonstrated success overseeing a significant portfolio of multiple concurrent, high-complexity programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives and substantial technology investment.
 ·       Deep knowledge of Transaction Banking technology domains, including corporate digital channels and connectivity, payments and cash-management infrastructure, liquidity solutions, ledger or core-banking integration, APIs, data, cloud platforms and platform modernization.
 ·       Proven experience with portfolio financial management, integrated planning, benefits realization, vendor oversight, delivery governance and executive reporting.
 ·       Experience leading senior program and project management teams and influencing large matrixed delivery organizations across business, technology and control functions.
 ·       Demonstrated delivery in environments with material regulatory, cyber, operational resilience, data and third-party risk requirements.
 Leadership and technical skills
 ·       Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritization and investment governance.
 ·       Executive judgment, commercial acumen and value-based decision making.
 ·       Integrated roadmap, dependency, critical-path and risk management.
 ·       Technology fluency across architecture, engineering, cloud, APIs, data, cybersecurity, resilience and platform operating models.
 ·       Outstanding executive communication, board-level storytelling and ability to present a concise, evidence-based view of decisions and trade-offs.
 ·       Strong stakeholder influence, conflict resolution and ability to lead through ambiguity without relying solely on direct authority.
 ·       People leadership, talent development, succession planning and creation of high-performing, inclusive teams.
 Education and credentials
 ·       Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
 ·       MBA, advanced technical degree or equivalent executive experience preferred.
 - Portfolio, program, project, Agile, Lean or technology governance certifications are assets, such as PfMP, PgMP, PMP, SAFe or equivalent.

 Who We Are: 
 TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple.  Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. This leader establishes the enterprise AI domain strategy, target-state architecture, standards, roadmaps, governance frameworks, reference architectures, and investment priorities required to scale AI responsibly across the organization.

The Director functions as the senior architecture authority for AI, partnering closely with business executives, enterprise architects, platform leaders, risk functions, and technology teams to ensure AI investments are coordinated, reusable, governed, and strategically aligned.

This role balances long-term strategic planning with strong execution leadership, ensuring the enterprise AI roadmap translates into measurable business outcomes while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and architectural consistency.

What will you do?

Enterprise AI Domain Strategy

Define and maintain the enterprise AI architecture strategy.
Establish target-state AI domain architecture and multi-year roadmaps.
Create AI reference models, standards, principles, policies, and guardrails.
Ensure AI strategy aligns with enterprise business strategy, technology strategy, and operating model.

Enterprise Investment Alignment

Establish visibility into AI investments across global business units.
Identify duplication, fragmentation, risk, and technology overlap.
Drive enterprise-wide reuse and strategic consolidation of AI capabilities.
Guide investment decisions toward scalable enterprise platforms and services.

Domain Governance & Standards

Evolve enterprise controls governing AI deployment, autonomy, human oversight, security, risk, and compliance.
Oversee exception management and architecture decision processes.

AI Portfolio & Roadmap Leadership

Coordinate roadmap activities across business groups and technology organizations.
Ensure foundational AI investments support future enterprise demand.
Assess emerging technologies and define adoption strategies.

Executive Engagement

Communicate AI opportunities, risks, and architectural direction.
Facilitate strategic alignment between business leaders and technology organizations.
Present architecture recommendations to leadership and governance bodies.

Responsible AI & Regulatory Oversight

Establish enterprise Responsible AI architecture principles.
Ensure AI initiatives comply with regulatory expectations, model governance requirements, privacy obligations, and risk frameworks.
Drive transparency, explainability, accountability, and human oversight standards.
Partner with Risk, Security, Compliance, Legal, and Data leaders to mature enterprise AI governance.

Capability Development

Build and mentor a high-performing AI architecture community.
Develop AI architecture practices, methodologies, and knowledge-sharing programs.
Support Solution Architects and other Domain Architects in adopting enterprise standards.
Foster innovation while maintaining governance and execution discipline.

Value Realization

Define measures supporting AI investment value realization.
Track enterprise outcomes and adoption trends.
Ensure strategic AI initiatives generate measurable business value.
Continuously evolve roadmaps based on outcomes and feedback.

Success Measures

Well-defined and widely adopted enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
Reduction of redundant AI investments and technology fragmentation.
Strong alignment of AI initiatives to business priorities and enterprise standards.
Effective governance and regulatory compliance across AI initiatives.
Increased adoption of approved enterprise AI capabilities.
Demonstrated business value from AI investments.
High confidence from executives, business leaders, and technology stakeholders.
Strong execution against roadmap commitments and strategic objectives.

Education

Master's degree preferred.

AI-specific certifications highly desirable.

Experience

10+ years of architecture leadership experience.
5+ years leading enterprise AI, data, analytics, digital transformation, or emerging technology domains.

Experience within highly regulated industries, preferably insurance, wealth management, banking, or financial services.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A (Revenue)
jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Director, Financial Planning & Analysis to lead revenue planning, reporting and operations in one connected team. Reporting to our SVP, Finance, you will own how we set revenue targets, track commits and actuals, forecast, and pay for performance, and you will lead the Revenue Operations team that powers our go-to-market engine.

This is a new, expanded role that brings FP&A and RevOps together. You will turn revenue data into decisions: building commission plans that motivate the right behaviour, forecasting with Sales, Client Success and Finance, and giving executives a single, trusted view of the revenue business. You will lead a team that includes a Revenue Operations group and an FP&A analyst who owns accounting and reporting for revenue.

If you love the intersection of finance and go-to-market, want to move a team from reporting to planning, and are motivated by a mission-driven company, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Revenue planning and forecasting

Own the revenue plan: set bookings, ARR and revenue targets and translate them into quotas and territory or segment capacity in partnership with Sales, Client Success and Marketing
Lead company-wide revenue forecast cycle in partnership with GTM Operations.
Prepare scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support GTM planning and Sales leadership conversations.
Partner with Finance and GTM leadership during the annual planning cycle, aligning revenue targets, headcount assumptions and GTM investment with financial models and board-level plans.
Build and maintain financial models that link GTM drivers (pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion) to financial outcomes.

Revenue reporting and insight

Develop executive-level dashboards and deliver trusted weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting on top line performance
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that shape GTM strategy and drive performance improvements.
Standardize KPIs and definitions across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, creating a single source of truth for the organization.
Oversee revenue reporting and reconciliation work with Accounting to keep reported revenue accurate, timely and auditable

Sales Compensation

Design, model and refresh sales commission and incentive plans aligned to company strategy and budget
Oversee commission calculation, administration, auditing and dispute resolution, including tooling and controls
Forecast commission expense and report on plan effectiveness, attainment and payout trends

Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a team that includes Revenue Operations and an FP&A analyst, building planning capability alongside strong reporting
Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team, translating financial and operational data into recommendations
Drive continuous improvement in processes, systems and controls as we scale and implement new financial planning tools

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, revenue operations, sales finance or a related field, including 3+ years leading people; SaaS or fintech experience strongly preferred
Hands-on experience designing sales commission and incentive plans, and administering them in a tool such as CaptivateIQ or Xactly
Deep experience with revenue reporting and forecasting: targets, pipeline and commit management, actuals, and variance analysis
Advanced financial modeling skills, plus experience with planning software (e.g., Pigment, Adaptive Insights, Anaplan) and an ERP such as NetSuite
Strong command of Salesforce and BI tools (e.g., Tableau), and an understanding of SaaS and fintech metrics
Proven ability to build and scale processes, systems and controls across a go-to-market organization
Curiosity about AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and a track record of using them to improve analysis and automate reporting
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present to executives and influence Sales, Client Success and Finance leaders
A coaching mindset: you build teams, develop talent and bring people together across functions
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA, CPA or CFA is an asset

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

jobs.description:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About This Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team - West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

Own the revenue outcomes for the segment, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large-scale competitive replacement deals.
Build a high caliber team in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.
Establish a reputation for excellence by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering & Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You Could Be a Great Fit If

💼 You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR
💰 You have helped win $1M+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals
🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k+) deals
📊 You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.
🤝 You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer-to-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.
🤓 You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.
⚙️ You have successfully sold a complex multi-product platform and have won competitive rip-and-replace sales motions.

Bonus

You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

You Shouldn't Apply If

You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations
You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

Our Philosophy

Here Are a Few Key Points That Should Give You An Idea Of What It Is Like To Work With Us

We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby
We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals
We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience
We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.
Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.
Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.
Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders

Benefits

A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about
Competitive salary, commission and equity.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services is accountable for clinical and non-clinical asset planning, maintenance and management. The role provides overall leadership to Mackenzie Health equipment needs for short-term and long-term asset planning, tracking, maintenance, management, and refresh. The director is responsible for overseeing all facility and redevelopment work required to plan, procure, and complete installation of medical equipment. This role also provides Director-level leadership to the Central Equipment and Biomedical Engineering departments. This role works within an environment that has Design-Build-Finance-Maintain (DBFP) equipment relationships, Managed Equipment Services (MES) contract, as well as a traditional in-house biomedical engineering service and support model. This role also works closely with Mackenzie Health Redevelopment department to plan, procure, and implement the Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) components of various redevelopment projects. Additionally, the Director coordinates efforts with various departments to develop and maintain a multi-year equipment plan and budget, ensuring appropriate inventory levels, mitigation of corporate risk, and balances demand with broader organizational need.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain current knowledge of laws, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to corporate purchasing practices.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, develop a multi year clinical technology strategy, in conjunction with clinical and nonclinical leaders, and that aligns with organizational priorities. The strategy must include centralized purchasing/procurement of materials, equipment, machinery, and services required for operations, projects, and capital investments.
Responsible for the implementation of all Equipment projects from needs identification through to commissioning and on-going maintenance.
Manage and oversee all aspects of large-scale equipment installation projects including managing internal and external stakeholders, shop drawing reviews, scope of work development, project schedule development, budget management, reporting, commissioning, training, and close-out documentation.
Work collaboratively with the Digital Health portfolio to ensure all required integrations are planned and implemented to support equipment use.
Provide executive leadership with strategic and tactical advice, as well as risks and opportunities related to emerging healthcare technologies and long-term organizational planning.
Provide advice to management at all levels by using knowledge of equipment market and procurement.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, supervise or manage complex negotiations to settle commercial disputes and claims with suppliers by establishing goals and approving commercial settlements.
Manage the Philips MESP contract ($300M+ over 14-year contract life) and provide support to Philips and the Mackenzie Clinical team in the administration of the MESP contracted services.
Provide direct leadership to Biomedical Engineering and Central Equipment staff and services across a multi site hospital system.
Establish policies and procedures supporting safe equipment use and maintenance.
Lead service contract procurement and negotiations.
Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
Develop performance KPI for adequate service and support of medical equipment.
Work with multiple equipment vendors to coordinate design and construction activities, monitor performance and intervene to rectify issues.
Ensure the development and maintenance of work systems, goals and objectives, management systems, teamwork, and resource management for departments within the area of accountability.
Create and maintain asset management and tracking workflows and processes.
Create and maintain a space management program.
Space management includes oversight and recommendations to resolve all space requests. Working collaboratively with Redevelopment, Facilities, Clinical, Clinical Support Teams to ensure space allocations are prioritized and allocated based on hospital priorities.
Act as Chair of the Change Request Group (SAFES) to ensure alignment with corporate vision and mission.
Manage the intake, review, and implementation of all changes related to Space, Aesthetics, Furniture, Equipment, and Signage.
Provide leadership, support, and direction to program staff on issues related to performance, corporate direction, service delivery, staff development, Human Resources Management (HRM), realignment, and change management strategies.
Direct the process of establishing, implementing, and reporting on appropriate quality and productivity indicator measurement tools, based on provincial benchmarks, best practice standards, and legislative requirements.
Co-develop annual budgets and operating plans that align with the hospital’s programs and directives, and ensure the program stays within budget.
Ensure all assigned employees comply with hospital, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
Build external and internal business relationships to gather information, identify market and industry trends, build partnership and alliances to support and facilitate the hospital’s objectives and plans.
Management of Regulatory Requirements as applicable to equipment installations ensuring all documentation is submitted and approved by appropriate regulatory bodies to support the installation and use of medical equipment (e.g. HARP, CNSC).
Ensure effective procurement activities that meet the requirements and needs of the hospital’s internal stakeholders.
Ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors; investigate, report, debrief and take or direct corrective action as appropriate on incidents.
Manage human resources which include recruitment, selection and training.
Teach, coach and lead staff in the development and monitoring of quality indicators and improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/organizations/community groups to achieve program objectives, integrate, and link services and foster partnerships across the continuum of service delivery.
Participate in education and training specific to current, relevant federal and provincial health and safety legislation, standards, and guidelines.

What must you have?

Minimum of a Master’s Degree or Master’s ready in Business, Economics, or in a related field, from an accredited university.
Minimum of 5-10 years experience working in equipment planning and procurement within a health care environment.
Minimum of five (5) years’ working in a senior leadership role, preferably in a health care environment.
Biomedical service leadership experience is required or similar experience that is deemed equivalent.
Training or recent experience with drafting requests for proposals and vendor agreements is required.

What else do you bring?

Strong knowledge of hospital operations.
Demonstrated experience in negotiating and managing large, complex contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of the appropriate tools for grading, analyzing, and assessing materials, equipment, supplies, services, and other commodities.
Demonstrated knowledge of Supply Chain Management (SCM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) software.
Demonstrated excellent critical and logical thinking, analysis, and reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
Demonstrated project management, change management, and analytical thinking skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams toward a vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness and effectiveness.
Demonstrated strategic business sense with financial management and budget development skills.
Demonstrated understanding of interrelationships between clinical and support programs.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex systems and human resources at the executive level.
Demonstrated leadership skills with ability to foster relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to coach, advise and teach others using the principles of adult learning.
Demonstrated training, experience, or utilization of lean methodology for process improvement.
Demonstrated ability to independently identify issues, plan improvements, measure success and continue improvement.
Proven attendance record.
Demonstrates understanding and complies with patient and staff safety policies and procedures that foster a safe and inclusive environment for all.
Ability to perform the essential duties of the job.
Effectively uses empathy in interactions with others.
Demonstrates behaviours consistent with Mackenzie Health’s Commitment to Caring.
Models behaviour that is aligned with the values of Mackenzie Health – Excellence, Leadership and Empathy.
Commitment to providing an exceptional experience for staff and clients within a challenging and exciting health care environment.

Preferably, Your Profile Also Includes

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Join RBC's US CIO Technology Strategy and Architecture team as Director, Enterprise Integration Services for the OneRBC: CNB Integration program—a transformational, multi-year initiative that will reshape how RBC operates post-acquisition. In this strategic role, you'll architect and drive the technology integration of City National Bank into RBC's operating model, designing solutions that enable seamless cross-entity operations while establishing repeatable playbooks for future M&A activities.

This is a career-defining opportunity where you'll partner with RBC and CNB enterprise leadership to synthesize complex requirements into cohesive technology strategies spanning identity & access management, cloud infrastructure, network architecture, security posture alignment, and modern workplace modernization. You'll own the validation and de-risking of integration decisions through proof-of-concept initiatives, ensuring solutions deliver tangible business outcomes while maintaining enterprise standards and regulatory compliance.

Beyond CNB, you'll build RBC's M&A integration capability—establishing integration playbooks, standards, and governance models that position RBC to confidently and efficiently integrate future acquisitions. If you're a strategic thinker with deep Microsoft and infrastructure expertise, comfort with constructive challenge, and passion for building organization-scale solutions, this role offers the scope and impact to make a lasting difference at an enterprise scale.

What will you do?

Strategic Integration Design & Delivery

Develop end-to-end integration plans and solutions: Define and evolve technology integration for CNB across identity, cloud, network, security, and workplace domains.
Synthesize requirements into phased roadmaps: Translate competing business/technical needs into actionable plans, balancing trade-offs (e.g., security vs. usability).
Drive alignment with RBC standards: Partner with enterprise teams to ensure CNB solutions adhere to RBC frameworks while fostering innovation.

Stakeholder Leadership & Alignment

Act as technical liaison: Bridge CNB leadership, RBC CIO, and enterprise teams to maintain alignment on priorities.
Communicate complex decisions to executives: Present integration trade-offs and business cases in clear, non-technical terms.
Facilitate cross-functional consensus: Lead design reviews and build trust to resolve conflicts among infrastructure, security, and operations teams.

Solution Validation & De-Risking

Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives: Validate integration assumptions (e.g., identity federation, network testing) before scaling.
Define success criteria and baselines: Establish metrics to ensure solution efficacy.
Align with modern SDLC practices: Collaborate with development teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native patterns.

M&A Integration Capability Building

Codify playbooks and reference architectures: Document CNB integration patterns for reuse in future acquisitions.
Establish governance models: Create standards for technology discovery, risk mitigation, and deployment across M&A scenarios.
Build and mentor integration talent: Develop RBC’s M&A capability by identifying and grooming future leaders.

Operational Readiness & Governance

Ensure sustainable operations: Partner with support teams to define runbooks, escalation processes, and continuous improvement.
Maintain regulatory compliance: Align solutions with financial services regulations and audit standards (e.g., cross-border requirements).
Monitor and optimize post-deployment: Drive enhancements using user feedback, metrics, and lessons learned.

What do you need to succeed?

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
10–12+ years in technology integration, infrastructure, or security leadership roles.
5+ years in architect/senior technical leadership roles, leading complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts.
Deep Microsoft expertise: Azure, Entra ID/Azure AD, Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams), hybrid identity, and federated access.
Broad infrastructure & security experience: Network architecture, firewall design, cloud infrastructure, IAM, zero-trust principles, and compliance frameworks.
Financial services regulatory knowledge: Understanding of Canadian/US banking compliance and operational models.
SDLC fluency: Modern software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization.
Strategic communication: Ability to translate technical concepts for C-suite audiences and influence senior leadership.

Nice to have:

Familiarity with RBC’s technology landscape, architecture frameworks, and governance models.
Prior involvement in technology integration during mergers/acquisitions.
Multi-tenant architecture: Experience designing solutions for complex, federated organizational structures.
Proven ability to operate effectively in large, complex, matrix-structured environments.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
